# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-SBC-001`
**Title:** In-Line CD-SEM Critical Dimension & Overlay Metrology of Shared Bitline Contacts  
**Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Layout Hierarchy:** 8F² Cell Architecture | Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB) | Shared Bitline Contact (BLC)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Metrology Tool Qualification & In-Line Execution)

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the high-throughput, non-destructive in-line CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope) metrology routine to inspect post-etch shared bitline contact (BLC) vias across the active diffusion regions of adjacent 8F² 1T1C DRAM cell pairs. It governs dimensional fidelity (contact diameter/CD along X/Y axes) and litho-etch overlay relative to active area (diffusion) and wordline (poly gate) stacks.

---

### 2. Metrology Workflow & Execution Steps

```
+------------------------------------+
| 1. Wafer Loading & Vacuum Pumpdown |
+------------------------------------+
                  |
                  v
+------------------------------------+
| 2. Beam Alignment & Low-Landing E  |
+------------------------------------+
                  |
                  v
+------------------------------------+
| 3. Automated Die Stepping (13 Sites)|
+------------------------------------+
                  |
                  v
+------------------------------------+
| 4. Secondary Electron Edge Trace   |
+------------------------------------+
                  |
                  v
+------------------------------------+
| 5. CD & Overlay Offset Extraction  |
+------------------------------------+
```

1. **Wafer Loading & Recipe Selection:**
   - Load production or qualification lot wafers onto the automated CD-SEM cassette load port.
   - Initiate high-vacuum chamber pumpdown until base vacuum pressure reaches $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ Pa}$.
   - Select the verified recipe: `REC_180NM_8F2_BLC_POST_ETCH`.

2. **Electron Beam Tuning & Landing Energy Setup:**
   - Set acceleration voltage ($V_{\text{acc}}$) to $500\text{ V} - 800\text{ V}$ with beam current $I_{\text{beam}} \le 10\text{ pA}$ to eliminate dielectric charging on ILD oxide layers.
   - Perform automated stigmator centering, beam focus, and dynamic tilt correction over global alignment fiducials.

3. **Multi-Die Sampling & Auto-Navigation:**
   - Navigate along a 13-point radial map (Center, Mid-radius, Edge-die exclusion $\ge 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Use high-precision pattern recognition (normalized cross-correlation template matching) to center the field of view (FOV) precisely on the shared bitline contact node between the two adjacent access transistors (nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, diffusion width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

4. **Secondary Electron Profile Acquisition:**
   - Scan a calibrated $1.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ area covering the shared BLC opening and surrounding active area edges.
   - Utilize secondary electron (SE) threshold edge-detection (50% peak-to-baseline derivative method) to trace inner contact hole contours along both X (parallel to wordline) and Y (parallel to bitline) directions.

5. **CD & Overlay Extraction & Disposition:**
   - Record bottom and top CD values of the shared contact hole.
   - Measure center-of-mass overlay shift $(\Delta X, \Delta Y)$ between the BLC center and the underlying active diffusion landing pad ($W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - If measurement exceeds the process limits, automatically flag lot for rework/strip prior to tungsten (W-plug) metallization.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Tolerance / Spec Limit | Measurement Method / Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Shared BLC Critical Dimension (CD)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 12\text{ nm}$ ($3\sigma \le 6.0\text{ nm}$) | In-line CD-SEM secondary electron trace ($50\%$ threshold), in nanometers ($\text{nm}$) |
| **BLC-to-Diffusion Overlay Error ($\mathbf{|\Delta X|}, \mathbf{|\Delta Y|}$)** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ | $\le 25\text{ nm}$ ($3\sigma$) | Center-of-geometry offset between contact hole and active diffusion ($W = 220\text{ nm}$), in nanometers ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Contact Hole Circularity / Ellipticity ($CD_x / CD_y$)** | $1.00$ | $0.92 \text{ to } 1.08$ | Ratio of major to minor orthogonal diameters (dimensionless) |
| **CD-SEM Inspection Vacuum Pressure** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ Pa}$ | Max allowable $8.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ Pa}$ | Cold cathode ion gauge reading inside analysis chamber, in Pascals ($\text{Pa}$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active diffusion width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Memory cell layout: 8F² folded bitline with bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells and connected via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C architecture requiring tight pitch control with bitline and wordline pitch approximately $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Folded-bitline architecture constraints and differential sense development ($C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) requiring strict shared contact integrity to prevent imbalance between complementary bitlines.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Kelvin Bridge & Cross-Bridge Kelvin Resistor (CBKR) Contact Resistance Probing

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-CBKR-001`  
**Process Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 / µm)  
**Cell Architecture:** 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) — Access Transistor Diffusion & Shared Bitline Contact (W-Plug / Silicide Interface)  
**Metrology Scope:** In-Line Electrical Test (E-Test) & Physical Contact Resistance ($R_c$) Extraction  

---

### 1. Equipment & Test Structure Setup

1. **Automated Wafer Prober & Parameter Analyzer**:
   - Automated parametric probe station (e.g., Keysight 4070/4080 or Keithley S530) configured with a 4-point probe card and low-noise triaxial Kelvin connections ($I_{force}$, $V_{sense}$).
   - Set thermal chuck temperature to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to match thermal retention qualification conditions.
2. **CBKR Test Structure Geometry**:
   - Device Under Test (DUT): Dedicated Cross-Bridge Kelvin Resistor (CBKR) test vehicle located on the scribe line/kerf or test array, replicating the access transistor active diffusion width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, and shared bitline tungsten contact plug (W-plug) nominal contact size $d = 180\text{ nm}$ to $220\text{ nm}$.
   - Bottom layer: Active $N^+$ diffusion tap ($W_D = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Interconnect layer: Tungsten plug (W-plug) into Bitline metal ($M_1$ / tungsten damascene).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
       [Force Current I+] (Pad 1: Diffusion Tap)
             │
             ▼
  ┌───────────────────────┐
  │   N+ Diffusion Line   │
  └───┬───────────────┬───┘
      │  ┌─────────┐  │
      └──┤ Contact ├──┘  <─────── [Sense Voltage V+] (Pad 3: Bitline Tap)
         │ W-Plug  │
      ┌──┴─────────┴──┐
      │ Bitline Metal │
  ┌───┴───────────────┴───┐
  │   Interconnect M1     │
  └───────────────────────┘
             │
             ▼
       [Force Return I-] (Pad 2: Diffusion Return)
       
  [Sense Reference V-] (Pad 4: Remote Ground/Substrate Reference)
```

1. **Wafer Alignment & Contact Touchdown**:
   - Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck; perform optical pre-alignment and pattern recognition on the primary alignment fiducials.
   - Execute probe tip touchdown onto aluminum/copper test pads with an overdrive of $35\text{ µm} \pm 5\text{ µm}$ to ensure clean contact scrub through surface native oxide without damaging pad metal.
2. **Four-Terminal I-V Sweep**:
   - Connect Force High ($I^+$) to Pad 1 (Diffusion lead) and Force Low ($I^-$) to Pad 2 (Opposite diffusion terminal).
   - Connect Sense High ($V^+$) to Pad 3 (Bitline metal lead directly over contact) and Sense Low ($V^-$) to Pad 4 (Reference zero-current tap).
   - Sweep forced DC current $I_{force}$ from $-1.0\text{ mA}$ to $+1.0\text{ mA}$ in linear steps of $50\text{ µA}$, recording voltage drop $V_{sense}$.
3. **Contact Resistance ($R_c$) Extraction**:
   - Extract raw Kelvin resistance:
     $$R_K = \frac{dV_{sense}}{dI_{force}}$$
   - Correct for 2D current crowding and diffusion sheet resistance ($R_s$) using the standard CBKR finite-element correction factor:
     $$R_c = R_K - \frac{R_s \cdot \delta^2}{3 W_D^2}$$
     where $W_D = 220\text{ nm}$ is active diffusion width and $\delta$ is contact misalignment offset extracted via in-line SEM.
4. **Specific Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$) Calculation**:
   - Calculate specific contact resistivity using contact area $A_c$ (nominal $180\text{ nm} \times 180\text{ nm} = 3.24 \times 10^{-10}\text{ cm}^2$):
     $$\rho_c = R_c \times A_c \quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$
5. **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage Check**:
   - Apply nominal precharge reverse bias $V_{BL} = V_{DD}/2$ across the diffusion junction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and measure parasitic leakage to substrate.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Acceptance Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chuck Thermal Stability** | $85.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated RTD sensor on wafer chuck |
| **Probe Overdrive Travel** | $35$ | $\pm 5$ | $\text{µm}$ | Z-stepper displacement sensor |
| **Bitline Contact Resistance ($R_c$)** | $\le 45$ | Max $< 60$ | $\Omega/\text{contact}$ | 4-point Kelvin I-V parametric extraction |
| **Specific Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$)** | $\le 1.5 \times 10^{-8}$ | $\pm 0.3 \times 10^{-8}$ | $\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$ | Area-normalized Kelvin extraction ($A_c = 180 \times 180\text{ nm}^2$) |
| **Diffusion Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | Max $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA}/\text{cell}$ | Sub-picoamp electrometer at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $V_{bias} = V_{DD}/2$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

1. **Access Transistor Dimensions & Cell Geometry**:
   - Access transistor active channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with shared bitline contact between adjacent memory cells in an $8F^2$ footprint.  
   *(Source: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`)*
2. **Capacitance & Interconnect Constraints**:
   - Bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) connected to stacked capacitor nodes requiring noise immunity with target cell capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ and nominal bitline capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.  
   *(Sources: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`; `Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`)*
3. **Leakage & Thermal Operating Targets**:
   - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target must remain $< 1\text{ fA}/\text{cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain cell retention interval $> 64\text{ ms}$.  
   *(Sources: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`; `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`)*
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) **Document ID:** `SOP-QA-FIB-180NM-001` **Title:** Cross-Sectional FIB-SEM Void Inspection & Acceptance Review **Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | 1T1C Folded Bitline Cell Topology ($8F^2$) | Quality Assurance & Metrology Protocol **Action Type:** Buy (Procured Foundry / OSAT Metrology & Failure Analysis Acceptance Verification) --- ## 1. Process Flow Diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Sample Ingestion & Site Localization
Shared Bitline Contact & W-Plug"] --> B["In-Situ Protective Cap Deposition
Pt / C capping in FIB chamber"] B --> C["Focused Ion Beam Cross-Sectioning
Ga+ ion milling & low-current Polish"] C --> D["High-Resolution In-Lens In-Line SEM Inspection
Void measurement & aspect-ratio review"] D --> E["Quality Acceptance Review & Sign-Off
Check against critical physical thresholds"] ``` --- ## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure ### Step 1: Specimen Preparation & Fiducial Alignment 1. Load the patterned wafer / die sample containing the $8F^2$ 1T1C access transistor diffusion and shared bitline contacts into the Dual-Beam FIB-SEM chamber. 2. Evacuate chamber to high vacuum ($< 5 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$). 3. Align to target coordinates targeting the shared bitline contact (connecting adjacent access transistors with gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active diffusion width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact path to the stacked capacitor. ### Step 2: Protective Strapping Layer Deposition 1. Gas Injection System (GIS) deposition of an electron-beam induced Carbon/Platinum (EBIC/EBIP) protective seed layer ($100\text{ nm}$) over the target contact ROI. 2. Follow with an ion-beam induced Platinum (IBIP) protective strap ($1.0 - 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$) to eliminate curtaining and ion milling damage on the oxide/dielectric interfaces. ### Step 3: Dual-Beam Ion Cross-Sectioning & Fine Polish 1. Perform trench rough-milling using a focused $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam at $30\text{ kV}$, $3\text{ nA}$ down to the Si substrate interface. 2. Switch to low-energy/low-current ion milling ($30\text{ kV} \rightarrow 5\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ pA} - 100\text{ pA}$) for fine surface polishing across the center line of the shared bitline contact and storage contact tungsten plugs. ### Step 4: In-Lens High-Resolution SEM Inspection 1. Position electron beam perpendicular/tilted ($52^\circ$ eucentric tilt) toward the cross-section face. 2. Acquire secondary electron (SE) and in-lens backscattered electron (BSE) micrographs at an accelerating voltage of $1.5\text{ kV} - 3.0\text{ kV}$ and working distance $\le 4\text{ mm}$. 3. Inspect for key anomalies: - Seam voids or keyhole voids within the core of the shared bitline W-plug. - Micro-voiding or delamination at the contact barrier/silicide interface with access transistor diffusion. - Contact bottom punch-through or bridging relative to the $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ bitline and wordline pitch. ### Step 5: Data Archival & Acceptance Disposition 1. Quantify void area ratio ($A_{\text{void}} / A_{\text{plug}}$) and measure physical critical dimensions against CD-SEM calibration standards. 2. Log defect inspection report into the QA Metrology Portal and disposition wafer lots (Pass / Review / Scrap). --- ## 3. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DRAM-180NM-014: Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization (8F² 1T1C DRAM Cell)

---

### 1. Process Flow & Verification Architecture

```text

┌───────────────────────┐  │ ┌───────────────────────┐
│  Spacing & Enclosure  │  │ │   LVS & Extraction    │
│        Tuning         ├──╯ │       Sign-Off        │
└───────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Active Diffusion & Access Gate Width/Length Verification**:
   - Run design rule check on the access NMOS active region and polysilicon gate layer.
   - Enforce gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active transistor channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure gate oxide physical thickness adheres to the $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation dielectric specification.

2. **Shared Bitline Contact & Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Spacing**:
   - Verify layout sharing of the bitline contact drain node between adjacent access transistors in the folded bitline architecture.
   - Constrain contact-to-gate edge spacing and enclosure rules around the tungsten contact plug (W-plug) to prevent bridging and ensure isolation under alignment tolerances.

3. **Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Stacked Node Isolation Check**:
   - Inspect the crown/cylinder stacked capacitor bottom-plate layout erected over the access transistor drain contact.
   - Check clear clearance between adjacent storage node plates across unit cells to eliminate shorts and inter-cell leakage while preserving node surface area for the target equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

4. **Array Grid Pitch & 8F² Boundary Rule Optimization**:
   - Check pitch constraints on Wordline (WL) and Bitline (BL): optimize routing pitches within $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - Constrain unit cell layout boundary footprint to an exact $8F^2$ geometry ($\text{Area} = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Adjust spacing and metal enclosure rules to maintain bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) within $150\text{ to }250\text{ fF}$ for array blocks of 256/512 cells per bitline.

---

```text
               │████                                   │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0        95       190       285     380 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Unit Cell Layout Area ($8F^2$)** | $0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC cell bounding-box area calculation ($F = 180\text{ nm}$) |
| **Wordline / Bitline Routing Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Periodic pitch spacing measurement DRC rule |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30$ (Nominal: $28$) | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1 \text{ to } 9:1$ (Max $\le 10:1$) | ratio | Extracted array net capacitance ratio evaluation |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE corner simulation on extracted layout |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources

- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Access channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact, stacked capacitor over bitline via W-plug, $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source 2**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets* (Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint area $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$, $C_s \ge 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, $C_b = 150\text{ to }250\text{ fF}$, $C_b/C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$, degradation threshold at $10:1$).
- **Source 3**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$, capacitor EOT $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch range $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$, data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup

### Document Metadata
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Cell Topology**: 1T1C Folded Bitline Layout ($8F^2$)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Target Process Level**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Front-End & Middle-of-Line (FEOL / MOL)

---

### Process Workflow Diagram
```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: Ingest Technology Layers &  │
│        Define Array Boundaries       │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Code 1T1C Access Transistor │
│      Channel Width & Length Rules    │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: Implement Array Pitch Rules  │
│    (Wordline & Bitline Constraints)  │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 4: Configure Capacitor Over     │
│   Bitline (COB) & Shared BL Contacts │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 5: Execute DRC Engine & Export  │
│       Error Mask Geometry Database   │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Layer Definition & Boundary Ingestion**:
   - Declare and map GDSII/OASIS physical mask layers for Active Diffusion (OD), Poly Gate/Wordline (PO), Bitline Contact (BC), Bitline (M1/BL), Storage Node Contact / Tungsten Plug (SNC/W-Plug), and Capacitor Top/Bottom Electrodes.
   - Tag the DRAM core array boundary region to differentiate tight array design rules from loose peripheral logic rules.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension Rule Coding**:
   - Establish minimum channel length rule: `L_gate = 180 nm` for the 1T1C NMOS access transistor.
   - Establish channel active width rule: `W_active = 220 nm`.
   - Constrain poly-to-poly clearance outside the channel to prevent bridged adjacent gates.

3. **Bitline and Wordline Pitch Optimization**:
   - Parameterize array pitch constraints for both horizontal Wordline (WL) and vertical Bitline (BL).
   - Enforce pitch verification within the exact target envelope: minimum pitch `360 nm` to maximum pitch `400 nm`.
   - Incorporate spacing checks between parallel bitlines to limit bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$) below the signal degradation threshold ($C_{BL} \le 250\text{ fF}$).

4. **COB (Capacitor Over Bitline) & Contact Layout DRC Rules**:
   - Enforce shared bitline contact geometry: verify single bitline contact shared symmetrically between two adjacent memory cells along the active diffusion run.
   - Set enclosure and spacing constraints for the tungsten plug (W-plug) connecting the access transistor drain to the bottom electrode of the crown/cylinder stacked capacitor.
   - Define stacked capacitor top-to-bottom overlap and outer enclosure rules to preserve dielectric area for $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 28\text{ fF}$ storage capability.

5. **DRC Deck Compilation & Verification Run**:
   - Compile the rule deck into the target EDA DRC engine (e.g., KLayout DRC / Magic / open-source toolchain).
   - Execute verification on full $8F^2$ matrix test patterns; verify zero false-positives at dense cell borders and shared contact junctions.

---

### Physical Rule Targets & Dimensions

```text
Array Pitch (Min)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │

                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
Access Length (L)┤█████████████████                    │
                 │█████████████████                    │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       100      200      300     400 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Bound | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | Exact Nominal (DRC Min) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Width Check on Active/Gate overlap |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | Exact Nominal (DRC Min) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Length Check on Active along Gate |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch Envelope** | `360` to `400` | $[360, 400]$ Allowed Range | $\text{nm}$ | 2D Pitch & Centerline Spacing Check |

---

### Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry parameters ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells, and stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Array bitline and wordline pitch window ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) and $8F^2$ 1T1C stacked capacitor layout architecture.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Cell and bitline capacitive parameters ($C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) justifying pitch spacing constraints to prevent cross-coupling.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Foundation DRC Deck Adaptation for Tight-Pitch Memory Array Rules
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-DRC-180NM-001`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m node)  
**Cell Topology:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor (Capacitor Over Bitline - COB)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP specifies the adaptation and customization of standard baseline 180nm foundry Design Rule Checking (DRC) decks (e.g., standard logic design rule sets) to accommodate tight-pitch DRAM memory core array rules. Baseline logic decks enforce relaxed spacing rules that inhibit the high-density footprint required by an $8F^2$ folded bitline DRAM array ($A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$). This procedure establishes array-specific rule waivers, conditional array marker layers, and exact geometric constraints for critical active area, wordline (gate), bitline, and tungsten contact/plug layers.

---

### 2. Workflow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: Array Boundary Marker Layer Definition & Boolean Conditioning             |
|   - Add `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER` to mask baseline logic pitch & spacing checks         |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: Active Area (OD/DIFF) & Access Transistor Rule Parameterization           |
|   - Set Access Transistor L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm                                  |
|   - Enforce shared bitline contact landing area geometries                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: Wordline (Poly/Gate) & Bitline (M1/W-Line) Tight-Pitch Adaptation         |
|   - Constrain Wordline (WL) pitch to 360 nm - 400 nm (Line = 180 nm, Space = 180 nm) |
|   - Constrain Bitline (BL) pitch to 360 nm - 400 nm (Line = 180 nm, Space = 180 nm) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 4: Storage Node & Shared Contact Plug Enclosure / Spacing Verification       |
|   - Shared Bitline Tungsten (W) Contact plug pitch & enclosure                    |
|   - Storage Node Contact (SNC) plug clearance to Wordline / Bitline               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 5: Regression Run, Violation Triage & Cell Footprint Sign-Off                |
|   - Ensure zero false violations inside array; confirm Area = 0.259 um^2 per cell |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Array Boundary Marker Layer Definition & Boolean Conditioning
1. Define a reserved layer: `LAYER DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER = <GDS_LAYER_NUMBER>`.
2. Wrap baseline foundry rules (e.g., standard logic poly-to-poly spacing $> 240\,\text{nm}$) with Boolean exclusion clauses:
   $$\text{CORE\_POLY} = \text{POLY} \ \mathbf{NOT}\ \text{DRAM\_ARRAY\_MARKER}$$
   $$\text{ARRAY\_POLY} = \text{POLY} \ \mathbf{AND}\ \text{DRAM\_ARRAY\_MARKER}$$
3. Direct all customized memory rules to evaluate strictly within `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER`.

#### Step 2: Access Transistor & Active Area (OD) Parameterization
1. Implement dimension verification for unit access NMOS transistors:
   - Channel Length: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$
   - Channel Width: $W = 220\,\text{nm}$
2. Allow merged active diffusion between pairs of adjacent memory cells to support shared bitline contacts.
3. Verify gate dielectric oxide thickness parameter tagging ($t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\,\text{nm}$).

#### Step 3: Wordline & Bitline Pitch/Spacing Rule Insertion
1. **Wordline Rule Set (`WL_RULE`):**
   - Minimum gate poly critical dimension (Line width): $180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Minimum poly-to-poly space in array: $180\,\text{nm}$ to $220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Target array Wordline pitch constraint: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.
2. **Bitline Rule Set (`BL_RULE`):**
   - Minimum bitline metal/plug width: $180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Minimum bitline-to-bitline space in array: $180\,\text{nm}$ to $220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Target array Bitline pitch constraint: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.

#### Step 4: Contact & Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Rule Adaptation
1. Parameterize contact rules for shared bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C cells.
2. Define storage node contact (SNC) tungsten plug (W-plug) vertical clearance and overlay enclosure targeting crown-type or cylinder-type stacked capacitor interfaces over bitline (COB).

#### Step 5: Full Array DRC Execution & Verification
1. Run physical verification across the full memory block (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
2. Confirm zero DRC syntax errors, zero spacing violations across array boundaries, and absence of false positive logic-rule violations inside `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER`.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Minimum | Nominal / Target | Maximum | Units | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Footprint Area ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$) | — | `0.259` | `0.260` | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC Automated Area Extraction / GDS polygon query |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Gate Physical Dimensions ($L \times W$) | `180 × 220` | `180 × 220` | `180 × 220` | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Width & Length Rule Assertions |
| **AC-03** | Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Array Pitch | `360` | `380` | `400` | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Pitch/Spacing DRC Measurement |
| **AC-04** | Target Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget Verification | `25` | `28` | `30` | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) & capacitance rule checker |
| **AC-05** | Parasitic Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | `5.0 : 1` | `7.0 : 1` | `9.0 : 1` | ratio | Array RC Extraction (256/512 cells/BL block) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  * Defined $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$ ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$).
  * Defined $C_s$ budget: $\ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\,\text{fF}$).
  * Defined bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b = 150\,\text{fF}$ to $250\,\text{fF}$ per $256/512$-cell block) and constraint ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (not exceeding $10:1$).
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Unit access transistor channel dimensions: Length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, Width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  * Shared bitline contact layout between two adjacent memory cells.
  * Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) utilizing tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  * Wordline and bitline tight pitch requirement: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.
  * Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

```text
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: Overlay 8F2   │
│       DRAM Array       │
│       Topologies       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Step 4: Compute     │
│  Geometric Deviations  │
│    & Sizing Deltas     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Step 5: Synthesize   │
│  Memory Array Waiver   │
│    & Customized DRC    │
│         Rules          │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Ingest Standard Foundation Logic DRC Decks**:
   - Parse native foundry 180nm DRC runsets (standard logic rules for active area `DIFF`, polysilicon gate `POLY`, contact `CONT`, and metal 1 `M1`).
   - Extract baseline logic constraints: minimum gate channel length ($L_{\text{logic, min}}$), minimum active width ($W_{\text{logic, min}}$), standard contact-to-gate spacing, and standard interconnect metal pitch.

2. **Define 8F² Array Design Rules & Geometry Boundaries**:
   - Establish the target 8F² unit memory cell layout topology ($F = 180\text{ nm}$):
     - Access transistor gate channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Access transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Gate oxide thickness envelope: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation equivalent.
   - Configure shared bitline contact landing topology between two adjacent memory cells.

3. **Map Tight-Pitch Array Envelopes**:
   - Set dense periodic array pitch for Bitline (BL) and Wordline (WL) within the $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch window ($2F$ limit).
   - Ingest capacitor plug/drain landing area parameters designed for a stacked capacitor (Crown or Cylinder MIM/polysilicon structure contacting via tungsten plug).

4. **Perform Automated Rule Deviation & Delta Analysis**:
   - Run layout geometric comparison scripts to flag violations where array features deviate below standard logic design rules:
     - Compare standard logic metal/polysilicon pitch against array target ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
     - Check shared bitline contact enclosure and gate-to-contact spacing against standard peripheral logic DRC checks.
     - Isolate stacked capacitor tungsten contact (W-plug) landing pads from standard logic BEOL metallization checks.

5. **Generate Array-Specific DRC Deck Modification Layers**:
   - Create a dedicated array boundary marker layer (e.g., `MEM_ARRAY_PRBOUNDARY` / `DRAM_CORE_MARKER`).
   - Condition the DRC deck: inside the array marker, branch to adapted memory design rules ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $\text{pitch} = 360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$); retain standard logic spacing in the periphery and sense amplifier boundaries.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ deviation on drawn layout | Automated DRC deck geometric extraction |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ deviation on drawn layout | Automated DRC deck geometric extraction |
| **Bitline & Wordline Array Pitch** | $360\text{ nm} \text{ to } 400\text{ nm}$ | Uniform bounded range ($[360, 400]\text{ nm}$) | Critical Dimension (CD) pitch check across array |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Profile** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ physical target equivalent | Process assumption / deck model verification |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *8F² and 6F² unit cell geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - *Contact topology*: Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells; stacked capacitor erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Array pitch*: Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - *Gate dielectric*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

## SOP-DRC-180-002: Tight-Pitch Array DRC Deck Rule Coding & Boundary Boolean Layer Customization

```text

└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tight-Pitch Array    │
│  Spacing Rule Coding   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Periphery Standard   │
│     DRC Isolation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  DRC Deck Compilation  │
│   & Verification Run   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Error Filtering &    │
│     Wafer Geometry     │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the exact coding methodology for customizing design rule checking (DRC) decks to support tight-pitch $8F^2$ memory array blocks alongside standard CMOS periphery logic on a 180nm open-source DRAM chip process.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layer Map Declaration & Array Boundary Extraction**:
   - Define dedicated marker layers in the layout environment and deck compiler: `ARRAY_BOUND` (Layer 99/0) to delineate repetitive 1T1C core cell matrices from periphery logic.
   - Synthesize Boolean operations in the DRC deck:
     ```text
     ARRAY_ZONE     = COPY ARRAY_BOUND
     PERI_ZONE      = NOT ALL_CHIP ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_DIFF     = DIFF AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_DIFF      = DIFF NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_POLY     = POLY AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_POLY      = POLY NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_CONT     = CONT AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_CONT      = CONT NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ```

2. **Tight-Pitch Memory Array Spacing Rule Coding**:
   - Code tighter lithography-optimized pitch and spacing rules within `ARRAY_ZONE`:
     - Access Transistor channel dimension constraints: enforce gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (`ARRAY_POLY` width across `ARRAY_DIFF`) and active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ (`ARRAY_DIFF` width under gate).
     - Bitline and Wordline pitch validation: enforce minimum pitch across parallel wordline and bitline runs to $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
     - Shared Bitline contact check: verify enclosure and contact pitch of shared tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads between adjacent 1T1C pairs within `ARRAY_ZONE`.

3. **Periphery Standard DRC Rules Isolation**:
   - Preserve default 180nm standard logic rules within `PERI_ZONE` (e.g., standard logic poly-to-poly spacing, standard active diffusion spacing, and periphery I/O contact enclosure rules) to prevent false DRC violations in the relaxed periphery circuitry.

4. **Array-to-Periphery Boundary Interface Rule Definition**:
   - Derive interface transition zone: `BOUNDARY_TRANSITION = SIZE ARRAY_ZONE BY 0.50 um AND PERI_ZONE`.
   - Implement boundary-crossing rules preventing abrupt discontinuation of wordlines, dummy poly line terminations, and gate oxide transition spacings between cell array thin gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) and thick peripheral I/O gate oxides.

5. **DRC Deck Compilation, Execution, and Verification**:
   - Compile the adapted deck using the physical verification tool engine (e.g., KLayout DRC / Magic / Calibre).
   - Execute batch verification over full-chip hierarchical GDSII/OASIS databases.
   - Inspect output error classes; verify zero false DRC flags along the `ARRAY_ZONE` boundary perimeter.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Width Check (`ARRAY_POLY` over `ARRAY_DIFF`) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Width Check (`ARRAY_DIFF` under `ARRAY_POLY`) |
| **Bitline & Wordline Array Pitch** | $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | Minimum $\ge 360\text{ nm}$, Maximum $\le 400\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Pitch/Spacing Rule Engine |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Verification** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | Nominal target at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Process Deck Variable |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  *(Citing access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline architecture with shared bitline contacts via W-plug).*
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  *(Citing bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, and $8F^2$ cell layout architecture).*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: DRC Deck Regression Validation & Pitch-Violation Metrology on $8F^2$ Matrix Layout
**Context Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) $\rightarrow$ 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) $\rightarrow$ DRC Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization $\rightarrow$ DRC Deck Regression Validation & Pitch-Violation Metrology on $8F^2$ Matrix Layout  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the formal regression validation procedure for customized physical verification (DRC) rule decks adapted to dense $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM array regions. The goal is to verify pitch-violation metrology algorithms, eliminate false-positive flags across sub-micron array topologies, and detect layout pitch regressions across wordline (WL), bitline (BL), and shared contact geometries.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Input Layout & Dense Array Boundary Definition       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Pitch Metrology Layer Boolean Derivations           |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Run DRC Deck Regression on 8F^2 Calibration Matrix  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Spacing Violation & Metrology Extraction Analysis    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Step 1: Input Layout & Dense Array Boundary Definition**
   - Import the calibrated $8F^2$ cell array GDSII/OASIS layout containing access transistors, bitline contact nodes, and wordlines.
   - Tag the dense memory core using the dedicated `DRAM_ARRAY_BOUND` boundary layer to instruct the DRC engine to selectively engage relaxed/adapted tight-pitch design rules rather than standard logic design rules.

2. **Step 2: Pitch Metrology Layer Boolean Derivations**
   - In the DRC deck script (e.g., KLayout `drc` or Calibre SVRF), define derived boolean layers for the access transistor active area and wordlines/bitlines.
   - Set up two-dimensional pitch-check operations across orthogonal directions:
     - Wordline pitch: Measure center-to-center distance along the bitline track.
     - Bitline pitch: Measure center-to-center distance along the wordline track.
     - Contact enclosure/spacing: Verify shared bitline contact (connecting adjacent cells) spacing to surrounding active boundaries.

3. **Step 3: Run DRC Deck Regression on $8F^2$ Calibration Matrix**
   - Execute the DRC regression suite against a synthetic defect-injection matrix containing intentional pitch offsets ($-20\text{ nm}$, nominal, $+20\text{ nm}$) and nominal design cells.
   - Confirm that standard dense features clear cleanly without reporting false positives on nominal cells, while injected violations trigger precise DRC metrology coordinate markers.

4. **Step 4: Spacing Violation & Metrology Extraction Analysis**
   - Parse the DRC results database (RDB).
   - Verify that the reported physical dimensions match target critical dimensions:
     - Access transistor channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Access transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Array pitch metrics across wordline/bitline tracks: within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure clean execution with zero false-positive error flags on nominal $8F^2$ unit cells.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metrology Item | Physical Target / Nominal Metric | Allowable Tolerance / Criteria | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | Deck flag triggered if pitch $< 360$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | Deck flag triggered if length $< 180$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | Deck flag triggered if width $< 220$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Synthetic Defect Detection Rate** | $100$ | $0$ escape violations, $0$ false-positive flags | $\%$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Confirms unit cell geometry for 180nm access transistor: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms shared bitline contact topology between two adjacent memory cells.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Establishes bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ for $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ 1T1C memory arrays.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DRC-180-042: DRAM Array Spacing Rule Encoding & Shared Contact Enclosure Verification

- **Level / Hierarchy**: [Circuit Design] > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Target Cell Architecture**: 1T1C Folded Bitline ($8F^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$, Unit Cell Area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$)

---

### 1. Process & Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     DRC Rule Deck      │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Bitline Shared     │
│   Contact Enclosure    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Array Active-to-Gate  │
│   Spacing & Overlap    │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Physical Sign-Off &   │
│      LVS Netlist       │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **DRC Array Boundary & Grid Rule Encoding**:
   - Initialize the foundry/open-source DRC rule deck for the memory array block (`ARRAY_BLOCK` layer tag).
   - Encode the feature size base parameter $F = 0.180\ \mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the nominal wordline (poly gate) and bitline metal pitch rule constraint to **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$** ($2F$ pitch regime).
   - Define the cell footprint check ensuring total unit cell area does not exceed **$0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$** for folded bitline $8F^2$ geometry.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension & Active (OD) Spacing Checks**:
   - Enforce access NMOS channel length rule: $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.180\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Enforce access NMOS channel width rule: $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.220\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Encode isolation spacing (shallow trench isolation / STI between adjacent active lines) to match cell pitch constraints ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ array pitch).

3. **Bitline Shared Contact Enclosure Verification**:
   - Locate the shared bitline contact (connecting two adjacent symmetric 1T1C access transistors to the metal bitline via tungsten plug / W-plug).
   - Verify active area diffusion enclosure around the shared contact plug. Ensure contact center-to-edge alignment provides complete contact landing without boundary bridging.
   - Enforce minimum gate-to-contact spacing (poly gate to shared bitline contact landing plug) to eliminate gate-drain shorting risks during contact etch misalignments.

4. **Storage Node Contact (Capacitor Plug) Enclosure & Spacing**:
   - Validate drain/source storage node landing pads for the stacked capacitor (COB topology) tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Verify clearance between the storage node landing plug and passing wordlines.
   - Ensure the capacitor bottom plate boundary conforms to high-$k$ crown/cylinder MIM or poly boundary clearances above the bitlines.

5. **Physical Sign-Off & Array Parasitic Rule Extraction**:
   - Execute full DRC deck check on a $256 \times 256$ or $512 \times 512$ cell array block.
   - Run parasitic extraction (PEX) rule checks to verify that bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) remains strictly between **$150\text{ fF}$ and $250\text{ fF}$** per block segment, matching the storage capacitor target ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Footprint Area ($8F^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$) | $\le 0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC Layout Geometry Check |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Dimensions ($L \times W$) | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Width/Length Assertion |
| **AC-03** | Array Wordline / Bitline Pitch | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | 2D Pitch Linearity DRC Rule |
| **AC-04** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) per Block | $150 \text{ to } 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | LVS / PEX Netlist Extraction |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Shared bitline contact between two adjacent memory cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
2. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance limit ($C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ per 256/512 cell array block).
3. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - Array bitline and wordline pitch regime ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - 1T1C stacked capacitor integration rules.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): DRAM Array Design Rule Encoding for Dense Active and Poly Spacing

**Document ID:** SOP-DRC-180NM-ARY-001  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Hierarchy Level:** Circuit Design / Layout Verification (DRAM Array 8F² Cell Topology)

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the step-by-step procedure for encoding dense active area (OD/DIFF) and polysilicon gate (WORDLINE/POLY) physical design rules into an automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) runset (e.g., KLayout `drc`, Calibre SVRF, or Magic) for 180nm 8F² folded-bitline 1T1C DRAM core memory arrays. It guarantees physical manufacturability, avoids bridging/shorting at aggressive pitches, and protects shared contact enclosures.

---

## 2. Theoretical Background & Rule Hierarchy

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["180nm 8F² Unit Cell Array Boundary (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm)"] --> B["Layer Separation & Pitch Definition"]
    B --> C["Dense Poly/Wordline Spacing Encoding (Pitch: 360 - 400 nm)"]
    B --> D["Dense Active/OD Spacing & End-to-End Gap Encoding"]
    C & D --> E["Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Enclosure Checks"]
    E --> F["DRC Runset Compilation & Zero-Violation Sign-off"]
```

In an 8F² folded-bitline layout:
- Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ µm}$), active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\text{ µm}$).
- Array wordline pitch is tight ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), requiring customized array-specific design rules distinct from standard peripheral logic design rules.
- Bitline contacts are shared between two adjacent 1T1C memory cells.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Array Region Layer Definition & Boolean Isolation
1. Define the dedicated array boundary marker layer (e.g., `ARRAY_MK`, GDS layer 99/0) to isolate dense periodic memory cells from peripheral CMOS logic.
2. Form array-specific active and poly layers using boolean intersections:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}} = \text{DIFF} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}} = \text{POLY} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$

### Step 2: Dense Polysilicon (Wordline) Spacing & Width Rule Encoding
1. **Array Poly Width (`POLY.W.1`):** Encode nominal gate channel length constraint:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{width} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})$$
2. **Array Poly-to-Poly Spacing (`POLY.S.1`):** Encode dense wordline pitch boundary rule. For pitch range $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ at $L = 180\text{ nm}$:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{space} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})\quad [\text{yielding pitch } \ge 360\text{ nm}]$$
   Set maximum allowable unrelaxed array poly pitch to $0.40\text{ µm}$ ($400\text{ nm}$).

### Step 3: Dense Active Area (OD/DIFF) Spacing & Channel Width Encoding
1. **Array Active Width (`OD.W.1`):** Encode transistor access channel width:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{width} \ge 0.22\text{ µm}\ (220\text{ nm})$$
2. **Array Active-to-Active Spacing (`OD.S.1`):** Set parallel active-track spacing:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{space} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})$$
3. **Active End-of-Line (EOL) Spacing (`OD.S.2`):** Set cut-to-cut spacing along active line ends isolating adjacent 2-cell active islands to $\ge 0.18\text{ µm}$.

### Step 4: Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Enclosure Rule Encoding
1. Define shared bitline contact layer:
   $$\text{BLC}_{\text{array}} = \text{CONT} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$
2. Encode symmetric enclosure of shared BLC by active area on both sides along the bitline axis to prevent junction leakages and unlanded contact punchthrough:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{enclosure}(\text{BLC}_{\text{array}}) \ge 0.05\text{ µm}\ (50\text{ nm})$$
3. Verify gate-to-contact isolation clearance:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{space}(\text{BLC}_{\text{array}}) \ge 0.07\text{ µm}\ (70\text{ nm})$$

### Step 5: Rule Deck Compilation & Verification Run
1. Format rules in standard deck syntax (e.g., KLayout DRC / Calibre format):
   ```ruby
   # KLayout DRC Snippet for 180nm Dense DRAM Array
   array_poly = poly.and(array_mk)
   array_od   = active.and(array_mk)
   array_blc  = contact.and(array_mk)

   array_poly.width(0.18, "@ Array Poly Gate Length < 180nm")
   array_poly.space(0.18, "@ Array Poly-to-Poly Spacing < 180nm (Pitch < 360nm)")
   array_od.width(0.22,   "@ Array Active Width < 220nm")
   array_od.space(0.18,   "@ Array Active-to-Active Spacing < 180nm")
   array_od.encloses(array_blc, 0.05, "@ Array Shared Bitline Contact Active Enclosure < 50nm")
   ```
2. Execute DRC deck on the full 8F² unit array macro block. Confirm 0 false positives across array boundaries.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layer Hierarchy & Geometric Pre-conditions Setup**

   - Ensure the wordline and bitline layout pitch constraints are defined within the range of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Shared Bitline Contact Boolean Derivation**
   - Extract the shared bitline contact landing region between adjacent pass transistors:
     $$\text{BLC\_SHARED} = \text{CONT} \cap \text{DIFF}$$
   - Derive the active boundary overhang and polysilicon gate spacing margins around `BLC_SHARED`.

3. **Rule Implementation in DRC Deck**
   - **Diffusion Enclosure Rule:** Encode the minimum diffusion boundary enclosure around `BLC_SHARED` across width and length directions to ensure reliable landing margin without punch-through or leakage.
   - **Poly Spacing Rule:** Encode the minimum clearance from `BLC_SHARED` edges to the adjacent wordline poly gate edges ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) to prevent gate dielectric breakdown and short circuits during tungsten plug (W-plug) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP).

   - Compile the rule definitions into the production DRC engine format (e.g., KLayout `drc` script or Magic tech format).

5. **Full Array Execution and Violation Reporting**
   - Execute the compiled DRC deck across the multi-cell 8F² folded bitline array core.
   - Verify that all shared bitline contacts satisfy enclosure requirements with zero residual violations.

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP defines the engineering run for automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) verification and subsequent critical dimension / overlay metrology sign-off for the shared bitline contact in an $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM cell array at the 180 nm node. The primary objective is to verify design rule compliance for access transistor geometries, bitline and wordline pitches, and shared contact enclosure tolerances to prevent junction shorting and ensure contact resistance stability.

### 2. Workflow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```

| Step 1: Layout Data Preparation & Rule Deck Compilation                           |
| - Stream in GDSII/OASIS hierarchical database for the 8F^2 1T1C array block.      |

+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

| - Run automated DRC deck across active (OD), poly wordline (WL), bitline contact  |
|   (CB/BLC), and metal bitline (BL) layers.                                        |
| - Check WL and BL wiring pitch within target range [360 nm - 400 nm].             |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Shared Bitline Contact Enclosure & Overlay Verification                   |
| - Verify shared contact enclosure by the active drain diffusion region between    |
|   the two adjacent memory access transistors.                                     |
| - Inspect edge-to-gate isolation and tungsten plug (W-plug) landing margins.       |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: In-Line Metrology Sign-Off & Defect Review                                |
| - Perform CD-SEM review of shared contact diameter and overlay error vector.      |

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Layout Ingestion & Hierarchy Initialization**:
   - Stream in the finalized 180 nm GDSII/OASIS hierarchical database for the $8F^2$ folded-bitline array block.
   - Confirm active area dimensions for the 1T1C access transistor: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

2. **DRC Engine Setup & Array Pitch Validation**:
   - Compile and initialize the tailored DRC ruleset targeting memory core array constraints.
   - Run design rule checks on dense array interconnects: verify wordline (gate) pitch and bitline wiring pitch within the critical window of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

3. **Shared Contact Enclosure & Spacing Verification**:
   - Execute specialized rule checks on the shared bitline contact (landing via tungsten plug / W-plug between the shared drains of two adjacent cells).
   - Check strict contact-to-active enclosure rules to eliminate active clipping or junction leakage paths.
   - Validate spacing between the shared bitline contact edge and the adjacent wordline polysilicon edge to prevent dielectric breakdown or micro-bridging.

4. **Metrology Correlation & Final Sign-Off**:
   - Cross-correlate optical/SEM alignment coordinates with DRC critical-marker coordinates.
   - Flag any soft-rule or hard-rule violations in the DRC error inspector; verify 0 DRC fatal errors in array core and periphery interfaces.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Automated DRC Regression Suite Execution & Array Margin Metrology Sign-Off
**Hierarchy / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup > Automated DRC Regression Suite Execution & Array Margin Metrology Sign-Off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m / 180 nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Environment Setup & Runset Pre-Check**:
   - Initialize automated regression verification environment targeting the 180 nm open-source DRAM PDK.
   - Load customized hierarchical DRC rules for folded bitline $8F^2$ array blocks (differentiating dense memory array rules from peripheral logic rules).
   - Ensure cell layout dimensions conform to access NMOS channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with shared bitline contacts between adjacent memory cells.

2. **Automated Hierarchical DRC Regression Execution**:
   - Execute batch-mode DRC regression script across the full DRAM array block ($256$ to $512$ cells per bitline).
   - Run spacing rule checks on dense array patterns: active area pitch, wordline (gate poly) pitch, bitline spacing, and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact clearance.
   - Verify layout dimensions for Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stacked capacitor / crown MIM structures and via contacts.

3. **Array Margin Metrology Extraction & Sign-Off**:
   - Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) and verify that it remains within the allowable budget across the 256–512 cells/BL segment ($150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$).
   - Extract storage node nominal capacitance ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$, nominal target $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Compute bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio ($C_b / C_s$) to ensure read sensing margin is maintained. Check that $C_b / C_s$ is strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (never exceeding $10:1$).
   - Confirm differential voltage read margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ yields an operational read window of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **DRC Error Logging & Sign-Off Reporting**:
   - Collate clean DRC run logs (`0 clean errors` across array and boundary transition regions).
   - Sign off the automated regression report and commit metrology records to the physical design database.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Sign-Off Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Layout Footprint ($8F^2$)** | $0.259$ | Exactly $0.259$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($L / W$)** | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | Target nominal (Zero DRC violations) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28$ | Minimum $\ge 25$ to $30$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150 \text{ -- } 250$ | Valid for 256 to 512 cells/BL block | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 \text{ -- } 9.0$ | Strict upper bound $< 10.0$ | Ratio (dimensionless) |
| **Differential Voltage Read Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ -- } 150$ | Minimum $\ge 100$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 3. Literature Sources & Context Citations

- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Footprint metrics for folded bitline: $8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline).
  - Bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio target: $5:1$ to $9:1$ ($C_b / C_s > 10:1$ degrades read margin severely).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Signal development formula $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Differential signal read margin: $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout features: shared bitline contact, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Minimum storage capacitance: $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environment Setup & Rule Deck Initialization**:
   - Source the 180nm DRAM verification suite environment.
   - Configure the customized hierarchical DRC run script specifying separate switch definitions for repetitive core array regions (`DRAM_ARRAY_EN=1`) versus peripheral CMOS logic (`PERI_STD_RULES=1`).
   - Define exclusion layers for crown/cylinder capacitor formations and tungsten plug contacts to enable dedicated array rule enforcement.

2. **Sub-Array Block-Level Regression**:
   - Execute batch DRC on the isolated 8F² sub-array layout block containing the active access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contacts, and crown/cylinder capacitor contact pads.
   - Verify wordline (gate) and bitline pitch spacing ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) across edge cells, dummy cells, and sub-array boundary interfaces.
   - Check gate oxide dielectric physical target limits ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) across the transistor channel zones.

3. **Sense Amplifier & Column Periphery Regression**:
   - Run batch DRC across the folded bitline sense amplifier interface block (CMOS cross-coupled inverter latches, equalization networks, and isolation gates).
   - Ensure matching pitch transition rules between dense array BL//BL pairs and sense amplifier equalization transistors.

4. **Full-Chip Top-Level Batch Execution**:
   - Launch multi-threaded full-chip hierarchical DRC batch execution across the assembled top-level GDSII/OASIS database.
   - Verify power distribution grids, sub-wordline drivers, column decoders, peripheral IO pads, and chip seal rings.
   - Generate full-chip error database and filter for array-periphery boundary violations.

5. **Array Margin Metrology & Sign-Off**:
   - Parse execution log files and rule report decks (`.rep` / `.drc_errors`).
   - Ensure zero false positives and zero hard design rule violations across both core memory sub-arrays and periphery.
   - Archive regression reports into the sign-off tracking repository.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Check Item | Target Metric | Unit | Physical Context / Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | nm | Target channel length across 8F² access transistors |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | nm | Target channel width across active array areas |
| **Wordline / Bitline Interconnect Pitch** | `360 to 400` | nm | Dense array repeating pitch limit |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | nm | Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric layer thickness |
| **Unwaived DRC Violation Count** | `0` | errors | Clean regression sign-off across array & full chip |

---

- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - *“Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.”*
  - *“Capacitance Budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.”*
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - *“Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.”*
  - *“Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.”*
  - *“Storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.”*

  - *“Precharge Operation: Prior to wordline assertion, bitlines are equalized to $V_{DD} / 2$ using an equalization transistor network.”*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Array Boundary Margin Metrology Analysis & Sign-Off Documentation

### Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-042`
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Cell Architecture:** 1T1C Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB), $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Topology  
**Lifecycle Stage:** Physical Verification Metrology & Sign-Off  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the industrial metrology analysis, optical proximity/lithography edge-placement verification, and sign-off criteria for array-to-periphery boundary margins in a 180nm $8F^2$ DRAM core. It ensures that cell-to-periphery proximity effects, contact landing margins, and gate/bitline pattern terminations meet strict yield, leakage, and capacitance retention specifications prior to tape-out mask release.

---

### 2. Verified Literature Citations & Physical Constraints
- **Cell Dimension & Pitch Baseline:** Gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$), access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\ \mu\text{m}$), bitline and wordline pitch $P = 360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Capacitance & Dielectric Integrity:** Target storage node cell capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), gate oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation), cell capacitor EOT $= 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$ (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*; *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
- **Leakage & Sensing Requirements:** Junction and sub-threshold leakage $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to support retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$; bitline load capacitance budget $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ ensuring a differential readout $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ (*Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```text
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               Array Boundary Metrology Verification Flow                           |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Automated DRC Regression Deck Setup & Execution                          |
|           - Load 180nm calibrated DRC rule deck into physical verification engine  |
|           - Define array-to-periphery transition region (dummy ring / boundary)    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 2] Edge-Placement & Array Pitch Metrology Inspection                        |
|           - Measure wordline (WL) & bitline (BL) pitches across boundary (360-400nm)|
|           - Verify access gate length L = 180 nm and width W = 220 nm on boundary |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 3] Dummy Cell & Transition Termination Metrology Verification               |
|           - Verify dummy wordline/bitline termination structures                   |
|           - Measure tungsten plug (W-plug) contact overlap & landing clearances    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 4] Leakage, Capacitance & Margin Metrology Sign-Off                         |
|           - Extract boundary parasitics (target CBL ~ 250 fF, Ileak <= 1 fA/cell)  |
|           - Generate formal Array Boundary Metrology Sign-Off Certificate          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Automated DRC Regression Deck Setup & Boundary Extraction
1. Load the customized 180nm DRAM array spacing rule deck into the verification tool.
2. Isolate the coordinate window for array-periphery boundaries (defined by the transition between regular periodic $8F^2$ array matrices and sense amplifier/decoder peripheral CMOS logic).
3. Execute the batch DRC regression suite targeting edge placement error (EPE), end-of-line (EOL) pullback, and array dummy cell termination rings.

#### Step 2: Pitch & Critical Dimension (CD) Metrology Analysis
1. Extract linear CD metrology profiles across boundary wordlines (WL) and bitlines (BL).
2. Measure array boundary pitch uniformity against the target pitch range ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$).
3. Measure gate critical dimensions for the outermost active cell access transistors:
   - Target gate length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Target active width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
4. Flag any optical proximity line-end shortening exceeding $\pm 5\%$ of the nominal $180\text{ nm}$ gate length.

#### Step 3: Contact & Storage Plug Landing Margin Inspection
1. Verify tungsten plug (W-plug) bitline contact and storage node contact landing margins at the boundary rows/columns.
2. Confirm dummy capacitor crown/cylinder structures maintain spacing margins preventing bridge shorts to periphery metallization.
3. Validate that dielectric isolation around the boundary satisfies the equivalent oxide thickness criteria ($EOT = 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$) without thinning under pattern-density gradients.

#### Step 4: Boundary Parasitic Extraction & Formal Sign-Off Documentation
1. Run boundary parasitic extraction (PEX) for the outermost complementary bitline pairs (BL and /BL) adjacent to the array edge.
2. Confirm the boundary bitline capacitance does not exceed the budget ($C_{BL} \le 250\text{ fF}$) to ensure sense amplifier differential signal development ($\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$).
3. Validate modeled sub-threshold and junction leakage target ($\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
4. Compile DRC regression logs, CD measurement histograms, and boundary overlay margins into the official sign-off report: `ARRAY_BOUNDARY_METROLOGY_SIGNOFF.rpt`.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline & Wordline Boundary Pitch** | $360\text{ to } 400$ | $360\text{ nm (min)} \le P \le 400\text{ nm (max)}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated CD/DRC Metrology Engine |
| **Outermost Cell Transistor Gate CD ($L \times W$)** | $180 \times 220$ | $L: 180 \pm 9\text{ nm}$; $W: 220 \pm 11\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Model-Based Pattern CD Metrology |
| **Boundary Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | Maximum $250.0$ (ensures $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV}$) | $\text{fF}$ | Automated Post-Layout PEX Extraction |
| **Boundary Cell Leakage Current** | $\le 1.0$ | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (retention $> 64\text{ ms}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE Post-PEX Corner Simulation |

---

### 5. Document Revision History
- **Version 1.0.0**: Initial physical verification and sign-off release for 180nm $8F^2$ DRAM open-source baseline. Tested against DRC regression suites and literature specifications.
