# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated DRC Execution & Wordline/Bitline Density Optimization

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Layout GDS Export    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated DRC Engine  │◄─╮
└────────────┬───────────┘  │
             │              │
             ▼              │
┌────────────◇───────────┐  │
│    DRC Violations?     │  │
└────────────◇───────────┘  │
       │            │       │
    Yes│          No│       │
       ▼            ▼       │
┌─────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────┐
│Pitch/Spacing│  │ BL/WL Parasitic Extract│
│Tuning Loop  ├──╯└───────────┬───────────┘
└─────────────┘               ▼
                 ┌────────────────────────┐
                 │  Acceptance Sign-Off   │
                 └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-DRC Layout Verification & Ingestion**:
   - Stream in the top-level 8F² folded-bitline cell array layout in GDSII/OASIS format.
   - Confirm baseline 180nm device geometric dimensions: access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the bitline contact (shared between two adjacent memory cells) is centered symmetrically to avoid contact enclosure violations.

2. **Automated DRC Rule Deck Compilation & Execution**:
   - Launch the automated DRC verification suite configured specifically for 180nm open-source rules.
   - Run design rule checks on all base layers, gate oxide, active diffusion, contact/vias (W-plug), wordline (polysilicon/polycide), and bitline (M1 metal/bitline layer).
   - Flag all critical spacing errors, minimum area violations, and gate/contact overlap discrepancies.

3. **Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Density Optimization**:
   - Extract bitline and wordline pitch profiles across the repetitive cell array; tighten and align pitches within the target design window of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Balance interconnect density to optimize parasitic capacitance: target a nominal bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ relative to the target cell storage capacitance $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.
   - Perform boundary and corner dummy pattern insertion along array perimeters to maintain optical and etching lithography consistency without violating minimum line-to-line spacing.

4. **Iterative DRC Cleansing & Parasitic Sign-Off**:
   - Perform automatic error-coordinate marker generation and run automated layout adjustment scripts for spacing infractions.
   - Re-run batch DRC until zero DRC violations (`DRC Clean: 0 Errors`) are obtained.
   - Stream out clean layout data to parasitic extraction (PEX) to ensure differential sensing margin $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ prior to final tapeout approval.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | Exact target | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Geometry Check |
| **Transistor Active Width ($W$)** | `220` | Exact target | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Geometry Check |
| **Wordline / Bitline Pitch** | `360 – 400` | $[360, 400]$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Array Pitch Measurement |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | `250` | Nominal extraction | $\text{fF}$ | Post-Layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX) |
| **DRC Error Count** | `0` | Clean ($0$ errors) | count | Automated DRC Run Report |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with W-plug drain contact.
  - Minimum capacitance budget: $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Cell layout topology: $8\text{F}^2$ or $6\text{F}^2$ 1T1C architecture.
  - Storage capacitor retention minimum: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Array pitch specifications: Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
  - Bitline capacitance extraction target: $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ for cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, providing $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC Deck Customization & Wordline/Bitline Pitch Rule Parameterization
**Node / Generation**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Cell Architecture**: 1T1C Folded Bitline Topology ($8F^2$)  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Extracted Documentation**: [drc_deck_pitch_parameterization.md](docs/knowledge/drc_deck_pitch_parameterization.md)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 1: Cell Grid    │
│  Setup & F=180nm Base  │
│    Pitch Definition    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Folded 8F2   │
│    Wordline/Bitline    │
│         Pitch          │
│    Parameterization    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 3: Charge Pump   │
│   V_PP Overdrive DRC   │
│   Deck Spacing Rule    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 4: Bitline RC   │
│  Budget & Capacitance  │
│      Ratio Check       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 5: Automated    │
│  DRC Deck Execution &  │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Step 1: Cell Grid Setup & Feature Size Definition**
   - Configure DRC design grid base unit to $F = 180\,\text{nm}$ ($0.18\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Fix maximum 1T1C cell area envelope to folded bitline standard:
     $$\text{Area}_{\text{cell}} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$$

2. **Step 2: Folded $8F^2$ Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Pitch Parameterization**
   - Parameterize Bitline Pitch ($P_{BL}$) on Metal1:
     - Minimum BL width $W_{BL} = 1F = 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$.
     - Minimum BL-to-BL spacing $S_{BL} = 1F = 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ (Nominal pitch $P_{BL} = 2F = 0.36\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Parameterize Wordline Pitch ($P_{WL}$) on Polysilicon/Active Gate:
     - Minimum WL gate length $L_g = 1F = 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$.
     - Wordline unit cell pitch $P_{WL} = 4F = 0.72\,\mu\text{m}$ (or active pitch equivalent $2F = 0.36\,\mu\text{m}$ staggered pass transistor pitch).

3. **Step 3: High-Voltage $V_{PP}$ Wordline DRC Deck Customization**
   - Since NMOS pass transistors have threshold $V_{th} = 0.5\,\text{V} - 0.7\,\text{V}$, driving WL only to $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ leads to $V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.2\,\text{V}$ (33% stored charge loss).
   - Wordlines carry pumped overdrive voltage:
     $$V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\,\text{V} \text{ to } 2.8\,\text{V}$$
   - Update DRC rule deck to enforce high-voltage thick-oxide / boosted dielectric spacing rules for all $V_{PP}$ nets, driver nodes, and Dickson charge pump flying capacitor boundaries ($C_{\text{pump}} = 20\,\text{pF} - 50\,\text{pF}$, 4-stage pump).

4. **Step 4: Bitline Parasitic Capacitance & Ratio Budget Check**
   - Enforce array block constraints for 256 or 512 cells per bitline:
     - Storage Node Capacitance: $C_s \ge 25\,\text{fF} \text{ to } 30\,\text{fF}$ (nominal $28\,\text{fF}$).
     - Bitline Parasitic Capacitance budget: $C_b = 150\,\text{fF} \text{ to } 250\,\text{fF}$.
     - Capacitance Ratio Constraint: Maintain $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (reject layout if $C_b / C_s \ge 10:1$ to prevent severe read margin collapse).

5. **Step 5: Automated DRC Deck Execution & Signal Margin Verification**
   - Run the customized DRC deck across array boundary blocks and cross-coupled CMOS latch sense amplifiers.
   - Verify differential read voltage signal margin:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \ge 100\,\text{mV} \text{ to } 150\,\text{mV}$$
   - Log sign-off violations if spacing creates excessive fringe bitline capacitance violating $\Delta V \ge 100\,\text{mV}$.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                                ┌──────────────────────┐
                                │■■■■■■■■■             │
 5. Delta V Signal (Min: 100 mV)┤■■■■■■■■■             │
                                │███                   │
 4. Storage Cap C_s (Nom: 28 fF)┤███                   │
3. Bitline Cap C_b (Max: 250 fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   2. Boosted V_PP (Min: 2.50 V)┤▒▒▒                   │
                                │▒▒▒                   │
 1. Area Budget (8F2: 0.259 um2)┤░░░                   │
                                │░░░                   │
                                └┬────┬─────┬────┬─────┘
                                0.0 62.5  125.0 187.5   
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Allowable Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. 1T1C Cell Area ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$)** | `0.259` | $\le 0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |
| **2. Wordline Boosted Voltage ($V_{PP}$ Overdrive)** | `2.50 to 2.80` | $\ge 2.50$ (Min write voltage $1.8\,\text{V}$) | $\text{V}$ |
| **3. Bitline Capacitance ($C_b$ for 256/512 cells)** | `150 to 250` | $\le 250$ ($C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **4. Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **5. Differential Read Signal ($\Delta V$)** | `100 to 150` | $\ge 100$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 3. Source Citations
- **Source 1**: *High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture* (NMOS $V_{th} = 0.5\,\text{V} - 0.7\,\text{V}$, $1.2\,\text{V}$ charge loss, Dickson 4-stage pump $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\,\text{pF} - 50\,\text{pF}$, $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\,\text{V} - 2.8\,\text{V}$).
- **Source 2**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets* (Folded $8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$; $C_s = 25\,\text{fF} - 30\,\text{fF}$, nominal $28\,\text{fF}$; $C_b = 150\,\text{fF} - 250\,\text{fF}$; $C_b / C_s = 5:1 \text{ to } 9:1$; limit $< 10:1$).
- **Source 3**: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* (CMOS cross-coupled latch, bitline equalization to $V_{DD}/2$, read signal $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) = 100\,\text{mV} - 150\,\text{mV}$).

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the configuration, parameterization, and execution of automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) decks using KLayout for 180nm generation $8F^2$ folded bitline DRAM cells. It verifies that dense repeating wordline (WL) and bitline (BL) pitches, transistor channel geometries, and contact spaces conform strictly to target electrical and physical boundaries.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environment & Script Initialization**:
   - Launch KLayout in batch DRC mode (`klayout -b -r drc_deck.lydrc -rd input_layout=<path_to_layout>`).
   - Define technology constants: feature size parameter $F = 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ ($180\,\text{nm}$).
   - Set database precision grid to $0.001\,\mu\text{m}$ ($1\,\text{nm}$).

2. **Parameterize Pitch & Feature Geometries in DRC Deck**:
   - Declare parameterized variables in Ruby/Python DRC deck:
     ```ruby
     # 180nm 8F^2 Unit Parameters (in um)
     F_SIZE       = 0.180
     WL_L_MIN     = 0.180        # Access transistor channel length
     BL_W_MIN     = 0.220        # Active area width
     PITCH_MIN    = 0.360        # Minimum wordline / bitline pitch
     PITCH_MAX    = 0.400        # Maximum wordline / bitline pitch target
     ```

3. **Layer Derivation & Contact Extraction**:
   - Extract raw layers: `poly` (Wordline/Gate), `active` (Diffusion), `metal1` (Bitline), and `contact` (Bitline/Transistor contact).
   - Derive channel region: `channel = poly & active`.
   - Derive bitline-to-channel contact tap points shared between adjacent memory cells.

4. **DRC Rule Evaluation Execution**:
   - **Gate Length ($L$) Check**: Verify `poly.width(WL_L_MIN, 'Gate length < 180 nm')`.
   - **Active Width ($W$) Check**: Verify `active.width(BL_W_MIN, 'Active width < 220 nm')`.
   - **Array Pitch Measurement**: Measure repeating edge-to-edge pitch across array tiles:
     - Wordline pitch: `poly.space(PITCH_MIN - WL_L_MIN)`.
     - Bitline pitch: `metal1.space(PITCH_MIN - BL_W_MIN)`.
     - Flag any periodicity deviations violating the $[360\,\text{nm},\,400\,\text{nm}]$ pitch envelope.

5. **Report Generation & Error Verification**:
   - Output violations to a standard XML/RDB report (`drc_violations.lyrdb`).
   - Check error count; an automated return code `0` is required for sign-off.

---

| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\pm 0$ (Minimum bound) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\pm 0$ (Minimum bound) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Database Coordinate Snap Grid** | $1.0$ | $\pm 0$ (Exact grid snap) | $\text{nm}$ |

  - *Context cited*: Unit cell geometry channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$; bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Resist Coat:**
   - Mount test/pilot wafers onto the automated coater track.
   - Dispense Shipley 1813 positive photoresist at 4000 RPM targeting a nominal film thickness of ~1.3 µm.
   - Execute soft bake on an inline flat aluminum hotplate at 115°C for 60 seconds.

2. **DRC Gauge Extraction & Test Mask Loading:**
   - Load the parameterized 8F² DRAM cell DRC pattern into the stepper/aligner reticle stage.
   - Target critical active area, wordline (WL), and bitline (BL) pitch tracks calibrated between 360 nm and 400 nm.
   - Set alignment marks referenced to Gen 2 precision targets.

3. **Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) Execution:**
   - Expose the array using a 365nm i-line optical projection source (NA 0.25 Plan Achromat objective lens).
   - Step an exposure dose and focal offset matrix across the wafer to establish the Process Window (DoF vs. Exposure Latitude).

4. **Development & Rinse:**
   - Immerse/puddle develop the wafer using Microposit MF-319 developer for 45 to 60 seconds.
   - Perform a continuous deionized (DI) water cascade rinse for 60 seconds, followed by high-purity N2 spin dry.

5. **CD-SEM & Overlay Yield Metrology Audit:**
   - Transfer wafer to Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) and automated optical alignment inspection station.
   - Measure 1T1C access transistor channel dimensions: gate length nominal $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width nominal $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Verify wordline and bitline pitches across array dense edges to prevent bridging or pattern pinch-off.
   - Measure multi-die alignment registration errors across the wafer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Batch DRC Scripting & Iterative Layout Pitch Compaction Execution

**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > Automated DRC Execution & Wordline/Bitline Density Optimization > Automated Batch DRC Scripting & Iterative Layout Pitch Compaction Execution  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Parameterized 8F² Layout Cell Instantiation:**
   - Instantiate the standard 8F² folded bitline unit cell layout using GDSII/OASIS automation scripts (Python/KLayout API).
   - Configure access transistor dimensions: gate channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Map shared bitline contact geometry shared between two adjacent memory cells and position the drain contact tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pad to interface with the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure.

2. **Automated Batch DRC Script Setup:**
   - Configure a headless batch DRC runner script (`run_drc_batch.py` or shell wrapper) targeting the 180nm design rule deck.
   - Set execution rule decks for critical layers: Active Area (Diffusion), Polysilicon/Wordline (WL), Contact/Via, and Metal1/Bitline (BL).
   - Direct execution outputs to structured XML/JSON reports with coordinate-indexed error flags.

3. **Iterative Pitch Compaction Algorithm Execution:**
   - **Step 3.1 (Wordline / Poly Pitch Optimization):** Incrementally decrement wordline-to-wordline pitch and gate spacing by step sizes of $\Delta = 5\,\text{nm}$ until design rule boundary limits are flagged.
   - **Step 3.2 (Bitline / Metal Pitch Optimization):** Incrementally compress bitline-to-bitline pitch and contact enclosure margins by $\Delta = 5\,\text{nm}$ while observing minimum metal spacing and enclosure around shared bitline contacts.
   - **Step 3.3 (Automated DRC Sweep):** At each compaction iteration, automatically run the batch DRC suite; parse error count. Revert step to the last clean coordinate if spacing or width violations occur.

4. **Capacitor Landing & Voltage Rule Compatibility Check:**
   - Ensure wordline driver routing and polysilicon gate spacing conform to the high-voltage clearance rules required for the boosted wordline potential ($V_{PP} \ge 2.5\,\text{V}$ to $2.8\,\text{V}$, driven by the on-chip Dickson charge pump) without dielectric breakdown or punch-through.
   - Validate W-plug to stacked capacitor landing pad clearance to support the minimum required storage capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\,\text{fF}$) footprint.

5. **Clean Layout Extraction & Sign-Off:**
   - Export final compacted cell array GDSII/OASIS file.
   - Run full-chip batch sign-off DRC to confirm zero violations.

---

| **Batch DRC Violation Count** | $0$ errors | Batch DRC engine report (KLayout / Magic / Calibre batch log) |

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Parameters applied:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$; folded bitline 8F² stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with shared bitline contact; tungsten plug (W-plug) drain landing; minimum storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 28\,\text{fF}$ per cell.
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture:**
  - *Parameters applied:* High-voltage wordline overdrive spacing requirements corresponding to boosted levels $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\,\text{V}$ to $2.8\,\text{V}$ (supplying $V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive}$ to prevent threshold voltage write loss).

An industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) tailored for the DRAM Foundation VN multi-agent council:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Iterative Wordline & Bitline Pitch Compaction Loop Execution
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180-LCO-007`  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Iterative Wordline & Bitline Pitch Compaction Loop Execution  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Objective & Principle
Execute an automated, rule-driven compaction and Design Rule Checking (DRC) loop on the $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM cell array to shrink Wordline (WL) and Bitline (BL) pitches to their physical minimum without violating lithographic spacings, contact overlap boundaries, or electrical sensing targets.

```
       [Layout Baseline: W=220nm, L=180nm]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Automated Pitch Compaction: Δx/Δy]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Batch DRC & Interconnect Extraction]
          ├─► Violations > 0 ──► Incremental Pitch Rollback
          └─► Clean (0 Errors)
                       │
                       ▼
       [Electrical & Capacitance Verification]
        (C_s >= 25-28 fF, C_BL <= 250 fF, ΔV >= 100 mV)
                       │
                       ▼
            [Sign-off / GDS Freeze]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parameter Initialization & Cell Boundary Definition:**
   - Load the parameterized unit cell layout containing the access transistor (drawn channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and the shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Establish initial trial grid intervals: Wordline Pitch ($P_{WL}$) at $400\text{ nm}$ and Bitline Pitch ($P_{BL}$) at $400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Automated Incremental Shrink Step:**
   - Execute an automated layout manipulation script to reduce $P_{WL}$ and $P_{BL}$ concurrently by discrete increments of $\Delta p = 5\text{ nm}$.
   - Scale polysilicon wordline gate space and metal/tungsten bitline line-to-line spacing proportionally while preserving contact enclosure margins around the shared BL contact.

3. **Batch DRC Verification Execution:**
   - Trigger the headless batch DRC engine against the compacted cell array (instantiated as an $8 \times 8$ sub-matrix to account for boundary and optical proximity effects).
   - Parse execution logs for violations (minimum metal space, poly-to-poly space, active-to-gate spacing, and contact enclosure rules).
   - If DRC violations occur, halt forward shrink, record the violation coordinates, and roll back by $+5\text{ nm}$ along the constrained axis.

4. **Parasitic Extraction & Readout Signal Check:**
   - Run parasitic interconnect extraction on the clean compacted array to evaluate bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$).
   - Evaluate differential voltage swing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ assuming standard precharge to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Confirm that shrinking pitch does not inflate $C_{BL}$ beyond $250\text{ fF}$ (which suppresses readout margin below critical signal development thresholds).

5. **Freeze Geometry and Export GDS:**
   - Upon meeting physical pitch bounds ($360\text{ nm} \le P_{WL}, P_{BL} \le 400\text{ nm}$) and zero DRC errors, output the final optimized GDSII stream for cell array integration.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch ($P_{WL}$, $P_{BL}$)** | $360\text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Layout GDS Measurement / Caliper |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($L / W$)** | $L = 180 \pm 0$, $W = 220 \pm 0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Static DRC Geometry Audit |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-Compaction Parasitic Extraction (PEX) |
| **Readout Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | SPICE Readout Simulation ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$) |
| **Array Batch DRC Violations** | $0$ (Clean) | Count | Batch DRC Error Log Report |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**  
  *Context applied:* Established target pitch range for 180nm nodes ("Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately 360 nm to 400 nm") and required minimum cell storage capacitance ($C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
  *Context applied:* Defined the baseline access transistor channel geometry ("Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm"), the shared bitline contact with W-plug architecture, and the minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**  
  *Context applied:* Defined sensing development parameters, bitline parasitic ceiling ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$), and nominal differential signal readout range ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$) calculated via $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII/OASIS Ingestion & Layer Mapping Validation**:
   - Stream in the compacted 8F² DRAM cell array core, wordline drivers, sense-amplifier blocks, and boundary dummy cells.
   - Verify layer bindings against the 180nm design kit definitions: active diffusion (OD), polysilicon/wordline (POLY), bitline contact (CB), metal bitline (M1/BL), tungsten contact plug (W-plug), and capacitor base/plate (MIM/Crown).

2. **Automated Array Pitch & Critical Dimension (CD) Metrology**:
   - Execute pitch metrology across the core array to measure repeating cell bounds:
     - Access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) and channel width ($W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - Wordline (WL) pitch and bitline (BL) pitch across $X$ and $Y$ axes.
   - Ensure the cell footprint satisfies the target $8F^2$ topology ($8 \times (0.18\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.2592\,\mu\text{m}^2$).

3. **Spacing Violation Audit & Contact Enclosure Verification**:
   - Run DRC decks to inspect minimum spacing rules between adjacent wordlines, bitlines, and storage node contacts.
   - Audit shared bitline contact (CB) enclosure over active diffusion and metal bitline landing margin.
   - Inspect tungsten plug (W-plug) landing margin over access transistor drain terminals for stacked capacitor placement without bridging to neighboring lines.

4. **Pattern Density & Metal Fill Balance Check**:
   - Evaluate local and global layer density across the core array and sense amplifier arrays.
   - Validate active area, poly, and metal layer densities against CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization) uniformity criteria to eliminate dishing or erosion risks.

5. **Violation Triage, Layout Compaction Loop & Final Sign-Off**:
   - If any DRC violation flags (spacing, minimum area, notch, or enclosure), mark layout coordinates and invoke layout pitch compaction execution for remediation.
   - Generate automated DRC sign-off log and checksum; archive report with zero critical violations.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-8F2-001`
**Title:** L/W Spacing Violation Metrology Review & $8F^2$ Density Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > Automated DRC Execution & Wordline/Bitline Density Optimization > L/W Spacing Violation Metrology Review & $8F^2$ Density Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Procured Foundry / MPW IP Line)

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the inspection, review, and verification protocol for layout-versus-mask critical dimensions (CD), transistor active area width ($W$), gate length ($L$), contact spacing, and pitch density on 180nm $8F^2$ folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cells.

---

### 2. Workflow Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Layout GDSII Ingestion & Automated DRC Run"] --> B["Identify CD & Spacing DRC Markers (L, W, Contact Pitch)"]
    B --> C["Automated CD-SEM / Optical Metrology Review"]
    C --> D{"Check Transistor CD: L=180nm, W=220nm, Pitch=360-400nm"}
    D -- "Violation" --> E["Flag Out-of-Tolerance Spacing / Generate Mask Bias Request"]
    D -- "Pass" --> F["$8F^2$ Unit Cell Density & Contact Pitch Verification"]
    F --> G{"Verify Cell Area == 0.259 µm²"}
    G -- "Fail" --> H["Reject Layout / Cell Pitch Re-optimization"]
    G -- "Pass" --> I["Sign-off Metrology Review & Release to Tapeout/Procurement"]
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **GDSII Ingestion & DRC Error Marker Filtering**
   - Import the routed 1T1C array block layout (containing bitline/wordline pitches between 360 nm and 400 nm).
   - Filter automated DRC output for access transistor design rule violations: active layer width ($W$), poly gate line length ($L$), and bitline contact enclosure rules.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension Verification ($L$ & $W$)**
   - Align metrology measurement gauges on the 1T1C access NMOS channel:
     - Target gate physical length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Target active width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the gate oxide physical thickness adheres to the $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal baseline ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ thermal dry $\text{SiO}_2$).

3. **Bitline Contact & Shared Node Spacing Review**
   - Inspect the shared bitline contact (W-plug) positioned between adjacent memory cells.
   - Measure bitline pitch and wordline pitch across array cross-sections, verifying pitch conformity within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

4. **$8F^2$ Unit Cell Density & Footprint Metrology Calculation**
   - Measure the 1T1C unit cell bounding box for the folded bitline layout:
     $$\text{Target Unit Cell Area} = 8 \times F^2 = 8 \times (0.180\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$$
   - Verify cell boundaries ensure sufficient overhead for crown/cylinder stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) structures without bridging neighboring storage nodes.

5. **Storage Node Contact Margin & Capacitance Pre-Check**
   - Verify that landing pad spacing provides sufficient margin for stacked capacitor integration achieving $\ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$) with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} \approx 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                180nm 8F2 Physical Dimensions & Targets 
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░       │
         L (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░       │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
         W (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
   C_s Min (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                                 │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓                                 │
Unit Area (um2)┤█                                      │
               │█                                      │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0        55       110       165     220 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Inspection Tool / Gauge | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Tolerance | Pass/Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Length ($L$)** | Automated CD-SEM / DRC Gauge | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($\pm 9\text{ nm}$) | $171 \le L \le 189\text{ nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Width ($W$)** | Automated CD-SEM / DRC Gauge | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($\pm 11\text{ nm}$) | $209 \le W \le 231\text{ nm}$ |
| **Unit Cell Footprint ($8F^2$)** | Layout Density Extraction | $0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | $\pm 1\%$ | Nominal $8 \times (0.18\,\mu\text{m})^2$ |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | 2D Pitch Metrology Gauge | $360\text{ -- }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Exact Band | $360 \le \text{Pitch} \le 400\text{ nm}$ |

---

### 5. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact via W-plug; stacked capacitor with ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$); minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint area $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ (compared to open bitline $6F^2$ of $0.194\,\mu\text{m}^2$); storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$); $C_b / C_s$ ratio maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) with EOT around $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric dry oxidation thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$; array bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Low-Dose Beam Alignment & Focusing**:
   - Establish electron beam landing energy (typically $500\,\text{V} - 800\,\text{V}$ low-acceleration voltage to prevent electrostatic charging on dielectric/polysilicon surfaces).
   - Perform automated stigmator adjustment and dynamic auto-focus at an off-array dummy site $\ge 20\,\mu\text{m}$ away from active memory cell sites to eliminate beam-induced photoresist shrinkage.
3. **Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Critical Pitch Metrology Recipe**:
   - Position the inspection region over repeating dense wordlines and bitlines in the 8F² folded-bitline matrix.
   - Configure edge-detection algorithm thresholds (derivative maximum method) across 16 parallel scan lines to capture dense periodic wordline and bitline pitches.
4. **Access Transistor Dimension Verification**:
   - Set cursor measurement gates across the access transistor channel length ($L$) and active area width ($W$).
   - Execute multi-point line scan averaging over the access gate poly profile to suppress line edge roughness (LER) noise.
5. **Shared Bitline Contact Metrology Configuration**:
   - Configure elliptical/circular boundary fitting algorithms on the shared bitline contact (connecting adjacent memory cells) and the tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads prior to stacked capacitor formation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-8F2-OPC
**Title:** 8F² Unit Cell Area and Optical Proximity Correction Edge Placement Verification  
**Process Node / Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Classification:** Metrology & Lithography / Physical Layout Verification  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the physical verification, CD-SEM inspection, and Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Edge Placement Error (EPE) metrology for the 180nm 1T1C stacked-capacitor 8F² DRAM cell. The objective is to verify that printed silicon dimensions match the layout target grid, guarantee the target 8F² unit cell area, and prevent bridge/pinch defects across wordline (WL), bitline (BL), and shared contact levels.

---

### 2. Workflow Diagram

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: GDSII / OASIS Design Grid & 8F² Cell Area Extraction            |
| - Verify F = 180 nm, Access L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm                      |
| - PitchBL = 2F (360 nm), PitchWL = 4F (720 nm) -> Area = 8F² = 0.259 µm²|
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: Full-Chip Model-Based OPC & EPE Simulation                      |
| - Evaluate aerial image across ±10% dose & focus window                 |
| - Extract Edge Placement Error (EPE) on WL/BL line ends & contact pads  |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: Automated In-Line CD-SEM Metrology Execution                    |
| - Measure post-etch gate length (L = 180 nm) and active width (W = 220nm)|
| - Inspect shared bitline contact landing and perimeter overlap           |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 4: Acceptance Disposition & Tolerance Review                       |
| - Validate CD-SEM & EPE against acceptance criteria thresholds           |
| - Release mask layer / wafer lot or route to litho rework               |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII / OASIS Target Geometry & Layout Area Extraction:**
   - In the layout verification tool (e.g., KLayout / Calibre), extract the active matrix unit cell bounding box.
   - Confirm baseline lithographic feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Set nominal access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active diffusion channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Verify array pitch parameters: Bitline pitch $\text{Pitch}_{\text{BL}} = 2F = 360\text{ nm}$ and Wordline pitch $\text{Pitch}_{\text{WL}} = 4F$ (or cell pitch along WL direction spanning shared contact architecture) to ensure the unit cell area strictly satisfies:
     $$\text{Area} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.180\text{ }\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.2592\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$$

2. **Model-Based Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) & EPE Simulation:**
   - Apply 180nm DUV (248nm KrF) optical and resist models to the gate (wordline) and bitline metallization layers.
   - Insert line-end hammerheads, serifs, and assist features to counteract optical corner rounding and line-end pull-back.
   - Run full-chip simulated contour extraction across nominal focus and dose.
   - Measure Edge Placement Error ($\text{EPE} = \text{Edge}_{\text{simulated}} - \text{Edge}_{\text{target}}$) at critical evaluation gauges:
     - Wordline over active channel edges ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
     - Bitline shared drain contact landing pads.
     - Storage node capacitor contact (tungsten plug) landing locations.

3. **In-Line CD-SEM Wafer Metrology:**
   - Load patterned wafer into the automated Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) post-lithography (ADI) and post-etch (ACI).
   - Execute programmed 9-point site inspections across the wafer radius (center, middle, edge):
     - Measure gate critical dimension $L$ across 50 consecutive memory cells per site.
     - Measure active area width $W$ across adjacent cell channels.
     - Inspect the shared bitline contact hole diameter and CD overlay on the tungsten plug layer.

4. **Defect Review & Lot Disposition:**
   - Flag any location where post-OPC contour deviation or CD-SEM measurement exceeds allowable EPE bounds.
   - If line pinching (EPE negative excursion) or bridging (EPE positive excursion) occurs, reject wafer lot for litho rework/re-strip and recalibrate OPC optical mask bias tables.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Tool / Method | Source Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **8F² Unit Cell Area** | $0.2592\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2 \pm 0.015\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$ | Layout GDSII Bounding Box Extraction / CD-SEM Metrology | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm} \pm 10\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM (Post-Etch Inspection) | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Access Transistor Active Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm} \pm 12\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM (Active Area ACI) | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Bitline Pitch ($\text{Pitch}_{\text{BL}}$)** | $360\text{ nm} \text{ to } 400\text{ nm}$ | CD-SEM Pitch Metrology Gauge | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |
| **Critical Layer Edge Placement Error (EPE)** | $\le \pm 15\text{ nm}$ | Automated OPC Verification Contour Metrology | Derived from 180nm gate pitch & critical overlay budget |

---

### 5. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Verified access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), 8F² folded bitline unit cell architecture, shared bitline contact geometry, and tungsten plug (W-plug) capacitor contact requirements.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Verified 8F² cell layout configuration, bitline and wordline pitch ranges ($360\text{ nm} \text{ to } 400\text{ nm}$), and gate dielectric parameters.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Verified folded-bitline integration constraints and differential signal margin dependencies driven by cell layout capacitance.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

**Target:** 8F² 1T1C DRAM Cell Array & Boundary Transition

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         Import Layout (GDSII / OASIS)        │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘

│                                              │
│   Optical & Pitch Metrology Verification     │
│        (Wordline & Bitline Pitch)            │

└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │

│         (Gate Length L & Width W)            │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Cell Array Boundary Dummy Ring Check      │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Final Clean DRC Stream-Out Sign-Off       │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layout Hierarchy Import & Layer Map Setup**
   - Stream in the finalized 8F² unit cell layout, sense amplifier pitch matching boundary, and cell array tile hierarchy in GDSII/OASIS format.
   - Attach the 180nm Design Rule Deck with explicit layer assignments for active area (DIFF/OD), wordline polysilicon (POLY), bitline tungsten contact/metal (M1/BL), and stacked capacitor contact plug (W-plug / Node Contact).

2. **Array Boundary & Pitch Metrology Verification**
   - Execute automated metrology measurement sweeps across the core 8F² array and cell-to-periphery boundary regions.
   - Verify wordline (WL) pitch and bitline (BL) line-to-line pitch along the principal axes to prevent lithographic under-resolution. Ensure array pitch is strictly calibrated within target bounds.

3. **Active Channel & Gate Dimension Cleansing**
   - Run localized DRC spacing and width verification on the 1T1C access transistor active region and gate electrode.
   - Flag and clean all critical dimension (CD) violations: enforce drawn gate channel length and transistor active width to prevent sub-threshold leakage excursions.

4. **Shared Bitline & Node Contact Enclosure Cleansing**
   - Verify contact-to-gate spacing and enclosure rules for the shared bitline contact (shared between two adjacent 1T1C memory cells) and capacitor node contact plugs.
   - Clean all edge-overlap and corner-to-corner spacing violations to eliminate bridging risks during tungsten CMP and lithographic alignment.

5. **Dummy Cell Ring & Edge Boundary Metrology Check**
   - Inspect boundary termination rings surrounding the active array adjacent to the folded bitline sense amplifier interface.
   - Verify optical proximity correction (OPC) dummy cell continuity to eliminate edge-of-array pattern distortion and boundary proximity shifts.

6. **Sign-Off & Golden Stream-Out**
   - Run flat hierarchical DRC regression across the entire stitched array and pitch-matched boundary.
   - Generate zero-violation sign-off report (`DRC_VIOLATIONS = 0`) before committing GDSII/OASIS to tape-out mask preparation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Array Pitch** | `360 to 400` | nm | ±2.0 nm | Automated Design Rule Metrology / CD-SEM Layout Caliper |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | nm | ±3.0 nm | In-line Layout DRC Width Rule Verification Engine |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | nm | ±3.0 nm | In-line Layout DRC Width Rule Verification Engine |
| **Uncleansed DRC Violations** | `0` | count | Exact (0) | Hierarchical Sign-off DRC Rule Check Engine |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  * *Unit Cell Geometry:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * *Bitline Interface:* Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells in 8F² folded bitline architecture.
* **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  * *Interconnect Pitch:* Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ for standard 180nm 1T1C DRAM architectures.
  * *Topology:* 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor (1T1C) 8F² cell array configuration.

**Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | 8F² Folded Bitline Cell Topology | Gen 2 (µm)

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text

│                       │

│                       │
│    LVS & DRC Clean    │
│        Signoff        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **DRC Error Map Extraction & Array Perimeter Isolation**:
   - Run the full-chip DRC deck on the active memory array block containing 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Filter error markers specifically targeting **Boundary Pitch** and **Contact Spacing / Enclosure** violations occurring at the interface between the regular 8F² array and the peripheral wordline/bitline driver boundaries.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension & Pitch Verification**:
   - Cross-check access NMOS channel dimensions against layout specifications: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Inspect active wordline (WL) and bitline (BL) pitches at array boundaries. Ensure standard repetition pitch is maintained at $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - If pitch compression or edge termination collapse drops pitch below $360\text{ nm}$, apply optical proximity dummy lines (dummy wordlines/bitlines) to equalize nested-to-isolated lithographic bias.

3. **Shared Bitline Contact & Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Spacing Alignment**:
   - Locate shared bitline contacts positioned between adjacent paired memory cells.
   - Verify contact clear spacing to adjacent gate polysilicon wordlines ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) meets minimum DRC spacing limits.
   - Verify the storage node contact plug (W-plug connecting the access transistor drain to the stacked capacitor over bitline) enclosure and clearance to neighboring metal/polysilicon features.

4. **8F² Array Footprint & Boundary Termination DRC Fix**:
   - For an 8F² folded bitline unit cell with target footprint area of $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ ($F = 180\text{ nm}$), verify that edge termination transition cells do not alter active gate channel length ($180\text{ nm}$) or width ($220\text{ nm}$).
   - Adjust contact enclosure overlays, widen end-of-line contact landing pads to eliminate line-end pull-back, and enforce a minimum pitch $\ge 360\text{ nm}$ at array periphery.

5. **Signoff Verification**:
   - Re-run geometric DRC to ensure zero violations in contact and pitch layers across the entire array and boundary transition zones.
   - Execute LVS (Layout Versus Schematic) extraction to confirm connectivity of all shared bitline contacts and storage node contacts.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limits | Units | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | Nominal: $180 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Metrology / CD-SEM |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | Nominal: $220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Metrology / CD-SEM |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch (Array & Boundary)** | `360 to 400` | Min: $360$, Max: $400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Optical / Layout DRC Deck |
| **8F² Folded Bitline Unit Cell Footprint** | `0.259` | Nominal: $0.259 \pm 0.005$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Area Calculation Rule |
| **Total DRC Boundary & Spacing Violations** | `0` | Hard Limit: $0$ (Clean Signoff) | Count | Physical DRC Engine |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C architecture, 8F² folded bitline layout.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
3. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - Folded bitline 8F² physical cell footprint: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Array block architecture: 256 or 512 cells per bitline.

```text
│  Metrology Sign-Off   │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **DRC Run & Spatial Error Extraction**:
   - Execute the 180nm hierarchical design rule deck (GDSII/OASIS input) targeting active diffusion, wordline/polysilicon, bitline metal, and contact plug masks.
   - Define a coordinate spatial window encompassing the array core edge through the sense amplifier / row decoder boundary ring.
2. **Boundary Defect Categorization & Clustering**:
   - Filter and cluster DRC markers flagging minimum spacing, enclosure, and pitch discontinuities across the array termination zone.
   - Separate array dense line violations (wordline/bitline target pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) from relaxed peripheral routing rules.
3. **Transition Ring Pitch Harmonization**:
   - Insert graded dummy active and dummy wordline structures at the boundary to prevent optical proximity lithography rounding and nested-to-isolated line collapse.
   - Route bitline contact tungsten plugs (W-plugs) shared between cells with strict adherence to symmetric contact spacing and uniform enclosure rules.
4. **Capacitive & Leakage Metrology Triage**:
   - Verify that boundary layout perturbations do not degrade the access transistor active dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) or increase sub-threshold leakage above target.
   - Validate that bitline routing parasitic capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$) maintains signal margins into the cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier.
5. **Back-Annotation, LVS Sign-Off & Clean-deck Freeze**:
   - Perform boundary layout-versus-schematic (LVS) verification to confirm complete connectivity of folded-bitline pairs ($BL$, $/BL$) and equalization gates.
   - Freeze clean boundary layout cells upon achieving zero fatal DRC/pitch flags.

---

```text

    Min Cap (fF)┤▒▒▒▒                                  │ 28 fF
    Gate Ox (nm)┤▓                                     │ 3.5 nm
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│ 360 - 400 nm
```

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Spacing & Pitch Rule Engine |
| **Storage Cell Minimum Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | 3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout Interconnect Extraction |
| **Access Transistor Leakage Current** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell (at } 85^\circ\text{C)}$ | Calibrated SPICE Device Leakage Metrology |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Geometry & Capacitance Budget*: Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum storage capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$; tungsten plug (W-plug) bitline contact shared between adjacent cells.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Interconnect & Pitch Scaling*: Dense bitline and wordline pitch established at $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric physically grown with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thickness ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).

  - *Signal Development*: Folded-bitline architecture with typical bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF to } 28\text{ fF}$, driving differential sense margin $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.


---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **DRC Violation Triage & Boundary Identification:**
   - Execute DRC deck across memory array-to-periphery boundaries.
   - Filter contact-to-gate spacing and array edge pitch violations caused by optical diffraction and non-periodic array termination.
2. **Dummy Wordline (DWL) Insertion & Pitch Regularization:**
   - Place non-active dummy wordlines at the array termination boundary to maintain an identical optical neighborhood.
   - Enforce wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$ through the active-to-dummy transition zone to prevent micro-loading and flare during lithography.
3. **Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Enclosure & Gate Spacing Optimization:**
   - Position shared bitline contact symmetrically between adjacent 1T1C access transistors (access channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Adjust contact enclosure and spacing to adjacent polysilicon gates to ensure dielectric isolation without pinching the active area.
4. **Model-Based Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) & SRAF Synthesis:**
   - Apply sub-resolution assist features (SRAFs) and line-end serif extensions on wordline and bitline termination fingers.
   - Run model-based optical proximity correction to adjust mask edges targeting on-wafer contact critical dimension (CD) uniformity.
5. **Lithography Verification (Aerial Image Simulation):**
   - Perform full-chip contour simulation at nominal exposure dose and defocus conditions ($\pm 0.1\text{ µm}$).
   - Verify that simulated print contours maintain electrical clearance and eliminate bridging/necking violations.

---

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline / Bitline Array Pitch** | `360` to `400` | $\text{nm}$ | $[360, 400]\text{ nm}$ strict boundary range |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | $\text{nm}$ | Nominal target ($\pm 5\%\text{ CD margin}$) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | $\text{nm}$ | Nominal target ($\pm 5\%\text{ CD margin}$) |
| **Array Boundary Residual DRC Violations** | `0` | count | Absolute zero clean sign-off |

---

  - *“Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.”*
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *“A classic 180nm DRAM cell uses a 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor (1T1C) architecture with an 8F^2 or 6F^2 cell layout... Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately 360 nm to 400 nm.”*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Full-Chip Clean Boundary Metrology & Regression DRC/LVS Verification Sign-off
**Hierarchy Level:** Metrology & Layout Sign-Off (Industrial Leaf SOP)  
**Process Technology:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN), Gen 2 (µm)  
**Cell Topology:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tape-Out Sign-Off  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Verification Lifecycle

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Array-to-Periphery   │
│    Boundary Triage     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Boundary Critical    │
│   Dimension & Pitch    │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Regression Golden    │
│  DRC Suite Execution   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Full-Chip LVS      │
│  Netlist Extraction &  │
│      Pin Matching      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tape-Out Sign-Off &   │
│   Clean Mask Freeze    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Step 1: Cell-Array to Periphery Boundary Triage & Dummy Pattern Insertion**
   - Stream in full-chip GDSII/OASIS database.
   - Audit edge transitions where dense periodic 1T1C $8F^2$ cell arrays meet sense amplifier equalization networks and wordline decoders.
   - Verify optical proximity correction (OPC) dummy bitlines and dummy wordlines across the array boundary to prevent optical and etch micro-loading.

2. **Step 2: Boundary Critical Dimension (CD) & Pitch Metrology Audit**
   - Perform automated pattern-match CD metrology on access transistor channel geometries:
     - Channel length: nominal $L = 180\,\text{nm}$.
     - Channel width: nominal $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Inspect boundary bitline and wordline pitches across edge array blocks against the foundry lithography target of $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$.
   - Verify minimum spacing and enclosure of shared bitline contacts (drain contact via tungsten plug / W-plug) to ensure uniform landing without bridging or open contact defects.

3. **Step 3: Golden Regression DRC Execution**
   - Run the golden full-chip design rule checking (DRC) decks covering:
     - Active diffusion (OD), polysilicon gate (PO), shared bitline contacts (CO/W-plug), storage node contact (SNC), and capacitor bottom electrode (MIM/Crown) geometries.
     - Spacing, enclosure, and density gradient rules at the array-periphery interface.
   - Filter transient flags and verify $0$ DRC violations remaining across all mask layers.

4. **Step 4: Full-Chip LVS Device Extraction & Electrical Verification**
   - Perform full-chip Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) device extraction.
   - Confirm proper connectivity of CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier pairs ($\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$) and precharge equalization transistors.
   - Verify extracted cell storage capacitance meets layout budget: target $C_s \ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ per cell with bitline parasitics balanced relative to $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\,\text{fF}$.
   - Ensure soft-error and alpha-particle immunity budget ($C_s \ge 28\,\text{fF}$) is satisfied for the stacked capacitor high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO stack).
   - Ensure zero pin mismatches, zero open circuits, and zero short circuits across both array and periphery nets.

5. **Step 5: Sign-Off Mask Freeze & Release**
   - Generate automated DRC and LVS summary reports (`drc_summary.rep`, `lvs_summary.rep`) confirming zero fatal violations.
   - Checksum-verify the sign-off GDSII/OASIS layout and freeze tape-out archive.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                                                          
                        ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                        │■                               │
     Gate Oxide Tox (nm)┤■                               │
                        │░░░                             │
        Min Cell Cs (fF)┤░░░                             │
 Access Ch. Width W (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒            │
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒            │
Access Ch. Length L (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓               │
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓               │
        BL/WL Pitch (nm)┤████████████████████████████████│
                        │████████████████████████████████│
                        └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                         0      90      180    270    360 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360` to `400` | $\text{nm}$ | Metrology Rule Extraction (DRC Rule Deck) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | Length $L = 180$, Width $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated CD Metrology & Device Extraction |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `25` to `30` (min `28` for soft-error immunity) | $\text{fF}$ | Full-Chip LVS Parasitic & Device Extraction |
| **Full-Chip Regression DRC Violations** | `0` (Zero violations allowed) | count (integer) | Golden Foundry DRC Sign-off Run |
| **Full-Chip LVS Topology Discrepancies** | `0` (Zero shorts, opens, or mismatched ports) | count (integer) | Golden Full-Chip LVS Netlist Comparison |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - High-$k$ dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) with capacitance budget $\ge 28\,\text{fF}/\text{cell}$ to safeguard against alpha-particle soft errors and coupling.
   - Refresh interval criteria requiring sub-threshold & junction leakage $< 1\,\text{fA}/\text{cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
   - Folded bitline topology with CMOS cross-coupled inverter sense amplifier latches and precharge/equalization network ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
   - Typical cell capacitance baseline $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ with bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\,\text{fF}$, generating differential readout signal $\Delta V \approx 100\,\text{mV} - 150\,\text{mV}$.

3. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) targeting storage capacitance of $25 - 30\,\text{fF}/\text{cell}$ for retention time $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications: $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$.
   - Thermally grown gate dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$ dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) with $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness.

1. **Procurement Specification Dispatch (Technical Requirements Sheet):**

   - Mandate specific rule checks for array boundary termination: continuous guard-ring substrate taps, dummy wordline (polysilicon) pitch degradation buffer zones, and dummy bitline optical proximity correction (OPC) transition regions around the memory array perimeter.

   - Run the automated deck across the macro boundary between the $8F^2$ array core and the folded-bitline sense amplifier / wordline periphery decoders.
   - Validate continuous guard-ring enclosure around the array edge to isolate substrate carrier injection and mitigate charge collection on storage capacitors.
   - Measure dummy polysilicon and dummy bitline pitch continuity from array core into edge termination to prevent micro-loading and optical proximity effects during 248nm/193nm lithography and etch.

4. **DRC / Metrology Deck Sign-Off:**
   - Verify zero unmapped geometric violations in the array-to-periphery transition strip.
   - Archive vendor deck hash, rule checksums, and execution logs under quality management revision control.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-MET-180-042`
**Title:** Precision Tooling & Fixturing for Full-Chip Array-to-Periphery Boundary Metrology & DRC Sign-off Run  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Discipline:** Mechanical Assembly & Metrology Tooling / Physical Verification  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Executive Summary & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the precise kinematic fixturing, vacuum chuck planarization, and thermal-mechanical alignment protocol required to position a processed 200 mm wafer for high-resolution critical dimension scanning electron microscopy (CD-SEM) and automated boundary-metrology inspection across the dense cell array-to-periphery transition zone. 

The procedure guarantees mechanical fixture stability, stage travel repeatability, and thermal equilibrium prior to executing physical boundary calibration and full-chip DRC verification for 180 nm 1T1C $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM layouts.

---

### 2. Verified Context & Engineering References
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Access transistor geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * Shared bitline contact between adjacent memory cells; tungsten plug ($W$-plug) drain contact.
  * Cell capacitance target: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ with leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  * 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ folded bitline layout; target capacitance $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  * Critical pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch is $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
  * Gate dielectric: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  * Sense amplifier differential sensing relies on precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  * Nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ vs bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, generating differential read signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Tooling & Fixturing Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       PRECISION TOOLING & FIXTURING FLOW                      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Kinematic Chuck Cleaning & Inspection (Pinhole & Flatness Verify)   |
|                                       |                                       |
|                                       v                                       |
|  [Step 2] Wafer Robotic Loading & Multi-Zone Vacuum Fixturing (Differential)  |
|                                       |                                       |
|                                       v                                       |
|  [Step 3] Thermal Stabilization & Stage Drift Nullification (Equilibrium)    |
|                                       |                                       |
|                                       v                                       |
|  [Step 4] Global-to-Local Optical Alignment & Array Boundary Lock             |
|                                       |                                       |
|                                       v                                       |
|  [Step 5] Metrology CD-SEM Baseline & DRC Boundary Sign-off Automation Hand-off|
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tooling Pre-Check & Kinematic Chuck Preparation
1. Clean the ceramic pin-chuck (silicon carbide or alumina) surface using cleanroom class 1 dry nitrogen purge ($0.2\text{ MPa}$, $< 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ filtered).
2. Measure ceramic chuck surface runout using a non-contact laser displacement interferometer across $r = 100\text{ mm}$ travel; verify total thickness variation (TTV) / chuck flatness is $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$.
3. Verify kinematic ball-groove mounts (Kelvin or Maxwell clamp interface) are torqued to $1.2\text{ N}\cdot\text{m} \pm 0.05\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$.

#### Step 2: Wafer Loading & Multi-Zone Vacuum Fixturing
1. Transfer the 180 nm patterned wafer onto the pre-aligned end-effector lift pins under ISO Class 3 laminar flow.
2. Lower wafer onto the vacuum chuck. Engage 3-zone concentric differential back-side vacuum:
   * Inner zone ($r \le 40\text{ mm}$): $-80\text{ kPa} \pm 2\text{ kPa}$.
   * Middle zone ($40\text{ mm} < r \le 80\text{ mm}$): $-75\text{ kPa} \pm 2\text{ kPa}$.
   * Outer periphery ring zone ($80\text{ mm} < r \le 100\text{ mm}$): $-70\text{ kPa} \pm 2\text{ kPa}$.
3. Verify absence of micro-gap warping along the outer edge using confocal distance sensors.

#### Step 3: Thermal Equilibration & Stage Mechanical Damping
1. Idle stage assembly in metrology chamber at $21.5^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.1^\circ\text{C}$ for a minimum settling time of $120\text{ s}$ to dissipate heat from robot transfer.
2. Engage piezo-actuated dynamic vibration cancellation table ($< 0.5\ \mu\text{m}/\text{s}$ RMS vibration velocity in $1\text{--}100\text{ Hz}$ band).
3. Test linear piezo-stage feedback loop along $X/Y$ axes; stage thermal drift rate must stabilize below $0.8\text{ nm/min}$.

#### Step 4: Fiducial Alignment & Array-Periphery Boundary Registration
1. Perform coarse optical notch and global wafer alignment using primary wafer alignment marks at $(X_0, Y_0)$ and $(X_1, Y_1)$.
2. Step interferometer stage to the memory array boundary test structure where the dense $8F^2$ array ($360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch) interfaces with periphery sense amplifier blocks ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
3. Perform optical pattern recognition on the boundary verniers and calibrate stage coordinate transformation matrix to align mechanical axes with optical lithography axes.

#### Step 5: Automated Metrology Tooling Lock & DRC Sign-off Run Hand-off
1. Switch to electron beam column under high vacuum ($< 1 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
2. Acquire critical dimension images across the boundary transition:
   * Wordline/bitline pitch boundary ($360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$).
   * Tungsten plug ($W$-plug) contact landing enclosure and overlap rules.
   * Access transistor gate dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
3. Stream coordinate-matched metrology feature dimensions into the Automated DRC Sign-off Engine to validate array-periphery proximity spacing rules.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Instrument / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Chuck Flatness / Runout (TTV)** | $0.4\ \mu\text{m}$ | $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ across $200\text{ mm}$ | Non-contact laser displacement interferometer |

```text
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Step 1: Benchmark Critical Dimensions (CD) and Pitch Baseline**
   - Calibrate CD-SEM metrology tools across test reticles for dense array access transistors: verify nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Measure dense periodic array pitch to ensure conformance to the nominal $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ range for both bitline (BL) and wordline (WL).
   - Verify gate dielectric physical thickness targets of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ formed via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C to } 900^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Step 2: Array-to-Periphery Boundary Metrology Calibration**
   - Define inspection sites at the transition boundary where dense repeating $8F^2$ array cells terminate into CMOS sense amplifier pitch-matching logic.
   - Quantify nested-to-isolated line bias and optical proximity effect (OPE) line-end pullbacks at the shared bitline contact and pass-gate drain regions.
   - Calibrate tungsten plug (W-plug) contact overlays between the stacked capacitor bottom electrode and access transistor drain junction.

3. **Step 3: DRC Deck Rule Optimization & Execution**
   - Load the full-chip DRC deck configuring custom spacing and enclosure rules for the array boundary:
     - Check nested bitline/wordline line-end extensions into periphery dummy cells.
     - Validate spacing rules around shared bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C pairs.
     - Enforce minimum stacked capacitor footprint clearances (ensuring adequate volume for $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ storage capability).
   - Execute hierarchical full-chip DRC run across all boundary coordinates.

4. **Step 4: Machine Cleansing & Sign-Off Verification**
   - Run automated DRC error cleansing scripts to clear false-positive density violations caused by array-periphery density gradients.
   - Perform automated pattern-recognition CD metrology confirmation on worst-case boundary pinch/bridge hazard sites.
   - Generate sign-off certificate confirming zero fatal DRC spacing violations and metrology compliance within process window limits.

---

```text
Gate Ox Tox┤░                                          │

           └┬──────────┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬┘
            0         95        190        285      380 
```

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360 to 400` | Target range $[360, 400]$, CD-SEM boundary tolerance $\le \pm 5\%$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | `L = 180`, `W = 220` | Length $180 \pm 9$, Width $220 \pm 11$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | Ellipsometry / TEM target $3.5 \pm 0.2$ (grown at $850^\circ\text{C to } 900^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance & Retention** | $\ge 28$ ($\ge 25\text{ to } 30$) | Electrical test $\ge 25\text{ fF/cell}$ (retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact topology; minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage limit below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with W-plug.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Folded bitline differential sensing operation; bitline and cell capacitance parameters ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$).
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ architecture; cell capacitor target $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C to } 900^\circ\text{C}$ yielding $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

2. **Hierarchical Boundary Pattern & Pitch Verification**

3. **Critical Transistor & Contact Boundary Geometry Check**
   - Execute DRC extraction on all perimeter access transistors to ensure nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

4. **Full-Chip Physical DRC Run & Cleansing**
   - Execute hierarchical flat/boundary DRC sign-off across the full chip assembly (array, decoders, folded-bitline sense amplifiers, and peripheral logic).

5. **CD-SEM Metrology Review & Physical Parameter Validation**
   - Cross-reference lithography CD-SEM measurements at the array-periphery boundary against gate oxide physical thickness ($~3.5\text{ nm}$) and high-$k$ dielectric EOT target ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
