# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off
- **Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) | 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$)
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm)

---

## 1. Process Overview & Parameter Verification Workflow

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: Topological Netlist & Connectivity Extraction                  |
| - Verify 8F^2 unit cell footprint: Area = 0.259 um^2 (F = 180 nm)      |
| - Check access transistor geometry: L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm            |
| - Validate shared bitline contact topology (1 contact per 2 cells)    |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: LVS Clean Pin-to-Pin & Device Match Verification              |
| - Match Storage Node Capacitor (MIM / Crown / ONO) pin connectivity   |
| - Enforce 0 unmatched nets, 0 port mismatches, 0 false shorts/opens   |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: Parasitic Extraction (PEX) for Bitline & Storage Node         |
| - Extract lumped cell storage capacitance (C_s)                       |
| - Extract total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance (C_b / C_BL)     |
|   for array column blocks of 256 to 512 cells per bitline             |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 4: Transfer Ratio & Differential Read Margin Sign-Off            |
| - Calculate capacitance ratio: C_b / C_s                              |
| - Quantify differential readout signal:                               |
|   Delta V = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_DD / 2)                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### Detailed Execution Steps

1. **Topological Extraction & Geometry Audit**:
   - Extract device dimensions from GDSII layout. Verify access NMOS gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure cell footprint strictly measures $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ matching the folded bitline $8F^2$ baseline.
   - Confirm shared bitline contact topology between adjacent mirror cells over the active area.

2. **LVS Equivalence Check**:
   - Run hierarchical rule checks matching layout ports (`BL`, `/BL`, `WL`, `SN`, `V_plate`) against the spice schematic.
   - Confirm device recognition for the access NMOS transistor and storage node capacitor $C_s$ with zero topology discrepancies.

3. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Extract 3D field parasitic capacitance across the full bitline column block (256 or 512 cells per line).
   - Extract the storage node capacitance $C_s$ across the tungsten plug (W-plug) and high-$\kappa$ / ONO dielectric stack.

4. **Signal Development & Margin Calculation**:
   - Evaluate bitline-to-cell capacitance transfer ratio $C_b / C_s$.
   - Confirm the developed read signal $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ achieves the minimum required voltage for reliable latching by the sense amplifier.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Identifier | Parameter Description | Sign-Off Target Window | Verification Condition / Units | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-LVS-01** | Unit Cell Layout Area | $= 0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$) | PASS / FAIL |
| **AC-LVS-02** | Access Transistor Dimensions | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ (Layout extraction dimension) | PASS / FAIL |
| **AC-LVS-03** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ (Post-extraction lumped $C$) | PASS / FAIL |
| **AC-LVS-04** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ (For 256 or 512 cells per line) | PASS / FAIL |
| **AC-LVS-05** | Bitline-to-Cell Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ (Hard ceiling $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless ratio | PASS / FAIL |
| **AC-LVS-06** | Differential Readout Voltage ($\Delta V$) | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ (At sense amp differential nodes) | PASS / FAIL |

---

## 3. Literature Citations & Traceability

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Signal development relationship: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
   - Baseline signal margin: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, producing signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (nominally $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline parasitic budget: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Design margin constraint: $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$; degradation threshold at $> 10:1$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Minimum capacitance target of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ with shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-LVS-180NM-1T1C-001`
### Title: GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) | Generation: Gen 2 (µm) | Action Type: Make

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDS Stream Import &   │
│     Layer Mapping      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boolean Device & Pin  │
│       Derivation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      1T1C Device       │
│   Recognition & Net    │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    LVS Comparison &    │
│   Parasitic Sign-off   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDS Stream Import & Layer Table Mapping**
   - Import the 180nm $8F^2$ DRAM cell/array GDSII layout database into the extraction engine (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Netgen / Calibre).
   - Map physical mask levels: Active/Diffusion (OD), Wordline/Gate Poly (PO), Bitline Contact (BC), Bitline Metal/Poly (BL), Storage Node Contact (SN/W-plug), Crown/Cylinder Stacked Capacitor Bottom/Top Plate (CAP), and Metal Interconnects.

2. **Boolean Layer Operations & Pin Recognition**
   - Derive the n-channel 1T1C access transistor channel region: `Gate_Channel = Poly AND Active`.
   - Identify pin and label geometries on text layers across hierarchical boundaries: Wordline (`WL`), Bitline (`BL`), and Plate Line (`V_PL` / `V_DD/2`).
   - Flag and bind multi-cut shared bitline contacts between adjacent memory cells to enforce shared source/drain net integrity.

3. **Device Recognition & Connectivity Extraction**
   - **Access Transistor Extraction:** Extract NMOS transistor parameters: drawn channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - **Stacked Capacitor Extraction:** Extract 1T1C storage capacitor ($C_s$) formed over bitline via tungsten plug contact. Parameterize capacitor bottom-plate area/perimeter based on crown geometry and dielectric properties ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Build hierarchical SPICE subcircuit netlist (`layout_extracted.sp`) capturing connectivity between cell node, access transistor, bitline, and cell plate.

4. **LVS Equivalence Check & Discrepancy Resolution**
   - Run layout-versus-schematic comparison against the golden 1T1C schematic netlist.
   - Match pin topologies, cross-coupled folded bitline pairs, and cell symmetry.
   - Verify zero un-extracted devices, zero short circuits, and zero open nets.

5. **Parasitic Metric Extraction & Sign-off**
   - Extract lumped and distributed parasitic capacitance on the bitline ($C_{\text{BL}}$) and storage node ($C_s$).
   - Verify differential sensing signal margin:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Archive extraction report and freeze sign-off database.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Identifier | Target Specification | Exact Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions** | Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.0\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid/sizing extraction mismatch) | $\text{nm}$ |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## GDS Layer-to-Mask Map & Boolean Derivation Layer Definition (180nm 8F² DRAM)

---

### 1. Architectural Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               GDSII Stream Input (Calma)               │
│        (Layer / Datatype: DIFF, POLY, CONT, M1...)     │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             GDS-to-Mask Layer Map Loading              │
│       (Mapping stream numbers to symbolic masks)       │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│            Boolean Layer Derivation Execution          │
│ • Active Channel: DIFF AND POLY                        │
│ • S/D Terminals: DIFF NOT POLY                         │
│ • Storage Node: SN_CONTACT AND MIM_BOTTOM              │
│ • Bitline Contact: BL_CONTACT AND M1_BL                │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          Device Pin & Connectivity Extraction          │
│ • Access Transistor (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm)           │
│ • Stacked Capacitor (Crown/Cylinder MIM, Cs >= 28 fF)  │
│ • Wordline & Bitline Terminals (Pitch: 360 - 400 nm)   │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             LVS-Ready Clean Device Netlist             │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDS Layer Mapping Table Ingestion**:
   - Ingest physical GDSII stream layer and data-type definitions into the DRC/LVS rule engine:
     - `DIFF` (Layer 1, Datatype 0) -> Substrate Active Area.
     - `POLY` (Layer 2, Datatype 0) -> Wordline Gate Conductor.
     - `W_PLUG_BL` (Layer 3, Datatype 0) -> Shared Bitline Tungsten Contact Plug.
     - `M1_BL` (Layer 4, Datatype 0) -> Bitline Metal 1 Runner.
     - `W_PLUG_SN` (Layer 5, Datatype 0) -> Storage Node Tungsten Contact Plug.
     - `CAP_BTM` (Layer 6, Datatype 0) -> Crown/Cylinder Bottom Electrode.
     - `CAP_DIEL` (Layer 7, Datatype 0) -> High-$\kappa$ Dielectric / ONO Mask.
     - `CAP_TOP` (Layer 8, Datatype 0) -> Top Plate Counter-Electrode ($V_{DD}/2$ Plate).

2. **Boolean Layer Derivations**:
   - **Access Transistor Channel**: Derive `T_GATE = DIFF AND POLY`. Validate dimension gates against channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - **Source/Drain Terminals**: Derive `SD_DIFF = DIFF NOT POLY`.
   - **Shared Bitline Node**: Derive `BL_DIFF_NODE = SD_DIFF AND W_PLUG_BL` (shared between two adjacent 1T1C cells along the active line).
   - **Storage Node Drain Junction**: Derive `SN_DIFF_NODE = SD_DIFF AND W_PLUG_SN`.
   - **Stacked Capacitor Body**: Derive `CELL_CAP = (CAP_BTM AND CAP_TOP) ENCLOSED_BY CAP_DIEL` to establish active 3D capacitor formation above the tungsten plug.

3. **Terminal, Pin, and Connectivity Graph Generation**:
   - Establish electrical nodes via topological overlaps:
     - `CONNECT SD_DIFF, W_PLUG_BL BY OVERLAP`
     - `CONNECT W_PLUG_BL, M1_BL BY OVERLAP`
     - `CONNECT SD_DIFF, W_PLUG_SN BY OVERLAP`
     - `CONNECT W_PLUG_SN, CAP_BTM BY OVERLAP`
   - Formulate wordline and bitline conductive rails confirming bitline and wordline pitch within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

4. **Device Extraction and Metric Sign-off Deck Compilation**:
   - Extract 1T1C NMOS access transistor instance parameters: effective channel length ($L_{eff} = 180\text{ nm}$), channel width ($W_{eff} = 220\text{ nm}$), with thermal gate oxide thickness target equivalent to $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$.
   - Extract MIM/Crown stacked storage capacitor instance ($C_s$) using high-$\kappa$ dielectric parameters ($\kappa > 15$ or equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
   - Export extracted netlist formatted for LVS comparison against the reference 8F² folded bitline cell schematic.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
       DRAM Extraction & Retention Sign-off Targets
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░                                 │
 Leakage Limit @ 85C┤░                                 │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
Retention Time @ 85C┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
 Delta V Read Window┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   C_cell Min Target┤███████                           │
                    │███████                           │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0    37.5     75.0    112.5 150.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Exact Physical Target | Sign-off Tolerance / Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions** | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ |
| **Wordline / Bitline Pitch** | $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ | Minimum $360\text{ nm}$ boundary |
| **Stacked Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25\text{ fF to } 28\text{ fF}$ per cell | Target $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ |
| **Gate Dielectric Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ |
| **Capacitor Dielectric EOT** | $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) | $\le 4.0\text{ nm}$ |
| **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ (at $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$) | Range: $100 - 150\text{ mV}$ |
| **Cell Leakage & Data Retention Target** | Leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact via W-plug, crown/MIM stacked capacitor topology.
  - Dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$) with $\kappa > 15$, minimum cell capacitance target $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and cell leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, yielding $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8\text{F}^2$ 1T1C stacked cell layout, wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$), dielectric $\text{EOT}$ of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, and cell storage capacitance $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Title: Access Transistor & Storage Capacitor Device Extraction Rule Implementation **Module Path**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²)` > `1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²)` > `Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off` > `GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction` > `GDS Layer Mapping and Device Extraction Rule Deck Setup` > `Access Transistor & Storage Capacitor Device Extraction Rule Implementation` **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type**: Make | **Target Architecture**: 8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB) --- ### 1. Workflow & Topology Diagram ```mermaid graph TD A["GDS II Stream Layers
(DIFF, POLY, CONT, M1/BL, SN_CONT, CROWN, TOP_PLT)"] --> B["Boolean Layer Operations
Active Gate = DIFF AND POLY
Cap Bottom Node = CROWN AND SN_CONT"] B --> C["Device Extraction: NMOS Access FET
Extract W = 220 nm, L = 180 nm
Gate: Wordline (POLY) | Source: Bitline Contact (CONT)"] B --> D["Device Extraction: Stacked Capacitor (Cs)
Dielectric: ONO / Ta2O5 Stack
Plate 1: Storage Node (SN) | Plate 2: VPLATE / Cell Plate"] C --> E["LVS Extracted SPICE Netlist
(.subckt dram_cell_1t1c BL WL VPLATE)"] D --> E E --> F["LVS Comparison & Metric Sign-off
Extract Cs >= 25 fF to 30 fF
Pin & Connectivity Verification"] ``` --- ### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure 1. **GDS Layer Definition & Logical Derivation**: - Map physical layout layers: Active Diffusion (`DIFF`), Wordline Conductor (`POLY`), Diffusion Contact (`CONT`), Bitline Metal (`M1`), Storage Node Contact Via (`SN_CONT`), Crown Bottom Electrode (`CROWN`), and Top Cell Plate (`TOP_PLT`). - Define boolean derived layers in the extraction deck: - `GATE_CHAN = DIFF AND POLY` - `SOURCE_DRAIN = DIFF NOT POLY` - `BL_NODE = SOURCE_DRAIN AND CONT` (shared contact between adjacent cells) - `SN_NODE = SOURCE_DRAIN AND SN_CONT` (storage node tungsten plug interface) - `CAP_ACTIVE = CROWN AND TOP_PLT` 2. **Access Transistor Device Extraction Rule Syntax**: - Implement parametric MOSFET extraction rule: - Recognize device terminal geometry: Gate = `POLY`, Source/Drain = `SOURCE_DRAIN`, Substrate = `PWELL/SUB`. - Set extraction parameter equations: Length $L = \text{perimeter}(\text{GATE\_CHAN} \cap \text{SOURCE\_DRAIN}) / 2 = 180\text{ nm}$; Width $W = \text{area}(\text{GATE\_CHAN}) / L = 220\text{ nm}$. - Pin assignment: Map shared node to `BL` and isolated node to internal storage terminal `SN`. 3. **Stacked Storage Capacitor ($C_s$) Device Extraction Rule Syntax**: - Implement custom 2-terminal capacitor extraction (`CAPACITOR` / subcircuit model): - Terminal 1 (Positive / Storage Node): `SN_NODE` connected upward through `CROWN`. - Terminal 2 (Negative / Common Plate): `TOP_PLT` (biased at cell plate voltage $V_{\text{PLATE}} = V_{DD}/2$). - Model formula: Compute extracted capacitance $C_s$ based on crown bottom area and 3D sidewall perimeter using equivalent oxide thickness (EOT = 3.0 nm – 4.0 nm) and high-$k$ dielectric constant ($\kappa > 15$). Ensure calculated unit cell capacitance defaults to $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$. 4. **Netlist Generation & LVS Verification**: - Compile extraction rules and run GDS-to-netlist extraction. - Cross-compare the extracted hierarchical SPICE netlist against the golden 1T1C schematic netlist (`BL`, `WL`, and common `VPLATE`). - Flag any soft-error susceptibility, layout mismatches, dangling storage nodes, or dimensional deviations outside physical specs. --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets | Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | `180` | nm | $\pm 0.0$ nm (Exact nominal drawn) | LVS parameter comparison vs. schematic | | **Access Transistor Gate Width ($W$)** | `220` | nm | $\pm 0.0$ nm (Exact nominal drawn) | LVS parameter comparison vs. schematic | | **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` (Min allowable: `25.0` to `30.0`) | fF | Minimum $\ge 25.0\text{ fF/cell}$ | Extracted SPICE netlist capacitive parasitics | | **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | nm | $\pm 0.2$ nm | Process deck & rule validation limit | | **Capacitor Dielectric EOT** | `3.0 to 4.0` | nm | [3.0, 4.0] nm range | Rule deck dielectric property sign-off | | **Cell Retention Leakage Target** | `< 1.0` | fA/cell | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell at 85°C}$ | Post-layout SPICE sub-threshold simulation | --- ### 4. Verified Literature Citations - **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: - *Transistor Geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact between adjacent cells. - *Capacitor Structure & Dielectrics*: Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug); ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$. - *Capacitance & Leakage Limits*: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. - **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: - *Cell Architecture*: 1T1C cell in $8F^2$ topology; storage capacitor maintained between $25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$ per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. - *Physical Thicknesses*: $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$; capacitor dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $\sim 3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$. - **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: - *Capacitive Ratios & Precharge*: Bitlines equalized to $V_{DD}/2$; typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ driving $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.

## 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
│      Extraction      │
```

```text
       180nm 1T1C LVS Extraction Geometric & Target Budgets     
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░                                  │
    Cell Cs (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│

   Access W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
   Access L (nm)┤███████████████████                   │

                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       95        190      285     380 
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDS II Layer Mapping & Boolean Pre-Processing**:
   - Ingest target layout GDS II stream file and parse layer-datatype mappings according to the 180nm open-source process design kit (PDK).
   - Execute geometric Boolean operations:
     - Form active diffusion regions via `ACTIVE = DIFF NOT NWELL`.
     - Form gate channels via `GATE = POLY AND ACTIVE`.
     - Derive capacitor contact via `SN_NODE = W_PLUG AND POLY_CROWN` and bitline node via `BL_NODE = W_PLUG AND METAL1`.
2. **Device Recognition & Parameter Extraction**:
   - Extract access NMOS transistors: identify terminal connectivity for Source (shared bitline contact `BL`), Drain (storage node `SN`), Gate (wordline `WL`), and Bulk (P-substrate `VBB`).
   - Extract physical dimensions from layout geometries: evaluate channel length $L$ and channel width $W$.
   - Extract stacked storage capacitor ($C_s$) topology (Crown/Cylinder MIM or Polysilicon) erected above the drain contact through the tungsten plug (W-plug).
3. **Pin & Port Connectivity Graph Generation**:
   - Extract pin text labels and boundary port shapes from metallization layers (`METAL1` for bitline, `POLY`/`METAL` for wordline, and plate voltage `V_CP`).
   - Run connectivity tracing from contacts up through tungsten plugs and metal interconnects to build the layout electrical graph.
   - Detect shorts, opens, floating gates, and uncontacted diffusion regions prior to netlist pairing.
4. **Golden Schematic Pairing & Isomorphism Comparison**:
   - Read Golden SPICE netlist defining the $8F^2$ folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cell matrix and complementary sense amplifier latch ($BL$ / $/BL$).
   - Perform graph isomorphism comparison: match instance names, terminal assignments, pin definitions, and device parameters ($W, L, C$).
   - Flag any discrepancies (device mismatches, net shorts/opens, or port naming differences) for corrective layout loop.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Specification | Tolerance / Window | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | $\pm 0.0$ (Exact grid matching) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | $\pm 0.0$ (Exact grid matching) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360` to `400` | $[360, 400]$ range | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Storage Node Extracted Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0$ (Target $\ge 28.0$) | Nominal target budget | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **LVS Netlist Comparison Discrepancies** | `0` (Zero shorts, opens, device mismatches) | Clean Sign-off (`0`) | Count |

---

## 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Unit cell architecture: $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells.
  - Storage node structure: Crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM capacitor contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Target minimum storage capacitance: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring noise immunity and refresh retention.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Complementary bitline interconnect topology ($BL$ and $/BL$) connected to cross-coupled latch sense amplifier.
  - Typical cell storage capacitance benchmark: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Cell layout & retention requirements: $8F^2$ architecture requiring storage capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Interconnect geometry: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Netlist-to-GDS Geometric Recognition and Connectivity Extraction

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) [DRAM Architecture] > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) [Circuit Design] > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off [Circuit Design] > GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction [Circuit Design] > Netlist-to-GDS Geometric Recognition and Connectivity Extraction [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm, Particle Count < 5 / wafer.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using 4-Point Probe / Ellipsometer / Fume Hood Interlock.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: GDS Layer Boolean Operations & Device Recognition Rule Formulation
**Discipline:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification (LVS)  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Topology:** 1T1C DRAM Cell ($8F^2$ Folded Bitline Architecture)

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Raw GDSII Mask     │
│         Stream         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Layer Boolean      │
│      Derivations       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Device Recognition &  │
│     Pin Derivation     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Connectivity      │
│    Extraction & LVS    │
│      Clean Match       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDS Layer Mapping & Primary Layer Ingestion:**
   - Ingest raw GDSII stream layers: Active/Diffusion (`DIFF`), Polysilicon Wordline (`POLY`), N-Well / P-Well implants (`NWEL`/`PWEL`), N+ / P+ Source-Drain implants (`NIMP`/`PIMP`), Bitline Contact / Contact Plug (`CONT`/`W-plug`), Bitline Metal (`M1`), Storage Node Contact Pad (`SNCP`), Crown/Cylinder Capacitor Bottom Plate (`SN_CAP`), Capacitor Top Plate/Plate Line (`PLATE`), and Via levels (`VIA1`).

2. **Formulate Geometric Boolean Operations:**
   - **Active Gate Conductor:** Derive access gate geometry by boolean AND of active diffusion and poly wordline:  
     $$\text{GATE\_1T} = \text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$$
   - **Access Transistor Source/Drain Regions:** Derive active diffusion diffusions outside gate poly:  
     $$\text{DIFF\_SD} = \text{DIFF} \setminus \text{POLY}$$
   - **1T1C Access Transistor Channel Identification:** Intersect gate with N-implant in P-well:  
     $$\text{CHAN\_1T} = \text{GATE\_1T} \cap \text{NIMP} \setminus \text{NWEL}$$
   - **Stacked Capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) Dielectric Overlap:** Derive capacitor recognition layer from bottom storage electrode and top plate intersection:  
     $$\text{CAP\_AREA} = \text{SN\_CAP} \cap \text{PLATE}$$

3. **Terminal Pin Derivation & Terminal Recognition:**
   - **Gate Terminal ($G$):** Poly wordline connected directly to $\text{CHAN\_1T}$ along the wordline track.
   - **Bitline Terminal ($D$ or $S_1$):** Formed by active diffusion $\text{DIFF\_SD}$ contacting the shared bitline contact tungsten plug:  
     $$\text{BL\_DIFF} = \text{DIFF\_SD} \cap \text{CONT} \cap \text{M1}$$
   - **Storage Node Terminal ($S$ or $S_2$):** Formed by active diffusion contacting the crown tungsten plug (W-plug):  
     $$\text{SN\_DIFF} = \text{DIFF\_SD} \cap \text{SNCP}$$
   - **Capacitor Storage ($C_s$) Node Pins:** Node 1 corresponds to $\text{SN\_CAP} \cap \text{SNCP}$; Node 2 connects to the common cell plate line $\text{PLATE}$ biased at $V_{DD}/2$.

4. **Device Property Extraction & Netlist Formulation:**
   - Extract drawn channel length $L = \text{Perpendicular\_Length}(\text{GATE\_1T})$ and drawn width $W = \text{Parallel\_Width}(\text{GATE\_1T})$.
   - Extract capacitor surface area and perimeter, scaling with high-$k$ dielectric equivalent thickness to yield storage node capacitance $C_s$.
   - Output extracted spice subcircuit for comparison against schematic netlist:
     ```spice
     * 1T1C Memory Cell Instance
     M_ACC BL WL SN VSS NMOS_1T W=220n L=180n
     C_CELL SN PLATE C=28fF
     ```

5. **LVS Connectivity & Ambiguity Resolution:**
   - Enforce shared bitline contact symmetry rules between adjacent 1T1C cells to resolve pin interchangeability between complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Run LVS geometric topology checking to confirm error-free pin connectivity and 1:1 schematic-to-layout isomorphism.

---

### Dimensional & Metric Parameters

```text
                                                        
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░                                  │
  Target Cs (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
     L Gate (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
     W Gate (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       90        180      270     360 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated LVS Boolean edge measurement on $\text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated LVS Boolean edge measurement on $\text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$ |
| **Wordline / Bitline Interconnect Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | 2D DRC/LVS pitch and spacing measurement on $\text{POLY}$ & $\text{M1}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (Nominal range: $25 \text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extraction netlist parameter check (assuring retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parasitic device electrical parameter threshold evaluation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Citations
- **Source 1:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown-shaped structure with W-plug, dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$), capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — 1T1C $8F^2/6F^2$ architecture, cell capacitance range $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, high-$k$ dielectric EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$, thermal dry gate oxide physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 3:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* — Folded-bitline cell charge distribution, precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, sensing signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Interleaved Sense Amp & Array Pin Connectivity Graph Extraction

### Workflow Architecture
```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   GDS Layout Input    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Layer Polygon Boolean │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Array Bitline     │
│    Contact Tracing    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Interleaved Pitch   │
│        Mapping        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     SA Latch Port     │
│       Matching        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Pin Graph & Netlist  │
│       LVS Clean       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **GDS Layout Ingestion & Layer Definition**:
   - Stream in the 180nm GDS-II database containing the 1T1C $8F^2$ DRAM array block and adjacent sense amplifier strip layouts.
   - Decompose polygon layers into active diffusion ($W = 220\text{ nm}$), poly gate ($L = 180\text{ nm}$), tungsten contact plugs (W-plug), bitline metallization, and storage-node capacitor connections.

2. **Array Bitline Contact Recognition**:
   - Run 2D geometric boolean operations to identify shared bitline contacts between adjacent access transistors.
   - Trace continuous bitline metal polygons traversing the memory core down to the boundary ring.

3. **Interleaved Pitch Mapping & Spatial Assignment**:
   - Due to the memory bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$), map alternating bitline pairs ($BL_{2k}$ to the top SA strip and $BL_{2k+1}$ to the bottom SA strip).
   - Trace complementary pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$) across the folded-bitline topology into the respective differential sense amplifier column boundaries.

4. **Sense Amplifier Port & Equalization Node Connectivity**:
   - Extract pin-to-node connectivity for the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch ports ($SAN$, $SAP$) and the bitline equalization/precharge network ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Verify that all physical metal-to-pin overlaps resolve without dangling open circuits or shorted complementary paths.

5. **Pin Connectivity Graph Construction & LVS Cross-Check**:
   - Construct a directed bipartite connectivity graph connecting array bitline terminals to sense amplifier I/O pins.
   - Compare the extracted layout connectivity graph against the schematic netlist to verify zero topological discrepancies.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        Extraction Metric Thresholds    
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░                                │
Leakage Sign-off (fA)┤░                                │
                     │▒▒▒                              │
     Cell Target (fF)┤▒▒▒                              │
  BL Cap Tracing (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
  Pitch Matching (nm)┤█████████████████████████████████│
                     │█████████████████████████████████│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      90      180     270    360 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **$360$** | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC/GDS pitch measurement along array-to-SA boundary |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$\approx 250$** (sign-off target) | $\text{fF}$ | Parasitic Extraction (PEX) 2.5D/3D field solver |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28$** | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted MIM/Stacked capacitor model integration |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Sign-Off** | **$\le 1$** at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE post-layout sub-threshold/junction simulation |

---

### Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ in folded-bitline topology; precharge to $V_{DD}/2$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Pitch matching constraint: Sense amplifier pitch matches memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node), requiring interleaved layout.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

*Captured into knowledge base at [sop_interleaved_sense_amp_pin_graph_extraction.md](docs/sop_interleaved_sense_amp_pin_graph_extraction.md).*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Extracted Netlist Versus Schematic Topology & Node Equivalence Metrology

**Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — 1T1C Bitcell Array & Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Subsystems  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Verification

---

### 1. Metrology Architecture & Verification Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│    Layout GDSII Geometry & Golden SPICE/CDL   │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│   Device Layer Boolean & Pin LVS Extraction   │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│        Graph Isomorphism & Topology           │
│             Node Matching Matrix              │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│     Parametric Tolerance & Sign-off Check     │
│   (W/L Ratios, C_s, C_BL, Gate Tox, EOT)      │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Extraction Rule Deck & Netlist Ingestion**:
   - Compile the 180nm GDS-II database against the Golden Hierarchical SPICE / CDL netlist.
   - Run connectivity extraction across active diffusion, polysilicon wordline (WL), tungsten plug contacts (W-plug), bitline (BL, /BL), and capacitor over bitline (COB) metal/dielectric plates.

2. **Graph Isomorphism & Structural Topology Matching**:
   - Formulate bipartite connectivity graphs representing:
     - The schematic netlist (containing 1T1C storage cells, equalization networks, and cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier latches).
     - The GDS-extracted netlist.
   - Execute topological nodal matching to confirm zero net, pin, or port discrepancies:
     - Access transistor gate terminal $\rightarrow$ Wordline node (`WL`).
     - Transistor drain/source terminal $1 \rightarrow$ Shared bitline contact (`BL` or `/BL`).
     - Transistor drain/source terminal $2 \rightarrow$ Tungsten plug to bottom storage plate (`SN`).
     - Storage capacitor plate $\rightarrow$ Cell plate reference voltage (`V_PL` / `V_DD/2`).

3. **Parametric & Dimension Equivalence Evaluation**:
   - Extract physical gate geometry for the access transistors: evaluate effective channel length $L$ and channel width $W$.
   - Extract capacitor plate area and dielectric profile: verify stacked cell storage capacitance $C_s$ and bitline parasitic capacitance $C_\text{BL}$.
   - Ensure the thermal gate oxide thickness ($T_\text{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) corresponds to the intended electrical parameters.

4. **Sensing Signal Budget & Array Coupling Verification**:
   - Compute extracted signal swing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_\text{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_\text{cell} - \frac{V_\text{DD}}{2}\right)$ using extracted $C_s$ and $C_\text{BL}$.
   - Flag any bitcell node failing retention target capacitance or exceeding sub-threshold/junction leakage bounds.

5. **Sign-off Discrepancy Reporting & Archival**:
   - Export discrepancy report (`.rpt`) capturing unmatched instances, open nets, short circuits, or parameter delta outliers ($\Delta L$, $\Delta W$, $\Delta C$).
   - Output signed LVS-clean certificate upon satisfying all acceptance criteria.

---

### 3. Key Parameter Metrology Targets

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░                               │
   Cap Cs (28 fF)┤░░░░░░                               │
                 │▒▒                                   │
Gate Tox (3.5 nm)┤▒▒                                   │
Access W (220 nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Access L (180 nm)┤██████████████████████████████       │
                 │██████████████████████████████       │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       55       110      165     220 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Verification Stage | Target Nominal Value | Machine Acceptance Tolerance | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | Extracted vs Schematic Geometry | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.00\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid/dimension mismatch) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Gate Width ($W$)** | Extracted vs Schematic Geometry | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.00\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid/dimension mismatch) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Stacked Capacitor Metrology | $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ (Nominal $\ge 28\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25.0\text{ fF}$ (Minimum cutoff) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_\text{BL}$)** | Extracted BL Interconnect Net | $250\text{ fF}$ | $\le 275\text{ fF}$ ($+10\%$ ceiling) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | Readout Sensing Equivalence | $100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$ | $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ (Minimum signal margin) | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_\text{leak}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | Sub-threshold & Junction Extraction | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 5. Context & Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture via W-plug, storage capacitance minimum budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and cell leakage budget $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Folded-bitline differential topology, cross-coupled inverter latch, cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline parasitic $C_\text{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, precharge equalization to $V_\text{DD}/2$, and readout differential signal swing $\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C storage retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ maintained with storage capacitance $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$, thermal gate oxide dry oxidation thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, and pitch dimensions of $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** LVS Pin-to-Port Discrepancy Debug and Clean Equivalence Sign-off  
**Document Track:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off > GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction > LVS Pin-to-Port Discrepancy Debug and Clean Equivalence Sign-off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Extract GDS Pin     │
│    Shapes & Labels     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Generate CDL      │
│   Schematic Netlist    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Run Net-to-Node &    │
│  Pin Matching Engine   │◄──────────────────╮
│                        │                   │
└────────────┬───────────┘                   │
             │                               │
             │                               │
             ▼                               │
┌────────────◇───────────┐                   │
│                        │                   │
│  Discrepancies Found?  │                   │
│                        │                   │
└────────────◇───────────┘                   │
             │                               │
             │                               │
             ├───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────╮
             │Yes: Floating/Swapped/Mismatched Pins                          │No: 100% Topologically Matched
             ▼                               │                               ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                   │                  ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │                   │                  │                        │
│  Trace Pin Geometry &  │                   │                  │   Sign-off Clean LVS   │
│  Label Layer Bindings  │                   │                  │      Equivalence       │
│                        │                   │                  │                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘                   │                  └────────────────────────┘
             │                               │
             │                               │
             ▼                               │
┌────────────────────────┐                   │
│                        │                   │
│  Correct Pin-to-Port   │                   │
│       Aliasing &       ├───────────────────╯
│    Short/Open Nodes    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Layout Pin Extraction & Layer Binding Setup
1. Define the GDS pin identification layer table for the $180\text{ nm}$ ($F = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$) cell array ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
2. Bind layout text labels to their underlying conducting geometries:
   - Bitline true port: `BL` (Metal 1 routing layer).
   - Complementary bitline port: `/BL` (Metal 1 routing layer).
   - Wordline gate driver port: `WL` (Polysilicon / Poly-silicide gate strap layer).
   - Sense amplifier strobe control rails: `SAN` (N-sense pulldown) and `SAP` (P-sense pullup).
   - Array precharge/equalization control: `EQ` and precision reference rail `V_BLP` ($V_{DD} / 2$).
3. Ensure all label text origins are physically enclosed within the target pin boundary polygon without overlapping adjacent metal geometries or diffusion bounds.

### Step 2: Schematic Netlist Generation & Export
1. Export the golden transistor-level subcircuit netlist (`.cdl` / SPICE format) containing:
   - 1T1C storage matrix (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
   - Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch (NMOS pull-down pair, PMOS pull-up pair).
   - Equalization NMOS network tied to $V_{BLP}$.
2. Verify pin port ordering and naming syntax across subcircuit definitions:
   ```spice
   .SUBCKT SENSE_AMP_LATCH BL BL_BAR SAN SAP EQ VBLP VDD GND
   .SUBCKT CELL_1T1C WL BL SN
   ```

### Step 3: Automated LVS Netlist Comparison & Discrepancy Parsing
1. Execute the hierarchical LVS comparison engine between extracted layout devices and the schematic CDL.
2. Filter discrepancy report into three metrology categories:
   - **Port Name Mismatch / Unmatched Pins:** Unrecognized text labels or missing pin geometry declarations.
   - **Shorted Pins:** `BL` to `/BL` or `WL` to substrate/ground shorts via misalignment.
   - **Open/Floating Ports:** Polysilicon wordline segments broken across the array stitch boundary or contact vias unplaced.
3. Validate that storage capacitor node `SN` connects directly to the cell storage dielectric ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ nominal target $28\text{ fF}$) and remains internal to the sub-array block.

### Step 4: Corrective Layout Tuning & Equivalence Sign-off
1. Relocate misaligned pin label origins to the exact center coordinate of the corresponding metal contact/pad.
2. Eliminate false opens by adding missing redundant via arrays at the sense amplifier interfaces (`SAN`, `SAP`, `EQ`).
3. Re-run comparison until the report output certifies:
   ```text
   # LVS STATUS: CLEAN / EQUIVALENT
   # DEVICES MATCHED: 100%
   # NETS MATCHED: 100%
   # PORTS MATCHED: 100%
   ```

---

## 2. Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
     C_s Budget Min (fF)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
Delta V_sig Min (x10 mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
       C_b/C_s Ratio Min┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
       C_b/C_s Ratio Max┤███████████                   │
                        │███████████                   │
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0.0    6.2    12.5   18.8  25.0 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Tolerance / Bounds | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-MET-01** | LVS Pin-to-Port Equivalence Rate | **100.0%** | Exactly 0 unmatched, shorted, or open pins | `%` | LVS Equivalence Log Parsing |
| **AC-MET-02** | Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) | **$\ge 25.0$** (nominal **$28.0$**) | $25.0$ to $30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout parasitic extraction ($Q_s$ node) |
| **AC-MET-03** | Bitline Capacitance ($C_b$ or $C_{BL}$) | **$150.0$ to $250.0$** | In array block of 256 or 512 cells | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted parasitics on `BL` and `/BL` |
| **AC-MET-04** | Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | **$5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$** | Must remain $< 10.0 : 1$ (margin degrades at $\ge 10:1$) | Ratio | Ratio calculated from extracted $C_b$ and $C_s$ |
| **AC-MET-05** | Differential Read Voltage ($\Delta V$) | **$100.0$ to $150.0$** | Minimum $\ge 100.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Signal development evaluation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ |

---

## 3. Literature Context Citations

1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Footprint standard: Folded-bitline $8F^2$ ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ cell area at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Capacitance specification: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\text{ fF}$); $C_b$ parasitic capacitance of $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ across 256/512 cells per bitline.
   - Ratio requirement: $C_b / C_s$ maintained strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (severe degradation if exceeding $10:1$).
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Architecture & Signal development: Complementary folded bitlines `BL` and `/BL`, precharged to $V_{DD}/2$ via equalization network.
   - Charge transfer equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ generating $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ differential read signal margin for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
3. **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
   - Operational phases and control pin connections: Equalization control `EQ` tying bitlines to precision $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$; wordline overdrive pulse $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$; N-sense pulldown rail `SAN` (switching from $V_{DD}/2$ to $\text{GND}$); P-sense pullup rail `SAP` (activating 1–2 ns delay after `SAN` to pull high bitline to $V_{DD}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## LVS Discrepancy Parsing and Pin-to-Port Extraction Mapping
**Project:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & Metrology / LVS Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Topology:** 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Memory Array  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Flow Execution

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    GDS2 Device/Pin     │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Netlist Topology    │
│         Build          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pin-to-Port Aliasing  │
│  & Discrepancy Parse   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Equivalence Sign-off  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDS2 Layout Device and Text/Pin Layer Extraction:**
   - Compile the layout extraction rule deck with exact layer mapping for 180nm CMOS/DRAM layers (Active, Poly gate, Tungsten contact plug `W-plug`, Bitline Metal, and MIM / Crown capacitor top/bottom plates).
   - Ensure text labels on layout pins strictly attach to their respective pin shapes for access transistor gates, shared bitline contacts (`BL`, `/BL`), wordlines (`WL`), plate bias (`V_PLATE`), and sense-amplifier control lines (`SAN`, `SAP`).

2. **Extracted Netlist Generation & Dimension Extraction:**
   - Execute geometric parasitic and device extraction.
   - Extract 1T1C access transistor channel dimensions verifying exact physical geometries: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Map stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structures connected through tungsten plugs (`W-plug`) to verify physical cell capacitance extraction.

3. **Pin-to-Port Connectivity Aliasing & Topology Compilation:**
   - Build hierarchical pin-to-port mapping between the schematic netlist and extracted layout netlist.
   - Correlate complementary bitline pairs (`BL` and `/BL`) to the interleaved folded-bitline sense-amplifier ports matching array pitch ($360\text{ nm}$).
   - Parse global and local supply rails (`V_DD`, `GND`, `V_DD / 2` equalization nodes).

4. **LVS Discrepancy Parsing & Error Isolation:**
   - Parse the LVS comparator report for:
     - **Unmatched Pins / Ports:** Identify pin open circuits, floating labels, or non-coincident label-to-metal coordinates.
     - **Net Discrepancies:** Detect shorts between adjacent bitlines (`BL` to `/BL`) or swapped folded-bitline pairings along the sense-amplifier boundary.
     - **Device Property Tolerances:** Check geometric and extracted capacitance mismatches exceeding sign-off thresholds.

5. **Equivalence Sign-off & Extraction Export:**
   - Re-run LVS with pin-swapping and symmetry recognition enabled for cross-coupled inverter pairs in the sense-amplifier latch.
   - Confirm zero unmatched nets, zero unmatched devices, and zero port mismatches; export clean calibrated netlist for post-layout parasitic extraction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                                                        
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
   Pitch (nm)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                │
W_access (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                │
  dV_min (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
    C_BL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
     C_s (fF)┤████                                     │
             │████                                     │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0        90        180       270      360 
```

1. **Access Transistor Extracted Channel Dimensions:**
   - Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$ (grid-snapped).
   - Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$.
2. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$):**
   - Minimum extracted capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ (typical nominal $25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).
3. **Array Bitline Pitch Matching:**
   - Sense amplifier and bitline layout pitch: exactly $360\text{ nm}$ in the 180nm node interleaved layout.
4. **Signal Sensing Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$) Margin:**
   - $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ under nominal $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$.
5. **Sub-threshold and Junction Leakage Current:**
   - Maximum leakage target: $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Transition to 8F² folded bitline with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Tungsten plug (`W-plug`) contact and ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
  - Folded-bitline cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch between complementary bitlines `BL` and `/BL`.
  - Signal charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ developing differential voltage $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$; latch activation through `SAN` (pulls to GND) and `SAP` (pulls to $V_{DD}$).
  - Interleaved layout pitch matching array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Full-Chip LVS Hierarchical Clean Equivalence & ERC Sign-off Metrology

**Document ID:** SOP-DRAM180-MET-LVS-001  
**Target Node:** 180nm Planar CMOS / 8F² Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) DRAM  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial EDA / Foundry Sign-off Ruledeck Verification)  
**Parent Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > LVS Pin-to-Port Discrepancy Debug and Clean Equivalence Sign-off > Full-Chip LVS Hierarchical Clean Equivalence & ERC Sign-off Metrology

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the sign-off flow for hierarchical Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) equivalence matching and Electrical Rule Checking (ERC) across the full-chip 180nm 1T1C DRAM design. It validates electrical topology, port-to-pin mapping, device parameter bounds, well connectivity, and capacitor dielectric extraction from full-chip GDSII stream data against the gold post-layout SPICE netlist.

---

### 2. Operational Procedure

```
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
   | Step 1: Input Database & Ruledeck Environment Setup   |
   | (Load GDSII Stream, CDL Netlist, Foundry DRC/LVS/ERC) |
   +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                               |
                               v
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
   | Step 2: Hierarchical Boundary & Sub-block Pre-match   |
   | (1T1C Matrix Array, Sense Amplifiers, Row/Col Decoders)|
   +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                               |
                               v
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
   | Step 3: ERC Full-Chip Execution & Well/Gate Validation|
   | (Floating Wells, Thin-Oxide Over-Voltage, Gate Ties)  |
   +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                               |
                               v
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
   | Step 4: Device Extraction & Physical Parameter Bounds |
   | (L=180 nm, W=220 nm, C_s >= 28 fF, Tox=3.5 nm oxide)  |
   +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                               |
                               v
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
   | Step 5: Full-Chip Equivalence Matrix & Clean Sign-off |
   | (Pin-to-Port Isomorphism, 0 Discrepancies, Check-in)  |
   +-------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Ingestion & Ruledeck Configuration
1. Import the taped-out full-chip GDSII stream database and the golden schematic netlist (CDL/SPICE format).
2. Configure the 180nm foundry LVS/ERC runset with exact device extraction definitions for:
   - 1T1C access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Stacked Crown/MIM capacitors using ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ dielectrics.
   - Complementary folded-bitline cross-coupled sense amplifiers and precharge equalization networks ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).

#### Step 2: Hierarchical Cell Instantiation & Port Mapping
1. Define hierarchical checking boundaries for repeated dense blocks: memory core sub-arrays ($8\text{F}^2$ unit cells), sense amplifier banks, wordline drivers, and perimeter pad rings.
2. Run pin-to-port equivalence checks on bitlines ($\text{BL}$, $\overline{\text{BL}}$), wordlines ($\text{WL}$), capacitor top-plate bias ($V_{\text{plate}}$), and sense amplifier latch signals ($\text{SAN}$, $\text{SAP}$). Verify 100% matched labeling with zero open/short circuits.

#### Step 3: Electrical Rule Checking (ERC) Sign-off Run
1. Execute full-chip ERC rules to detect:
   - Floating n-well and p-well substrate taps across memory arrays and periphery logic.
   - Direct gate oxide ties to power rails violating electrostatic discharge (ESD) or antenna safety margins.
   - High-voltage overstress across thin gate oxides ($3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$).
2. Debug and clear all ERC warnings; verify substrate/well contact tap density complies with latch-up prevention rules.

#### Step 4: Device Parameter Extraction & Tolerance Audit
1. Extract passive and active device metrics using 2.5D/3D field extraction models:
   - Verify access transistor gate dimensions meet target channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Extract stacked storage node capacitance $C_s$ to confirm nominal values meet noise immunity and soft-error criteria ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, minimum $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Verify bitline parasitic capacitance budget ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) to ensure read differential signal window $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV}$.
2. Run property comparison (`TOLERANCE` checks) ensuring effective width/length and capacitance deviations remain within 0% netlist matching tolerance.

#### Step 5: Final Equivalence Verification & Sign-off Lock
1. Run final full-chip flat/hierarchical graph comparison.
2. Confirm the run completes with:
   - `LVS STATUS: CLEAN / EQUIVALENCE ACHIEVED`
   - `ERC STATUS: 0 ERRORS / 0 WARNINGS`
3. Archive the LVS summary report, device extraction log, and run deck version hash into the design release vault.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Geometry** | Length $L = 180$, Width $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated LVS Geometry Parameter Extraction |
| **Stacked Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (Minimum $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Field Extraction / LVS Parameter Matching |
| **Differential Sense Signal Window ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Post-LVS SPICE Dynamic Transient Simulation ($C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) |
| **Full-Chip LVS & ERC Discrepancy Count** | Exactly $0$ | Discrepancies / Violations | Hierarchical LVS/ERC Ruledeck Report Sign-off |

---

### 4. Context References & Source Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

  - Leakage constraint: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Folded-bitline cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch and precharge equalization ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
  - Extracted parameter ratios: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding differential voltage $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C $8\text{F}^2/6\text{F}^2$ stacked capacitor target of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-001: Process Stackup & Dielectric Constant Profile Definition for 3D Field Solver Extraction

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the exact physical layer stackup, material properties, and dielectric constant ($\kappa$) profile required to calibrate and execute a 3D field solver (e.g., FasterCap, Raphael, or Ansys Q3D) for extraction of bitline ($C_b$) and storage node ($C_s$) parasitic capacitance in an 8F² folded bitline 180nm open-source DRAM cell architecture.

---

### 2. Physical Process Stackup & Permittivity Profile

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------+ Top Plate (TiN / Poly)
|   Capacitor Dielectric: Ta2O5 / Al2O3 or ONO (EOT 3-4 nm)    | κ > 15 (or Ta2O5 / Si3N4)
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Storage Node (SN) Crown / Cylinder (W / Poly Plug)         | Height ~ 0.8-1.0 µm
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD-2 / IMD): High-density SiO2    | κ = 3.9
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Bitline (BL / Metal / Polycide) Contact Shared             | Pitch: 360 - 400 nm
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD-1 / BPSG / SiO2)               | κ = 3.9
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Gate Dielectric (Dry SiO2) Physical Thickness: 3.5 nm      | κ = 3.9
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Silicon Substrate & Access Transistor (L=180nm, W=220nm)  | Active Silicon (Si)
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

| Layer Name | Function / Structure | Physical Thickness / Dimension | Material | Relative Permittivity ($\kappa$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Substrate / Channel** | Access NMOS | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | Crystalline Si | 11.7 |
| **Gate Oxide** | Wordline Gate Dielectric | $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ | Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ | 3.9 |
| **Wordline / Gate** | Conductor / Access Gate | Pitch = $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | Polysilicide / W | Conductor ($\sigma = 10^7\text{ S/m}$) |
| **ILD-1** | Pre-Metal / Bitline Dielectric | Planarized fill | BPSG / $\text{SiO}_2$ | 3.9 |
| **Bitline (BL)** | Folded Bitline Conductor | Pitch = $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | Polycide / W / Cu | Conductor |
| **SN Contact Plug** | Storage Node Connection | W-plug above drain | Tungsten (W) | Conductor |
| **ILD-2** | Bitline-to-Capacitor IMD | Isolation matrix | High-density $\text{SiO}_2$ | 3.9 |
| **Storage Capacitor** | Crown / Cylinder MIM/SIS | Footprint in 8F² ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) | Poly / TiN electrode | Conductor |
| **Capacitor Dielectric**| High-$\kappa$ / ONO Stack | $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$ | $\kappa > 15$ |

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Geometry & Boundary Box Setup:**
   - Define a 3D simulation bounding box encompassing an 8F² folded bitline sub-array tile ($2 \times 2$ cell cluster minimum, unit cell area $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
   - Enforce periodic boundary conditions on lateral cell boundaries along bitline and wordline pitches ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).

2. **Access Transistor & Gate Definition:**
   - Instantiate active NMOS channel dimensions with physical length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Define gate oxide layer thickness at $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$ with $\kappa = 3.9$.

3. **Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) & Bitline Contact Meshing:**
   - Instantiate shared bitline contact via and tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
   - Assign dielectric material $\text{SiO}_2$ ($\kappa = 3.9$) to ILD-1 and ILD-2 volumes around bitlines and contact plugs.

4. **Storage Capacitor Dielectric Parameter Assignment:**
   - Model the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/cylinder geometry above the W-plug.
   - Assign dielectric properties to the storage capacitor insulator: $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$, using $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO stack with relative permittivity $\kappa > 15$.

5. **Solve Electrostatic Maxwell Equations:**
   - Run adaptive mesh refinement targeting $< 1\%$ electrostatic energy convergence error.
   - Extract the full mutual and self-capacitance matrix for storage node $C_s$, bitline parasitic $C_b$, and cross-coupling terms ($C_{BL-BL}$, $C_{BL-WL}$, $C_{SN-BL}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Evaluation Method | Target Spec | Verification Threshold |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | 3D Field Solver Extraction | $25.0\text{ fF} - 30.0\text{ fF}$ (Nominal $28.0\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25.0\text{ fF/cell}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | Full block extraction (256/512 cells/BL) | $150.0\text{ fF} - 250.0\text{ fF}$ | $\le 250.0\text{ fF}$ |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | Calculated Ratio | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ | $< 10.0 : 1$ (Sign-off gate) |
| **Capacitor Dielectric Profile** | Stackup verification | $\kappa > 15$ with $\text{EOT} \in [3.0, 4.0]\text{ nm}$ | Profile Match |

---

### 5. Source Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact; W-plug drain contact; ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stacked capacitor dielectric with $\kappa > 15$; nominal $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** $8\text{F}^2$ cell footprint; $C_s$ target of $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$; wordline and bitline pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:** $8\text{F}^2$ folded bitline cell area = $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$; $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ across 256/512 cell blocks; $C_b / C_s$ ratio maintained strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$ read degradation limit).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Substrate & FEOL Active Channel Configuration**:
   - Establish P-well silicon substrate baseline and Shallow Trench Isolation (STI).
   - Configure access transistor active channel dimensions to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. **FEOL Gate Oxide & Wordline Stack Definition**:
   - Specify the gate dielectric layer as thermally grown Silicon Dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) formed via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Enter physical gate oxide thickness as $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\kappa = 3.9$) into the 3D field solver technology file.
   - Define polycide wordline conductor layers with critical pitch within $360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$.
3. **MOL Contact & Bitline Interconnect Specification**:
   - Specify shared bitline contact vias and storage node contacts using Tungsten plugs (W-plugs) embedded in pre-metal dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$ / BPSG, $\kappa \approx 3.9$).
   - Model the bitline conductor layer with wire pitch set between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
4. **Stacked Capacitor (COB) High-k Dielectric Stackup**:
   - Define Crown/Cylinder stacked capacitor topology over bitline (COB).
   - Configure capacitor dielectric stack using ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k thin film.
   - Set equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) to $3.0\text{ nm}-4.0\text{ nm}$ with relative permittivity target $\kappa > 15$.
5. **BEOL Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) & 3D Solver Extraction Mesh Sign-Off**:
   - Define BEOL inter-metal dielectrics ($\text{SiO}_2$ / USG / fluorinated oxide) with nominal permittivity $\kappa = 3.9-4.1$.
   - Run 3D field solver boundary extraction for bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$) and cell storage capacitance ($C_s$) to ensure sense amplifier differential margin.

---
