```text
Gate Tox┤▒▒                                            │
        │▒▒                                            │
     EOT┤░░                                            │
        │░░                                            │
        └┬──────────┬───────────┬──────────┬──────────┬┘
        0.0       31.2        62.5       93.8     125.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **FEOL Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-resolution spectroscopic ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Capacitor Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Quasi-static C-V profiling on test macros |
| **Capacitor Stack Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15.0$ | Dimensionless | High-frequency C-V extraction on MIM test structure |
| **Minimum Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ (range $25 \text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver PEX extraction & wafer prober C-V |
| **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parameter analyzer leakage test at retention sign-off |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pattern Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM metrology |

---

### Literature Citations & Verification Sources

1. **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
   - Access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Crown-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) structure with tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - High-k dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) providing effective $\kappa > 15$.
   - Target capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
   - Cell capacitor retention budget: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k stack with $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
3. **`Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`**:
   - Ratio $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ vs $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$, delivering sensing differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Commercial 3D Solver ICT/Techfile Model Generation & Boundary Encoding

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the technical procedure for generating, compiling, and calibrating commercial 3D field solver process description files (Interconnect Technology Format / `.ict` or equivalent rule decks) and boundary conditions for parasitic extraction (PEX) of 180nm 1T1C $8F^2$ DRAM cell arrays.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Start: Layer Stack &  │
│       Dielectric       │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Boundary Condition   │
│        Encoding        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      ICT/Techfile      │
│   Compilation & Rule   │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Golden 3D Benchmark   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Sign-off   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Step 1: Process Stackup & Dielectric Constant Profile Ingestion**
   - Ingest physical layer profiles into the `.ict` text description:
     - Thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric physical thickness: **$3.5\text{ nm}$**.
     - High-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectric stack (e.g., ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ and effective relative permittivity $\kappa > 15$).
     - Conductor profiles: Silicon substrate, access transistor polysilicon/silicide gate ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), tungsten plugs (W-plug), bitline metal/polycide, and crown/cylinder storage node structures.

2. **Step 2: Lateral Pitch & Interconnect Encodings**
   - Declare nominal lateral lithographic pitches in the technology file:
     - Wordline (WL) pitch: **$360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$**.
     - Bitline (BL) pitch: **$360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$**.
   - Define shared bitline contact geometry and crown capacitor spatial clearances over the bitline (COB).

3. **Step 3: Boundary Condition Configuration for Array Simulation**
   - Encode boundary conditions for the finite-element / boundary-element field solver:
     - **Periodic Boundary Conditions (PBC)** on $X$ and $Y$ array boundaries to mimic infinite repetitive $8F^2$ cell behavior.
     - **Dirichlet Boundary Conditions ($V = 0\text{ V}$)** on the bottom substrate backplane and fixed ground planes.
     - **Neumann Boundary Conditions ($\frac{\partial V}{\partial n} = 0$)** at top open-air boundaries or floating far-field boundaries.

4. **Step 4: Techfile Compilation & Cross-Validation**
   - Run the field solver compiler utility to translate `.ict` into the calibrated binary lookup ruleset / fast-cap engine database.
   - Perform syntax, dielectric boundary check, and mesh convergence verification.

5. **Step 5: Reference Cell Extraction & Sign-off**
   - Execute 3D field extraction on a golden $8F^2$ multi-cell reference block.
   - Extract storage node capacitance ($C_s$), total bitline capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$), and compute the read-out differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate against the sign-off criteria before releasing the model for production LVS/PEX flows.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
Critical 3D Extraction Verification Targets
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                      │
Delta V Min (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                      │
    C_s Min (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒                                 │
                │▒▒▒▒▒                                 │
   C_BL Max (fF)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

1. **Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)**: 
   - Minimum target: **$25\text{ fF to }28\text{ fF per cell}$** (minimum $\ge 25\text{ fF}$, nominal $\ge 28\text{ fF}$).
2. **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)**: 
   - Target maximum: **$\le 250\text{ fF}$** for folded bitline arrays.
3. **Signal Readout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)**: 
   - Target range: **$100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$** under $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
4. **Physical Gate & Dielectric Thickness Calibration**:
   - Gate oxide physical thickness: exactly **$3.5\text{ nm}$**.
   - Capacitor dielectric equivalent oxide thickness: **$3\text{ nm to }4\text{ nm}$** ($\kappa > 15$).

---

### 4. Literature References
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; high-$\kappa$ dielectric $\kappa > 15$; $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $C_s = 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$); EOT $= 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate $\text{SiO}_2 = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded-bitline differential signal formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$; $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF} \implies \Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

```text
              │
              ▼
┌──────────────────────────┐
│   Sign-Off Signatures:   │
│       C_BL and C_s       │
└──────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Physical Metrology & Cross-Sectional Dimension Acquisition
1. Retrieve cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (X-TEM) and scanning electron microscopy (X-SEM) images from test-chip scribe-line monitor sites.
2. Measure physical film thicknesses across the front-end-of-line (FEOL) and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) stack:
   - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric physical thickness.
   - Wordline (WL) and Bitline (BL) line width, spacing, and critical pitch.
   - Storage node tungsten plug (W-plug) contact height and diameter.
   - Capacitor crown/cylinder electrode height and capacitor dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT).
3. Validate thin-film optical refractive index ($n$) and dielectric constant ($\kappa$) values using multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry on dedicated planar monitor wafers.

### Step 2: 3D Field Solver Stackup Deck Formulation
1. Assemble physical layer thickness coordinates $(z_{\text{bottom}}, z_{\text{top}})$ and lateral sidewall taper profiles into the 3D parasitic field solver technology deck (e.g., FastCap/Raphael format).
2. Populate effective permittivity parameters ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$) for each dielectric domain:
   - Inter-layer dielectric (ILD) / pre-metal dielectric (PMD) oxides.
   - High-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ triple-layer or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack).
3. Specify boundary conditions for adjacent shared cell nodes according to the $8F^2$ folded-bitline layout geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact).

### Step 3: Parametric C-V Wafer-Level Electrical Characterization
1. Measure high-frequency (100 kHz – 1 MHz) capacitance-voltage (C-V) test keys on parametric test vehicles at $85^\circ\text{C}$:
   - Multi-finger bitline array comb-to-comb and comb-to-substrate test structures.
   - Storage node array capacitor test structures (macro array of parallel 1T1C cells).
2. De-embed probe pad and routing parasitics using two-step Open-Short de-embedding protocols.
3. Quantify cumulative cell leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to verify dielectric integrity.

### Step 4: 3D PEX Profile Calibration & Error Minimization
1. Execute electrostatic 3D field solver extractions across nominal, fast, and slow process corners for the defined cell layout geometry.
2. Calculate relative extraction discrepancy:
   $$\text{Error} = \frac{|C_{\text{simulated}} - C_{\text{measured\_de-embedded}}|}{C_{\text{measured\_de-embedded}}} \times 100\%$$
3. Adjust effective corner radii, sidewall angles, and localized fringing $\kappa_{\text{eff}}$ within bounds until the field solver output correlates to golden silicon metrology.
4. Sign off calibrated technology stackup profile rules for production parasitic extraction (PEX) workflows.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Constraint |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | **$25.0$ to $30.0$** (Min: $\ge 28.0$ for high-noise margins) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Measured per cell at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **AC-02** | Total Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$) | **$250.0$** | $\text{fF}$ | Golden C-V correlation within $\pm 5\%$ |
| **AC-03** | Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($T_{\text{ox}}$) | **$3.5$** | $\text{nm}$ | Measured by TEM/Ellipsometry |
| **AC-04** | Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of Capacitor Dielectric | **$3.0$ to $4.0$** | $\text{nm}$ | Derived from C-V accumulation |
| **AC-05** | Effective Capacitor Dielectric Permittivity ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$) | **$> 15.0$** | Dimensionless ($\kappa$) | For $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$ stack |
| **AC-06** | Unit Cell Leakage Current | **$\le 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Tested at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **AC-07** | Signal Development Differential Margin ($\Delta V$) | **$100.0$ to $150.0$** | $\text{mV}$ | $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$ |

---

## 4. Context Source Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - *Unit Cell Geometry & Contacts:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact in $8F^2$ folded-bitline topology with tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - *Capacitor Dielectric & High-$\kappa$:* ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - *Capacitance & Leakage Targets:* Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget; sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - *Retention & Target Capacitance:* Storage capacitor maintaining $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell (data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - *Film Properties & Pitches:* Capacitor EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$; thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

3. **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
   - *Parasitic Interconnect & Readout Margin:* Nominal bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ against $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, providing a differential signal margin $\Delta V$ of $100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ developed onto complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-PEX-3D-EXT-001`
**Title:** 3D Electrostatic Field Solver Boundary Setup & Capacitance Extraction Run  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu\text{m}$) — 8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor (COB)  
**Lifecycle State:** Sign-off / Parasitic Extraction (PEX)  

---

### 1. Structural & Boundary Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["GDSII / OASIS 8F² Layout Layer Stream-In"] --> B["Define 3D Simulation Bounding Box & Dielectric Stack"]
    B --> C["Assign Boundary Conditions (Periodic X/Y, Grounded Dirichlet Z)"]
    C --> D["Set Conductor Potentials & Interconnect Material Discretization"]
    D --> E["Execute 3D Electrostatic Field Solver (Poisson's Equation)"]
    E --> F["Extract Capacitance Matrix: C_s, C_BL, C_coupling"]
    F --> G["Acceptance Criteria Metric Sign-Off"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Layout Import & 3D Simulation Domain Setup
1. Stream in the DRC/LVS-clean $8F^2$ DRAM unit cell layout array (minimum $3 \times 3$ cell array around target victim cell):
   - Access Transistor: Channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Structure: Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with tungsten contact plugs ($W\text{-plug}$).
2. Define the simulation bounding box $(X, Y, Z)$:
   - Lateral ($X, Y$): Extend domain to enclose the active cell, shared bitline contact, and adjacent complementary folded bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$).
   - Vertical ($Z$): Enclose substrate/well ground plane through Metal 1 (bitline) up to the top plate of the crown-shaped capacitor.

#### Step 2: Dielectric Stack & Material Assignment
1. Specify dielectric layer material properties according to design rules:
   - Inter-layer dielectric (ILD): $\text{SiO}_2$ ($\kappa \approx 3.9$).
   - Storage node dielectric stack: High-$\kappa$ stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$) calibrated to effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
2. Define conductor contacts:
   - Polysilicon/MIM crown storage node, bitline metal (M1), pass-transistor gate (Wordline, poly/salicide), and W-plug interconnects.

#### Step 3: Boundary Condition Configuration
1. **Lateral Boundaries ($X_{\min}, X_{\max}, Y_{\min}, Y_{\max}$):**
   - Apply **Periodic Boundary Conditions (PBC)** to emulate the repetitive infinite array topology of the $8F^2$ DRAM core.
2. **Vertical Boundaries ($Z_{\min}, Z_{\max}$):**
   - Apply **Dirichlet Zero-Potential Boundary Condition** ($V = 0\,\text{V}$) at the substrate backplane ($Z_{\min}$) and top encapsulation/far-field boundary ($Z_{\max}$).

#### Step 4: Net Bias & Field Solver Execution
1. Set excitation voltages for parasitic matrix formulation:
   - Bitline bias: Precharge level $V_{\text{precharge}} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\,\text{V}$ (for $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$).
   - High-voltage Wordline: Driven up to boosted level $V_{PP} = 2.5\,\text{V}$ to $2.8\,\text{V}$ ($V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}}$, with $V_{th} \approx 0.5\,\text{V} - 0.7\,\text{V}$).
2. Solve Poisson's equation $\nabla \cdot (\varepsilon \nabla \phi) = -\rho$ across the mesh using adaptive finite-element/boundary-element refinement until energy convergence error is $< 0.1\%$.
3. Compute the full coupled capacitance matrix:
   $$Q_i = \sum_{j} C_{ij} V_j$$

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                                                        
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░░                                 │
C_Coupling (Max)┤░░░░░                                 │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
  Delta V Signal┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
   C_BL (Target)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
       C_s Stack┤█████                                 │
                │█████                                 │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Extraction Scope | Acceptance Sign-Off Target | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Crown MIM / ONO Stack | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | 3D Field Solver integration of storage node |
| **Total Bitline Parasitic ($C_{BL}$)** | M1 + Contacts + Crossing Poly | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped interconnect matrix extraction |
| **Read Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | Charge Sharing Margin | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ |
| **Adjacent Bitline Coupling ($C_{\text{coupling}}$)** | BL-to-$\overline{\text{BL}}$ adjacent pair | $\le 25.0$ ($< 10\%$ of $C_{BL}$) | $\text{fF}$ | Off-diagonal mutual capacitance matrix check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Unit cell access transistor geometry: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$.
   - Storage node budget: Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ for soft-error noise immunity.
2. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture:**
   - Enhancement NMOS access transistor $V_{th} \approx 0.5\,\text{V} - 0.7\,\text{V}$.
   - Boosted Wordline bias: $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\,\text{V} - 2.8\,\text{V}$ (for nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$).
3. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
   - Precharge equalization level: $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\,\text{V}$.
   - Reference target parasitics: $C_s \approx 25\,\text{fF} - 28\,\text{fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\,\text{fF}$.
   - Resulting differential readout signal swing: $\Delta V = 100\,\text{mV} - 150\,\text{mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 3D Dielectric Stack Profile & Periodic Boundary Condition Setup

**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Open-Source DRAM)  
**Discipline**: Circuit Design / PEX & 3D Electrostatic Field Solver Extraction  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3D Dielectric Stack   │
│   Profile Definition   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Mesh & Periodic     │
│     Boundary Setup     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    3D Field Solver     │
│     Electrostatic      │
│        Solution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Parasitic C_BL & C_s  │
│       Validation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Step 1: Dielectric Stack & Material Permittivity Profile Configuration**
   - Import the 180nm process techfile and layer thickness profile into the 3D field solver deck.
   - Configure the substrate and access transistor gate oxide stack: assign thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ with relative permittivity $\varepsilon_r \approx 3.9$.
   - Define the Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) isolating the bitline (BL) and storage node contacts over the tungsten contact plug (W-plug).
   - Configure the crown/cylinder storage capacitor dielectric layer using an ONO triple stack or high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ and effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$).

2. **Step 2: 3D Memory Cell Layout Boundary & Periodic Setup**
   - Instantiate an $8F^2$ unit cell bounding box containing the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and shared bitline contact.
   - Set periodic boundary conditions (PBC) along the lateral X and Y axes matching the active array pitch:
     - Wordline (WL) pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
     - Bitline (BL) pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - Apply Dirichlet boundary condition ($V = 0\text{ V}$) to the bottom substrate plane and Neumann (zero electric flux / open) or grounded boundary conditions to the top far-field boundary well above the capacitor crown plate.

3. **Step 3: Adaptive Mesh Generation & Conductor Net Tagging**
   - Assign net identifiers: Bitline (`BL`), Complementary Bitline (`/BL`), Storage Node Plate (`SN`), Gate/Wordline (`WL`), and Common Capacitor Top Plate (`CP`).
   - Define adaptive mesh refinement at conductor interfaces, setting maximum edge length $\le 10\text{ nm}$ around thin dielectric interfaces ($\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) and high-aspect-ratio crown sidewalls.

4. **Step 4: Electrostatic Solver Run & Extraction Validation**
   - Execute the 3D Poisson equation electrostatic solver across the periodic simulation volume.
   - Extract the full capacitance matrix including intra-cell and inter-cell parasitic coupling:
     - Storage node capacitance $C_s$.
     - Bitline wire and coupling capacitance $C_{BL}$.
     - Bitline-to-storage-node coupling capacitance $C_{BL\text{-}SN}$.
   - Verify differential sense amplifier readout voltage margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.

---

### 3. Key Baseline Extraction Metrics

```text
                            ┌──────────────────────────┐
                            │█████████████████         │
Bitline Capacitance CBL (fF)┤█████████████████         │
                            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
          Bitline Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    Min Storage Node Cs (fF)┤▒▒▒                       │
                            │▒▒▒                       │
     Cell Retention Temp (C)┤░░░░░░░                   │
                            │░░░░░░░                   │
                            └┬─────┬──────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                             0    95     190   285  380 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

1. **Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)**: $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ (acceptable range $25\text{ fF to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell to satisfy retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
2. **Capacitor Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)**: $3\text{ nm to }4\text{ nm}$ with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
3. **Array Periodic Boundary Pitch (BL & WL Pitch)**: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$ along the periodic X/Y simulation boundaries.
4. **Total Bitline Extracted Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)**: $\approx 250\text{ fF}$ (targeting differential readout signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ into sense amplifier).

---

### 5. Context Citations

- *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Unit cell $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; high-$\kappa$ dielectric $\kappa > 15$; minimum capacitance budget $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* ($1\text{T}1\text{C}$ $8F^2$ topology; storage capacitance $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; EOT $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide $3.5\text{ nm}$).
- *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, differential sensing voltage $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-CKT-180-PEX-007`
**Title:** Adaptive Conformal Meshing & 3D Electrostatic Capacitance Extraction Run  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm / µm) | **Topology:** 8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & Parasitic Extraction (PEX) Sign-off  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Layout GDSII &     │
│     Techfile Prep     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Boundary & Material  │
│      Assignment       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Adaptive Octree    │
│   Conformal Meshing   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   3D Electrostatic    │
│     Field Solver      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Convergence Check   │
│   Delta E <= 1 pct    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Matrix Extraction &  │
│       Cs Check        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry Import & Layer Stratification Setup**:
   - Import the DRC/LVS-clean GDSII/OASIS layout containing the 8F² 1T1C DRAM cell block (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; tungsten plug / W-plug contact).
   - Load the 180nm techfile defining material stacks: Crown/cylinder capacitor dielectric stack (equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$; or $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / ONO triple dielectric), gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$), and inter-layer dielectrics (ILD).
2. **Boundary Condition & Excitation Port Definition**:
   - Clip the simulation bounding box around the active 1T1C cell, including adjacent bitline ($BL$, $\overline{BL}$) and wordline ($WL$) coupling neighbors.
   - Assign **Dirichlet boundary conditions** on terminal conductors: storage node plate ($V_{\text{plate}}$), cell node electrode ($V_{\text{cell}}$), bitlines ($BL$, $\overline{BL}$), and substrate ground planes ($V_{SS} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Assign **Homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions** ($\partial V / \partial n = 0$) or periodic boundaries on external domain sidewalls to model infinite array symmetry.
3. **Adaptive Conformal Discretization (Octree/FEM Meshing)**:
   - Run coarse initial octree volume grid discretization across the bulk dielectric domain.
   - Apply localized conformal geometric refinement around high aspect-ratio 3D Crown/Cylinder capacitor walls, W-plug interfaces, and the thin $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ EOT dielectric layer.
   - Refine mesh elements along curved and angled boundaries using conformal boundary projection to eliminate staircase artifacts.
4. **Electrostatic Potential Field Solution & Adaptive Refinement**:
   - Solve the 3D electrostatic Laplace equation:
     $$\nabla \cdot (\varepsilon(x,y,z) \nabla \Phi) = 0$$
   - Evaluate electrostatic field energy $U_E = \frac{1}{2} \int \varepsilon |\nabla \Phi|^2 \, dV$.
   - Execute iterative $h$-refinement on mesh elements with localized field gradient error estimators exceeding tolerance until energy convergence delta criteria ($\Delta U_E \le 1.0\%$) is reached.
5. **Maxwell Capacitance Matrix Extraction & Model Reduction**:
   - Extract multi-conductor Maxwell capacitance coefficients via charge integration:
     $$Q_i = \oint_{\partial \Omega_i} \varepsilon \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{S} \implies C_{ij} = \frac{\partial Q_i}{\partial V_j}$$
   - Generate SPICE-compatible sub-circuit netlist containing cell storage capacitance $C_s$, total bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$, and parasitic cross-coupling terms ($C_{BL-WL}$, $C_{BL-BL}$, $C_{s-BL}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric Description | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (Minimum $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Field solver electrostatic charge integration ($Q_{\text{plate}} / \Delta V$) |
| **Bitline Total Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Integrated lumped bitline conductor extraction |
| **Capacitance Energy Convergence ($\Delta U_E$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\%$ | Iterative adaptive mesh pass comparison ($\|U_k - U_{k-1}\| / U_k$) |
| **Capacitor Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Techfile physical/dielectric parameter sign-off |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Access Transistor Geometry*: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact; crown-shaped polysilicon/MIM capacitor with tungsten plug (W-plug).

  - *Capacitance Budget*: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ required to preserve noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Cell Capacitance Target*: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ storage capacitor for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Dielectrics & Pitch*: Crown/Cylinder stacked capacitor with $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ at equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - *Bitline Coupling & Capacitance Matrix*: Typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ operating against typical lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, delivering differential readout signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Storage Node & Bitline Coupling Capacitance Verification & Sign-off

### Document Metadata
- **Node / Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)
- **Cell Architecture:** 1T1C Folded Bitline Layout ($8F^2$), Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB)
- **Action Type:** Make / Verification Sign-off

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  3D Field Solver Mesh & Boundary Setup       │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Coupling Capacitance Matrix Extraction Run  │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Bitline & Storage Node Parasitic Sign-off   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Geometry & Boundary Setup for 3D Field Solver**
   - Import the post-LVS $8F^2$ array layout tile (including access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, and shared bitline contacts).
   - Set up electrostatic Neumann/periodic boundary conditions around a $4 \times 4$ cell array bounding box to accurately simulate neighbor-to-neighbor fringe fields.
   - Define material stacks: tungsten plug (W-plug), stacked crown capacitor electrodes with high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, such as $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO), and inter-metal dielectric layers.

2. **Full-Spectrum Capacitance Matrix Extraction Run**
   - Execute the 3D electrostatic field solver on the meshed cell array to extract the multi-conductor capacitance matrix:
     $$\mathbf{Q} = \mathbf{C} \cdot \mathbf{V}$$
   - Extract primary components:
     - Storage node capacitance $C_s$ (target stacked cell capacitor + storage node fringe parasitics to substrate and wordlines).
     - Total lumped bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$ along the column.
     - Storage-node-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance $C_{SN\text{-}BL}$.
     - Adjacent bitline-to-bitline coupling capacitance $C_{BL\text{-}BL}$.

3. **Signal Development & Coupling Ratio Verification**
   - Compute bitline attenuation and signal margin during charge sharing:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Calculate parasitic coupling ratio $C_{BL} / C_s$ to ensure sufficient read margin for the cross-coupled sense amplifier.
   - Verify that storage node to bitline coupling noise does not degrade the retention margin or cause false reads during bitline precharge / sensing transitions.

4. **Sign-off Metric Audit & Netlist Generation**
   - Confirm all extracted values satisfy the electrical criteria checklist.
   - Annotate back-annotated parasitics into the extracted SPICE netlist for dynamic timing and sense-amplifier latching simulation.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Criterion |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30$ (min. budget $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver integration over stacked crown capacitor |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped parasitic extraction along active bitline column |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Calculated at sense amp nodes: $\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ |
| **Cell Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC device leakage evaluation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget; high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{ONO}$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$); leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; tungsten plug (W-plug) contact over bitline.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Storage capacitor target range of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, resulting in differential signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ across complementary bitlines ($BL$, $/BL$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Bitline Coupling Metrology & Sense Amplifier Differential Margin Validation

**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off > PEX 3D Field Solver Extraction for Bitline & Storage Node Parasitics > **Bitline Coupling Metrology & Sense Amplifier Differential Margin Validation**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($180\,\text{nm}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1. PEX RC Netlist    │
│         Import         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2. Bitline Parasitic  │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Capacitance Ratio  │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   4. Wordline Signal   │
│      Development       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    5. Differential     │
│  Sensing Margin Eval   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  6. SA Latch Sign-off  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **PEX 3D RC Post-Layout Netlist Ingestion**
   - Import the 3D field-solver parasitic netlist for the folded bitline memory block (containing 256 or 512 cells per bitline pair, cell area $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $8F^2$, $F = 180\,\text{nm}$, access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$).
   - Set operating temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate worst-case leakage and signal degradation.

2. **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) & Coupling Metrology**
   - Measure lumped total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) across complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Verify that total bitline parasitic capacitance satisfies the budget of $150\,\text{fF} \le C_b \le 250\,\text{fF}$.
   - Characterize mutual inter-bitline coupling capacitance ($C_{bb}$) and bitline-to-wordline coupling to ensure common-mode folded-bitline noise cancellation during adjacent line transitions.

3. **Storage Node Capacitance & Budget Ratio Validation**
   - Extract the storage capacitor node capacitance ($C_s$) formed by the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure (dielectric stack: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$).
   - Confirm storage node capacitance is $C_s \ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ (nominal target: $28\,\text{fF}$).
   - Calculate capacitance ratio $R = C_b / C_s$. Verify that $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$. Flag any block where $C_b / C_s > 10:1$ as a failure.

4. **Equalization & Precharge Initialization**
   - Initialize the equalization transistor network prior to wordline activation.
   - Precharge and equilibrate complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) to precisely $V_{DD} / 2$.

5. **Wordline Assertion & Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$)**
   - Assert the wordline ($WL$) on the selected access transistor to transfer cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto the active bitline $BL$.
   - Measure the developed single-ended differential voltage before latching:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate that differential signal $\Delta V$ is between $100\,\text{mV}$ and $150\,\text{mV}$ under worst-case data patterns (data '0' and data '1').

6. **Sense Amplifier Latch Sign-off & Refresh Verification**
   - Fire the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch signals ($SAN$ pulling low toward $V_{SS}$, $SAP$ pulling high toward $V_{DD}$) across complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Verify non-destructive latch resolution, full rail-to-rail signal restoration ($V_{DD}$ / $V_{SS}$ refresh), and confirm that leakage current remains below $1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │■■                                     │
C_b / C_s Ratio┤■■                                     │
               │◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆               │
 Delta V Signal┤◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆               │
C_s Nom. Target┤▒▒▒▒▒                                  │
               │▒▒▒▒▒                                  │
  C_b Parasitic┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      62.5     125.0     187.5  250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Symbol | Min Target | Nominal Target | Max Target | Unit | Verification Condition |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance** | $C_b$ | $150$ | $200$ | $250$ | $\text{fF}$ | 3D PEX extraction, 256/512 cells/BL |
| **Storage Node Capacitance** | $C_s$ | $25$ | $28$ | $30$ | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked COB capacitor, $\kappa > 15$ |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio** | $C_b / C_s$ | $5:1$ | $7.1:1$ | $9:1$ | Dimensionless | Fail condition: $> 10:1$ |
| **Read Differential Signal Margin** | $\Delta V$ | $100$ | $125$ | $150$ | $\text{mV}$ | $V_{BL} - V_{/BL}$ prior to SA latch |
| **Storage Node Leakage Current** | $I_{\text{leak}}$ | — | $< 0.5$ | $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Junction + subthreshold at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, $V_{DD} / 2$ equalization network.
   - Charge transfer formula: $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ and differential voltage formula:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Nominal differential margin $\Delta V \approx 100\,\text{mV}$ to $150\,\text{mV}$ for $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$) for common-mode noise immunity.
   - Bitline capacitance budget: $C_b = 150\,\text{fF}$ to $250\,\text{fF}$ across array blocks of 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Capacitance ratio constraint: $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (severe signal degradation if $> 10:1$).
   - Storage node capacitance requirement: $C_s \ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ (nominally $28\,\text{fF}$).
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Unit cell access transistor geometry: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Soft error and coupling immunity target: $C_s \ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$.
   - Leakage current sign-off: $I_{\text{leak}} \le 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-042: Inter-Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$) Matrix Extraction & Cross-Coupling Metrology

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Methodology

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    BL Geometry and     │
│         Pitch          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3D PEX Electrostatic  │
│         Solve          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Extract Matrix C_BL   │
│        and C_c         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Differential Margin   │
│    Delta V Sign-off    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Engineering Procedure

1. **Boundary & Structural Mesh Setup (8F² Layout)**
   - Import the DRC/LVS-clean $8F^2$ folded-bitline layout database.
   - Constrain the extraction window to cover multi-finger bitline arrays with physical bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, sharing bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C cells ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Define surrounding dielectric media: stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) inter-layer dielectrics (ILD) and high-$k$ dielectric stacks ($\kappa > 15$).

2. **3D Field-Solver Electrostatic Maxwell Extraction**
   - Execute the 3D parasitic extraction (PEX) field solver to resolve Laplace/Poisson field equations across complementary folded bitline tracks ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) and adjacent active cell columns.
   - Compute the full Maxwell capacitance matrix $[C]$, capturing self-capacitance ($C_{BL,self}$), cross-coupling capacitance to nearest adjacent bitlines ($C_{c,BL-BL}$), and fringe capacitance to wordlines and storage node tungsten plugs (W-plugs).

3. **Capacitance Matrix Formulation & Total Bitline Load Evaluation**
   - Formulate total effective bitline capacitance:
     $$C_{BL} = C_{BL,ground} + \sum C_{c,BL-WL} + 2 \cdot C_{c,BL-BL}$$
   - Confirm that the total lumped capacitance $C_{BL}$ aligns with the folded-bitline nominal load budget of approximately $250\text{ fF}$.

4. **Sense Amplifier Differential Signal ($\Delta V$) Margin Validation**
   - Model the charge sharing between the 1T1C cell storage node ($C_s$) and the bitline load ($C_{BL}$):
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$
   - Evaluate signal margin using verified storage capacitance baseline ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$, up to $30\text{ fF}$) against $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Simulate worst-case anti-phase cross-talk coupling noise from neighboring bitlines switching simultaneously during sensing to guarantee sense amplifier margin integrity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Metrics

| Metric Description | Target Specification | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Window | Sign-off Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Nominal extracted line load | *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget** | $25 \text{ to } 30$ (Min: $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ soft-error/coupling immunity | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* / *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |
| **Sense Amplifier Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Measured differential latch margin | *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* |
| **Bitline Physical Wiring Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Target extraction layout grid pitch | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Unit Cell Geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline contact shared between adjacent cells in $8F^2$ topology.
  - High-$k$ dielectric stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for bitline coupling immunity and alpha-particle soft error protection.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Sense amplifier readout charge redistribution: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Standard operating values: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, producing signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline wiring pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-CIR-180-SAMP-001`
**Title:** Folded-Bitline Sense Amplifier Transient Differential Margin ($\Delta V$) SPICE Characterization  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m regime)  
**Cell Topology:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB)  
**Action Type:** Make / Characterize  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the transient SPICE simulation methodology to characterize and validate the differential signal margin ($\Delta V$) developed across complementary bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) during read operations on a 180 nm $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM array prior to sense amplifier latching.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 1: Netlist Assembly & PEX Parasitic Model Setup        |
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 2: Bitline Precharge & Equalization Setup (V_DD / 2)   |
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 3: Access Transistor Wordline Strobe & Signal Dump     |
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 4: Differential Margin (ΔV) Metric Extraction & Signoff|
       +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Netlist Assembly & Parasitics Inclusion**
   - Import post-layout PEX extracted netlists for the folded bitline pair ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) including lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and access transistor parameters ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Instantiate the stacked storage capacitor model $C_s$ with target capacitance ranging between $25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Incorporate junction and sub-threshold leakage parameters kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at operating temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Precharge & Equalization Phase**
   - Configure transient sources to activate the equalization transistor network prior to wordline activation.
   - Force bitline precharge voltage $V_{\text{precharge}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Verify initial bias balance between $\text{BL}$ and reference folded bitline $\overline{\text{BL}}$ with zero static offset.

3. **Cell State Initialization & Wordline Strobe**
   - Initialize cell storage node voltage $V_{\text{cell}}$ for both Read-0 ($V_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$) and Read-1 ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$) scenarios.
   - Assert the wordline (WL) pulse to turn on the access transistor, discharging/transferring cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ onto $\text{BL}$ while $\overline{\text{BL}}$ remains at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

4. **Transient $\Delta V$ Margin Measurement**
   - Run SPICE transient analysis (`.tran`) at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Sample the differential margin right before sense-amplifier cross-coupled latch activation:
     $$\Delta V = |V_{\text{BL}} - V_{\overline{\text{BL}}}| = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right|$$
   - Ensure the signal stabilizes within the target $100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$ window before latching clocks ($\text{SAN}$ / $\text{SAP}$) trigger.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Post-layout transient SPICE measurement ($|V_{\text{BL}} - V_{\overline{\text{BL}}}|$) |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25 \text{ to } 30$ (min $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted 3D PEX / C-V testbench sign-off |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted folded-pair parasitic network sum |
| **Operating Sign-off Temperature** | $85$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | SPICE ambient simulation temperature setting |
| **Cell Leakage (Sub-threshold & Junction)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC/Transient leakage integration at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Sense Amplifier Threshold Mismatch & Dynamic Latching Margin Monte Carlo Sign-off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Domain Council:** DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council — Circuit Design Group  

---

### 1. Process & Latching Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     PEX Parasitic      │
│        Netlist         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Bitline Equalization  │
│         V_DD/2         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Charge Sharing Delta  │
│           V            │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAN Activation Pull   │
│        to V_SS         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAP Activation Pull   │
│        to V_DD         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     1000-Point MC      │
│        Sign-Off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Extraction Setup & Netlist Conditioning:**
   - Import the post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) netlist of the folded bitline sense amplifier and 1T1C access transistor array ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ per access transistor).
   - Annotate extracted bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and unit stacked cell capacitor $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.
2. **Bitline Precharge & Equalization Initialization:**
   - Apply the precharge cycle across the equalization network to short complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$, stabilizing both lines precisely at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
3. **Signal Development (Charge Sharing Dynamic Phase):**
   - Assert the wordline ($WL$) on the target access transistor ($T = 85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Evaluate charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ and verify dynamic voltage differential:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
4. **Sense Amplifier Latching Strobe Execution:**
   - Fire the NMOS cross-coupled latch pull-down strobe ($\text{SAN}$ pulling toward $V_{\text{SS}}$), followed by the PMOS latch pull-up strobe ($\text{SAP}$ pulling toward $V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Track latching flip time and monitor differential rail amplification ($\text{BL}$ vs $\overline{\text{BL}}$) to prevent false sensing caused by threshold mismatch.
5. **Monte Carlo Mismatch & Dynamic Latching Sign-Off:**
   - Execute a 1,000-run Monte Carlo statistical analysis incorporating local threshold voltage mismatch ($\Delta V_{\text{th}}$) and access transistor sub-threshold/junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to verify dynamic latching margin yield across $3\sigma$ process variations.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                 │
 Temp Boundary┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                 │
              │▒                                       │
 Leakage Limit┤▒                                       │
    C_s Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                │
Signal Delta V┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      37.5      75.0     112.5   150.0 
```

1. **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$):**  
   - **Target Metric:** $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ (for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$).
2. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$):**  
   - **Target Metric:** $\ge 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal) to $28\text{ fF}$ minimum per cell.
3. **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current:**  
   - **Target Metric:** $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ boundary.
4. **Retention Window / Operating Thermal Boundary:**  
   - **Target Metric:** Data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at an operating temperature of $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]:**  
  Equalization to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$; differential signal generation equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$; cross-coupled inverter activation via $\text{SAN}$ pulling to $V_{\text{SS}}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**  
  Access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current requirement $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**  
  Minimum capacitance requirement of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ ensuring data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked capacitor dielectric targets.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## $C_{BL} / C_s$ Charge-Sharing Ratio & $\Delta V$ Metric Verification Sign-off

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX Netlist)│
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Storage Capacitance Verification (Cs)│
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: Bitline Parasitic Capacitance (C_BL) │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 4: Dynamic Readout Charge-Sharing & ΔV │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 5: Sign-off & Tolerance Pass/Fail Gate │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governs the post-layout metrological verification and sign-off for the **charge-sharing ratio ($C_{BL} / C_s$)** and **readout differential signal voltage ($\Delta V$)** on the open-source 180nm 1T1C $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM architecture.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Netlist Generation**:
   - Execute 3D field-solver / calibrated rule-based parasitic extraction on the verified LVS layout of the $8F^2$ unit cell matrix and folded bitline sense amplifier (BL / $\overline{\text{BL}}$) paths.
   - Include access transistor gate-overlap capacitances, bitline contact junction capacitance, and adjacent line-to-line coupling at the 360 nm to 400 nm bitline pitch.

2. **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Static & Dynamic Extraction**:
   - Extract the total capacitance of the crown/cylinder stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - Ensure cell capacitance $C_s$ satisfies the physical retention budget across the cell plate node at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$) Extraction**:
   - Calculate total parasitic loading $C_{BL}$ along the full folded bitline rail, summing bitline metal capacitance, shared contact parasitic junctions, and sense amplifier input node capacitances.
   - Compute the charge-sharing ratio:
     $$\text{Ratio} = \frac{C_{BL}}{C_s}$$

4. **Equalization & Charge-Sharing $\Delta V$ Simulation**:
   - Set initial precharge state: equalized bitlines at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Initialize cell storage voltage: logic high ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and logic low ($V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Assert the wordline ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) to trigger charge dumping:
     $$Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$$
   - Measure the developed differential voltage $\Delta V$ across the folded complementary bitlines prior to sense amplifier latch activation (SAN/SAP):
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$

5. **Sign-off Review & Quality Gate**:
   - Compare extracted $C_s$, $C_{BL}$, $\Delta V$, and junction leakage metrics against the sign-off criteria.
   - Log compliance data into metrology tracking and issue sign-off approval.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Unit | Measurement Method / Physical Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$** (Min. threshold: **$28\text{ fF}$**) | Post-layout PEX extraction of stacked crown/cylinder capacitor structure |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$\le 250\text{ fF}$** | Extracted distributed RC along full folded bitline pitch (360 nm – 400 nm) |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | Transient readout simulation before sense amplifier strobe activation |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Subthreshold & Junction)** | **$\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$** | DC leakage extraction at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; baseline values $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: $8F^2$ cell geometry with access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C storage capacitor target $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## GDSII Layer Mapping & 2.5D Field Solver Extraction Rule Deck Setup for 8F² Layout

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) establishes the configuration, layer mapping, dielectric profile definitions, and boundary conditions required for 2.5D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) on a 180nm $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM cell architecture. It defines the setup parameters to accurately extract cell storage node capacitance ($C_s$) and bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$) to ensure the required sensing margin ($\Delta V$).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    GDSII Layer Map     │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Dielectric &      │
│   Conductor Profile    │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boundary Extraction   │
│       & Meshing        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2.5D Field Solver RC  │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      C_BL and C_s      │
│        Sign-off        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream Layer-to-Techfile Mapping**:
   - Parse the layout stream and map GDSII layer numbers and datatypes to extraction layer aliases:
     - Active Area / Diffusion: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Gate / Wordline (WL): Poly silicon gate, physical oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$.
     - Bitline Contact (BLC): Shared contact between adjacent cell pairs via tungsten plug (W-plug).
     - Bitline (BL): Metal/poly interconnect with pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
     - Storage Node Contact (SNC): W-plug landing onto access transistor drain.
     - Storage Node Capacitor (SN / Crown): Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/cylinder geometry.
     - Cell Plate / Top Plate: Common capacitor upper electrode.

2. **Conductor Material & Resistivity Deck Setup**:
   - Define bulk resistivities and sheet resistances for polysilicon wordlines ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch), tungsten plugs (W-plugs), metal bitlines, and crown/cylinder storage node electrodes.
   - Configure contact interface resistance boundaries at the shared bitline contact and storage node contact interfaces.

3. **Dielectric Stack & High-k Field Solver Profile Configuration**:
   - Parameterize the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) stack surrounding the bitline and wordlines.
   - Configure gate oxide properties ($SiO_2$, physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up the stacked capacitor high-k dielectric layer parameters:
     - Material: ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ stack.
     - Permittivity: Effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
     - Equivalent Oxide Thickness: $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.

4. **2.5D Boundary Condition & Discretization Setup**:
   - Define multi-conductor windowing and boundary conditions for folded-bitline complementary pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Set conformal boundary meshing along the vertical crown/cylinder sidewalls and neighboring bitlines to capture lateral fringing capacitance ($C_{coupling}$) and ground plane capacitance accurately.

5. **RC Parasitic Extraction Execution & Netlist Formatting**:
   - Execute the 2.5D field solver rule deck over the extracted cell tile and neighboring array perimeter.
   - Generate the distributed DSPF/SPEF parasitic RC netlist including storage node lumped-equivalent capacitance ($C_s$), bitline line parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$), and mutual coupling components.

6. **Sign-Off Verification**:
   - Calculate the charge-sharing differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate that the extracted $C_s$, $C_{BL}$, and resulting $\Delta V$ satisfy circuit sensing constraints.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                       Extraction Metric Budgets        
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
Delta V Signal┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
 C_BL (Target)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_s (Target)┤█████                                   │
              │█████                                   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      62.5      125.0    187.5   250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ (nominal $25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25\text{ fF/cell}$ minimum | 2.5D field solver lumped extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250\text{ fF}$ | $\pm 10\%$ ($225\text{ to } 275\text{ fF}$) | PEX distributed netlist summation |
| **Signal Development Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ | $[100, 150]\text{ mV}$ | Post-layout charge-sharing readout evaluation |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa$) & EOT** | $\kappa > 15$; $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{EOT} \in [3.0, 4.0]\text{ nm}$ | Dielectric rule deck specification check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node structure: Crown-shaped polysilicon / MIM structure erected via tungsten plug (W-plug) in a capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture.
  - Dielectric stack: ONO triple dielectric or $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Storage capacitance requirement: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Readout operation: Charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto equalized bitline ($V_{DD}/2$).
  - Differential signal formulation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Extracted capacitance metrics: Typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, typical $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding expected $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Retention threshold: Storage capacitance maintained at $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Dielectric thickness: Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($Si_3N_4$ or $Ta_2O_5$).
  - Interconnect geometry: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide dry oxidation thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

```text
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Transient Simulation  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    BL-WL Metrology     │
│        Sign-off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Raw RC Parasitic Netlist Ingestion & Boundary Definition**
   - Import the 3D field-solver parasitic extraction netlist (DSPF/SPEF) for the 8F² folded bitline memory array, access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), tungsten plug (W-plug), and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) storage node.
   - Designate critical observation nodes: bitline true/complement ($BL$, $\overline{BL}$), wordline ($WL$), and storage node ($SN$).

2. **Parasitic Netlist RC Network Reduction**
   - Apply frequency-dependent pole-residue / selective $\pi$-model reduction algorithms to collapse distributed interconnect parasitic mesh networks along wordlines and bitlines with 360–400 nm pitch.
   - Filter parasitic sub-fF decoupling elements without collapsing inter-wire cross-coupling capacitors ($C_{WL-BL}$, $C_{BL-\overline{BL}}$) or gate-overlap capacitances ($C_{gd}$, $C_{gs}$).

3. **Schematic Back-Annotation & Structural Audit**
   - Back-annotate the reduced parasitic RC network into the 180nm CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier and 1T1C array transient simulation harness.
   - Perform a DC continuity and topology audit to ensure access transistor gate dielectric physical thickness (~3.5 nm thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$) and storage node connectivity remain uncompromised.

4. **Dynamic Transient Readout & Cross-Coupling Metrology Execution**
   - Equalize $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ to $V_{DD}/2$ using the equalization transistor network prior to wordline activation.
   - Assert $WL$ to turn on the access transistor, dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline.
   - Measure bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$, cell capacitance $C_s$, readout differential voltage $\Delta V$, and transient cross-coupling noise induced by wordline switching onto the adjacent bitline pairs.

5. **Sign-off Validation & Archive**
   - Verify that all electrical and physical parameters satisfy the required sign-off thresholds at 85°C.
   - Export back-annotated timing/voltage reports and freeze netlists into the design archive.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metrology Target | Acceptance Metric Target | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Extracted capacitor metrology / AC simulation |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Parasitic RC extraction back-annotation |
| **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ (millivolts) | Transient differential sense simulation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Sub-threshold & Junction)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Static DC metrology at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Verified Context Citations

- **Storage Cell Capacitance ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) & Leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$):**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Minimum 28 fF capacitance budget, sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C).
  - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C; gate dielectric $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
- **Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) & Readout Margin ($\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$):**
  - *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$).
- **Geometry & Array Pitch ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Pitch = $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$):**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.
