# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-WCMP-002`
**Title:** W-CMP Slurry Formulation & Prestonian Polish Rate Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type COB 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > W-Plug $\text{WF}_6$ Reduction & CMP Planarization Contact Module Simulation > Tungsten CMP Overburden Removal & Dishing Metrology Profile Simulation > W-CMP Slurry Formulation & Prestonian Polish Rate Calibration  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
This SOP outlines the formulation and empirical Prestonian polish rate calibration of colloidal silica/alumina acidic slurry with $\text{Fe(NO}_3\text{)}_3 / \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ oxidizer systems for tungsten (W) plug planarization. The procedure establishes the Prestonian removal rate constant ($K_p$) governing the Preston equation:
$$\text{MRR} = K_p \cdot P \cdot V$$
where $P$ is downforce pressure and $V$ is platen relative linear velocity, ensuring controlled tungsten overburden removal down to the underlying dielectric ILD with minimal plug recess and dishing for 180nm 1T1C $8F^2$ Crown-COB contact structures.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                            W-CMP CALIBRATION FLOW                                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Slurry Formulation: Acidic colloidal silica + Oxidizer (pH 2.0 - 2.5)          |
|                                       │                                           |
|                                       ▼                                           |
| 2. Point-of-Use (POU) Delivery & Pad Conditioning (Grid-abrade diamond disk)       |
|                                       │                                           |
|                                       ▼                                           |
| 3. Multi-Point Preston Matrix Polish (Sweeping Downforce P & Platen Speed V)      |
|                                       │                                           |
|                                       ▼                                           |
| 4. Post-CMP Megasonic Clean & Metrology (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / 4PP Sheet R) |
|                                       │                                           |
|                                       ▼                                           |
| 5. Preston Constant (Kp) & Selectivity Extraction (W-to-Oxide Rate Ratio)         |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 2.1: Slurry Formulation & Point-of-Use (POU) Preparation
1. **Slurry Base Blending**: Blend high-purity deionized (DI) water with high-purity colloidal abrasive particles (mean primary particle diameter $50\text{--}70\text{ nm}$, abrasive solids loading $3.0\text{--}5.0\text{ wt}\%$) in a fluoropolymer-lined batch tank.
2. **Oxidizer & Acid Addition**: Add periodic/ferric nitrate catalyst $\text{Fe(NO}_3\text{)}_3$ ($0.05\text{--}0.15\text{ wt}\%$) and stabilize with malonic acid / nitric acid to buffer the formulation to an acidic regime of $\text{pH } 2.2 \pm 0.2$.
3. **POU Activation**: Meter hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, $30\%$ semiconductor grade) via an in-line chemical delivery loop immediately prior to pad dispense at a volumetric ratio yielding $1.5\text{--}2.5\text{ wt}\% \text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ in active slurry. Ensure continuous agitation to prevent abrasive agglomeration.

#### Step 2.2: Pad Conditioning & In-Situ Conditioning Setup
1. Mount a stacked polyurethane polishing pad (e.g., IC1000/Suba-IV concentric grooved pad) onto Platen 1.
2. Execute a 20-minute ex-situ break-in using a diamond conditioner disk ($100\text{ grit}$) at $40\text{ N}$ downforce and $95\text{ RPM}$ disk rotation under $250\text{ mL/min}$ DI water flush.
3. Configure in-situ diamond conditioning during all polishing sweeps at $25\text{ N}$ downforce, sweeping continuously across pad radius at $10\text{ sweeps/min}$ to maintain steady-state surface pad roughness ($R_a \approx 3.5\text{--}5.0\ \mu\text{m}$).

#### Step 2.3: Preston Matrix Execution on Blanket Monitor Wafers
1. Prepare prime $200\text{ mm}$ test monitor wafers:
   - Group A: Blanket CVD Tungsten ($500\text{ nm}$ W over $20\text{ nm}$ Ti/TiN adhesion liner on thermal $\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Group B: Blanket TEOS / High-Density Plasma (HDP) $\text{SiO}_2$ ($500\text{ nm}$).
2. Set slurry flow rate to $180 \pm 10\text{ mL/min}$ targeted at the pad center-wafer interface.
3. Execute sequential 60-second polish runs across a calibrated $P \cdot V$ matrix:
   - Condition 1: Downforce $P_1 = 2.0\text{ psi}$ ($13.8\text{ kPa}$), Platen/Carrier speed $\omega = 40/38\text{ RPM}$ ($V_{\text{avg}} \approx 0.65\text{ m/s}$).
   - Condition 2: Downforce $P_2 = 3.5\text{ psi}$ ($24.1\text{ kPa}$), Platen/Carrier speed $\omega = 70/67\text{ RPM}$ ($V_{\text{avg}} \approx 1.15\text{ m/s}$).
   - Condition 3: Downforce $P_3 = 5.0\text{ psi}$ ($34.5\text{ kPa}$), Platen/Carrier speed $\omega = 100/96\text{ RPM}$ ($V_{\text{avg}} \approx 1.65\text{ m/s}$).
4. Record motor current / friction torque profile for platen and carrier to monitor shear load linearity.

#### Step 2.4: Post-CMP Wet Clean & Surface Quench
1. Transfer wafer immediately into double-sided PVA brush scrubber with $0.5\text{ wt}\% \text{ NH}_4\text{OH}$ / dilute organic acid solution to arrest micro-etching and lift colloidal abrasive residues.
2. Megasonic rinse at $1.0\text{ MHz}$ under ultra-pure DI water for $45\text{ s}$ followed by surface-tension-gradient (Marangoni) isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor dry.

#### Step 2.5: Metrology & Prestonian Rate Calibration Extraction
1. Measure pre- and post-CMP W film thickness across 49-point diameter scans using a 4-Point Probe (4PP) resistivity mapping tool:
   $$T_W = \frac{\rho_{\text{eff}}}{R_{\text{sheet}}}$$
2. Measure pre- and post-CMP $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness across identical coordinates via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE).
3. Compute Material Removal Rate ($\text{MRR}_W$ and $\text{MRR}_{\text{Oxide}}$) in $\text{\AA/min}$ or $\text{nm/min}$.
4. Plot $\text{MRR}_W$ versus $P \cdot V$ product ($\text{kPa} \cdot \text{m/s}$). Extract slope $K_p$ by linear regression and verify Prestonian linearity ($R^2 \ge 0.99$).
5. Compute slurry selectivity ratio:
   $$S_{W/\text{Ox}} = \frac{\text{MRR}_W}{\text{MRR}_{\text{Oxide}}}$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Tolerance / Spec Limit | Measurement Method / Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Active Slurry pH** | $2.20$ | $\pm 0.15$ (Range: $2.05\text{--}2.35$) | Calibrated inline/benchtop automated pH electrode |
| **Tungsten Polish Rate ($\text{MRR}_W$)** | $280\text{ nm/min}$ (at $P=3.5\text{ psi}$, $V=1.15\text{ m/s}$) | $\pm 20\text{ nm/min}$ ($\pm 7.1\%$) | 4-Point Probe (4PP) 49-point sheet resistance map |
| **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU)** | $3.5\%$ ($1\sigma$) | $\le 5.0\%$ | $[(\sigma_{\text{MRR}} / \text{MRR}_{\text{mean}}) \times 100\%]$ (3mm edge exclusion) |
| **Selectivity ($W : \text{SiO}_2$)** | $45 : 1$ | $\ge 35 : 1$ | 4PP (W loss) vs. Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\text{SiO}_2$ loss) |
| **Prestonian Linearity ($R^2$)** | $0.995$ | $\ge 0.990$ across $[P \cdot V]$ test space | Linear regression fit ($K_p$ calibration curve) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Defines the structural baseline of the $180\text{ nm}$ node incorporating $8F^2$ stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects, and strict leakage constraints ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), requiring sub-nanometer planarization to prevent bridging and parasitic contact resistance degradation.
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Establishes $180\text{ nm}$ cell geometry, critical bitline/wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$), and gate dielectric baseline, dictating strict oxide erosion and dishing budgets during contact module plug clearing.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-180NM-W-CMP-002`
## Title: Two-Step Bulk W Removal & TiN Barrier Polish Recipe Simulation
**Parent Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type COB 3D Stack > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > W-Plug $\text{WF}_6$ Reduction & CMP Planarization Contact Module Simulation > Tungsten CMP Overburden Removal & Dishing Metrology Profile Simulation  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Simulation Setup

In the 180nm 1T1C COB DRAM flow, the tungsten contact plug connects the active device drain/source nodes to the crown storage capacitor and bitlines across tight cell pitch geometries ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, pitch $\approx 360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$). To form isolated, coplanar W-plugs without keyhole voiding, shorting, or excessive recess/dishing, CMP planarization utilizes a calibrated two-step polish model:
- **Platen 1 (P1 - Bulk Tungsten Polish):** High-removal-rate acidic slurry with selective oxidizer targeting bulk overburden clearance down to the TiN adhesion/barrier layer.
- **Platen 2 (P2 - Barrier & Soft Touch Polish):** Selective slurry targeting the TiN barrier layer and initial ILD/oxide touch, engineered to stop uniformly on the interlayer dielectric with minimal plug recess.

```
       [Bulk W Overburden (~400 nm)]
─────────────────────────────────────────────
 ─── TiN Adhesion/Barrier Layer (~20 nm) ───
=============================================
   ILD Oxide      | W-Plug |      ILD Oxide
 (Pitch: 360-400nm)| L=180nm| (Pitch: 360-400nm)
                  | W=220nm|
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Simulation Procedure

1. **Geometry & Substrate Profile Initialization:**
   - Import post-CVD W-fill topography into the surface kinematics TCAD engine.
   - Define cell geometry parameters: transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and cell array contact pitch across $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Initialize the layered thin-film stack: ILD oxide, conforming Ti/TiN barrier liner, and bulk tungsten overburden.

2. **Step 1: Bulk W Overburden Polish (P1 Model):**
   - Apply Prestonian removal kinematics: $\text{MRR} = K_p \cdot P \cdot V$, where downforce pressure is parameterized at $4.0 - 5.0\text{ psi}$ and platen/carrier rotational speeds set at $80 - 110\text{ rpm}$.
   - Select acidic silica slurry with $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2 / \text{Fe}(\text{NO}_3)_3$ oxidizer system calibrated for high tungsten etch rate ($> 3000\text{ \AA/min}$) and high selectivity to TiN ($\text{Sel}_{\text{W:TiN}} > 20:1$).
   - Run simulation until optical/motor eddy-current endpoint detection registers breakthrough to the TiN barrier layer.

3. **Step 2: TiN Barrier Clearance & Dielectric Touchdown (P2 Model):**
   - Transition kinematics to lower mechanical downforce ($1.5 - 2.5\text{ psi}$) and platen speed ($60 - 75\text{ rpm}$) to mitigate contact plug micro-scratching.
   - Switch slurry model to high-selectivity barrier polish chemistry ($\text{Sel}_{\text{TiN:W}} \ge 1:1$, $\text{Sel}_{\text{TiN:SiO}_2} \approx 3:1 - 5:1$).
   - Execute fixed-time polish simulation with controlled $15\% - 20\%$ overpolish to completely clear residual TiN stringers across dense array fields without punching through the ILD dielectric.

4. **Step 3: Topography & Dishing/Erosion Metrology Extraction:**
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles across the dense 8F² contact array.
   - Measure center-to-edge plug recess, contact plug dishing, array field oxide erosion, and perimeter topography.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Contact Target Dimension** | $L = 180 \pm 10$, $W = 220 \pm 15$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / TCAD Mesh Extraction |
| **Contact Array Pitch Boundary** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Metrology Profile Analysis |
| **Array Oxide Loss / Field Erosion** | $\le 15.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometric / AFM Simulation Profiler |
| **W-Plug Center Recess / Dishing** | $\le 20.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-Resolution AFM Profile Simulation |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Unit Cell Geometry:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): AFM Topography & Optical Profilometry Dishing Metrology Characterization

## Module: Metrology / CMP Planarization Contact Module
**Target Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Unit Cell, Crown-Type COB Architecture)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)  
**Objective**: Quantify micro-scale tungsten plug dishing and dielectric erosion across storage node and bitline contact plug arrays using Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) and non-destructive Optical Profilometry.

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

#### Phase A: Automated Optical Profilometry (Macro/Die-Level Dielectric Erosion & Step Height)
1. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-W-CMP cleaned wafer onto the optical profilometer vacuum chuck.
   - Execute automated notch alignment and global coordinate mapping.
2. **Die-Level Roughness & Step-Height Scan**:
   - Calibrate white-light interferometry / phase-shifting interferometry mode with reference mirror tilt alignment.
   - Measure 49-point wafer mapping across center, middle, and edge radial zones to profile macro-topography variations across dense memory arrays versus isolated test structures.
   - Extract dielectric erosion profiles between active cell arrays (pitch: 360 nm to 400 nm) and peripheral oxide fields.

#### Phase B: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) High-Resolution Plug Dishing Profile
3. **AFM Tip Selection & Cantilever Calibration**:
   - Mount a high-aspect-ratio silicon tip (nominal tip radius < 10 nm, spring constant ~40 N/m).
   - Calibrate laser deflection sum signal and photodiode centering; establish resonance frequency (~300 kHz) for Tapping/Non-Contact Mode to prevent tip wear on tungsten plugs.
4. **Pattern Recognition & Navigation**:
   - Align the AFM optical optics to the COB contact plug array in the 8F² memory cell array (unit cell layout: access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set scan coordinates to target the shared bitline drain contact and storage node W-plugs.
5. **Topography Acquisition**:
   - Set scan window to $2\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 2\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (capturing $>16$ adjacent contact plugs across the 360–400 nm pitch grid).
   - Set scan rate to $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to $1.0\text{ Hz}$ at $512 \times 512$ pixel resolution.
6. **Data Processing & Dishing Extraction**:
   - Apply 1st-order line-by-line polynomial flattening to eliminate sample tilt.
   - Extract cross-sectional height profiles across the center of adjacent tungsten plugs.
   - Calculate tungsten dishing depth ($H_{\text{dishing}} = Z_{\text{oxide\_field}} - Z_{\text{plug\_center}}$) and perimeter dielectric erosion.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **W-Plug Dishing Depth** | $\le 15$ | $\text{nm}$ | Tapping-mode AFM (cross-sectional line trace) |
| **Array Dielectric (Oxide) Erosion** | $\le 20$ | $\text{nm}$ | Optical Profilometry / AFM step-height |
| **Array Pattern Pitch Verification** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM line profile (plug-to-plug pitch) |
| **Wafer-Level Topography Map Sampling** | $49$ | $\text{points}$ | Automated Optical Profilometry mapping |

---

### 3. Context & Literature Citations

* **Cell Geometry & Array Pitch**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ *(Sources: "180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench" & "Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering")*.
* **Interconnect Stack**: Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) *(Source: "180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench")*.
* **Wafer Map Metrology Strategy**: Standardized automated 49-point wafer mapping protocol for tracking radial non-uniformity across process runs *(Source: "Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology")*.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Kelvin Test Structure Layout & 3D TCAD Contact Mesh Generation

**Document Link:** [sop_kelvin_tcad_mesh_generation.md](docs/sop_kelvin_tcad_mesh_generation.md)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Council Classification:** Circuit Design / Metrology & TCAD

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Layout Definition:   │
│   Kelvin 4-Terminal    │
│       Structure        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     GDSII / OASIS      │
│    Hierarchy Export    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   3D TCAD Boundary &   │
│  Material Deposition   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Adaptive Mesh      │
│  Generation: Contact   │
│  Interface Refinement  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Electromigration &   │
│    Current Crowding    │
│       Simulation       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Kelvin Four-Terminal Layout Generation**:
   - Establish access transistor geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology)*.
   - Set critical interconnect pitch: Bitline and Wordline pitch to $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ *(Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture)*.
   - Lay out 4 isolated test pads for Force(+), Sense(+), Force(-), and Sense(-): width $W_{\text{pad}} = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$ *(Source: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM))*.
   - Route lower Force/Sense arms to active diffusion and upper Force/Sense arms to the contact plug metal cap with $180\text{ nm} \times 180\text{ nm}$ contact via window.

2. **3D TCAD Domain Construction**:
   - Import the GDSII boundary cropped to $X \in [-1.0\ \mu\text{m}, +1.0\ \mu\text{m}]$, $Y \in [-1.0\ \mu\text{m}, +1.0\ \mu\text{m}]$.
   - Stack materials vertically: Si substrate ($Z = -0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ to $0\ \mu\text{m}$), barrier $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$ ($10\text{ nm} / 15\text{ nm}$), Tungsten ($\text{W}$) plug ($Z = 0$ to $0.6\ \mu\text{m}$), and top metal interconnect ($Z = 0.6\ \mu\text{m}$ to $1.0\ \mu\text{m}$).

3. **Adaptive 3D Contact Mesh Discretization**:
   - **Far-field Bulk**: Tetrahedral element sizing $h_{\max} = 100\text{ nm}$.
   - **Transition Regions**: Growth rate $r = 1.25$ toward contact aperture.
   - **W-Plug / Si Current Crowding Interface**: Apply fine mesh refinement box ($Z = -10\text{ nm}$ to $+20\text{ nm}$):
     - In-plane pitch: $\Delta x, \Delta y \le 5\text{ nm}$.
     - Normal interfacial pitch: $\Delta z \le 1.0\text{ nm}$.
     - Corner vertex refinement: Apply localized edge elements $\le 2\text{ nm}$ at all four perimeter corners of the $180\text{ nm} \times 180\text{ nm}$ via edge.

4. **Numerical Simulation & Extraction**:
   - Inject test current $I_{\text{force}} = 10\ \mu\text{A}$ to $100\ \mu\text{A}$ through the Force terminal; record voltage drop $V_{\text{sense}}$ across Sense(+) and Sense(-).
   - Compute Kelvin resistance $R_{\text{Kelvin}} = \frac{V_{\text{sense}}}{I_{\text{force}}}$ and calibrate 2D current-crowding correction factor to extract intrinsic specific contact resistivity $\rho_c$.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░                                  │
Capacitance (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Pad Overlap (um)┤▓▓                                    │
                │▓▓                                    │
   Via Mesh (nm)┤██                                    │
                │██                                    │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       90        180      270     360 
```

1. **Contact Via Aperture Critical Dimension**: $180\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ ($171\text{ nm}$ to $189\text{ nm}$).
2. **Interconnect Pitch DRC Compliance**: Wordline and Bitline pitch within $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ with zero design rule violations.
3. **Contact Interfacial Normal Mesh Pitch ($\Delta z$)**: $\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ across the $\pm 10\text{ nm}$ transition boundary of the $\text{W-plug}/\text{Si}$ interface.
4. **Mesh Element Quality**: Minimum dihedral / tetrahedral angle $\alpha_{\min} \ge 18^\circ$ (zero inverted or zero-volume elements).

---

### Verified Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), COB architecture, and Tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**: Test pad sizing ($W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$), pad spacings, and specific contact resistivity formulation ($\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Interconnect pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$) and cell capacitance specification ($25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$).

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Four-Terminal Kelvin Test Structure Parametric GDS Layout & Pad Routing

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Define the layout synthesis, parametric pad placement, and routing rules for a four-terminal Kelvin cross-bridge/contact test vehicle in a 180nm DRAM process. This structure eliminates parasitic probe contact and wire resistance, directly isolating the specific interface resistance ($R_c$) of the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact and bitline/storage-node interfaces.

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Parametric Contact & Via Cell Definition**:
   - Instantiate the central Kelvin junction using the target node contact: define the via/contact layer representing the tungsten plug (W-plug) connecting the bottom conduction layer (e.g., active area/polysilicon/M1) and the top metallization layer (e.g., bitline/M2).
   - Constrain the contact geometry according to the technology design rules matching the 180nm node dimensions (feature length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, contact critical dimension matching the pitch budget of $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).

2. **Orthogonal Lead & Branch Generation (Cross-Bridge Topology)**:
   - Route two distinct conductive leads to the top layer of the contact interface: one force trace ($I^+$) and one sense trace ($V^+$).
   - Route two distinct conductive leads to the bottom layer below the contact interface: one force return trace ($I^-$) and one sense return trace ($V^-$).
   - Layout leads orthogonally or in a cross-bridge geometry to minimize lateral current crowding across the boundary corners and avoid overlapping sense and force current paths prior to the contact interface.

3. **Pad Array Floorplanning & Routing**:
   - Route each of the four branches ($I^+$, $V^+$, $V^-$, $I^-$) to a dedicated square probing pad.
   - For automated wafer-level collinear probe cards or individual probers, arrange the pad pitch and size to accommodate probe tips (e.g., tip radius $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$, standard collinear or $2\times 2$ pitch).
   - Ensure symmetric trace lengths and balanced sheet resistances on the sense lines ($V^+$, $V^-$) to prevent offset drift during high-impedance voltmeter measurements.

4. **Design Rule Checking (DRC) & GDS Stream-Out**:
   - Run full design rule checks (DRC) covering metal pitch ($360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$ spacing limits), minimum enclosure of the W-plug by top and bottom conductive layers, and antenna rules on large probe pads.
   - Stream out the finalized test vehicle block into GDSII format under cell name `KELVIN_WPLUG_180NM`.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method / Physical Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Contact/Feature Dimension** | $180\text{ nm}$ (length) / $220\text{ nm}$ (width) | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | CD-SEM (Critical Dimension SEM) |
| **Interconnect Pitch (Bitline / Wordline)** | $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$ | Design limit $\ge 360\text{ nm}$ | Automated GDS DRC Engine |
| **Test Probe Tip Compatibility** | $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$ tip radius | Design clearance | Physical prober pad clearance / CD-SEM |
| **Kelvin Forcing Current Range** | $1.0\text{ mA}\text{ to }10\text{ mA}$ | Rated continuous current | Automated Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (SMU) |

---

#### 4. Context Source Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; tungsten plug (W-plug) contact interface between stacked capacitor and bitline node.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.
- **[Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance]**: Probing mechanics and current ranges ($I = 1\text{ mA}\text{ to }10\text{ mA}$), probe tip radius ($50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$), and four-terminal potential drop metrology principles.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-TCAD-180-WPLUG-001: 3D Solid Geometry Reconstruction & Adaptive Boundary Mesh Generation for W-Plug Interface

### Workflow Topology

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     GDSII / Kelvin     │
│   Layout Extraction    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      3D Solid CSG      │
│     Reconstruction     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Conformal Ti/TiN    │
│  Liner Layer Modeling  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        Adaptive        │
│  Octree/Delaunay Mesh  │
│       Refinement       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Interface Boundary   │
│       Quality &        │
│   Convergence Check    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Kelvin Test Structure Boundary & Layout Ingestion**:
   - Import the Kelvin four-terminal test structure layout from the GDSII stream.
   - Establish bounding box limits aligned to the unit cell grid: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and pitch dimensions constrained by the $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline grid.
   - Position the contact via coordinates directly over the active area/drain junction and Metal-1 tap.

2. **3D Solid Geometry Reconstruction (CSG Emulation)**:
   - Extrude the active silicon substrate and drain diffusion tap ($W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Construct the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) stack.
   - Perform a Boolean subtraction to define the contact via barrel extending through the ILD down to the silicon interface.
   - Extrude the overlying Metal-1 interconnect layer using an exact physical thickness target of $350\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 5\%$).

3. **Conformal Barrier/Liner & Plug Volume Definition**:
   - Model the conformal Ti/TiN adhesion/diffusion barrier shell lining the sidewalls and bottom of the contact hole.
   - Solidify the core volume of the contact via as the chemical vapor deposited Tungsten (W) plug body contacting the bottom drain diffusion and capped by the $350\text{ nm}$ Metal-1 layer.

4. **Adaptive Boundary Mesh Refinement**:
   - Define sub-micron mesh refinement windows localized around the high current density zones: W-plug/TiN/drain junction interface and W-plug/Metal-1 transition interface.
   - Configure non-uniform directional mesh grading: apply a fine normal discretization step ($\Delta z \le 1.0\text{ nm}$ to $2.0\text{ nm}$) across the material boundaries to capture current crowding and potential drop.
   - Apply Delaunay tetrahedralization or conformal octree meshing with geometric progression grading away from the boundary interfaces into bulk dielectric regions.

5. **Mesh Integrity and Quality Verification**:
   - Execute a Delaunay element quality audit: verify minimum dihedral angles, aspect ratio thresholds, and boundary element conformity.
   - Verify boundary mesh node sharing to prevent hanging nodes or non-conformal interpolations across the heterogeneous metal-semiconductor and metal-metal interfaces prior to TCAD drift-diffusion/ohmic transport solving.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Metal-1 Extrusion Physical Thickness** | $350 \pm 17.5$ ($\pm 5\%$) | $\text{nm}$ | 3D Solid Geometry Coordinate Verification |
| **Active Substrate Interface Footprint** | $180 \times 220$ ($L \times W$) | $\text{nm} \times \text{nm}$ | CSG Bounding Box Metrology |
| **Array Bitline/Wordline Pitch Range** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Layout Pitch Distance Rule Check |
| **Interface Mesh Edge Quality Factor** | $\ge 0.35$ (Aspect Ratio $\le 4:1$ at boundary) | Dimensionless | TCAD Mesh Engine Element Quality Inspector |

---

### 3. Literature Context & Citation

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transistor layout geometry: access channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Memory cell transition utilizes stacked Crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) with drain contact routing via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Cell architecture is 1T1C with $8F^2 / 6F^2$ footprint; bitline and wordline pitch is calibrated between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - Overlying interconnect metallization (Metal-1) target thickness calibrated at $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ for contact landing and Kelvin routing.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-TCAD-MESH-180NM-001`
**Title:** TCAD Contact Mesh Discretization Quality Metrology & Delaunay Aspect Ratio Validation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type COB 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > Kelvin Structure Parasitic Contact Resistance & Current Crowding TCAD Extraction > Kelvin Test Structure Layout & 3D TCAD Contact Mesh Generation > TCAD Contact Mesh Discretization Quality Metrology & Delaunay Aspect Ratio Validation  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial / Off-The-Shelf TCAD Mesh Engine Qualification)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Metrology Pipeline

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Import GDSII Kelvin   │
│   Contact Structure    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     3D Delaunay /      │
│      Voronoi Mesh      │
│       Generation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Compute Tetrahedral   │
│    Aspect Ratio and    │
│    Dihedral Angles     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Adaptive Mesh      │
│  Refinement at W-Plug  │
│   Contact Interface    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Check Discretization  │
│    Convergence and     │
│     Export to TCAD     │
│         Engine         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry Import & Boundary Discretization**:
   - Ingest the 3D solid model of the Kelvin test structure derived from the 180nm cell layout (contact area corresponding to access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and shared bitline/storage node contacts with pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Define material domain boundaries: Silicon active area, titanium silicide interface, and tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. **Delaunay / Voronoi 3D Tessellation**:
   - Execute constrained 3D Delaunay triangulation to discretize the contact volume into non-overlapping tetrahedra.
   - Enforce boundary Delaunay compliance ensuring all circumspheres of surface triangles are empty of conflicting vertices.
3. **Contact Interface Adaptive Refinement**:
   - Establish gradient mesh sizing along the current-crowding path across the tungsten plug (W-plug) to silicon active region.
   - Apply geometric refinement boxes along the contact interface to resolve electrostatic potential and current density gradients without causing sudden mesh density transitions.
4. **Metrology Quality Evaluation & Aspect Ratio Metric Extraction**:
   - Compute element-wise radius-ratio aspect ratios:
     $$\text{AR} = \frac{R_{\text{circum}}}{3 \cdot r_{\text{in}}}$$
   - Calculate minimum and maximum dihedral angles ($\theta_{\min}, \theta_{\max}$) for each tetrahedral element across the entire Kelvin contact domain.
   - Flag slivers, caps, and needle elements failing the quality criteria.
5. **Quality Verification & Solver Export**:
   - Confirm discretization quality criteria are satisfied across $100\%$ of active conduction volumes.
   - Export validated `.grd` / `.msh` mesh file into the TCAD Poisson/drift-diffusion transport solver for parasitic Kelvin contact resistance extraction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Contact Footprint** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Coordinate metrology on active boundary mesh |
| **Bitline / Wordline Layout Pitch Mesh Domain** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-sectional boundary dimension inspection |
| **Delaunay Tetrahedral Aspect Ratio ($R_{\text{circum}} / 3r_{\text{in}}$)** | $\le 4.5$ (Worst-case $\le 10.0$ at non-interface bulk) | unitless ratio | Automated grid quality log parser |
| **Minimum Dihedral Angle ($\theta_{\min}$)** | $\ge 15.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | 3D mesh diagnostic inspector (no sliver elements) |
| **Maximum Dihedral Angle ($\theta_{\max}$)** | $\le 155.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | 3D mesh diagnostic inspector (no flattened cap elements) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates access transistor physical channel dimensions: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Identifies contact structure stack: crown-shaped structure erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) and shared bitline contact topology.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Validates bitline and wordline pitch boundaries of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, defining outer mesh domain bounding boxes.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Confirms folded bitline differential signal development requirements dependent on parasitic contact resistance minimization.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): W-Plug Ti/TiN Barrier Interfacial Transport & Current Crowding TCAD Simulation

**Document ID:** `SOP-TCAD-MET-WPLUG-180NM`  
**Classification:** Technical / Metrology & Process TCAD Leaf SOP  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Cell Topology:** 1T1C COB (Capacitor Over Bitline, 8F²)  

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the numerical modeling, mesh refinement, and transport extraction protocols for evaluating tungsten plug (W-plug) contact resistance, interfacial carrier tunneling through the Ti/TiN diffusion barrier/adhesion liner, and perimeter current crowding effects into n⁺/p⁺ silicon active regions of 180nm DRAM cells.

---

## 2. Structural & Material Architecture

```
           [ Top Metal Contact / Bitline Interconnect ]
                        │
                        ▼
       ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
       │     Bulk Tungsten Core (W)      │  ρ_bulk ~ 5.3-10 µΩ·cm
       ├─────────────────────────────────┤
       │     CVD TiN Barrier Layer       │  Diffusion Barrier
       ├─────────────────────────────────┤
       │     PVD/CVD Ti Ohmic Contact    │  TiSi2 silicide interface
       └────────────────┬────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
       [ n+/p+ Doped Silicon Active Area ] (Access Transistor Drain/Source)
```

### Physical & Geometric Dimensions
* **Access Transistor Active Diffusion:** Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology)*.
* **Cell Layout Footprint:** Folded bitline $8F^2$ topology with wordline/bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$ *(Sources: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology, Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture)*.
* **W-Plug Critical Dimension (Diameter):** $180\text{ nm}$ nominal via opening aligned to active diffusion contact.
* **Ti/TiN Liner Stack:**
  * Titanium (Ti) underlayer: $10\text{ nm}$ to $15\text{ nm}$ for titanium silicide ($\text{TiSi}_2$) contact formation.
  * Titanium Nitride (TiN) barrier: $15\text{ nm}$ to $20\text{ nm}$ to prevent WF₆ chemical attack during CVD tungsten deposition.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Simulation Procedure

### Step 1: 3D/2.5D TCAD Mesh Definition & Geometry Construction
1. Define the 3D active silicon substrate volume ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) doped with donor implants for n⁺ storage node/bitline diffusion ($N_D \ge 1 \times 10^{20}\text{ cm}^{-3}$).
2. Construct the circular/cylindrical via opening above the junction with top diameter $180\text{ nm}$.
3. Conformal shell deposit the Ti ($10\text{ nm}$) and TiN ($15\text{ nm}$) liners along sidewalls and contact bottom, capped with a bulk Tungsten (W) fill.
4. Establish dynamic adaptive mesh refinement:
   * Silicon bulk: $\Delta x, \Delta y, \Delta z \le 10\text{ nm}$.
   * Ti/TiN-to-Si interface region: Sub-nanometer refinement ($\Delta z \le 0.5\text{ nm}$) over a $5\text{ nm}$ window across the silicide interface to accurately resolve electric field gradients and thermionic field emission.

### Step 2: Physical Models & Interfacial Transport Setup
1. **Drift-Diffusion & Band-to-Band Models:** Activate Fermi-Dirac carrier statistics, high-field saturation, and incomplete dopant ionization.
2. **Contact Interfacial Tunneling:**
   * Implement Non-Local Tunneling (WKB approximation) across the TiSi₂/Si barrier to account for Field Emission (FE) and Thermionic-Field Emission (TFE).
   * Specify metal work function $\Phi_m$ calibrated for the Ti/TiN-silicide interface yielding a nominal Schottky barrier height $\Phi_B \sim 0.55\text{–}0.60\text{ eV}$ to n-type Si.
3. **Resistivity Assignments:**
   * Bulk W: $\rho = 10\ \mu\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   * TiN liner: $\rho = 150\ \mu\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   * Ti/TiSi₂ layer: $\rho = 15\ \mu\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

### Step 3: Bias Conditions & Current Crowding Extraction
1. Apply boundary potentials: Ground ($0\text{ V}$) to the silicon active diffusion boundary, sweep contact voltage $V_{\text{contact}}$ from $-0.2\text{ V}$ to $+0.2\text{ V}$ at operational temperatures ($T = 300\text{ K}$ and $T = 358\text{ K} / 85^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Extract current density vector field $\vec{J}(x, y, z)$ along the contact perimeter to map current crowding at the edges where current turns from horizontal diffusion to vertical plug flow.
3. Determine contact transfer length ($L_T$) and calculate contact resistance ($R_c$) and specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) using the Transmission Line Model formulation:
   $$\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2 \quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$
   *(Source: Transmission Line Measurement for Specific Contact Resistivity)*.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method | Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Specific Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{-7}$ | $\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$ | Extracted from TCAD current density slope vs. voltage at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ | *Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity* |
| **Contact Transfer Length ($L_T$)** | $\le 0.18$ ($\le L = 180\text{ nm}$) | $\mu\text{m}$ | $L_T = \sqrt{\rho_c / R_s}$ evaluated along the active diffusion edge | *Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity* |
| **Off-State Junction Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Total leakage integrated at contact perimeter at $V = 1.0\text{ V}$, $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Storage Node Minimum Capacitance Margin ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 25.0$ to $28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Post-contact coupling extraction verification | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |

---

## 5. References & Context Citations
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), 1 fA/cell leakage limit at 85°C, and $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ minimum capacitance budget.
* **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity:** Formulation for total resistance $R_T = 2R_c + (R_s/W)d$, transfer length $L_T$, and specific contact resistivity $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** $8F^2$ cell pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$), 1T1C COB architecture, and $25\text{–}30\text{ fF}$ retention budget.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-TCAD-180-WPLUG-MESH`
**Title:** Ti/TiN Liner & W-Plug Contact Geometry & Mesh TCAD Setup  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > Kelvin Structure Parasitic Contact Resistance & Current Crowding TCAD Extraction > W-Plug Ti/TiN Barrier Interfacial Transport & Current Crowding TCAD Simulation > Ti/TiN Liner & W-Plug Contact Geometry & Mesh TCAD Setup  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
Establish the 2D/3D TCAD physical geometry domain and refined finite-element mesh for the Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Tungsten Plug (W-plug) contact and Ti/TiN barrier liner. This setup models current crowding, interfacial barrier potential drop, and parasitic contact resistance at the access transistor drain/storage node junction for an 8F² 180nm DRAM cell.

---

### 2. TCAD Setup & Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
       +---------------------------------------------+
       |   W-Plug Top Boundary (Capacitor Node)      |
       |                   (W)                       |
       |     |                                 |     |
       |     |  +---------------------------+  |     |
       |     |  | TiN Barrier (10 nm)       |  |     |
       |     |  | Ti Adhesion/Silicide (10nm|  |     |
       +-----+--+---------------------------+--+-----+
       |   Drain Region (L = 180nm, W = 220nm)       |
       |          Substrate (Silicon)                |
       +---------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Geometry Initialization & Domain Definition:**
   - Define the active silicon access transistor active area with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$) and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Set contact via opening diameter conforming to the 180nm design rule pitch envelope (line/space aligned with bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Model the stacked contact height spanning the pre-metal dielectric layer up to the bottom electrode interface of the crown storage capacitor.

2. **Conformal Barrier Liner & Plug Material Definition:**
   - Deposit conformal liner layers along the sidewalls and bottom silicon contact window:
     - Pure Titanium (Ti) wetting/adhesion layer: $ physical thickness $t_{\text{Ti}} = 10\text{ nm}$.
     - Titanium Nitride (TiN) diffusion barrier layer: physical thickness $t_{\text{TiN}} = 10\text{ nm}$.
   - Fill the remaining high-aspect-ratio contact cylinder with bulk Tungsten ($\text{W}$).
   - Define interfacial silicide layer ($\text{TiSi}_2$) at the $\text{Si} / \text{Ti}$ boundary with barrier height $\Phi_{Bn} \approx 0.6\text{ eV}$.

3. **Multi-Zone Adaptive Mesh Discretization:**
   - **Bulk Region:** Apply a relaxed mesh in the bulk silicon substrate and interior W-plug with maximum grid spacing $\Delta x_{\max} = 20\text{ nm}$, $\Delta y_{\max} = 20\text{ nm}$.
   - **Interfacial Gradient Zone:** Refine grid along the $\text{Si} / \text{Ti} / \text{TiN} / \text{W}$ interfaces:
     - Set mesh normal spacing $\Delta z_{\min} \le 1.0\text{ nm}$ across the $10\text{ nm}$ Ti and $10\text{ nm}$ TiN films.
     - Implement geometric growth ratio $r \le 1.2$ extending into the bulk $\text{W}$ and $\text{Si}$ regions to resolve electric field peaks and current crowding.
   - **Junction Curvature:** Refine mesh around the contact via bottom corners to avoid convergence errors caused by electric field singularities.

4. **Physics Model Assignment & Boundary Conditions:**
   - Enable Fermi-Dirac statistics, high-field saturation, and bandgap narrowing models.
   - Activate thermionic emission and Fowler-Nordheim / tunneling transport mechanisms across the $\text{TiSi}_2 / \text{Si}$ Schottky barrier.
   - Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions on the top of the W-plug (Storage Node Contact electrode) and the silicon bulk contact.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Active Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\pm 0$ (Design input) | $\text{nm}$ | TCAD Geometry Coordinate Verification |
| **Transistor Active Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\pm 0$ (Design input) | $\text{nm}$ | TCAD Geometry Coordinate Verification |
| **Bitline/Wordline Pitch Domain** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | Exact range limit | $\text{nm}$ | Boundary Coordinate Check |
| **Interface Edge Mesh Step Size ($\Delta z_{\min}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | Max threshold | $\text{nm}$ | Grid/Mesh Node Diagnostic Summary |
| **Linear Grid Growth Ratio ($r$)** | $\le 1.20$ | $\pm 0.05$ | Ratio (dimensionless) | Mesh Generator Log Output |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Sourced access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), 8F² folded bitline COB layout, and stacked capacitor implementation via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Sourced bitline and wordline pitch specifications ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) defining cell pitch boundary constraints.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Interfacial Thermionic-Field Emission & Current Crowding TCAD Simulation
**Node & Topology:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm) | 8F² Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB)  
**Process / Metrology Module:** Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Ti/TiN Barrier Interfacial Transport  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the TCAD setup, mesh refinement, and transport model calibration required to extract interfacial contact resistivity ($\rho_c$), thermionic-field emission (TFE) carrier tunneling profiles, and 2D/3D current crowding distributions across the Ti/TiN barrier layer between the n⁺-diffusion drain/storage node contact ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and the tungsten (W) plug contact.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: 3D TCAD Geometry & Meshing Setup
1. Define the 180nm 8F² unit cell geometry for the access transistor drain contact:
   - Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, transistor active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Pitch matching the wordline/bitline boundary constraints ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
2. Construct the storage node contact stack:
   - Heavily doped n⁺-silicon active area ($N_D \ge 1\times 10^{20}\text{ cm}^{-3}$).
   - PVD/CVD Ti contact layer ($10\text{ nm} - 15\text{ nm}$) + TiN barrier liner ($10\text{ nm} - 20\text{ nm}$).
   - CVD Tungsten (W) plug fill.
3. Apply adaptive mesh refinement:
   - Grid spacing $\Delta z \le 0.5\text{ nm}$ normal to the $\text{TiSi}_x/\text{Si}$ and $\text{TiN}/\text{Ti}$ interfaces to capture tunneling band bending.
   - Lateral grid $\Delta x, \Delta y \le 2.0\text{ nm}$ along the perimeter contact edges to resolve perimeter current crowding.

#### Step 2: Physical Model & Transport Calibration
1. Enable quantum mechanical carrier transport models at the contact boundary:
   - Thermionic-Field Emission (TFE) and Field Emission (FE) non-local tunneling across the Schottky barrier ($\Phi_{Bn} \approx 0.55\text{ eV} - 0.60\text{ eV}$ for $\text{TiSi}_2/\text{n-Si}$).
   - Fermi-Dirac statistics with bandgap narrowing (BGN) enabled for degenerately doped regions.
   - Temperature-dependent carrier mobility (Philips unified mobility model) including high field velocity saturation.
2. Calibrate boundary temperatures across the operational specification ($25^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$).

#### Step 3: Bias Sweep & Current Density Extraction
1. Apply quasi-stationary DC sweep across the Kelvin contact test structure from $V = -0.2\text{ V}$ to $+0.5\text{ V}$.
2. Extract the current density vector field $\vec{J}(x, y, z)$ through the contact via.
3. Integrate current density to compute:
   - Specific contact resistivity $\rho_c$ ($\Omega\cdot\mu\text{m}^2$).
   - Current crowding factor $\eta = J_{\text{edge}} / J_{\text{center}}$.
   - Effective contact resistance $R_c$ contributing to the cell RC budget.

#### Step 4: Storage Node RC Verification
1. Export extracted $R_c$ to the cell write/read RC delay model.
2. Verify total storage node series resistance ensures cell charge transfer ($Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$) without bottlenecking sense amplifier differential signal development ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$) within the targeted retention cycle.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement / Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Active Area Critical Dimensions** | $L = 180 \pm 5$, $W = 220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated TCAD mesh boundary parser |
| **Grid Discretization (Interface)** | $\Delta z \le 0.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Local mesh density inspection at Ti/Si interface |
| **Operating Simulation Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | TCAD thermal boundary condition check |
| **Bitline & Wordline Grid Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Layout coordinate boundary metric |
| **Target Sensing Voltage Margin** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Post-transport transient circuit simulation |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Confirmed geometry parameters:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) via tungsten plug (W-plug); leakage current evaluation baseline at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Confirmed pitch parameters:* Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; $8\text{F}^2$ cell topology retention window specification at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - *Confirmed electrical budget:* Charge dump relation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; differential sensing voltage target $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Kelvin Structure Specific Contact Resistivity & Resistance Extraction Validation

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  1. Kelvin Structure Layout & Contact Geometry Setup   │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  2. 4-Terminal DC Probe Forcing (I_force = 1 to 10 mA) │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│   3. Floating Sense Voltage Measurement (V_sense)      │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│ 4. Current Crowding De-embedding & Area Normalization  │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  5. Extraction & Acceptance Criteria Verification      │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

```text
        Physical Parameters and Baseline Constraints    
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │■■■■■■■                               │
  Retention (ms)┤■■■■■■■                               │
                │░░░░                                  │
  Cs Target (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
  Channel L (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
  Channel W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
BL/WL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       95        190      285     380 
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Kelvin Test Structure Layout Setup & Alignment**:
   - Align the 4-terminal Kelvin test structure configured for the COB storage node W-plug contact over the access transistor active diffusion area (channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).
   - Ensure the Ti/TiN barrier bilayer and W-plug via contact window dimensions match the drawn lithographic CD specifications.

2. **Instrument Hookup & 4-Wire Collinear S-Parameter / DC Meter Setup**:
   - Connect the outer force terminals (Pads 1 and 4) to a precision DC current source.
   - Connect the inner sense terminals (Pads 2 and 3) to a high-input-impedance ($> 10\text{ G}\Omega$) digital electrometer/voltmeter to measure floating potential difference without parasitic lead/probe loading.

3. **DC Current Forcing Sweep**:
   - Apply a constant DC drive current $I_{\text{force}}$ stepped between $1.0\text{ mA}$ and $10.0\text{ mA}$ across the outer force loop through the W-plug/barrier/diffusion contact interface.
   - Sweep forward and reverse polarities to verify ohmic linearity and rule out asymmetric non-ohmic Schottky rectification.

4. **Floating Potential Differential Measurement ($V_{\text{sense}}$)**:
   - Record the potential drop across the contact interface:
     $$V_{\text{contact}} = V_{\text{sense}} = V_2 - V_3$$
   - Calculate raw Kelvin contact resistance:
     $$R_{\text{k}} = \frac{V_{\text{sense}}}{I_{\text{force}}}$$

5. **2D/3D Current Crowding & Geometric De-embedding**:
   - Account for 2D/3D current crowding and sheet resistance ($R_s$) contributions of the underlying active diffusion/poly region using the four-point collinear sheet resistance formulation:
     $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right) = 4.5324 \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right)\quad [\Omega/\square]$$
   - Apply geometric finite-boundary correction factor $F(d/s)$ to decouple parasitic diffusion sheet resistance from interfacial resistance.

6. **Specific Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$) Extraction**:
   - Extract the specific contact resistivity $\rho_c$ via:
     $$\rho_c = R_{\text{interface}} \cdot A_{\text{contact}}$$
     where $A_{\text{contact}}$ is the calibrated active contact area of the COB W-plug.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DC Force Current Range** | $1.0\text{ to }10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Outer Kelvin Force SMU Probes ($1\text{--}4$) |
| **Active Transistor Geometry** | $L = 180 \pm 5$, $W = 220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM Metrology |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM / Scatterometry Metrology |
| **Cell Retention & Leakage Baseline** | $\text{Leakage} < 1.0\text{ fA/cell at }85^\circ\text{C}$; $\text{Retention} > 64$ | $\text{fA}$, $\text{ms}$, $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermally Controlled Probe Station ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sheet Resistance Scaling Pre-factor** | $4.5324 \pm 0.0005$ | $\text{ratio } [\pi/\ln(2)]$ | Thin-film 4-point probe potential ratio |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context Sources

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Resistance Parameter Extraction & SPICE Calibration

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-042`  
**Classification:** DRAM Foundation VN — Metrology / Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm Node / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Target Structure:** Kelvin Cross-Bridge Sheet Resistance & Storage Node Contact / W-Plug Resistance Test Vehicle  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the physical test protocol, parameter extraction methodology, and SPICE calibration sequence for 180 nm open-source 1T1C DRAM (8F² cell topology, access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$). The procedure measures sheet resistance ($R_s$), Kelvin contact resistance ($R_c$), and specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) across the Tungsten plug (W-plug) to storage node / drain diffusion boundary, mitigating parasitic lead resistance and current-crowding errors.

```
       [ Force I+ ]
            |
            v  (Cross-Bridge Arm)
 [ Sense V- ]-----[ Junction / Contact ]-----[ Sense V+ ]
            |
            v
       [ Force I- ]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Probe Station Setup & Contact Verification
1. Mount the characterization wafer onto the analytical probe station chuck held at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient calibration baseline) or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (DRAM junction qualification temperature).
2. Align probe needles (tungsten carbide probe tips, tip radius $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$) to the Kelvin cross-bridge pad array.
3. Verify Kelvin pad footprint and spacing (conforming to standard TLM / Kelvin pad width $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, pad length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$). Verify open-circuit probe integrity prior to energizing.

#### Step 2: Cross-Bridge Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Parameter Extraction
1. Apply the four-terminal van der Pauw / cross-bridge configuration:
   - Force a constant DC current $I = 1\text{ mA to } 10\text{ mA}$ between the outer orthogonal cross arms (probes 1 and 4).
   - Measure the floating potential difference $V$ across the perpendicular sense arms (probes 2 and 3).
2. Calculate the baseline diffusion/metal thin-film sheet resistance ($t \ll s/2$):
   $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right) \approx 4.5324 \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right)\quad [\Omega/\square]$$
3. Apply geometric correction factor $F(d/s)$ if boundary proximity to wafer edge is $< 40$ times probe spacing ($s = 1.0\text{ mm}$).

#### Step 3: Four-Point Kelvin Contact Resistance ($R_c$) Measurement
1. Route test current directly across the W-plug / diffusion interface:
   - Inject force current $I_{\text{force}} = 1\text{ mA}$ through the top contact arm via the tungsten plug.
   - Ground the bottom diffusion tap ($I_{\text{return}}$).
2. Sense the voltage drop across the interface using isolated voltage sense taps:
   $$V_{\text{sense}} = V_{\text{contact}} - V_{\text{diffusion}}$$
3. Extract Kelvin contact resistance directly free of parasitic lead resistance:
   $$R_c = \frac{V_{\text{sense}}}{I_{\text{force}}}\quad [\Omega]$$

#### Step 4: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) Correlation & Specific Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$)
1. Measure total resistance $R_T$ across adjacent TLM pads of width $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$ at stepped spacings:
   $$d = 5\ \mu\text{m},\ 10\ \mu\text{m},\ 20\ \mu\text{m},\ 40\ \mu\text{m},\ 80\ \mu\text{m}$$
2. Execute linear regression on $R_T$ vs. gap spacing $d$ using the relationship:
   $$R_T = 2 R_c + \left(\frac{R_s}{W}\right) \cdot d$$
   - Extract slope: $m = R_s / W$ (validates cross-bridge sheet resistance $R_s$).
   - Extract Y-intercept: $Y_0 = 2 R_c$ (confirms Kelvin extracted contact resistance).
   - Extract X-intercept: $X_0 = -2 L_T$, where $L_T$ is the transfer length.
3. Calculate specific contact resistivity:
   $$\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$

#### Step 5: SPICE Model Parameter Calibration & Back-Annotation
1. Incorporate extracted $R_c$ and $R_s$ into the 1T1C subcircuit model:
   - Assign lumped resistor `R_SN_CONTACT` between the access transistor drain ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and the crown-type capacitor bottom electrode.
   - Include cell target parameters: $C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$ and total cell leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Run transient bitline charge-sharing simulations to verify sensing margin and RC settling delay.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Constraint |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin-Film Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $4.5324 \cdot (V / I)$ | $\Omega/\square$ | Verified via 4-point probe with $I = 1\text{ to } 10\text{ mA}$ |
| **Pad Geometry (Kelvin / TLM Structure)** | Width $W = 100$, Length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Spacings: $d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80\ \mu\text{m}$ |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Crown-type stacked capacitor (ONO / high-$k$, $\kappa > 15$) |
| **Unit Cell Retention Leakage Limit** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at junction temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), crown-shaped capacitor over bitline (COB) with W-plug drain contact, dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity:** Pad dimensions ($W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$), gap spacings ($d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80\ \mu\text{m}$), resistance relation $R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, and resistivity extraction formula $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.
* **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance:** Collinear tungsten carbide tips ($r = 50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$, $s = 1.0\text{ mm}$), DC excitation current ($I = 1\text{ to } 10\text{ mA}$), thin-film geometric conversion constant $R_s = (\pi / \ln(2)) \cdot (V / I) = 4.5324 \cdot (V / I)\ [\Omega/\square]$, and edge correction factor $F(d/s)$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-KELVIN-001`
**Title:** Kelvin Cross-Bridge Test Structure Automated DC Probing & I-V Sweeps  
**Module:** Metrology & Electrical Characterization (PCM / TCAD Calibration)  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm, 8F² COB 1T1C DRAM)  
**Target Structure:** Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) to Storage Node Contact / Active Area Kelvin Cross-Bridge  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Load Wafer & Chuck   │
│        Thermal        │
│  Stabilization 85°C   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Optical Pattern    │
│  Alignment & Contact  │
│       Touchdown       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   4-Wire Kelvin DC    │
│    Current Forcing    │
│   I_force: -1mA to    │
│         +1mA          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Differential Sense   │
│   V_sense & Kelvin    │
│    Extraction R_c     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Ohmic Linearity &   │
│   Current Crowding    │
│      Assessment       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Wafer Load & Thermal Chuck Pre-Conditioning:**
   - Load the 180nm process control monitor (PCM) wafer onto the automated prober vacuum chuck.
   - Set the thermal chuck temperature controller to **85.0°C ± 0.5°C** (calibrated to the DRAM standard junction retention qualification baseline).
   - Allow thermal soak stabilization for ≥ 3 minutes to eliminate drift in test probe positioning.

2. **Automated Optical Alignment & Prober Touchdown:**
   - Execute prober optical pattern recognition (PR) on the Kelvin cross-bridge pad group (4-pad Kelvin layout: $I^+$, $I^-$, $V^+$, $V^-$).
   - Set probe tip z-axis overdrive to nominal **35 µm to 45 µm** past the initial electrical contact touchdown point to break the native aluminum/copper pad oxide without punch-through into lower dielectric layers.

3. **SMU Cabling & Triaxial Guard Setup:**
   - Connect four source-measure unit (SMU) channels with guarded triaxial cables configured in true 4-wire Kelvin topology:
     - **SMU 1 ($I^+$):** Force current path into the upper metal runner (W-plug top contact).
     - **SMU 2 ($I^-$):** Current return path via the orthogonal lower diffusion/active area arm ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - **SMU 3 ($V^+$):** High-impedance sense ($R_{in} > 10^{13}\,\Omega$) at the top potential tap.
     - **SMU 4 ($V^-$):** High-impedance sense at the lower diffusion potential tap.

4. **Automated DC I-V Sweep Execution:**
   - Apply a symmetrical bipolar current sweep across SMU 1 and SMU 2:
     - Sweep Range: **$-1.0\text{ mA}$ to $+1.0\text{ mA}$** in step sizes of **$50\ \mu\text{A}$**.
     - Compliance Voltage Limit: Set to **$2.0\text{ V}$** to prevent barrier dielectric puncture or localized thermal runaway.
     - SMU Integration Time: Set to **1 NPLC (Number of Power Line Cycles)** for high signal-to-noise resolution.
   - Concurrently acquire high-precision differential voltage $V_{\text{sense}} = V^+ - V^-$ across SMU 3 and SMU 4 at every current step.

5. **Specific Contact Resistance Extraction & Current Crowding Assessment:**
   - Calculate Kelvin contact resistance:
     $$R_c = \frac{\mathrm{d}V_{\text{sense}}}{\mathrm{d}I_{\text{force}}}$$
   - Fit the linear slope over the range $[-500\ \mu\text{A}, +500\ \mu\text{A}]$ to verify Ohmic contact behavior.
   - Check the Pearson correlation coefficient ($r^2$) of the I-V slope; deviations from linearity indicate non-uniform current crowding across the 180 nm contact interface or barrier diode formation.
   - Automatically log data arrays into the metrology database for TCAD compact model SPICE calibration.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Engineering Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Prober Chuck Temperature** | $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ | DRAM thermal qualification baseline condition for retention/leakage reliability. |
| **Probe Overdrive Travel** | $40\ \mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Bounds: $35\ \mu\text{m} \le z \le 45\ \mu\text{m}$) | Assures low contact probe resistance without damaging test pads. |
| **Kelvin I-V Linearity ($r^2$)** | $\ge 0.9990$ | Dimensionless ($0.9990 \le r^2 \le 1.0000$) | Confirms Ohmic behavior across the W-plug interface without Schottky rectification. |
| **Kelvin DC Extraction Current** | $\pm 1.0\text{ mA}$ | Sweep step: $50\ \mu\text{A} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{A}$ | Sufficient dynamic range for extraction while avoiding electromigration. |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Source 1: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***
  - *Context applied:* Unit cell geometry of access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug); thermal retention evaluation at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Source 2: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***
  - *Context applied:* 180nm cell retention baseline standard evaluated at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for 1T1C storage node stack.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Current Crowding & Geometric Correction Factor Analytical Sheet Resistance Extraction

- **Task**: Current Crowding & Geometric Correction Factor Analytical Sheet Resistance Extraction
- **Scope & Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > Kelvin Structure Parasitic Contact Resistance & Current Crowding TCAD Extraction > Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Resistance Parameter Extraction & SPICE Calibration > Current Crowding & Geometric Correction Factor Analytical Sheet Resistance Extraction
- **Technology Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu$m) / 180nm Node
- **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Methodology

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Start Four-Point    │
│         Test          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘

            │
            ▼

│                       │

│       V_M / I_F       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
```

```text
       Extracted Sheet Resistance Error Reduction (%)   
                                                        
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░                        │
 Bitline Contact Via┤░░░░░░░░░░                        │
Poly-Si Storage Node┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  W-Plug Via Contact┤███████████████                   │
                    │███████████████                   │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0     7.1     14.2    21.4   28.5 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Analytical Extraction Procedure

1. **Test Structure Setup & Boundary Parameter Verification**:
   - Establish Kelvin Cross-Bridge Sheet Resistor (CBKR) test layout dimensions based on cell critical dimensions: contact size $d = 180\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$), diffusion/bridge tap width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and pitch $\approx 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure thermal environment is stabilized at baseline chuck temperatures ($25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for ambient or $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for high-temperature DRAM retention verification).

2. **Kelvin Four-Terminal Current Forcing & Voltage Sensing**:
   - Inject positive forward DC current $I_F = 10.0\ \mu\text{A}$ through Terminal 1 (diffusion tap) down to Terminal 2 (W-plug/metal bridge) while maintaining reverse polarity check ($-10.0\ \mu\text{A}$) to eliminate thermoelectric EMF offsets.
   - Measure the sensed potential drop $V_M$ between high-impedance sense terminals (Terminal 3 on diffusion and Terminal 4 on top metal) using an electrometer/SMU input impedance $> 10^{13}\ \Omega$.
   - Calculate measured Kelvin resistance:
     $$R_{\text{meas}} = \frac{V_M(+I_F) - V_M(-I_F)}{2 \cdot I_F}$$

3. **Current Crowding & Geometric Ratio Formulation**:
   - Extract the dimensional boundary ratio $\delta = d / W = 180\text{ nm} / 220\text{ nm} \approx 0.818$.
   - Compute the analytical 2D sheet resistance correction factor $F_G(\delta)$ representing the non-uniform current flow at the contact periphery:
     $$F_G = \left[ 1 + \left(\frac{4}{\pi}\right) \left(\frac{W}{d}\right) \ln\left(\frac{4}{\pi \delta}\right) \right]^{-1}$$
   - When extraction involves cross-bridge sheet resistance strips ($L_s \gg W$), extract nominal uncorrected sheet resistance $R_{sq,\text{raw}} = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{\Delta V}{I_F}$.

4. **Analytical Contact Resistance ($R_c$) De-embedding**:
   - Compute the true sheet resistance $R_{sq} = R_{sq,\text{raw}} \cdot C_{\text{geom}}$, where $C_{\text{geom}}$ corrects for finite bridge arm widths.
   - Extract parasitic current-crowded interface contribution:
     $$R_c = R_{\text{meas}} - R_{\text{parasitic}}(F_G, R_{sq})$$
   - Formulate specific contact resistivity $\rho_c$ via 1D transmission line transfer length $\ell_t = \sqrt{\rho_c / R_{sq}}$.

5. **SPICE Parameter Calibration & Record Export**:
   - Fit extracted $R_{sq}$ and $R_c$ to the 180nm COB storage node contact SPICE sub-circuit model.
   - Export calibrated parameters into the BSIM/PDK deck for cell RC timing simulation (verifying retention window $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and sense amp $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Acceptance Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Kelvin Sense Current ($I_F$) Compliance** | $10.0$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\mu\text{A}$ | Parameter Analyzer SMU Ammeter |
| **Contact Dimension Ratio ($d/W$)** | $0.818$ ($180\text{ nm} / 220\text{ nm}$) | $\pm 0.025$ | Dimensionless | In-line CD-SEM Metrology |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature Stability** | $85.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Integrated RTD Thermocouple Controller |
| **Analytical $F_G$ Geometric Correction Residual** | $\le 2.0$ | Max $\pm 0.5$ | $\%$ | Analytical Model vs. Numerical 2D TCAD |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node W-plug contact topology erected above the drain contact.
  - Temperature baseline specification of $85^\circ\text{C}$ for leakage and retention targets.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ cell layout architecture with bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum retention time requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with cell capacitance budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Differential signal development requirement of $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ across bitline network under cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline load $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
