# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## W-Plug & Contact Subcircuit SPICE Model Calibration & Monte Carlo Validation

**Document ID:** `SOP-CKT-180-WPLUG-MC-001`  
**Classification:** Technical / Circuit Design & Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Crown-Type COB Topology)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Metrology    │
│  Extraction (Specific Contact Resistivity)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Subcircuit Netlist Synthesis (Distributed   │
│  W-Plug Bulk R_plug + Interface R_c Network) │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  SPICE Nominal Fitting & Model Calibration   │
│  Against 180nm Crown COB Storage Node Specs  │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Statistical Monte Carlo Simulation (N=1000) │
│  & Yield Sign-Off (Delta V & Retention Valid)│
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Data Import & De-embedding**
   - Import I-V metrology curves obtained from four-point Kelvin cross-bridge test structures fabricated on the 180nm wafer.
   - De-embed current-crowding effects and parasitic series resistance from the metal lead lines to isolate the intrinsic specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) and Kelvin contact resistance ($R_{\text{Kelvin}}$) at the tungsten plug (W-plug) to silicon/silicide interface.

2. **Hierarchical Subcircuit SPICE Netlist Construction**
   - Formulate the distributed subcircuit model (`.subckt WPLUG_CONTACT`) representing the COB storage node contact and bitline shared contact:
     - **Plug Bulk Resistance ($R_{\text{plug}}$)**: Calculated using the high-aspect-ratio cylinder resistivity of CVD Tungsten ($W$) across the dielectric thickness over the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - **Interface Resistance ($R_{\text{interface}}$)**: Multi-element ladder or barrier resistance modeling the Ti/TiN adhesion layer and silicide boundary.
     - **Parasitic Contact Capacitance ($C_{\text{contact}}$)**: Extracted sidewall-to-interlayer-dielectric parasitic coupling.

3. **SPICE Parameter Optimization & Calibration**
   - Parameterize nominal resistances and parasitic capacitances into the 180nm 1T1C DRAM macro model.
   - Run nominal transient DC/AC simulations under standard DRAM operation conditions:
     - Wordline access gate: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Precharge voltage: equalized to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
     - Cell storage node capacitance: $C_s \ge 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
     - Bitline load capacitance: $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Calibrate the model so signal development voltage yields $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ within the active sense amplifier activation strobe window.

4. **Statistical Monte Carlo Distribution Assignment**
   - Assign Gaussian statistical variations to the W-plug model parameters accounting for fab process variations:
     - Critical dimension variation of contact diameter ($\pm 3\sigma$ on $180\text{ nm}$ litho/etch).
     - Barrier thickness variation (Ti/TiN layer deposition uniformity).
     - Specific contact resistivity variation based on cross-wafer Kelvin cross-bridge spreads.
   - Execute $N = 1{,}000$ to $10{,}000$ run Monte Carlo transient simulation sweeps at operating temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.

5. **Readout Margin, Retention, and Soft-Error Yield Sign-Off**
   - Evaluate differential read sensing voltage distribution: ensure $\Delta V > 100\text{ mV}$ at $-3\sigma$.
   - Verify junction and sub-threshold leakage currents through the contact remain $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention intervals $> 64\text{ ms}$.
   - Export calibrated BSIM/SPICE subcircuit cards into the PDK release repository.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Minimum $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | SPICE AC Parameter Extraction / Crown Stack Metrology |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ (at $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) | $\text{mV}$ | SPICE Transient Monte Carlo ($-3\sigma$ tail) |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ (at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC Leakage Simulation / Parameter Sign-Off |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | Length $L = 180 \pm 10$, Width $W = 220 \pm 15$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline In-Die Metrology & Model Instance Netlist |
| **Refresh Retention Target** | $> 64.0$ (at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{ms}$ | Macro Timing & Retention Circuit Verification |

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transition toward 8F² folded bitline layouts with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Unit cell geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring soft-error noise immunity.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C architecture with crown/cylinder capacitor requiring $C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Retention time requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Equalization network to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
  - Charge sharing equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
  - Nominal signal development $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-DRAM180-COB-001`  
**Title:** Crown-Type 3D Cylinder Geometry & High-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO Dielectric Stack Optimization  
**Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($180\,\text{nm}$) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture Scope
This SOP defines the fabrication, dimensional verification, and thin-film dielectric deposition flow for erecting stacked crown-type storage nodes positioned over bitlines (COB) contacting the access transistor ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) through tungsten plugs (W-plug). The process engineers high-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or engineered ONO triple-dielectric stacks on 3D cylindrical bottom electrodes to achieve sufficient capacitance per cell within an $8F^2$ footprint (bitline/wordline pitch $\sim 360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Crown Cylinder Fabrication Flow:                                                                  |
|                                                                                                   |
| [1. Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) & W-Plug Polish]                                                  |
|   |--> Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of tungsten plug over access transistor drain     |
|                                                                                                   |
| [2. Mold Oxide Deposition & Deep Cylinder Etch]                                                   |
|   |--> PECVD sacrificial oxide mold; reactive ion etch (RIE) to open storage node cylinder hole   |
|                                                                                                   |
| [3. Bottom Electrode Formation (Crown Shell)]                                                     |
|   |--> Conformal polysilicon / TiN deposition inside cylinder hole; CMP/etchback to isolate crowns|
|   |--> Sacrificial mold wet-strip (HF etch) exposing inner & outer cylinder surfaces              |
|                                                                                                   |
| [4. High-k Dielectric Stack Deposition]                                                           |
|   |--> Conformal ALD/LPCVD ONO or Ta2O5 / Al2O3 high-k layer (EOT = 3.0 nm - 4.0 nm, kappa > 15)  |
|                                                                                                   |
| [5. Top Plate (Cell Plate) Counter-Electrode Deposition]                                          |
|   |--> In-situ doped poly-Si / metal top plate CVD encapsulation across 3D cylinders              |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Plug Planarization
1. Verify access transistor drain contacts with tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects planarized via tungsten chemical mechanical planarization (CMP).
2. Ensure underlying bitline layers and inter-metal dielectric (IMD) pass surface topology inspection prior to capacitor mold deposition.

#### Step 2: Sacrificial Mold Oxide Deposition & Cylinder Patterning
1. Deposit sacrificial phosphosilicate glass (PSG) or $\text{SiO}_2$ mold oxide via PECVD.
2. Apply deep-UV lithography to define the storage capacitor cylinder holes aligned to the underlying W-plugs within the $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$ pitch grid.
3. Perform anisotropic reactive ion etching (RIE) down to the landing W-plug, establishing vertical cylinder side-walls.

#### Step 3: Crown Bottom Electrode Formation
1. Deposit conformal polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) barrier layer (e.g., TiN/doped poly-Si) along the inner side-walls and bottom of the cylinder cavities.
2. Polish/etch back the top surface using node-separation CMP to isolate adjacent bottom electrodes.
3. Perform a timed selective wet etch (dilute HF dip) of the sacrificial mold oxide to expose both inner and outer cylindrical surfaces, completing the free-standing crown-type 3D cylinder.

#### Step 4: High-$k$ / ONO Dielectric Stack Deposition
1. Clean bottom electrode surfaces using native-oxide-free dilute chemistry.
2. Deposit the thin-film capacitor dielectric stack:
   - **Option A (High-$k$ Stack):** Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) or CVD of $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ (optionally with an $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ interfacial layer) targeting an effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and an Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.
   - **Option B (ONO Stack):** Thermally controlled LPCVD Oxide-Nitride-Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2 / \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4 / \text{SiO}_2$) triple-dielectric sequence yielding $\text{EOT} = 3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.

#### Step 5: Cell Plate Top Electrode Deposition & Anneal
1. Conformal chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of in-situ doped polysilicon or metal counter-electrode to fully envelop the 3D crown dielectric surfaces.
2. Execute post-deposition thermal treatment (rapid thermal anneal) to stabilize the dielectric crystal phase and eliminate interface trap states while preventing thermal degradation of underlying structures.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Minimum Target | Maximum Target | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 25.0$ (nominal target $\ge 28.0$) | $30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated probe station $C$-$V$ meter ($100\,\text{kHz} - 1\,\text{MHz}$) |
| **AC-02** | Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | — | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Low-current femtoampere parameter analyzer ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$) |
| **AC-03** | Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) | $3.0$ | $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / multi-frequency $C$-$V$ extraction |
| **AC-04** | Dielectric Relative Permittivity ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$) | $> 15.0$ | — | Dimensionless | Extracted from physical thickness vs. accumulation capacitance |
| **AC-05** | Minimum Data Retention Time ($t_{\text{ret}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\ge 64$ | — | $\text{ms}$ | Automated memory array test pattern (disturbed refresh cycle) |

---

### 4. Context References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Unit cell footprint: $8F^2$ / $6F^2$; access transistor channel $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  - Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: $\ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$ for soft-error noise immunity.
  - Dielectric stack options: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack providing $\kappa > 15$.
  - Leakage budget: $\le 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor (Crown or Cylinder type) using $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
  - Target capacitance range: $25\,\text{fF} - 30\,\text{fF/cell}$ to maintain retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM180-CIRC-042`
**Title:** Crown Cylinder 3D Aspect Ratio & Surface Area Analytical Parametrization  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu$m)  
**Layout Architecture:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB)  
**Target Structure:** Polysilicon / MIM Crown Cylinder Storage Node  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Determine Storage    │
│      Node Budget       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Formulate Analytical  │
│          Area          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Parametrize Aspect   │
│         Ratio          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Verification Against  │
│  Differential Margin   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Analytical Parametrization Procedure

#### Step 1: Establish Cell Capacitance and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Targets
1. Set the target storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (acceptable operational design window: $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$) to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and protect against alpha-particle soft errors.
2. Select the high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO) with an effective relative dielectric permittivity $\kappa > 15$ and target Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ ($t_{\text{ox,eq}} = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$ to $4.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$).

#### Step 2: Formulate Required Effective Surface Area ($A_{\text{eff}}$)
1. Apply the parallel-plate electrostatic approximation for thin conformal dielectric films:
   $$C_s = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} \cdot A_{\text{eff}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\text{EOT}} \cdot A_{\text{eff}}$$
   Where:
   - $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}$
   - $\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.9$
   - Permittivity ratio: $\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}$
2. Calculate the required effective active area for nominal $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ with $\text{EOT} = 3.5\text{ nm}$:
   $$A_{\text{eff}} = \frac{C_s \cdot \text{EOT}}{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}} = \frac{28 \times 10^{-15}\text{ F} \times 3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}}{3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}} \approx 0.284\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$$

#### Step 3: Parametrize 3D Crown Cylinder Geometry & Aspect Ratio ($AR$)
1. **Footprint & Diameter:**  
   In the $8F^2$ cell pitch ($F = 180\text{ nm}$, wordline and bitline pitch $P = 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), define the cylinder outer diameter $D_{\text{out}} \approx 200\text{ nm}$ to $220\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and crown shell wall thickness $t_{\text{wall}} \approx 25\text{ nm}$ to $30\text{ nm}$. Inner diameter $D_{\text{in}} = D_{\text{out}} - 2t_{\text{wall}} \approx 150\text{ nm}$ to $160\text{ nm}$.
2. **Surface Area Formulation:**  
   The crown cylinder dual-surface provides capacitive area from both outer and inner sidewalls plus bottom surfaces:
   $$A_{\text{eff}} \approx \pi \cdot (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) \cdot H_{\text{cyl}} + \frac{\pi}{4}(D_{\text{in}}^2)$$
   With mean diameter $D_{\text{mean}} = \frac{D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}}{2} \approx 185\text{ nm} = 0.185\text{ }\mu\text{m}$:
   $$A_{\text{sidewall}} \approx 2\pi D_{\text{mean}} H_{\text{cyl}} \approx 1.162 \cdot H_{\text{cyl}}$$
3. **Solve Cylinder Height & Aspect Ratio:**  
   - Base area contribution: $A_{\text{base}} \approx \frac{\pi}{4}(0.16)^2 \approx 0.020\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Required sidewall area: $A_{\text{sidewall}} = 0.284 - 0.020 = 0.264\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Required height: $H_{\text{cyl}} = \frac{0.264}{1.162} \approx 0.227\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $0.350\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (accounting for taper angles and non-idealities).
   - Aspect Ratio ($AR = H_{\text{cyl}} / D_{\text{out}}$): Target $AR$ range is parametrized between $1.2:1$ and $1.8:1$, preventing high-aspect-ratio cylinder collapse while achieving capacitance.

#### Step 4: Validate Readout Signal Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)
1. Evaluate signal margin dumped onto the folded bitline via access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$):
   $$\Delta V = \left( \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \right) \cdot \left( V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2} \right)$$
2. Confirm that with $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ and nominal bitline parasitic $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V$ falls strictly within the required $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ differential sensing window for the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Target Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Direct LCR CV-profiling at $1\text{ MHz}$ ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry & MOS Capacitor CV extraction |
| **Capacitor Leakage Current Density** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Precision picoammeter test at $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sense Amp Differential Readout ($\Delta V$)** | $125$ | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Oscilloscope picoprobe / SPICE transient readout |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**  
  - Confirms unit cell geometry access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in an $8F^2$ folded bitline layout with capacitor erected over W-plug drain contact.  
  - Sets the high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO) permittivity target $\kappa > 15$, minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage ceiling of $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
  - Confirms 1T1C storage capacitor allowable range of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.  
  - Specifies $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ high-$k$ equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, with bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**  
  - Supplies the differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.  
  - Confirms nominal bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, defining the required differential signal development window of $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Crown Cylinder 3D Geometric Envelope & Aspect Ratio Formulation

### 1. Scope & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the analytical formulation, geometric budgeting, and step-by-step physical parametrization for the 3D Crown Cylinder storage node capacitor in an $8F^2$ Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture at the 180 nm node ($F = 180\text{ nm} = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$). The goal is to formulate an exact 3D geometric envelope meeting the target capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) within layout envelope constraints while maintaining mechanical stability.

---

### 2. Physical Layout & Geometric Constraints

```
       |<------------- Outer Diameter D_out ------------->|
       |     |<--------- Inner Diameter D_in --------->|   |
       +-----+                                         +-----+  ^
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       |     |        Storage Dielectric Stack         |     |  |
       |     |       (ONO or Ta2O5 / Al2O3)            |     |  |
       |     |                                         |     |  Cylinder
       |     |                                         |     |  Height H
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       +-----+-----------------------------------------+-----+  v
       |================ Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) =============|
       +-----------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Unit Cell Footprint ($8F^2$ Layout):**
   - Feature size: $F = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Cell Area: $A_{\text{cell}} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.2592\ \mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Bitline and Wordline Pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
2. **Capacitor Envelope Limits:**
   - Maximum allowable outer diameter: $D_{\text{out}} \le 220\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ and respecting inter-crown spacing margins at $360\text{ nm}$ pitch).
   - Bottom electrode wall thickness: $t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 30\text{ nm}$.
   - Inner diameter: $D_{\text{in}} = D_{\text{out}} - 2 \cdot t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 220\text{ nm} - 60\text{ nm} = 160\text{ nm}$.
3. **Dielectric Stack Specification:**
   - Stack: ONO triple dielectric or high-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack.
   - Effective Dielectric Constant: $\kappa \ge 15$.
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $t_{\text{ox,eq}} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ ($3.0 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$ to $4.0 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$).

---

### 3. Analytical Formulation & Calculation Steps

#### Step 1: Effective Capacitance per Unit Area ($C''$)
Using parallel-plate equivalence for thin dielectrics across the 3D surface:
$$C'' = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\text{EOT}} = \frac{(8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}) \times 3.9}{\text{EOT}}$$

For target $\text{EOT} = 3.5\text{ nm} = 3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$:
$$C'' \approx \frac{3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}}{3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}} \approx 9.866 \times 10^{-7}\text{ F/cm}^2 \approx 9.87\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2$$

*(At $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$, $C'' \approx 11.51\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2$)*

#### Step 2: Total Effective Surface Area Budget ($A_{\text{eff}}$)
To achieve the minimum target capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (within the $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ window for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$):
$$A_{\text{eff,req}} = \frac{C_{\text{target}}}{C''} = \frac{28\text{ fF}}{9.87\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2} \approx 2.837\ \mu\text{m}^2$$

#### Step 3: 3D Crown Cylinder Surface Area Formulation
A 3D crown cylinder capacitor utilizes both the outer vertical wall, inner vertical wall, and top/bottom rim/base surfaces:
$$A_{\text{crown}} \approx \pi D_{\text{out}} H + \pi D_{\text{in}} H + \frac{\pi}{4}(D_{\text{in}}^2) = \pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) H + \frac{\pi}{4} D_{\text{in}}^2$$

Substituting nominal dimensions ($D_{\text{out}} = 0.22\ \mu\text{m}$, $D_{\text{in}} = 0.16\ \mu\text{m}$):
$$\pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) = \pi (0.22 + 0.16)\ \mu\text{m} \approx 1.194\ \mu\text{m}$$
$$\text{Base Area } A_{\text{base}} = \frac{\pi}{4}(0.16\ \mu\text{m})^2 \approx 0.0201\ \mu\text{m}^2$$

Solving for cylinder height $H$:
$$H = \frac{A_{\text{eff,req}} - A_{\text{base}}}{\pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}})} = \frac{2.837 - 0.0201}{1.194} \approx 2.36\ \mu\text{m}$$

With process margin and dielectric variation ($\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$), define the cylinder height envelope as:
$$H_{\text{crown}} = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } 2.4\ \mu\text{m}$$

#### Step 4: Aspect Ratio (AR) Formulation
Aspect ratio is formulated as the ratio of cylinder vertical depth/height to the inner/outer critical dimension:
$$\text{AR}_{\text{outer}} = \frac{H}{D_{\text{out}}} = \frac{2.36\ \mu\text{m}}{0.22\ \mu\text{m}} \approx 10.7 : 1$$
$$\text{AR}_{\text{etch}} = \frac{H}{D_{\text{in}}} = \frac{2.36\ \mu\text{m}}{0.16\ \mu\text{m}} \approx 14.8 : 1$$

Both values remain within the etch and mechanical collapse boundaries ($\text{AR} \le 15:1$) for Gen 2 ($180\text{ nm}$) oxide-mold deep reactive-ion etching (DRIE).

---

### 4. Step-by-Step Implementation Procedure

1. **Mold Oxide Deposition:**
   - Deposit sacrificial PECVD $\text{SiO}_2$ mold layer to target thickness $H = 2.36\ \mu\text{m} \pm 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$ directly above the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) containing the tungsten storage node plug (W-plug).
2. **Storage Node Contact Alignment & Deep Trench/Hole Dry Etch:**
   - Pattern cylinder hole array via photolithography aligned to underlying W-plug at pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
   - Perform high-aspect-ratio reactive-ion etch (HAR-RIE) through the sacrificial oxide mold to create openings with top diameter $D_{\text{out}} \le 220\text{ nm}$.
3. **Bottom Electrode Deposition & Node Separation:**
   - Conformally deposit doped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) liner ($t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 30\text{ nm}$) over the inner sidewalls and bottom of the cylindrical oxide cavities.
   - Perform chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP) or etch-back to isolate individual storage nodes at the mold surface.
4. **Sacrificial Mold Wet Strip (Crown Release):**
   - Perform dilute HF/buffered oxide etch (BOE) to strip the sacrificial $\text{SiO}_2$ mold, exposing both inner and outer cylinder sidewalls to form freestanding crowns.
5. **High-$k$ Dielectric & Top Plate Deposition:**
   - Conformally deposit the high-$k$ dielectric layer (ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective $\kappa \ge 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$).
   - Deposit upper plate counter-electrode (poly-Si or metal plate) filling the cylinder cavities and common plate plane.

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Engineering Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Crown Cylinder Height ($H$)** | $2.36$ | $2.00 \text{ to } 2.45$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Cylinder Etch Aspect Ratio ($\text{AR}$)** | $14.8 : 1$ | $\le 15.0 : 1$ | ratio (dimensionless) |
| **Cell Retention Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 6. Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 
  - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), $8F^2$ folded bitline topology, W-plug contact, ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$), target capacitance minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ stacked crown/cylinder capacitor, retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$, dielectric EOT $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-DRAM-180NM-CKT-004
**Title**: Crown Cylinder Footprint & Lateral Clearance Boundary Parametrization  
**Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | **Cell Architecture**: 1T1C Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB), $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Topology  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Define the dimensional footprint, outer diameter ($D_{\text{out}}$), sidewall thickness, and minimum lateral dielectric/mechanical clearance boundaries for a 3D Crown Cylinder storage node capacitor ($C_s$) positioned above the bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) in an $8F^2$ DRAM cell matrix. This procedure ensures cell-to-cell bridging prevention, layout rule conformance, and compliance with cell capacitance retention targets ($25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$).

---

### 2. Theoretical Workflow Diagram

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Establish Pitch & Footprint Envelopes (F = 180 nm, Pitch = 360 - 400 nm)       |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Parameterize Cylinder Diameter & Lateral Clearance Bound (Outer D <= 220-240nm)|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Set ONO / Ta2O5 High-k Dielectric Stack & Plate Clearances (EOT: 3 - 4 nm)     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Validate Total Storage Capacitance & Signal Budget (Cs >= 25 - 28 fF, dV)      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Establish 2D Grid Pitch & Bounding Box ($8F^2$)**:
   - Extract the feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Set the bitline pitch ($P_{\text{BL}}$) and wordline pitch ($P_{\text{WL}}$) within the defined range of **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$** ($2F$ nominal).
   - Define the unit cell boundary allocation: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, access transistor channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

2. **Parameterize Crown Cylinder Outer Footprint & Clearance**:
   - Align the crown cylinder bottom node coaxially over the drain contact tungsten plug (W-plug) above the bitline plane (COB configuration).
   - Set the outer diameter ($D_{\text{out}}$) of the crown cylinder to **$\le 220\text{ nm}$** to maintain symmetric lateral spacing across adjacent diagonal and orthoganol neighbors.
   - Establish the minimum inter-cylinder lateral clearance boundary ($S_{\text{clearance}} = P_{\text{pitch}} - D_{\text{out}}$) to at least **$140\text{ nm}$ to $180\text{ nm}$** across lithographic/etch process windows to prevent bridging during storage node formation.

3. **Incorporate Dielectric Layer Clearance & Top Plate Gap**:
   - Dimension the outer/inner dielectric trench clearance for triple ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$) targeting an Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of **$3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$**.
   - Guarantee that the remaining inter-cell gap after dielectric conformality and common top cell-plate deposition leaves zero micro-void pinch-off defects.

4. **Verify Storage Node Capacitance & Signal Margin Budget**:
   - Calculate analytical surface area across inner and outer vertical cylinder sidewalls and bottom floor to verify that target cell capacitance $C_s$ satisfies **$25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$** (minimum threshold of **$28\text{ fF}$** per cell for noise immunity).
   - Confirm differential voltage development margin on the folded bitline:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
     Ensure nominal $\Delta V$ is in the range of **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** when bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$.
   - Ensure cell layout sub-threshold and junction leakage limits remain **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** to sustain a data retention interval of $> 64\text{ ms}$.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch ($P_{\text{BL}}, P_{\text{WL}}$)** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM inspection |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / CV extraction |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (min. threshold $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated parametric CV tester |
| **Sensing Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Readout oscillogram / SPICE simulation |
| **Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $< 1.0$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Semiconductor parameter analyzer ($I_{\text{off}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked crown topology above drain via W-plug; high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$); capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout; capacitance target of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$); pitch range of $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded bitline precharge equalized to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$; signal development $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; typical signal swing $\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 3D Cylinder Height & Aspect Ratio Optimization for 28fF Target

**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Circuit Design & Process Integration — Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Litho CD Definition:  │
│     180nm to 220nm     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Oxide Mold Deep RIE   │
│          Etch          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Crown Bottom      │
│   Electrode & High-k   │
│       Dielectric       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Capacitance Ccell    │
│     Target: 28 fF      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Cell Footprint & Contact Critical Dimension (CD) Setup**:
   - Establish the 1T1C $8F^2$ layout coordinates based on bitline and wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Align the storage node cylinder envelope over the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact above the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the lithographic cylinder outer diameter target to $D \approx 180\text{ nm}$ to conform to pitch boundary limits without bridging adjacent cells.

2. **Dielectric Stack & Area Formulation**:
   - Configure the storage dielectric layer as an ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack providing an effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Target an Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.
   - Calculate required effective capacitor surface area $A_{\text{eff}}$ using $C = \frac{\kappa \varepsilon_0 A_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO2}} \varepsilon_0 A_{\text{eff}}}{\text{EOT}}$:
     $$\text{Capacitance per unit area } C' = \frac{3.9 \times 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}}{3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}} \approx 9.87\text{ fF/\mu m}^2$$
     $$\text{Required } A_{\text{eff}} \approx \frac{28\text{ fF}}{9.87\text{ fF/\mu m}^2} \approx 2.84\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$$

3. **Cylinder Height & Aspect Ratio Optimization**:
   - In a Crown/Cylinder 3D structure, surface area is mobilized on both the outer and inner cylindrical sidewalls plus base:
     $$A_{\text{eff}} \approx 2 \times (\pi \cdot D \cdot H) + \frac{\pi D^2}{4}$$
   - For diameter $D = 180\text{ nm} = 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$:
     $$\text{Sidewall perimeter contribution } 2\pi D \approx 1.131\text{ }\mu\text{m}$$
     $$H \approx \frac{A_{\text{eff}}}{2\pi D} \approx \frac{2.84\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2}{1.131\text{ }\mu\text{m}} \approx 2.51\text{ }\mu\text{m}$$
   - Set the cylinder mold height target to $2.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $2.6\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
   - Establish the cylinder aspect ratio $\text{AR} = \frac{H}{D} \approx \frac{2.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}}{0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}} \approx 13.9:1$ to $14.5:1$.

4. **Mold Formation, Deep Etch & Wet Release**:
   - Deposit sacrificial oxide mold layer to $2.5\text{ }\mu\text{m} \pm 5\%$ thickness over the planarized bitline stack.
   - Execute anisotropic reactive-ion etch (RIE) to open the cylinder cavities down to the underlying W-plug landing pads with profile angle $\ge 89^\circ$.
   - Deposit conformal bottom electrode (polysilicon or metal TiN/CVD stack).
   - Perform full wet chemical dip etch to strip the sacrificial oxide mold, releasing the inner and outer crown vertical surfaces.

5. **Dielectric Deposition, Top Plate & Electrical In-Line Verification**:
   - Concurrently deposit the high-k stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{ONO}$) uniformly over inner and outer crown walls.
   - Deposit the common plate top electrode and anneal.
   - Measure cell capacitance across memory test arrays using a CV meter or pulse-charge integration.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                       Capacitor Target Metrics         
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Retention (ms)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
              │▒▒                                      │
  Leakage (fA)┤▒▒                                      │
EOT Upper (nm)┤▓▓▓                                     │
              │▓▓▓                                     │
Ccell Min (fF)┤██████████████████                      │
              │██████████████████                      │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        16        32       48        64 
```

| Metric Parameter | Machine-Measurable Target | Tolerance / Boundary | Test Condition / Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | **$\ge 28.0\text{ fF}$** | Min $25.0\text{ fF}$, Nominal $28.0\text{ to }30.0\text{ fF}$ | CV / Pulse test at $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | **$3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$** | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / CV accumulation |
| **Dielectric Effective Constant ($\kappa$)** | **$\kappa > 15$** | Lower bound $\ge 15.0$ | Derived from physical thickness vs EOT |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | **$< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$** | Max $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Parametric tester at elevated temperature $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Data Retention Time** | **$> 64\text{ ms}$** | Refresh interval $\ge 64\text{ ms}$ | Functional memory test array at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Transistor & Cell Dimensions*: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; W-plug interconnect above drain contact.
  - *Dielectric & High-k*: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - *Capacitance & Leakage*: Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error and bitline noise immunity; leakage current kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Architecture & Retention*: 1T1C $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout maintaining $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ storage capacitance guaranteeing data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Pitch & EOT*: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k dielectric with EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Structural Mechanical Stability & Tilt Margin Physical Verification

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    1. Import 3D Crown Cylinder CAD & Layout Rules      │
│     (Cell: 8F², Pitch: 360-400 nm, COB W-Plug Base)    │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    2. Analytical Aspect Ratio (AR) & Envelope Model    │
│    (C_s Target: 25-30 fF, EOT: 3-4 nm, Ta2O5/Al2O3)    │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    3. Capillary Stiction & Wet-Etch Surface Tension    │
│       (Evaluate Lateral Capillary Pull Force F_cap)    │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    4. Mechanical Deflection & Tilt Margin Check        │
│      (Verify Beam Tip Deflection δ_max < Spacing)      │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     5. Sign-Off: Minimum Clearance & No Bridging       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the physical verification steps to analyze and validate the mechanical structural integrity, critical tilt margin, and capillary force-induced pattern collapse (stiction) for high-aspect-ratio (HAR) crown-type stacked capacitors erected over bitlines (COB) in 180nm 8F² DRAM cells.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry Import & Boundary Condition Formulation**
   - Extract the 8F² unit cell pitch grid ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ for wordline and bitline pitches).
   - Set the capacitor foundation boundary over the drain contact tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Constrain the bottom electrode cylinder anchor to a rigid, fixed cantilever support at the ILD/W-plug interface.

2. **Capacitance & Height Parametrization**
   - Model the 3D crown cylinder inner and outer active surface areas with the high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$, or $\text{ONO}$ stack) using target equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Constrain the cylinder height ($H$) and diameter ($D$) to achieve the required retention capacitance budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (minimum $28\text{ fF}$ threshold).

3. **Mechanical Modulus & Stress Profiling**
   - Apply polysilicon / metal bottom-electrode material properties (Young's modulus $E$, Poisson's ratio $\nu$, residual intrinsic film stress $\sigma$).
   - Formulate the elastic restoring moment of the hollow cylindrical beam under cantilever bending:
     $$I = \frac{\pi}{64} \left(D_{\text{out}}^4 - D_{\text{in}}^4\right)$$

4. **Capillary Force & Wet-Release Surface Tension Verification**
   - Calculate capillary meniscus forces acting between adjacent cylinders during post-wet etch DI water rinsing and drying:
     $$F_{\text{cap}} = \frac{2 \gamma \cos(\theta) \cdot A_{\text{proj}}}{d_{\text{space}}}$$
     where $\gamma$ is liquid surface tension, $\theta$ is contact angle, and $d_{\text{space}}$ is the inter-crown lateral spacing.

5. **Tilt Margin & Critical Collapse Deflection ($\delta_{\text{max}}$) Calculation**
   - Evaluate maximum lateral tip deflection $\delta_{\text{max}}$ under combined intrinsic gradient stress and capillary pull:
     $$\delta_{\text{max}} = \frac{F_{\text{cap}} H^3}{3 E I}$$
   - Verify that $\delta_{\text{max}} < \frac{1}{2} d_{\text{space}}$ to prevent physical contact, bridging, and leaning stiction between adjacent memory cells across the $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (min. threshold $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | 3D Field Solver Extraction / LCR Meter at $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Cell Feature & Inter-Crown Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM / GDS Layout DRC Verification |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / MOS $C$-$V$ profiling |
| **Maximum Allowable Tip Deflection ($\delta_{\text{max}}$)** | $< 50$ (Clearance margin $> 50\%$ spacing) | $\text{nm}$ | Finite Element Mechanical Simulation / Tilt SEM |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Context applied*: 8F² folded bitline layout; stacked capacitor erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug); high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$); minimum storage capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
- **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Context applied*: 1T1C stacked capacitor (Crown or Cylinder type) with retention budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell; EOT target of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$); bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

```text
Ta2O5 kappa max┤█████████████████████████              │
Ta2O5 kappa min┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │

                0        10       20        30       40 
```

---

### 2. Physical & Analytical Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Input Layout Footprint & Geometry Parametrization
1. Import unit cell dimensional layout constraints for the 180nm node:
   - Minimum feature size: $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint: $\text{Cell Area} = 8 \times (0.18\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Access transistor dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. Define the Crown Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D cylinder boundaries:
   - Outer diameter ($D_{\text{out}}$), inner diameter ($D_{\text{in}}$), cylinder height ($H$), and polysilicon/metal crown sidewall thickness ($t_{\text{wall}}$) where $D_{\text{in}} = D_{\text{out}} - 2 \cdot t_{\text{wall}}$.
   - Erect the bottom storage node electrode above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).

#### Step 2: Formulate Dual-Surface Area ($A_{\text{eff}}$) Analytical Solver
1. Model the active surface area utilizing both the outer and inner cylindrical sidewalls, along with the bottom surface:
   $$A_{\text{outer}} = \pi \cdot D_{\text{out}} \cdot H$$
   $$A_{\text{inner}} = \pi \cdot D_{\text{in}} \cdot H$$
   $$A_{\text{bottom}} = \frac{\pi}{4} \cdot D_{\text{in}}^2$$
2. Sum the cumulative effective capacitive area:
   $$A_{\text{eff}} = A_{\text{outer}} + A_{\text{inner}} + A_{\text{bottom}} + A_{\text{rim}}$$
   where $A_{\text{rim}} = \frac{\pi}{4} (D_{\text{out}}^2 - D_{\text{in}}^2)$ represents the top annular lip of the crown cylinder.

#### Step 3: Implement Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) & Permittivity Modeling
1. Establish physical dielectric parameters for the high-$k$ stack:
   - Material: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{ONO}$ (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric.
   - Effective dielectric constant: $\kappa_{\text{high-k}} > 15$ (typically $\kappa = 15 \text{ to } 25$).
   - Thermal gate oxide reference baseline: $\kappa_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.9$, physical gate oxide thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.
2. Derive Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
   $$\text{EOT} = t_{\text{phys}} \cdot \left(\frac{\kappa_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\kappa_{\text{high-k}}}\right)$$
   Constrain $\text{EOT}$ within the design window:
   $$3.0\text{ nm} \le \text{EOT} \le 4.0\text{ nm}$$

#### Step 4: Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) Analytical Integration & Ratio Check
1. Compute the analytical storage cell capacitance:
   $$C_s = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot A_{\text{eff}}}{\text{EOT}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{high-k}} \cdot A_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}}$$
   where $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}$.
2. Verify system coupling and array bitline margins:
   - For an array block of 256 or 512 cells per bitline, import bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Evaluate the capacitance ratio:
     $$5:1 \le \frac{C_b}{C_s} \le 9:1$$
   - Flag design violation if $C_b / C_s \ge 10:1$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25\text{ fF}$ (Nominal target: $28\text{ fF}$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Analytical solver calculation & small-signal C-V extraction |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.0\text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry & dielectric solver cross-check |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa$)** | $> 15$ | Dimensionless | Analytical extraction against physical thickness |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Static I-V leakage solver integration ($> 64\text{ ms}$ refresh) |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1\text{ to } 9:1$ ($< 10:1$) | Ratio (dimensionless) | Bitline array parasitics solver ratio check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Confirms access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), crown stacked capacitor topology over W-plug, high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$), storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and leakage ceiling $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Confirms $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ 1T1C stacked crown cylinder layout, $C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, and pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 3**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*  
  - Confirms folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint area ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$), array block bitline capacitance ($C_b = 150\text{ to } 250\text{ fF}$ for 256/512 cells/BL), and strict operating ratio $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ (failure boundary $\ge 10:1$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## COB 3D Dual-Surface Cylinder Geometry & Mesh Parametrization

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the parametric 3D geometric construction, conformal multi-zone finite-element meshing, and dielectric stack configuration for a Crown-Type Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) storage node in the 180nm Open-Source DRAM node (1T1C $8F^2$ cell architecture).

---

### 2. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Import Layout &     │
│  Pitch (360nm-400nm,   │
│       8F2 Cell)        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Parametrize       │
│      Dual-Surface      │
│        Cylinder        │
│  (Inner/Outer Walls)   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Assign Dielectric    │
│   Stack (EOT 3-4nm,    │
│      kappa > 15)       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Generate Conformal   │
│  Finite-Element Mesh   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Run 3D Electrostatic  │
│     Poisson Solver     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Verify Capacitance   │
│  (C >= 28 fF, Leakage  │
│        < 1 fA)         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Boundary & Spatial Footprint Setup**:
   - Set the simulation domain bounding box corresponding to an $8F^2$ DRAM cell pitch ($F = 180\text{ nm}$): wordline pitch and bitline pitch allocated between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Position the storage node contact footprint directly above the underlying access transistor drain contact via a Tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. **Dual-Surface Crown Cylinder Geometric Parametrization**:
   - Construct the bottom landing plate and vertical hollow cylinder above the bitline interconnect planes.
   - Define both the **outer vertical sidewall** ($r_{\text{outer}}$) and **inner vertical cavity wall** ($r_{\text{inner}}$) to maximize effective dual-surface electrostatic area within the allocated cell pitch.
   - Account for cylinder wall thickness $t_{\text{poly}} = r_{\text{outer}} - r_{\text{inner}}$ and crown height $H_{\text{cyl}}$ to provide required surface area without exceeding inter-cell bridging tolerances.
3. **High-$\kappa$ Dielectric Layer Definition**:
   - Conformally wrap both inner and outer cylinder surfaces with the storage dielectric stack: Oxide-Nitride-Oxide (ONO) triple layer or high-$\kappa$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$.
   - Constrain equivalent oxide thickness to $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ with bulk dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Concurrently configure the common plate upper electrode counter-conforming against both surfaces.
4. **Adaptive Conformal Mesh Discretization**:
   - Apply boundary-layer graded discretization normal to cylinder surfaces: set sub-nanometer mesh refinement across the thin dielectric film ($\Delta z, \Delta r \le 0.5\text{ nm}$) to capture steep field gradients.
   - Apply geometric curvature edge-refinement along cylinder rims and corners to suppress non-physical singular field concentrations.
   - Mesh interior bulk polysilicon/conductor regions with relaxed coarser tetrahedra/hexahedra to maintain computational tractability.
5. **Field Solver Execution & Verification**:
   - Execute 3D electrostatic Poisson solver applying plate-to-storage potential difference.
   - Integrate total charge across inner and outer surfaces:
     $$C_{\text{total}} = C_{\text{inner}} + C_{\text{outer}} + C_{\text{bottom}}$$
   - Extract capacitance and soft-error noise margins, confirming minimum cell capacitance and leakage ceilings.

---

### 4. Key Target Metrics & Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Capacitor Target Metrics          
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Refresh T┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
            │▒▒▒▒                                      │
     EOT Max┤▒▒▒▒                                      │
Dielectric k┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │
C_min Target┤███████████████████                       │
            │███████████████████                       │
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0        16         32        48        64 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | **$\ge 28$** (tolerance: $25\text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D electrostatic solver surface integral ($Q/V$) |
| **Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **$3\text{ to } 4$** (with $\kappa > 15$) | $\text{nm}$ | Parametric dielectric mesh profile extraction |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | **$< 1$** (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | TCAD transport & leakage carrier density solver |
| **Data Retention Interval Time** | **$> 64$** (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{ms}$ | Dynamic charge-decay retention verification |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Citations*: 180nm channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); $8F^2$ folded bitline layout; crown-shaped capacitor over bitline erected via tungsten plug (W-plug); ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric with effective $\kappa > 15$; minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error noise immunity; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Citations*: 1T1C $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout; storage capacitance requirement of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$; data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked cylinder/crown $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ dielectric with Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM-180NM-CAP-007`
**Title:** $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{/ONO EOT}$ & Multi-Dielectric Field Analytical Solver Formulation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Crown-Type 3D Cylinder Geometry & High-k $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{/ONO}$ Dielectric Stack Optimization > Crown Cylinder 3D Aspect Ratio & Surface Area Analytical Parametrization > COB Dual-Surface Area & EOT Analytical Capacitance Solvers Setup > $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{/ONO EOT}$ & Multi-Dielectric Field Analytical Solver Formulation  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Formulate and implement the analytical electrostatic field and Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) numerical solver for 3D Crown-type Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architectures in an $8F^2$ 180nm DRAM node. The solver models both high-$\kappa$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ and tri-layer $\text{ONO}$ ($\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4/\text{SiO}_2$) dielectric stacks to calculate electric displacement continuity, local electric field distributions, leakage constraints, and total cell storage capacitance ($C_s$).

---

### 2. Analytical Formulation & Theoretical Basis

#### 2.1 EOT Series Capacitance Model
For an $N$-layer dielectric stack between the bottom storage node electrode and top plate electrode, the total Equivalent Oxide Thickness referenced to $\text{SiO}_2$ ($\kappa_{\text{ox}} = 3.9$) is defined as:
$$\text{EOT} = \sum_{i=1}^{N} t_i \cdot \left(\frac{\kappa_{\text{ox}}}{\kappa_i}\right) = \sum_{i=1}^{N} t_i \cdot \left(\frac{3.9}{\kappa_i}\right)$$
- **Tri-layer ONO Stack:**
  $$\text{EOT}_{\text{ONO}} = t_{\text{ox,bottom}} + t_{\text{nitride}}\left(\frac{3.9}{\kappa_{\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4}}\right) + t_{\text{ox,top}}$$
- **High-$\kappa$ Stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ with Interfacial $\text{SiO}_x$):**
  $$\text{EOT}_{\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5} = t_{\text{IL}} + t_{\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5}\left(\frac{3.9}{\kappa_{\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5}}\right)$$

#### 2.2 Electrostatic Field Distribution
By Gauss's law and continuous normal displacement across dielectric interfaces ($\nabla \cdot \vec{D} = 0 \implies D_1 = D_2 = \dots = D_N$):
$$D = \epsilon_0 \kappa_i \mathcal{E}_i = \frac{Q_s}{A_{\text{eff}}}$$
$$\mathcal{E}_i = \frac{V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{plate}}}{\kappa_i \sum_{j=1}^N \frac{t_j}{\kappa_j}} = \frac{V_{\text{app}}}{\kappa_i \cdot \left(\frac{\text{EOT}}{\kappa_{\text{ox}}}\right)}$$
where $A_{\text{eff}}$ is the 3D crown cylinder effective dual-surface area, and $V_{\text{app}} = V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{plate}}$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Parameter Ingestion & Boundary Setup                               |
|    - Channel dimensions: L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm                       |
|    - Operating bias & temperature: 85 deg C                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Multi-Dielectric Stack Parameter Assignment                        |
|    - Evaluate ONO and Ta2O5 configurations                            |
|    - Target effective dielectric constant: kappa > 15                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. EOT & Capacitance Extraction Execution                             |
|    - Compute EOT within target bounds: 3.0 nm to 4.0 nm               |
|    - Solve Cs = (epsilon_0 * kappa_ox / EOT) * A_eff                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Electric Field, Retention, & Leakage Validation                   |
|    - Verify signal swing: Delta V = 100 mV to 150 mV                  |
|    - Validate retention: > 64 ms at 85 deg C                          |
|    - Enforce leakage limit: < 1 fA/cell at 85 deg C                   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Parameter Ingestion & Boundary Setup**:
   - Ingest unit cell layout constraints: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and cell array operating conditions at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Define cell plate voltage reference $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
2. **Dielectric Stack Parameter Assignment**:
   - Ingest permittivity and physical thickness bounds:
     - For $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ and engineered high-$\kappa$ stacks, ensure the effective composite dielectric constant satisfies $\kappa_{\text{eff}} > 15$.
     - For $\text{ONO}$, assign interfacial silicon dioxide and stoichiometric silicon nitride ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$) layers.
3. **EOT & Capacitance Extraction Execution**:
   - Compute total series $\text{EOT}$ using the formulation in Section 2.1, targeting the design window of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Couple $\text{EOT}$ with the 3D crown dual-surface area $A_{\text{eff}}$ to solve for storage capacitance:
     $$C_s = \frac{\epsilon_0 \kappa_{\text{ox}} A_{\text{eff}}}{\text{EOT}}$$
   - Verify that $C_s$ meets the target budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (minimum $28\text{ fF}$ for alpha-particle soft-error and coupling margin).
4. **Field Continuity & Leakage Solver Execution**:
   - Evaluate peak field across individual dielectric boundaries $\mathcal{E}_i$ under worst-case storage potentials ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Evaluate cell leakage current target against the maximum allowable threshold of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to guarantee data retention interval $> 64\text{ ms}$.
   - Pass computed $C_s$ to folded bitline sense amplifier coupling models ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) to ensure bitline differential signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$$

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value / Specification | Tolerance / Constraint | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0$ to $4.0$ | Exact range limit | $\text{nm}$ | Analytical Solver / C-V Profiling |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25$ to $30$ (nominal target $\ge 28$) | $\ge 25.0$ absolute min | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Solver Extraction / LCR Meter |
| **Cell Leakage Current (at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | Upper bound maximum | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Static Current Extraction / $I$-$V$ Solver |
| **Data Retention Time (at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $> 64$ | Lower bound minimum | $\text{ms}$ | Refresh Interval Timer / Retention Solver |
| **Differential Signal Swing ($\Delta V$)** | $100$ to $150$ | Validated range | $\text{mV}$ | Transient Bitline Sense Model ($C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Traceability
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; high-$\kappa$ stack $\kappa > 15$; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: 1T1C $8F^2/6F^2$ topology; storage capacitance specification of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$; data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ and $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ $\text{EOT}$ range of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Complementary bitline precharge to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$; differential sensing signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-DRAM180-COB-001`
**Title:** COB Dual-Surface Capacitance Solver Validation & Budget Metrology Benchmark  
**Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type COB 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Crown-Type 3D Cylinder Geometry & High-k $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO Dielectric Stack Optimization > Crown Cylinder 3D Aspect Ratio & Surface Area Analytical Parametrization > COB Dual-Surface Area & EOT Analytical Capacitance Solvers Setup > COB Dual-Surface Capacitance Solver Validation & Budget Metrology Benchmark  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the metrology benchmark and mathematical solver validation procedure for 3D Crown-type Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) dual-surface storage capacitors in 180nm 1T1C DRAM cells (8F² layout). It establishes the experimental capacitance-voltage ($C\text{–}V$) measurement protocol, leakage characterization, and numerical model extraction to ensure the physical cell satisfies charge retention and sensing signal margin budgets.

---

### 2. Analytical & Metrological Principles

A Crown-type COB structure leverages both the inner and outer sidewall surfaces plus bottom/rim top areas:
$$A_{\text{total}} = A_{\text{outer\_sidewall}} + A_{\text{inner\_sidewall}} + A_{\text{rim\_top}} + A_{\text{bottom}}$$
$$C_s = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} A_{\text{total}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\text{EOT}} A_{\text{total}}$$

The developed differential readout voltage delivered to the folded bitline sense amplifier latch is:
$$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       COB METROLOGY BENCHMARK FLOW                       |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [Step 1] CD-SEM & Cross-Section TEM
           - Measure cylinder inner/outer diameter, height & EOT (3-4 nm)
                                    │
                                    ▼
  [Step 2] Dual-Surface Analytical Solver Calibration
           - Compute dual-surface effective area A_total and nominal C_s
                                    │
                                    ▼
  [Step 3] Array C-V Test Structure Measurement
           - High-frequency C-V extraction on 10k-cell test array at 100 kHz
                                    │
                                    ▼
  [Step 4] Retention & Junction Leakage Extraction
           - Tri-temperature probe (25°C, 75°C, 85°C) to quantify I_leak
                                    │
                                    ▼
  [Step 5] Sense Margin Signal Validation
           - Extract bitline differential margin ΔV with C_BL = 250 fF
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Structural Profile & EOT Cross-Section Metrology
1. Mount the wafer on an in-line high-resolution CD-SEM / STEM sample stage.
2. Measure the physical dimensions of the patterned crown cylinder (outer diameter, wall thickness, cylinder height, and W-plug interface contact pitch). Verify wordline and bitline pitch within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
3. Via cross-sectional TEM and spectroscopic ellipsometry, determine physical dielectric thickness and verify Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of the high-k stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO) within the $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ range.

#### Step 2: Analytical Dual-Surface Solver Setup & Run
1. Ingest physical metrology coordinates into the analytical dual-surface capacitance solver.
2. Parameterize outer sidewall, inner cavity sidewall, top crown rim, and base surface contributions.
3. Compute total surface area $A_{\text{total}}$ and theoretical cell capacitance $C_s$ utilizing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.

#### Step 3: Array C–V Extraction & Benchmarking
1. Route test probes to specialized $10^4$-cell and $10^5$-cell parallel COB test macrostructures (Kelvin-sensed top plate contact and shared storage node contact).
2. Execute small-signal high-frequency $C\text{–}V$ sweeps ($100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$, $V_{\text{bias}} = 0\text{ V}$ to $V_{\text{DD}}$).
3. Normalize raw measured parallel capacitance by the cell count to extract per-cell capacitance $C_s$. Compare measured $C_s$ with solver predictions.

#### Step 4: Temperature-Accelerated Leakage Current Characterization
1. Place wafer on a thermal chuck stabilized at $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Apply full cell charge level ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$) to the node with access transistor biased in sub-threshold off-state.
3. Perform quasi-static $I\text{–}V$ electrometer current sampling to determine total sub-threshold, junction, and dielectric leakage current. Verify compliance with the $> 64\text{ ms}$ refresh retention window.

#### Step 5: Readout Signal Differential ($\Delta V$) Margin Verification
1. Connect bitline parasitic extraction macro to benchmark $C_{\text{BL}}$ nominal target ($250\text{ fF}$).
2. Calculate the signal development margin $\Delta V$ using the verified per-cell capacitance $C_s$.
3. Validate that $\Delta V$ delivers adequate overdrive ($100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) to overcome CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch offset.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Limits | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Minimum $25.0\text{ fF}$, typical $28.0\text{ to } 30.0\text{ fF}$ | HF LCR Meter / $C\text{–}V$ Analyzer ($100\text{ kHz}$) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | $3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Sub-fA Precision Source Measure Unit (SMU) |
| **Differential Sense Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $120$ | $\text{mV}$ | $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ ($C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$) | Oscilloscope / Automated Sense Margin Test Bench |
| **Wordline / Bitline Feature Pitch** | $380$ | $\text{nm}$ | $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM |

---

### 5. Literature & Context Citations

1. **Cell Layout, Capacitance Budget & Leakage Target:**
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
     - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Dielectric: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack with $\kappa > 15$.
     - Minimum capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft error and coupling noise immunity.
     - Maximum leakage budget: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Dielectric Thickness, Retention & Pitch Limits:**
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
     - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
     - High-k dielectric $\text{EOT}$: $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$).
     - Interconnect/array pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
3. **Differential Sensing Margin & Readout Budget:**
   - *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
     - Differential signal equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
     - Readout voltage development: $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ at $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
