**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-CS28FF-01`  
**Process Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / Architecture & Integration / Circuit Design / Metrology  
**Cell Layout:** 1T1C Folded Bitline ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$)  
**Action Type:** Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Process & Verification Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Step 1: CD & EOT    │
│       Profiling       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Step 2: C-V      │
│      Parametric       │
│      Extraction       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Step 3: Sensitivity  │
│   & Ratio Analysis    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Step 4: Mechanical   │
│  Cylinder Stability   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Step 1: Critical Dimension (CD) & EOT Metrology Screening**
   - Measure 3D Crown Cylinder outer/inner wall dimensions and height via in-line CD-SEM across array test structures placed over the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact.
   - Verify Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of the deposited high-$k$ stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{/Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO triple dielectric, $\kappa > 15$) via spectral ellipsometry on monitor pads, ensuring target EOT is within $3.0\ \text{nm}$ to $4.0\ \text{nm}$.
   - Confirm access transistor channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch within $360\ \text{nm}$ to $400\ \text{nm}$.

2. **Step 2: High-Frequency $C\text{-}V$ & Leakage Parametric Extraction**
   - Probe array capacitor test macros ($N = 10{,}000$ crown cells in parallel) using an automated parametric analyzer at $100\ \text{kHz}$ to $1\ \text{MHz}$.
   - De-embed test structure parasitic capacitance to extract single storage node capacitance $C_s$:
     $$C_s = \frac{C_{\text{macro}} - C_{\text{parasitic}}}{N}$$
   - Apply cell plateau operating bias ($V_{plate} = V_{DD}/2$) and measure cell leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to verify junction and sub-threshold leakage limits.

3. **Step 3: Sensitivity & Bitline Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) Validation**
   - Measure bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) across array blocks with $256$ to $512$ cells per bitline (nominal range $150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$).
   - Compute bitline-to-cell capacitance transfer ratio:
     $$r = \frac{C_b}{C_s}$$
   - Verify sensitivity boundary: flag warning if $r > 9:1$ and fail the lot if $r \ge 10:1$ to prevent severe read signal degradation.

4. **Step 4: 3D Crown Cylinder Mechanical Stability & Tilt Inspection**
   - Perform cross-sectional and top-down tilt tilt-SEM inspection (or AFM scan) post wet strip and dry cycle.
   - Screen for crown cylinder wall collapse, mechanical stiction between neighboring cylinders, or leaning caused by capillary forces and high aspect ratio stresses.
   - Ensure zero pattern bridging across adjacent cells within the $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░                                  │
   Max Leakage (fA)┤░                                  │
                   │▒▒                                 │
     EOT Limit (nm)┤▒▒                                 │
C_b Max Budget (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    C_s Target (fF)┤█████                              │
                   │█████                              │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     62.5    125.0    187.5 250.0 
```

| Parameter | Acceptance Metric | Lower Limit | Target | Upper Limit | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | De-embedded cell capacitance | $25.0$ | $28.0$ | $30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Dielectric EOT** | High-$k$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO) thickness | $3.0$ | $3.5$ | $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | Bitline to storage ratio ($256\text{--}512$ cells/BL) | $5.0 : 1$ | $7.0 : 1$ | $9.0 : 1$ | dimensionless |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | Sub-threshold + junction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | — | $< 0.5$ | $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Mechanical Cylinder Stiction/Collapse** | Optical/SEM defect count across array | — | $0$ | $0$ | defects/wafer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.
  - Crown-shaped structure erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Dielectric: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\ \text{fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Minimum capacitance budget: $25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF/cell}$ to ensure retention time $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - High-$k$ equivalent oxide thickness (EOT): $3.0\ \text{nm}$ to $4.0\ \text{nm}$.
  - Bitline/wordline pitch: $360\ \text{nm}$ to $400\ \text{nm}$.
- **Source 3: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
  - $8F^2$ Folded bitline cell footprint area: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$.
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$ for $256\text{--}512$ cells/BL): $150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$.
  - Bitline-to-cell ratio ($C_b / C_s$): strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$ max limit).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** 28 fF Cell Capacitance Parametric Sensitivity Matrix Simulation & Monte Carlo Analysis
- **Node / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Folded Bitline, Crown-Type COB MIM/Poly Architecture)
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Parametric       │
│    Analytical Model    │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Sensitivity Matrix   │
│  Jacobian Generation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Monte Carlo       │
│    Statistical Run     │
│        N=10000         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Bitline Sense Margin  │
│   Delta V Validation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│     Verification &     │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Sensitivity Distribution Profile

```text
       Capacitance Sensitivity Matrix (|dCs/dx| %)      
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░                               │
BL Cap (250fF)┤░░░░░░░░░                               │
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
  Cylinder Dia┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
      Crown Ht┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
   EOT (3-4nm)┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      10.5      21.0     31.5     42.0 
```

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Analytical Model & Netlist Parametrization
1. Configure the 1T1C netlist representing the 180nm unit cell with access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) connected over a tungsten plug (W-plug) to the 3D crown capacitor.
2. Parameterize the crown storage capacitor geometry:
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): Nominal range $3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ utilizing $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$) or ONO triple dielectric.
   - Cylinder inner/outer surface area ($A_{\text{eff}}$) governed by wordline/bitline cell pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) and crown height.
3. Couple the storage node to the bitline model with nominal bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and equalized precharge potential $V_{\text{pre}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$.

### Step 2: First-Order Parametric Sensitivity Matrix Construction
1. Calculate partial derivatives of storage capacitance $C_s$ with respect to primary process variables ($\mathbf{p} = [t_{\text{EOT}}, H_{\text{crown}}, D_{\text{cyl}}, \kappa]$):
   $$\mathbf{S} = \left[ \frac{\partial C_s}{\partial t_{\text{EOT}}}, \frac{\partial C_s}{\partial H_{\text{crown}}}, \frac{\partial C_s}{\partial D_{\text{cyl}}}, \frac{\partial C_s}{\partial \kappa} \right]$$
2. Execute localized $\pm 10\%$ single-parameter sweeps in SPICE to extract the normalized sensitivity coefficients.
3. Verify that high-$k$ dielectric EOT variation dominates first-order capacitance sensitivity ($> 40\%$).

### Step 3: Monte Carlo Statistical Dispersion Run
1. Define 3-sigma ($\pm 3\sigma$) Gaussian distribution profiles for:
   - Dielectric EOT: $\mu = 3.5\text{ nm}$, $\sigma = 0.12\text{ nm}$ ($\sim 3.4\%$).
   - Critical dimensions (cylinder diameter and crown height): $\sigma = 4.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Access transistor gate oxide: nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.
2. Execute $N = 10,000$ Monte Carlo sampling runs under nominal operating junction temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Extract probability distribution function (PDF) and cumulative distribution function (CDF) for $C_s$.

### Step 4: Sense Margin Differential Signal Evaluation
1. Simulate cell charge transfer $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ during wordline assert across all Monte Carlo sample points.
2. Compute differential readout signal developed across bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$:
   $$\Delta V = \left( \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \right) \cdot \left( V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2} \right)$$
3. Confirm that worst-case ($3\sigma$ lower tail) $\Delta V$ satisfies sensing margins prior to sense amplifier latch activation (SAN pull-down).

### Step 5: Verification & Leakage Retention Check
1. Verify sub-threshold and drain-junction leakage currents stay below the retention ceiling at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Validate that the cell retention time exceeds $64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across all passing runs.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Target Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ (Tolerance: $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE Monte Carlo Mean / Median extraction |
| **Bitline Readout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded bitline transient readout with $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Range** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Parametric matrix sweep parameter |
| **Maximum Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC operating point at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Data Retention Interval at Operating Temp** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Transient refresh interval check at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

## 5. Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) yielding effective $\kappa > 15$.
  - Target cell capacitance minimum of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C architecture in $8\text{F}^2$ or $6\text{F}^2$ layout.
  - Storage capacitance target range of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch around $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate oxide physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$.
  - Charge sharing relationship: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.
  - Nominal signal development of $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor Cylinder Mechanical Tilt & Stiction Limit FEA Modeling

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-FEA-180NM-042`  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Architecture)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & FEA Modeling  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   3D CAD Extraction:   │
│    Cylinder Height,    │
│    Pitch, Thickness    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Thermo-Mechanical &   │
│  Capillary Load Setup  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Finite Element     │
│  Analysis: Deflection  │
│    & Tilting Angle     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Capillary Stiction &  │
│      Yield Stress      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Post-Wet-Clean     │
│    Collapse Margin     │
│       Assessment       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Geometry Parameterization & Solid Model Construction:**
   - Parameterize the 3D crown-type capacitor cylinder aligned with the 180nm design rules on the bitline/wordline pitch range of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Define the bottom landing interface directly onto the tungsten contact plug (W-plug) above the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the physical dielectric stack model targeting the ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$k$ layer with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ to satisfy the target capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ per cell.

2. **Material Property & Boundary Condition Assignment:**
   - Define mechanical elasticity parameters for cylinder structural materials (Young’s modulus $E$, Poisson’s ratio $\nu$, thermal expansion coefficient $\alpha$) for polysilicon / metal electrode shells, ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ dielectrics, and supporting W-plug base.
   - Constrain the bottom surface of the tungsten plug contact with fully fixed Dirichlet boundary conditions ($U_x = U_y = U_z = 0$).

3. **Capillary & Surface Tension Load Formulation (Drying/Wet Clean Stiction):**
   - Apply meniscus capillary pressure loads acting on adjacent crown cylinder sidewalls caused by rinse liquid drying during sacrificial oxide wet etching:
     $$P_{\text{cap}} = \frac{2\gamma \cos\theta}{d}$$
     where $\gamma$ is the surface tension of the rinse fluid, $\theta$ is the contact angle, and $d$ is the inter-cylinder clearance governed by the $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch.

4. **Nonlinear FEA Static & Buckling Computation:**
   - Execute static deflection and eigenvalue buckling analyses to calculate maximum lateral cylinder tip displacement ($\delta_{\text{max}}$) and tilt angle ($\theta_{\text{tilt}}$).
   - Evaluate stress concentrations across the cylinder base-to-W-plug anchor interface to guarantee stresses remain strictly below the mechanical yield strength.

5. **Stiction Limit & Contact Clearance Verification:**
   - Quantify cylinder tip deflection relative to inter-cylinder clearance.
   - Verify that tip deflection does not exceed half the spacing between neighboring cylinders ($0.5 \times d_{\text{clearance}}$), avoiding permanent stiction/bridging shorts.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target & Limit | Exact Units | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / FEA Dielectric Stack Formulation |
| **Cell Target Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Integrated 3D Electrostatic FEA Solver |
| **Array Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / CAD Layout Verification |
| **Maximum Operating Temperature** | $85.0$ | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | Thermo-Mechanical Boundary Verification |
| **Maximum Tip Deflection ($\delta_{\text{max}}$)** | $< 15.0$ (no cylinder-to-cylinder stiction) | $\text{nm}$ | Nonlinear Elastic FEA Structural Simulation |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Capacitance & Transistor Geometry:** Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ target budget, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and W-plug anchor topology cited from *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*.
- **Pitch, EOT, & Thermal Operating Limits:** Bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, dielectric stack EOT of $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$), and thermal retention target at $85^{\circ}\text{C}$ cited from *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.
- **Bitline Readout Compatibility:** Cell signal integration baseline ($C_s \approx 25 - 28\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) referenced from *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*.

If $C_s < 25\text{ fF}$ or if structural collapse/bridging is detected, freeze lot and flag for dielectric thinning / capillary drying defect review. --- ### 3. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-CRN-001`
**Title:** Test Structure Mask Design & Automated Probe Card Setup for Crown Capacitor Arrays  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Topology:** Stacked Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB), Folded Bitline $8F^2$  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Architectural & Metrology Context

In 180nm DRAM fabrication ($F = 180\text{ nm}$), validating crown capacitor capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$) with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ directly on isolated single cells is impractical due to sub-femtofarad parasitic limits of commercial automated probe stations.

To extract dielectric integrity, capacitance density, and cell leakage at wafer sort, dedicated parametric scribe-line test structures comprising macro-arrays ($N = 10{,}000$ to $100{,}000$ parallel crown cells) are integrated into the test reticle alongside open/short de-embedding calibration structures.

```text
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Key Metrology & Design Targets (Scaled Metric Values)  │
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                                 
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░                             │
 C_b/C_s Ratio┤░░░░░░░░░░░                             │
              │▒▒                                      │
  Leakage @85C┤▒▒                                      │
Dielectric EOT┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                                  │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓                                  │
 C_cell Target┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0         7        14       21        28 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Step 1: Test Structure Layout & Mask Floorplanning"] --> B["Step 2: Automated Probe Card Interface & Cabling Setup"]
    B --> C["Step 3: Open/Short Fixture Calibration & Chuck Thermal Soak"]
    C --> D["Step 4: Automated C-V / C-t Extraction & Leakage Profiling"]
```

#### Step 1: Test Structure Layout & Mask Floorplanning (CAD/GDSII)
1. **Array Configuration**: Instantiate an $8F^2$ folded bitline array macro of $N = 100{,}000$ interconnected crown capacitor cells in parallel.
   - Unit cell footprint: Area $= 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.180\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Wordline and bitline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Bottom storage electrode: Connect crown nodes in parallel via tungsten plugs (W-plugs) to Metal-1 bus routing.
   - Top counter electrode (plate): Common continuous top-plate node contacting the high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO stack, $\kappa > 15$).
2. **De-Embedding Pads**: Include adjacent dummy test keys on the reticle:
   - *Open Pad Key*: Identical probe pads and interconnect routing without tungsten contact plugs/crowns.
   - *Short Pad Key*: Direct metal short between pad pairs for contact resistance extraction.
3. **Pad Pitch & Geometry**: Lay out ground-signal-ground (GSG) or dedicated Kelvin 4-point pads at a standard $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ area with $150\,\mu\text{m}$ pitch to interface standard automated vertical probe card cantilevers.

#### Step 2: Automated Probe Card Interface & Cabling Setup
1. Mount a low-leakage probe card (tungsten-rhenium or vertical membrane tips, leakage floor $< 10\text{ fA}$) onto the automated wafer prober docking ring.
2. Route triaxial cabling from prober head to the automated Parameter Analyzer / LCR Meter (e.g., Keysight B1500A with High-Resolution SMU and Multi-Frequency CMU).
3. Connect driven guard shields up to the probe card interface connector to eliminate cable shunt capacitance and parasitic leakage paths.

#### Step 3: Open/Short Fixture Calibration & Chuck Thermal Soak
1. Set the wafer chuck temperature controller to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate worst-case cell retention leakage conditions. Allow a 15-minute thermal stabilization soak.
2. Execute automated prober alignment using pattern recognition on reticle optical alignment marks.
3. Perform open/short/load C-V compensation across the measurement frequency band ($10\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$):
   - Touch down on the *Open Pad Key*: Measure $Y_{\text{open}} = G_{\text{open}} + j\omega C_{\text{open}}$ and store in the calibration register.
   - Touch down on the *Short Pad Key*: Measure $Z_{\text{short}} = R_{\text{short}} + j\omega L_{\text{short}}$ and store in the calibration register.

#### Step 4: Automated C-V / C-t Extraction & Leakage Profiling
1. Touch down on the 100k-crown array test pads with controlled needle overdrive ($35\,\mu\text{m}$ to $50\,\mu\text{m}$) ensuring contact resistance $R_c < 2\,\Omega$.
2. **Capacitance Extraction ($C$-$V$)**:
   - Apply a small AC oscillation signal ($V_{\text{AC}} = 30\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ at $f = 100\text{ kHz}$).
   - Sweep DC bias on the top plate from $-1.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$.
   - De-embed raw capacitance:
     $$C_{\text{cell}} = \frac{C_{\text{measured}} - C_{\text{open}}}{N}$$
     Ensure $C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$.
   - Extract EOT from maximum accumulation capacitance ($C_{\text{acc}}$) using $\kappa_{\text{eff}} > 15$ or standard $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric equivalent:
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot A_{\text{effective}}}{C_{\text{cell}}}$$
3. **Leakage Current Profiling ($I$-$V$ / $I$-$t$)**:
   - At $85^\circ\text{C}$, apply nominal cell operating bias $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Measure steady-state leakage current after a $5\text{ s}$ soak.
   - Calculate leakage per cell:
     $$I_{\text{leak, cell}} = \frac{I_{\text{total}}}{N}$$
     Verify $I_{\text{leak, cell}} < 1\text{ fA/cell}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated Multi-Frequency $C$-$V$ Meter ($100\text{ kHz}$, De-embedded) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Parametric extraction from accumulation $C_{\text{cell}}$ |
| **Dielectric Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Low-current SMU at $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Cell Footprint Compliance** | $0.259$ ($\pm 5\%$) | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Optical/CD-SEM reticle and layout metrology ($8F^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), folded bitline COB stacked capacitor over W-plug drain contact.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) providing $\kappa > 15$.
   - Cell capacitance budget minimum: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ to maintain soft error immunity; leakage target: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C stacked crown/cylinder cell with $C_s \ge 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Dielectric EOT target: $3\text{ nm to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
3. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Parasitic bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ to }250\text{ fF}$ for $256/512$ cells/BL with allowable $C_b/C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Crown Capacitor Test Structure Array & Pad Frame Mask Layout Design

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Unit Cell Pitch and   │
│    COB Stack Sizing    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Crown Test Array    │
│  Matrix Instantiation  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Kelvin and RF Pad    │
│     Frame Routing      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Lithography and Mask  │
│       Alignment        │
│      Integration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  DRC and ERC Sign-Off  │
│  and GDSII Streaming   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Layout & Design Procedure

1. **Unit Cell Geometry & Pitch Definition**:
   - Establish the $8F^2$ cell topology boundary using access transistor design dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Grid wordlines (WL) and bitlines (BL) at a pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, sharing the central bitline contact between adjacent pairs.
   - Place bottom electrode contact vias (drain nodes) to interface with the tungsten plug (W-plug) layer beneath the capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.

2. **Crown Capacitor 3D Test Array Instantiation**:
   - Instantiate three test vehicle variations:
     1. *Single Isolated Cell*: Dedicated to direct sub-threshold and junction parasitic leakage extraction.
     2. *Dense $1\text{k}\times 1\text{k}$ Macro Array*: Multi-cell parallel matrix for macro C-V and C-t metrology to measure collective capacitance $> 28\text{ pF}$ (yielding $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$).
     3. *Comb-Meander Nested Array*: To verify crown sidewall shorts and dielectric breakdown across adjacent cylinder boundaries.
   - Configure cylinder cylinder thickness targeting equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ corresponding to $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO dielectric stacks ($\kappa > 15$).

3. **Kelvin 4-Point & RF Pad Frame Routing**:
   - Route crown top-plate (common plate electrode) and bottom-plate nodes through low-resistance metal straps out to standard pitch probe pad frames ($100\times 100\ \mu\text{m}^2$ pad openings with $150\ \mu\text{m}$ pitch).
   - Configure Force/Sense Kelvin pairs to decouple series resistance and line parasitics during picoampere-level leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) and automated probe card C-V metrology.

4. **Mask Lithography Features & Optical Alignment Mark Insertion**:
   - Embed optical mask aligner crosshair fiducial alignment marks on the scribe lines for both contact and proximity exposure runs.
   - Calibrate clear/dark tone reticle bias accounting for an exposure dose budget of $120\text{--}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ using $365\text{ nm}$ (i-line) optics on positive photoresist (Shipley 1813 at $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness).

5. **DRC / ERC Sign-off & Mask Data Preparation (MDP)**:
   - Execute design rule checks (DRC) for minimum cylinder spacing, W-plug contact overlap, and metal enclosure margins.
   - Perform electrical rule checks (ERC) to confirm zero floating plates and stream out the final hierarchy as standard GDSII/OASIS format.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░░                             │
        EOT Target (nm)┤░░                             │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
 Bitline Pitch (x10 nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
Capacitance Target (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
 Exposure Dose (mJ/cm2)┤███████████████████████████████│
                       │███████████████████████████████│
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬───────┘
                       0.0    33.8   67.5    101.2      
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Unit | Verification Tool / Metrology |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated LCR Meter / C-V Profiler at $10\text{ kHz}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Extracted C-V |
| **Bitline & Wordline Layout Pitch** | $380$ | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated CD-SEM Metrology |
| **Cell Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-femtoamp Parametric Analyzer ($I_{\text{leak}}\text{--}V$) |
| **Lithography Clear Dose (i-line)** | $135$ | $120 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mJ/cm}^2$ | Optical Radiometer at $365\text{ nm}$ |

---

### 3. Verified Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Cell geometry dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $8F^2$ topology.
  - COB crown stacked architecture over W-plug contact; ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ dielectric with $\kappa > 15$.
  - Target capacitance budget: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ soft-error immunity.
  - Cell leakage current ceiling: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Minimum storage capacitance: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - High-$k$ equivalent oxide thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications: $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate oxide physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
  - Optical lithography calibration: $365\text{ nm}$ (i-line) exposure with $> 95\%$ beam uniformity.
  - Photoresist dose: $120\text{ to }150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ for $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thick Shipley 1813.
  - Scribe-line crosshair fiducial alignment mark requirements.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Custom Fine-Pitch Multi-Pin Probe Card Fabrication & Tooling Procurement
**Module**: Metrology & Electrical Characterization  
**Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Generate Pad      │
│    Coordinates and     │
│    Multi-Pin Layout    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Procure Probe      │
│  Technology: Vertical  │
│    MEMS or Buckling    │
│          Beam          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Micro-Drill Ceramic   │
│    Guide Plate and     │
│    Assemble Contact    │
│        Springs         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Optical Metrology:   │
│   Planarity and Tip    │
│    Alignment Check     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Dock to Automated    │
│  Prober and Validate   │
│      Leakage and       │
│       Parasitics       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Test Pad Netlist & Footprint Extraction**:
   - Extract pad coordinate files (GDSII / OASIS format) for the test structures measuring the Crown-type 3D cylinder capacitor arrays, wordline/bitline pitch grids (360 nm to 400 nm pitch arrays routed to macro-pads), and test sense-amplifier lines.
   - Define pin pitch constraints, mechanical keep-out zones, and Kelvined force/sense routing paths on the multi-layer printed circuit board (MLC/PCB) space transformer.

2. **Probe Architecture Selection & Tooling Procurement**:
   - Procure vertical MEMS / buckling-beam (Cobra-style) multi-pin probe card assemblies suited for high-density multi-site array testing over cantilevers to eliminate scrubbing damage on sensitive Crown capacitor dielectric layers.
   - Order laser-micro-machined ceramic upper/lower guide plates and low-noise coaxial/triaxial high-bandwidth signal cables matching wafer prober chuck interfaces.

3. **Space Transformer Fabrication & Micro-Spring Pin Assembly**:
   - Fabricate the Multi-Layer Ceramic (MLC) substrate featuring matched characteristic impedance ($Z_0 = 50\,\Omega$) and guarded trace shielding for ultra-low femtoampere-level leakage extraction.
   - Insert and seat rhodium-plated or tungsten-rhenium ($W\text{Re}$) micro-spring needles into the guide plate matrix under cleanroom inspection (ISO Class 5).

4. **Metrological Tip Alignment, Planarity & Scrub Characterization**:
   - Mount the assembled probe card onto an automated optical metrology station (e.g., automated tip inspection system).
   - Measure tip coplanarity across all pins and calibrate needle tip true position ($X, Y$) against layout coordinates.
   - Verify needle scrub length and contact overdrive travel profile on dummy aluminum/copper pad wafers.

5. **Parametric Meter Docking & Baseline Validation**:
   - Mount the probe card into the automated wafer prober station.
   - Execute open/short/leakage self-test diagnostics across all channels to verify background parasitic capacitance and inter-pin dielectric leakage at both $25^\circ\text{C}$ and $85^\circ\text{C}$ chuck operating conditions.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Individual Cell Capacitance Floor ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Multi-frequency C-V extraction on crown array test structures |
| **System Background Leakage Floor ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/channel}$ | Triaxial guarded pA/fA electrometer measurement at $85^\circ\text{C}$ chuck temperature |
| **Bitline / Wordline Layout Array Pitch Dimension** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / optical layout verification of the routed cell array pads |
| **Probe Tip Coplanarity / Alignment Window** | $\le \pm 12$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Non-contact optical/laser metrology across all active probe tips |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Verifications

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Cell Capacitance Budget*: Minimum storage cell capacitance target is specified as $\ge 28\,\text{fF}$ per cell to guarantee signal margin and noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.
  - *Leakage Target*: Sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold specified as $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Capacitor Architecture*: Crown-shaped 3D stack with tungsten plug (W-plug) drain contact using $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{ONO}$ dielectric layers.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Array Geometry Pitch*: Bitline and wordline array pitch explicitly verified at approximately $360\,\text{nm} \text{ to } 400\,\text{nm}$.
  - *Retention Baseline*: Retention criteria requiring $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30\,\text{fF}$ capacitance at $85^\circ\text{C}$ retention testing.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - *Charge Sharing Balance*: Typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ with bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$ establishing differential signal window $\Delta V \approx 100 \text{ to } 150\,\text{mV}$.

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Probe Card Docking & Mechanical Lock:**
   - Mount the customized multi-pin probe card for Crown Capacitor array test structures onto the automated wafer prober head.
   - Engage pneumatic docking clamps and verify card seated planarity using the top-plate proximity sensors.
2. **Wafer Loading & Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Load the 180nm processed wafer onto the prober vacuum chuck.
   - For thermal retention tests, set the chuck temperature to **85°C** and allow a 10-minute thermal stabilization cycle.
3. **Pattern Recognition & Optical Alignment (X-Y-Theta):**
   - Execute automated machine-vision alignment using primary and secondary wafer fiducials.
   - Perform Theta correction on the wafer stage to eliminate rotational skew relative to the probe card tip array.
4. **Z-Height Profiling & Touchdown Overdrive:**
   - Initiate laser/optical tip-height sensing across the probe card tips.
   - Approach wafer pad test structures until electrical contact is sensed; apply nominal contact overdrive (40 µm to 60 µm) to break native surface oxide on pads without cracking underlying dielectric stacks.
5. **C-V Instrument Calibration & Fixture De-embedding:**
   - Connect the LCR/impedance meter and SMU channels via triaxial cabling to the prober card interface.
   - Run Open/Short compensation standards on an impedance calibration substrate to de-embed parasitic trace/cable capacitances.
6. **Crown Array C-V & Leakage Metrology Sweep:**
   - Sweep bias voltage $V_{\text{bias}}$ to measure capacitance versus voltage for equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) extraction of the $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{ONO}$ dielectric.

nodes.sop_content:
An actionable, industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) tailored for the DRAM Foundation VN metrology workflow is detailed below.

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quasi-Static & Multi-Frequency C-V Profiling for EOT and Target Capacitance Extraction ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$)

- **Module**: Metrology / Electrical Characterization (PCM & Test Structures)
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Crown COB Architecture)
- **Hierarchy**: `1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²)` $\rightarrow$ `Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling` $\rightarrow$ `C-V & C-t Metrology Extraction`

---

### 1. Equipment & Test Structure Setup
1. **Instrument Configuration**:
   - High-precision LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer (e.g., Keysight E4980A / B1500A multi-frequency capacitance measurement unit - MFCMU) combined with a Quasi-Static C-V Unit (QSCV / High-Resolution SMU with leakage compensation).
   - Semi-automatic probe station equipped with triaxial Kelvin connections, active dry-air/nitrogen purge, and thermal chuck calibrated to $25^\circ\text{C}$ and $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Device Under Test (DUT)**:
   - Crown-type capacitor test structures: Array test keys (e.g., $10^4$ or $10^5$ parallel 3D crown storage cells connected to plate contact) and individual Kelvin test pads on Process Control Monitor (PCM) scribe-line modules.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Multi-Frequency C-V Sweep     | Bias: -1.5V to +1.5V @ 10 kHz, 100 kHz, 1 MHz    |
| (Depletion/Accumulation Check)| Signal: 25 mV rms AC osc amplitude               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Quasi-Static (QSCV) Sweep     | Ramp: -1.5V to +1.5V, ramp rate dV/dt <= 0.1 V/s  |
| (Interface Trap / Slow States)| Displacement current measurement I = C * (dV/dt)  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Parameter Extraction          | Extract C_s (target >= 28 fF/cell), EOT (3 to 4nm)|
| (Quantum/Series Corrections)  | Verify C_b / C_s ratio (5:1 to 9:1 for C_b range) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Open/Short/Load Calibration & Cable De-embedding**:
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit calibration on the probe card contact points up to $1\text{ MHz}$ to eliminate parasitic coaxial lead inductance ($L_s$) and series cable resistance ($R_s$).
2. **Multi-Frequency High-Frequency (HF) C-V Profiling**:
   - Apply a small AC oscillation signal ($V_{ac} = 20\text{--}25\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$) superimposed on a stepped DC bias voltage swept across the cell operating window ($V_{dc} = -1.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$, step size $25\text{ mV}$).
   - Run sweeps across multi-frequency grid: $10\text{ kHz}$, $100\text{ kHz}$, and $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Monitor dissipation factor $D = \tan \delta$; reject test blocks if $D > 0.05$ due to tungsten plug (W-plug) contact resistance or substrate grounding defects.
3. **Quasi-Static C-V (QSCV) Profiling**:
   - Execute linear voltage ramp sweep ($dV/dt \le 0.1\text{ V/s}$) from $-1.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$ under dark shield enclosure.
   - Measure quasi-static displacement charging current:
     $$I_q = C_{qs} \cdot \frac{dV}{dt} + I_{leak}$$
   - Apply automated leakage subtraction ($I_{leak}$ measured via steady-state hold step) to obtain the true equilibrium capacitance $C_{qs}(V)$.
4. **Extraction of Cell Capacitance ($C_s$), EOT, and Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)**:
   - Normalize the measured array accumulation capacitance by total cell count $N$ to extract per-cell storage node capacitance:
     $$C_s = \frac{C_{array}}{N}$$
   - Calculate the Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) from accumulation capacitance per unit area ($C_{acc} / A_{3D}$) using $\varepsilon_{ox} = 3.9 \times 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}$:
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{SiO_2} \cdot A_{3D}}{C_s}$$
   - Cross-check effective relative permittivity ($\kappa > 15$) for the $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / ONO}$ high-k stack against the known 3D crown cylinder height and sidewall area.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Tolerance | Physical Units | Evaluation Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Multi-frequency ($100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$) at nominal cell bias ($V_{cell} = 1.0\text{ V}$) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Strong accumulation capacitance regime, $V = +1.5\text{ V}$ |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa_{eff}$)** | $> 15.0$ | $\pm 10\%$ | Dimensionless | High-k $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / ONO}$ crown 3D cylinder |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1 \text{ to } 9:1$ | Max $< 10:1$ | Dimensionless Ratio | Cell array block ($C_b = 150 \text{ to } 250\text{ fF}$) vs storage node |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - *Stacked Capacitor Topology*: Crown-shaped structure erected above drain contact via W-plug; ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - *Capacitance Budget*: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.
- **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - *Capacitance & Retention Target*: Minimum capacitance of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell to guarantee data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Dielectric Thickness*: Stacked capacitors utilizing $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k dielectrics with Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
- **[Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**:
  - *Capacitance Margins & Budgets*: Storage node $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$). Bitline parasitic $C_b = 150\text{ to } 250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells/BL). Capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ kept strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrades severely if $> 10:1$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Wafer Test Structure Preparation & Cryo/Thermal Probe Station Open-Short Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type COB 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Metrology > C-V & C-t Metrology Extraction for EOT, Target Cell Capacitance ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$) & Dielectric Leakage Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                      │
│  1. Wafer Loading & Chamber Purge    │
│                                      │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                      │
│  2. Thermal Chuck Conditioning       │
│     (85°C Hot / Cryo Stabilization)  │
│                                      │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                      │
│  3. Open Calibration Execution       │
│     (Lift Probes, Parasitic C Null)  │
│                                      │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                      │
│  4. Short Calibration Execution      │
│     (Gold Standard / Metal Pad Null) │
│                                      │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                   │
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                      │
│  5. 1T1C Array Test Structure Landing│
│     & Residual Verification          │
│                                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chamber Loading & Environmental Purge:**
   - Mount the 180nm DRAM test coupon/wafer (containing crown-type capacitor test arrays and 4-point test structures) onto the triaxial thermal chuck.
   - Seal the probe station environmental shielding enclosure. Purge the dark box with dry nitrogen ($N_2$) until relative humidity (RH) is $< 5\%$ to avoid moisture condensation during thermal shifts.

2. **Thermal Conditioning & Equilibrium:**
   - Set the thermal chuck controller to the target qualification temperature for retention and leakage characterization: **$85^\circ\text{C}$** (or the target cryo baseline).
   - Allow a minimum soak time of 15 minutes to guarantee thermal stabilization across the chuck and reduce mechanical drift of micropositioners.

3. **Open Calibration (De-embedding Fixture Capacitance):**
   - Elevate the low-noise coaxial/triaxial probe tips (tungsten carbide / BeCu tips, radius $\approx 50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$) approximately $100\ \mu\text{m}$ to $250\ \mu\text{m}$ directly above the test pad surface without making physical contact.
   - Execute the impedance analyzer/LCR meter **Open Calibration routine** across the measurement spectrum (quasi-static up to multi-frequency C-V band) to null out cable stray capacitance, manipulator fringing capacitance, and residual line admittance ($Y_{\text{open}} \approx 0$).

4. **Short Calibration (De-embedding Fixture Residual Inductance and Resistance):**
   - Align the probe tips over an adjacent on-wafer dedicated shorting pad or gold/aluminum calibration substrate.
   - Lower the micropositioners to land the probes with controlled overdrive ($5\ \mu\text{m}\text{--}10\ \mu\text{m}$ travel) to break surface oxide.
   - Execute the **Short Calibration routine** on the LCR/meter to null out probe-tip contact resistance, series lead resistance, and residual loop inductance ($Z_{\text{short}} \approx 0$).

5. **Test Structure Alignment & Baseline Verification:**
   - Reposition probes onto the 1T1C array test structure (crown capacitor pads contacting drain W-plugs and bitlines with pitch $360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).
   - Run a baseline open-circuit check between isolated pads to confirm that residual background leakage current remains $< 1\text{ fA}$ per cell at $85^\circ\text{C}$ before initiating multi-frequency C-V profiling.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermal Chuck Operating Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Integrated Pt100 / thermocouple RTD sensor readout |
| **Target Storage Capacitance Extraction** | $\ge 28.0$ (Budget: $25\text{--}30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Multi-frequency C-V extraction on calibrated 1T1C crown array |
| **Background Fixture / Cell Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Low-noise electrometer / SMU at $85^\circ\text{C}$ holding bias |


---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Station Setup & Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Secure the 180nm test wafer onto the semi-automatic prober chuck under light-shielded, dark-box enclosure.
   - Set chuck temperature to **85°C** (thermal stress baseline for 64 ms retention certification) and allow temperature to stabilize for at least 15 minutes.
2. **De-Embedding & Calibration**:
   - Perform two-terminal Open/Short/Load calibration at the probe-card needle tips to de-embed coaxial cable parasitic capacitance, series resistance ($R_s$), and contact resistance on dedicated test structures.
3. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Sweep**:
   - Connect the High-Voltage electrometer/SMU channel to the capacitor top plate node and Low to the bottom contact plug (W-plug test pad).
   - Execute linear voltage staircase ramp from **$-1.8\text{ V}$ to $+1.8\text{ V}$** at a controlled ramp rate ($dV/dt = 0.05\text{ V/s}$) to measure the quasi-static equilibrium capacitance profile ($I_{QS} = C \cdot dV/dt$) and detect mobile charge / slow interface traps ($D_{it}$).
4. **Multi-Frequency High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweeps**:
   - Configure the LCR / Impedance Analyzer meter using parallel equivalent model ($C_p - G_p$) with an AC oscillator amplitude of **$25\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$**.
   - Execute DC bias sweeps from **$-1.8\text{ V}$ to $+1.8\text{ V}$** sequentially across discrete probe frequencies:
     - **10 kHz**: Low-frequency dispersion check.
     - **100 kHz**: Mid-band reference curve.
     - **1 MHz**: High-frequency bulk accumulation capacitance extraction.
5. **Parameter Extraction & Validation**:
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{cell}}$ from the accumulation regime at 1 MHz.
   - Calculate Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) using $EOT = \frac{\epsilon_{\text{SiO2}} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{\text{cell}}}$ considering the crown 3D cylinder surface area and dielectric permittivity ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Confirm cell retention budget feasibility against the 1 fA/cell leakage envelope at 85°C.

  - *Crown-shaped capacitor with ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k stack ($\kappa > 15$)*.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-DRAM180-CV-QM01
**Title:** Quantum Mechanical C-V Inversion Extraction for EOT, Flatband Voltage & Cell Capacitance Modeling ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$)  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | 8F² Crown-Type COB | Metrology & Device Modeling  
**Target Node:** 180nm (Gen 2)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the metrology characterization and extraction procedure for high-accuracy equivalent oxide thickness (EOT), flatband voltage ($V_{\text{fb}}$), quantum-mechanical band-bending corrections, and final 3D crown storage node capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$) on 180nm 1T1C DRAM test structures.

---

### 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Test Structure Loading & Calibration                                           |
|    - Load 180nm wafer with Crown Capacitor Array / Test MOS Diode onto chuck      |
|    - Execute open/short/load impedance calibration on LCR meter (10 kHz - 1 MHz)  |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Acquisition                                  |
|    - Perform split multi-frequency C-V sweeps (-2.0 V to +2.0 V) at 25°C & 85°C   |
|    - Extract accumulation, depletion, and strong inversion capacitance profiles  |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Quantum-Mechanical (QM) Inversion Modeling & EOT Fit                           |
|    - Solve 1D Schrödinger-Poisson equations for poly/metal gate and substrate QM  |
|      carrier confinement and centroid displacement Delta z_centroid               |
|    - Correct C_total = (1/C_diel + 1/C_qm_poly + 1/C_qm_sub)^-1 to extract EOT   |
|    - Determine V_fb and normalize to single 3D Crown Cell Area                     |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Cell Capacitance & Signal Budget Verification                                  |
|    - Scale extracted capacitance per unit area to 3D crown cylinder aspect ratio  |
|    - Validate single-cell storage capacitance C_s >= 28 fF and evaluate Delta V   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tool Setup and Impedance De-embedding
1. Mount the processed 180nm wafer containing large-area test macro capacitors and dense crown array test pads onto the temperature-controlled probe station chuck.
2. Set chuck temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ (worst-case retention baseline) and $25^\circ\text{C}$ (calibration baseline).
3. Connect precision LCR meter / semiconductor parameter analyzer probes using shielded Kelvin triaxial connections. Run Open/Short compensation to de-embed cable and contact parasitic capacitances.

#### Step 2: Multi-Bias C-V Sweep Acquisition
1. Apply DC bias voltage sweep from $-2.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$ with step size $\le 20\text{ mV}$ and AC oscillator amplitude $v_{\text{ac}} = 15\text{ mV}$.
2. Measure capacitance-voltage ($C$-$V$) and conductance-voltage ($G$-$V$) responses across test frequencies ($10\text{ kHz}$, $100\text{ kHz}$, and $1\text{ MHz}$).
3. Verify that series resistance correction is applied using conductance:
   $$C_{\text{corr}} = \frac{(G^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2) C_m}{G^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2 (1 - R_s G) - \omega^2 R_s C_m^2}$$

#### Step 3: Quantum Mechanical (QM) Correction & EOT/V_fb Extraction
1. Import corrected inversion and accumulation C-V curves into the Poisson-Schrödinger solver.
2. Account for quantum-mechanical finite carrier centroid offset ($\Delta z_{\text{centroid}}$) in the silicon substrate and polysilicon/metal gate:
   $$C_{\text{meas}}^{-1} = C_{\text{diel}}^{-1} + C_{\text{qm,inv}}^{-1} + C_{\text{poly}}^{-1}$$
3. Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
   $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO2}} \cdot \kappa}{\varepsilon_{\text{diel}}} \cdot t_{\text{phys}} = \varepsilon_{\text{SiO2}} \cdot A \cdot \left(\frac{1}{C_{\text{diel}}}\right)$$
4. Extract flatband voltage ($V_{\text{fb}}$) from the flatband capacitance $C_{\text{fb}}$ derived from Debye length screening calculations.

#### Step 4: 3D Crown Cell Capacitance Projection
1. Map extracted EOT and dielectric constant ($\kappa$) onto the 3D crown cylinder geometry (height, perimeter, inner/outer cylinder surfaces, and tungsten plug contact interface).
2. Compute single-cell capacitance $C_s$. Verify compliance with the differential readout signal margin:
   $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   ensuring noise immunity against soft errors and bitline coupling.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method / Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ | Max $\le 4.0\text{ nm}$ | QM Poisson-Schrödinger C-V fit ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0\text{ fF}$ | Min $\ge 28.0\text{ fF/cell}$ | Scaled 3D Crown Array C-V ($\text{fF/cell}$) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180\text{ nm},\; W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\%$ process window | Inline CD-SEM / Electrical Inversion ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermocouple chuck sensor ($^\circ\text{C}$) |

---

### 4. Context References
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance requirement: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity and bitline coupling suppression.
  - Temperature verification requirement: $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - EOT target for stacked crown/cylinder capacitors using high-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks: $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum storage capacitance boundary: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Charge sharing and signal development equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Thermal Chuck Setup & Kelvin Prober Calibration for 85°C C-t Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-042`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip)  
**Target Structure:** Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) / 1T1C 8F² Cell Array  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Calibration  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Chuck Thermal      │
│   Stabilization 85°C   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Kelvin Triaxial     │
│    Open/Short/Load     │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Thermal Expansion    │
│   Contact Alignment    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    C-t Transient &     │
│  Relaxation Metrology  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental & Thermal Shielding Setup:**
   - Engage the dark Faraday EMI shield box over the manual/semi-automatic Kelvin prober station.
   - Initiate continuous dry purge ($N_2$ or CDA) at $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0 \text{ SLPM}$ into the test chamber to prevent moisture condensation and frost during thermal cycles.

2. **Thermal Chuck Ramp & PID Stabilization:**
   - Power on the closed-loop thermal chuck controller; program setpoint temperature to $85.0^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Maintain a controlled thermal ramp rate ($< 10^\circ\text{C}/\text{min}$) to prevent thermal shock and chuck mechanical distortion.
   - Allow a minimum isothermal dwell time of 20 minutes at $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ to achieve steady-state thermal expansion across the chuck plate ($\Delta T \le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).

3. **Kelvin Triaxial Cable & Impedance Analyzer Calibration:**
   - Connect gold-plated tungsten probe tips via guarded triaxial low-noise Kelvin cabling (Force/Sense) to the LCR / C-V meter (e.g., Keysight E4980A / B1500A MFCMU).
   - Execute Open/Short/Load calibration at $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ directly at the probe-tip plane using an impedance calibration standard substrate:
     - **Open Correction:** Probe tips lifted $50\,\mu\text{m}$ above contact pads to calibrate out stray fixture capacitance and cabling parasitic conductance.
     - **Short Correction:** Probes dropped on shorting gold pad to eliminate lead and contact series resistance ($R_s$).
     - Verify background baseline capacitance floor is $\le 1.0\text{ fF}$ and leakage noise current is $\le 0.1\text{ fA}$.

4. **Wafer Loading & Thermal Drift Offset Compensation:**
   - Vacuum-mount the 180nm DRAM test wafer onto the $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ chuck.
   - Allow 5 minutes thermal soak for wafer chuck equilibrium.
   - Re-align probe needles to the 180nm Crown-type test structure pads (bitline contact / plate electrode pads, pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$).
   - Set contact overdrive to $15\,\mu\text{m}$ to ensure stable Kelvin contact without puncturing the top electrode metal/W-plug contact.

5. **C-t Transient & Leakage Relaxation Metrology Verification:**
   - Apply a baseline DC step bias to simulate cell retention charging and record capacitance transient $C(t)$ over a window exceeding $> 64\text{ ms}$.
   - Monitor dielectric relaxation and junction leakage current at $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ to verify low-leakage performance under thermal stress.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Unit | Verification Tool / Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chuck Temperature Setpoint & Uniformity** | $85.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Surface RTD / Thermocouple (Three-Zone Thermal Dynamics) |
| **Total Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $28.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Kelvin C-V / C-t Metrology ($180\text{nm}$ Cell Layout Topology) |
| **Total Dielectric & Junction Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Triaxial Guarded SMU ($180\text{nm}$ Cell Layout Topology) |
| **Retention Interval Measurement Window** | $> 64$ | $\ge 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | C-t Sampling Sweep Interval (Legacy $180\text{nm}$ Architecture) |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Basis for Capacitance & Leakage Targets:* Dictates the crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with minimum capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ per cell to resist soft errors and coupling, and target leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Basis for Retention Timing & Cell Geometry:* Specifies 1T1C $8\text{F}^2/6\text{F}^2$ cell design requiring $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ storage capacitance maintaining retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, utilizing crown/cylinder $Ta_2O_5$ or ONO dielectric with EOT $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ and bitline/wordline pitch around $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - *Basis for Thermal Uniformity & Ramp Control:* Informs the closed-loop PID temperature stabilization criteria of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to counteract thermal fluctuation and avoid micro-stress or thermal shock dislocation during test cycles.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): 85°C Deep-Depletion C-t Transient Extraction & Minority Carrier Generation Lifetime Characterization

**Process ID:** `MET-SOP-180NM-CT-85C`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm Open-Source DRAM Cell, 8F²)  
**Action Type:** Buy / External Metrology & Wafer Characterization System  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture Flow

The objective of this procedure is to execute pulsed capacitance-time ($C\text{-}t$) transient measurements on crown-type storage capacitor test arrays and MOS access structures at elevated operating temperature (85°C). This extracts the minority carrier generation lifetime ($\tau_g$), surface generation velocity ($s_0$), and cell retention leakage under deep-depletion conditions using Zerbst analysis.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Wafer Mount on Temptronic Thermal Chuck (25°C)"] --> B["Thermal Ramp to 85°C ± 0.5°C soaking for 15 min"]
    B --> C["Open/Short RF Cable & Switch Matrix De-embedding"]
    C --> D["Pre-bias to Accumulation / Flatband Condition"]
    D --> E["Fast Pulse to Deep Depletion (V_pulse, rise time < 100 ns)"]
    E --> F["Acquire C-t Transient Decay to Inversion (1 kHz - 1 MHz)"]
    F --> G["Zerbst Analysis: -d(C_ox/C)²/dt vs (C_inv/C - 1)"]
    G --> H["Extract tau_g & Leakage Validation (< 1 fA/cell)"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Thermal Chuck Conditioning & Substrate Contact**:
   - Load the 180nm test wafer onto the high-temperature shielded probe station chuck (e.g., Temptronic ThermoChuck).
   - Set chuck temperature to **85°C**; allow thermal stabilization for 15 minutes. Verify dry air or nitrogen purge to avoid surface oxidation and moisture-induced parasitic leakage.
2. **Instrument Setup & De-embedding**:
   - Connect the precision LCR meter / pulse generator (e.g., Keysight B1500A / B1505A with WGFMU or fast C-V module) to the device under test (DUT) using shielded Kelvin triaxial probes.
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit zero compensation at 85°C to eliminate probe and cable parasitic capacitances.
3. **Pulsing & Transient C-t Sampling**:
   - Apply a baseline pre-charge gate/plate bias driving the test capacitor/transistor array into accumulation/equilibrium inversion.
   - Step pulse voltage into deep depletion with a rise time $< 100\text{ ns}$ to prevent premature carrier recovery during the transition edge.
   - Record high-frequency (100 kHz – 1 MHz) capacitance versus time $C(t)$ until the transient reaches the thermal equilibrium inversion capacitance ($C_{\text{inv}}$) over an acquisition window $\ge 64\text{ ms}$.
4. **Zerbst Transient Extraction**:
   - Construct the Zerbst plot:
     $$\left[-\frac{d}{dt}\left(\frac{C_{\text{ox}}}{C(t)}\right)^2\right] \quad \text{vs.} \quad \left[\frac{C_{\text{inv}}}{C(t)} - 1\right]$$
   - Extract the minority carrier generation lifetime ($\tau_g$) from the slope of the linear regime and surface generation velocity ($s_0$) from the intercept.
   - Compute total generation leakage current density and convert to single-cell equivalent leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$) based on the $8\text{F}^2$ cell area ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$).

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░                                       │
 Leakage Limit┤░                                       │
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Retention Temp┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
       Cap EOT┤▓▓▓                                     │
              │▓▓▓                                     │
 C_cell Target┤██████████████                          │
              │██████████████                          │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      21.2      42.5     63.8     85.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Baseline Specification | Target / Acceptance Criteria | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | Thermal equilibrium stability | **$85 \pm 0.5$** | °C |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / ONO crown stack | **$3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$** | nm |
| **Target Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Crown-type 3D cylinder capacitor | **$\ge 28$** (tolerance: $25 - 30$) | fF/cell |
| **Total 85°C Junction & Dielectric Leakage** | Subthreshold + generation leakage | **$< 1.0$** | fA/cell |
| **Data Retention Time Target** | Refresh window retention at 85°C | **$> 64$** | ms |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

1. **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
   - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in folded bitline $8\text{F}^2$ architecture.
   - Storage capacitor: Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) using ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Leakage target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
   - Cell capacitor retention baseline: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ guaranteeing retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ for $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ crown stacks.
3. **`Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`**:
   - Readout signal dynamics: Bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, yielding differential signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$.
