# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180NM-042
**Title:** Dielectric Relaxation & Sub-fA High-Temperature Leakage Current Decomposition Analysis  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Crown-Type 3D Cylinder Geometry & High-k $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO Dielectric Stack Optimization > C-V & C-t Metrology Extraction for EOT, Target Cell Capacitance ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$) & Dielectric Leakage Characterization > High-Temperature (85°C) C-t Transient & Dielectric Leakage Relaxation Characterization > Dielectric Relaxation & Sub-fA High-Temperature Leakage Current Decomposition Analysis  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
This SOP establishes the characterization and metrology protocol to measure dielectric relaxation and decompose sub-femtoampere (sub-fA) leakage currents at elevated operating temperatures ($85^\circ\text{C}$) on 180nm 1T1C Crown-type stacked storage capacitors over bitline (COB). The procedure separates transient polarization/depolarization currents (Curie-von Schweidler relaxation: $I(t) \propto t^{-\alpha}$) from steady-state conduction mechanisms (Poole-Frenkel emission, Schottky barrier emission, and Fowler-Nordheim tunneling) to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 2. Equipment, Tooling & Test Structures
- **SMU / Electrometer:** Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer equipped with B1517A High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) capable of 0.1 fA measurement resolution and triaxial guarded probing.
- **Thermal Chuck:** Automated triaxial-shielded hot chuck system with closed-loop PID control calibrated to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ inside an inert $\text{N}_2$-purged dark box.
- **Test Structures:** 
  - Array test pattern: $10^4$ to $10^6$ parallel Crown-type 1T1C storage nodes with shared cell plate ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$) and access transistors held in hard turn-off ($V_{\text{WL}} = 0\text{ V}$).
  - Standalone crown MIM capacitor macro (bypass access transistor) with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | 1. Wafer Load, Triaxial Shielding & 85°C Thermal Soak |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | 2. Residual Charge Bleed & Baseline Drift Calibration |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | 3. High-Field Charging & Transient C-t / I-t Logging  |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | 4. Discharge (Depolarization) & Relaxation Profiling  |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | 5. Extraction: Decomposition into Steady-State vs fA  |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tool Setup, Triaxial Shielding & Thermal Soak
1. Load the 180nm test wafer onto the triaxial chuck inside the sealed Faraday cage dark box.
2. Purge the probe enclosure with dry $\text{N}_2$ to maintain relative humidity $< 5\%$ and eliminate surface moisture condensation at high temperature.
3. Ramp chuck temperature to **$85^\circ\text{C}$** and soak for $\ge 20\text{ minutes}$ to achieve thermal equilibrium across the wafer.
4. Establish triaxial guard connections down to the probe tips to suppress cable and fixture parasitic leakage below $0.05\text{ fA}$.

#### Step 2: Baseline Calibration & Pre-stress Discharge
1. Ground both the top plate ($V_{\text{plate}}$) and bottom storage node ($V_{\text{SN}}$) for $120\text{ s}$ to bleed any trapped remnant charges from prior thermal/electric handling.
2. Perform open-circuit zero-bias background current measurement for $60\text{ s}$; verify background fixture drift does not exceed $0.1\text{ fA}$.

#### Step 3: Voltage Step Stress & Charging Transient Measurement ($I_{\text{charge}}(t)$)
1. Apply a step stress bias representing worst-case DRAM storage state: $V_{\text{stress}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ across the dielectric stack ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$, $V_{\text{SN}} = 0\text{ V}$ or $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$).
2. Sample current $I_{\text{charge}}(t)$ logarithmically from $t = 1\text{ ms}$ to $t = 100\text{ s}$ using the high-resolution SMU in integration mode (Medium/Long NPLC).
3. Record total charging current:
   $$I_{\text{total}}(t) = I_{\text{displacement}}(t) + I_{\text{relax}}(t) + I_{\text{leak}}(\text{steady-state})$$

#### Step 4: Discharging (Depolarization) Transient Measurement ($I_{\text{discharge}}(t)$)
1. Step the applied voltage abruptly back to $0\text{ V}$ across the capacitor stack while maintaining continuous current logging.
2. Measure the depolarization current transient $I_{\text{discharge}}(t)$ from $t = 1\text{ ms}$ to $t = 100\text{ s}$.
3. In pure dielectric relaxation (Curie-von Schweidler behavior), the reversible polarization current satisfies:
   $$I_{\text{relax}}(t) = I_0 \cdot t^{-\alpha} \quad (0.8 \le \alpha \le 1.2)$$

#### Step 5: Current Decomposition & Parameter Extraction
1. Subtract the discharge transient from the charging transient to isolate the true steady-state high-temperature leakage current:
   $$I_{\text{leak}}(\text{steady-state}) = I_{\text{charge}}(t) - |I_{\text{discharge}}(t)| \quad \text{for } t \ge 10\text{ s}$$
2. Normalize the measured current to per-cell equivalent based on the test structure array multiplier $N_{\text{cells}}$.
3. Confirm that normalized cell capacitance meets or exceeds **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** (minimum design margin: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ using $100\text{ kHz}$ high-frequency C-V extraction.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | **$85$** | $^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ steady-state thermal soak |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | **$< 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ at steady state ($t \ge 10\text{ s}$) |
| **Target Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28$** (Acceptable window: $25\text{ -- }30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Measured via HF C-V / C-t at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **$3.0\text{ to }4.0$** | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from high-k ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{ONO}$) stack |
| **Target Data Retention Duration** | **$> 64$** | $\text{ms}$ | Derived retention interval at $85^\circ\text{C}$ operating condition |

---

### 5. Context Sources & Citations
- **Source 1:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - *Citations:* Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown topology; $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{ONO}$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$); minimum capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - *Citations:* 1T1C $8\text{F}^2$ cell layout; capacitor maintaining $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$; data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 3:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*  
  - *Citations:* Cell charge transfer and signal development $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; precharge voltage $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cell Retention & Soft-Error Immunity Metrology (28 fF / <1 fA Leakage Verification)

**Context / Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Cell Retention & Soft-Error Immunity Metrology  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180 nm)  
**Action Type**: Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Prep & Probe  │
│       Contact        │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│     Storage Node     │
│     Capacitance      │
│      Metrology       │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Retention & Sub-fA  │
│  Leakage Profiling   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Alpha Particle SER  │
│  Acceleration Test   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│      Pass/Fail       │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Test Structure Alignment & Wafer Thermal Stabilization
1. Load the 180nm test wafer onto a precision thermal probe station configured with a triaxial shielded chuck.
2. Align probe needles to the 1T1C test structures:
   - Access transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Array architecture: Folded bitline ($8F^2$ layout, cell area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, pitch $= 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
3. Ramp the thermal chuck temperature to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and hold for 10 minutes to reach steady-state thermal equilibrium.

#### Step 2: Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) & Ratio Verification
1. Connect an LCR meter (operating at $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$, $V_{ac} = 25\text{ mV}$) via low-leakage Kelvin probes to the Crown-type stacked storage node test macro (high-$\kappa$ dielectric stack: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO triple dielectric, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$).
2. Measure the unit cell storage node capacitance $C_s$.
3. Measure bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) on array blocks with 256/512 cells per bitline ($C_b \approx 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$).
4. Calculate the capacitance ratio:
   $$\text{Ratio} = \frac{C_b}{C_s}$$
   Ensure the ratio remains well below the $10:1$ critical read margin degradation boundary.

#### Step 3: Retention Time & Sub-fA Leakage Profiling at 85°C
1. Set access transistor gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}\ \text{SiO}_2$) biases: apply wordline turn-off bias to ensure subthreshold channel cutoff.
2. Charge the storage capacitor to logic high ($V_{DD} / \text{Array Data High}$) and initialize the retention clock.
3. Monitor the storage node voltage decay curve over time using a sub-femtoampere electrometric probe / SMU.
4. Calculate total leakage current ($I_{leak} = I_{subthreshold} + I_{junction} + I_{dielectric}$) at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$:
   $$I_{leak} = C_s \cdot \left(\frac{dV_s}{dt}\right)$$
5. Verify that cell data retention remains valid past the target refresh window of $t_{ret} > 64\text{ ms}$.

#### Step 4: Alpha-Particle Induced Soft-Error Rate (SER) Immunity Metrology
1. Position a calibrated planar alpha-particle radiation source ($^{241}\text{Am}$, emission energy $\sim 5\text{ MeV}$) above the unencapsulated array macro at a fixed geometry.
2. Initialize array cells with alternating test bit patterns (`0xAA` / `0x55`).
3. Run cyclic retention/read sweeps to detect critical charge collection ($Q_{crit} = C_s \cdot \Delta V_{BL}$).
4. Confirm that the nominal storage charge ($Q_{stored} \ge 28\text{ fF} \cdot V$) suppresses bitline coupling disturbance and soft-error bit flips under continuous irradiation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Lower / Upper Limit | Measurement Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Nominal: $28\text{ fF}$ | $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Multi-frequency C-V / LCR test macro |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$ @ 85°C)** | Target: $< 1.0\text{ fA}$ | $I_{leak} < 1.0\text{ fA}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Electrometric SMU / $C_s \cdot (dV/dt)$ decay |
| **Data Retention Time ($t_{ret}$ @ 85°C)** | Target: $> 64\text{ ms}$ | $t_{ret} \ge 64\text{ ms}$ | $\text{ms}$ | Array retention read/refresh sweep |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | Nominal: $5:1$ to $9:1$ | $\le 9:1$ (Strict max: $< 10:1$) | Dimensionless | Ratio of measured $C_b$ (256/512-cell BL) to $C_s$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain via W-plug.
   - ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for noise and alpha-particle soft-error immunity.
   - Leakage target: Subthreshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Retention requirement: $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - High-$\kappa$ equivalent oxide thickness: $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric: $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$.

3. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint: Area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$ for common-mode noise rejection.
   - Storage node nominal capacitance: $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (acceptable: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline parasitic capacitance: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Bitline-to-cell ratio: $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrades severely if $> 10:1$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Array Test Structure & Low-Noise Probe Card Procurement
**Track / Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) [DRAM Architecture] > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling [Circuit Design] > Cell Retention & Soft-Error Immunity Metrology (28 fF / <1 fA Leakage Verification) [Metrology] > Array Test Structure & Low-Noise Probe Card Procurement [Metrology]  
**Technology Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Target Specification:** Characterization of $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ storage cell capacitance, sub-femtoampere ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) leakage metrology, and bitline parasitic profiling ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Design Kelvin/Array   │
│    Test Structures     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Draft Probe Card    │
│   Procurement Specs    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Card Assembly &     │
│    Triaxial Wiring     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Docking, Alignment &  │
│    Noise Metrology     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Design Array Test Vehicle & Pad Structure (Scribing & Kerf Layout):**
   - Place array test structures on the test vehicle incorporating standalone 1T1C cells ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ access transistors with shared bitline contacts) alongside parallelized mini-arrays (e.g., $100 \times 100$ cells connected to a common node to resolve sub-femtoampere current scaling).
   - Layout 4-terminal Kelvin test pads and grounded guard rings surrounding high-impedance nodes to prevent surface leakage across adjacent metal tracks. Maintain bitline and wordline contact pitch according to design rules ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).

2. **Formulate Probe Card Technical Requirements & RF/DC Procurement Specification:**
   - Define probe card architecture requiring ultra-low-leakage ceramic or multilayer ceramic (MLC) needle guides with low-dielectric-absorption insulation (PTFE/ceramic substrate).
   - Specify individual probe tips with force ratings ($1.5\text{ to }2.5\text{ g/mil}$) to eliminate pad scrubbing punch-through on aluminum/copper top metal pads while maintaining contact resistance stability.
   - Require full triaxial cabling (Force, Sense, and Guard shields) terminated via low-noise triax connectors directly routed to the probe needles.

3. **Vendor Procurement & Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT):**
   - Release RFQ/Purchase Specification to certified precision probe card manufacturers with ISO/IEC low-current verification standards.
   - Require vendor validation of open-circuit path leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ chuck temperature to ensure background noise stays orders of magnitude below device leakage levels.
   - Inspect mechanical planarity, needle alignment, and tip wear under automated optical metrology prior to shipment acceptance.

4. **Prober Docking, Thermal Chamber Calibration & In-Situ Noise Floor Metrology:**
   - Dock the delivered low-noise probe card to the wafer prober interface in an electromagnetically shielded, dark, dry-air purged enclosure.
   - Ramp thermal chuck to $85^\circ\text{C}$ and run an open-air (probes lifted $50\,\mu\text{m}$ above wafer surface) baseline current sweep ($V = 0\text{ V to } 1.8\text{ V}$).
   - Verify that test station background noise floor and card leakage do not obscure the targeted sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).
   - Execute C-V metrology calibration using an LCR meter / parameter analyzer across frequencies ($10\text{ kHz to } 1\text{ MHz}$) to zero out bitline and cabling parasitics prior to validating storage capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Card Background Noise / Path Leakage** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{-16}$ ($< 0.1\text{ fA}$) | $\text{A (Amperes)}$ | At $85^\circ\text{C}$ chuck temp, $V_{bias} = 1.0\text{ V}$, probes lifted |
| **Thermal Chuck Operating Temperature** | $85 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Closed-loop thermocouple probe station monitor |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance Resolution** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Small-signal C-V metrology at $100\text{ kHz}$, $V_{bias} = V_{DD}/2$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance Characterization Range** | $250 \pm 25$ | $\text{fF}$ | Kelvin 4-terminal C-V extraction on standard bitline run |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context applied:* Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ access transistor, shared bitline contact), crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB), minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction/sub-threshold leakage requirement $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Context applied:* Folded bitline layout pitch ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ wordline/bitline pitch), $85^\circ\text{C}$ thermal test constraint for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$, and capacitance range constraints ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - *Context applied:* Bitline capacitance parameter ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ vs $C_s \approx 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$) for differential voltage signal evaluation and parasitic calibration.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Sub-Femtoampere Triaxial Direct-Current Leakage Characterization

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Optical Inspection / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Guarded Triaxial Probe Station Fixture Setup and Noise-Floor Calibration

### Executive Summary & Objective
This procedure specifies the hardware setup, triaxial active-guard routing, environmental shielding, and system calibration required to qualify a wafer-level probe station for sub-femtoampere direct-current (DC) leakage metrology on 180nm 1T1C DRAM cells. The primary target is ensuring a clean instrumentation noise floor capable of verifying junction/dielectric leakage targets strictly **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** at operating thermal conditions ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Faraday Shield &    │
│  Triaxial Cable Check  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Thermal Chuck      │
│    Conditioning 85C    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Open-Circuit      │
│    Baseline & Triax    │
│   Guard Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   System Noise Floor   │
│  Acceptance Test < 1   │
│           fA           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Faraday Enclosure & Vibration Isolation Setup**:
   - Float the pneumatic optical isolation table to decouple microphonic and mechanical ambient vibration.
   - Inspect the dark Faraday enclosure around the wafer stage; seal all optical access ports and verify ground continuity to clean instrumentation ground ($R_{\text{ground}} < 1\ \Omega$).
2. **Triaxial Cable Routing & Active Guard Fixturing**:
   - Connect high-isolation, low-noise triaxial cables (Centre Conductor: Force/Sense; Inner Shield: Active Guard; Outer Shield: Chassis Ground) directly from the Source Measure Unit (SMU) preamplifier to the probe arm manipulators.
   - Enforce minimum bend radius specifications on triaxial runs to prevent triboelectric charge buildup and micro-fractures in PTFE/Teflon insulation.
   - Connect the active guard potential of the SMU directly to the probe tip's concentric guard ring to eliminate cable/chuck shunt leakage paths.
3. **Thermal Conditioning of the Wafer Chuck**:
   - Set the thermal wafer chuck controller to $85^\circ\text{C}$ to match the standard retention qualification temperature.
   - Allow thermal stabilization for $\ge 30\text{ minutes}$ with closed enclosure lid to eliminate thermal drift and thermoelectric EMF voltages.
4. **Open-Circuit Triax Offset & Settling Calibration**:
   - Lift tungsten probe tips completely off the wafer surface ($\ge 500\ \mu\text{m}$ clearance).
   - Apply an SMU auto-zero / open-lead correction with an integration aperture set to 10–20 Power Line Cycles (NPLC).
   - Perform a stepped bias sweep across operating potential (0 V to nominal cell operating voltage) and monitor displacement/dielectric relaxation settling time.
5. **System Residual Noise-Floor Measurement & Sign-Off**:
   - Record continuous open-circuit current under full guarding at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across a 60-second measurement window.
   - Ensure peak-to-peak and root-mean-square (RMS) baseline fluctuations are safely below the 1 fA detection threshold.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **System Noise Floor (Residual Leakage)** | **$< 1.0$** | **fA** | Open-circuit probe lift-off, SMU guarded at $85^\circ\text{C}$, 10 NPLC |
| **Chuck Thermal Stability** | **$85.0 \pm 0.5$** | **$^\circ\text{C}$** | 4-wire RTD sensor reading during retention leakage qualification |
| **Target Storage Capacitance Budget** | **$\ge 28.0$** (range: $25 - 30$) | **fF/cell** | Crown-type stacked capacitor high-frequency C-V / charge extraction |
| **Data Retention Qualification Time** | **$> 64.0$** | **ms** | Refresh interval verification baseline at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Citations of Literature Context
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Context reference*: "Capacitance Budget: Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance. Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval..."
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context reference*: "The storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF (femtofarads) per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C. In 180nm nodes, stacked capacitors (Crown or Cylinder type) utilize silicon nitride (Si3N4) or tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5)..."

### **Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)**

#### **Title:** Temperature-Dependent DC Leakage Measurement & 85°C I-V Sweep Execution  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Gen 2 (µm)  
**Target Structure:** 1T1C Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Cell ($8F^2$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)

---

### **1. Scope & Objective**
Characterize sub-femtoampere direct-current ($DC$) leakage paths—comprising pass-transistor subthreshold leakage, access junction band-to-band tunneling/Shockley-Read-Hall generation, and crown capacitor dielectric leakage—at elevated junction temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$) to guarantee the minimum $> 64\text{ ms}$ DRAM cell retention interval.

---

### **2. Equipment & Test Setup**
- **Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SMU:** Keysight B1500A (equipped with High-Resolution SMU B1517A or Keithley 4200A-SCS with pre-amplifier remote unit).
- **Prober Station:** Temperature-controlled triaxial analytical probe station with enclosed dark box, dry nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) environmental purge, and active driven-guard coaxial/triaxial cabling.
- **Thermal Chuck Controller:** Closed-loop thermo-chuck capable of steady-state temperature stability within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across $25^\circ\text{C} - 125^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### **3. Step-by-Step Procedure**

#### **Step 1: Environmental Purge & Thermal Chuck Stabilization**
1. Load the 180nm DRAM test structure wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
2. Seal the prober enclosure and initiate a dry $\text{N}_2$ purge ($> 15\text{ SCFH}$) until the internal relative humidity drops below $5\%$ to prevent condensation and moisture-induced surface current paths.
3. Set the thermal chuck controller to **$85.0^\circ\text{C}$** and allow thermal soaking for a minimum of 15 minutes until chuck temperature settles within **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$**.

#### **Step 2: Sub-Femtoampere Triaxial Guarding & Zero-Offset Calibration**
1. Route triaxial inner shields (driven guard) directly to the probe needles contacting the Bitline ($\text{BL}$), Wordline ($\text{WL}$), Storage Node ($\text{SN}$ pad), and Substrate/Well ($\text{V}_{\text{BB}}$).
2. Execute open-circuit zero-null calibration with probes lifted $50\ \mu\text{m}$ above the contact pads.
3. Verify that the open-circuit baseline noise floor of the SMU does not exceed $\pm 50\text{ aA}$ ($0.05\text{ fA}$) over a 60-second baseline recording window.

#### **Step 3: Pin Bias & Terminal Conditions**
Contact the device terminals with tungsten/beryllium-copper probe tips:
- **Substrate / P-Well ($\text{V}_{\text{BB}}$):** Apply back-bias $\text{V}_{\text{BB}} = -0.5\text{ V}$ to $-0.8\text{ V}$ (or $0.0\text{ V}$ per test specification).
- **Wordline ($\text{WL}$ / Gate):** Force $\text{V}_{\text{WL}} = 0.0\text{ V}$ (access transistor turned OFF; inactive state). *(Note: Active state overdrive uses on-chip $\text{V}_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$ during write/read cycles).*
- **Storage Node ($\text{SN}$):** Force full-charge state $\text{V}_{\text{SN}} = \text{V}_{\text{DD}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ to test worst-case data '1' retention condition.
- **Capacitor Plate ($\text{V}_{\text{PL}}$):** Set cell plate to mid-point reference $\text{V}_{\text{plate}} = \text{V}_{\text{DD}} / 2 = 0.9\text{ V}$.

#### **Step 4: 85°C I-V Sweep Execution**
1. Configure SMU on the Bitline ($\text{BL}$) terminal:
   - **Mode:** Staircase Voltage Sweep.
   - **Sweep Range:** $\text{V}_{\text{BL}} = 0.0\text{ V}$ to $1.8\text{ V}$ in steps of $\le 50\text{ mV}$.
   - **Current Limit (Compliance):** $100\text{ pA}$ (to protect ultra-thin $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide and $3 - 4\text{ nm}$ EOT capacitor dielectric).
   - **Settling Delay:** Set pre-measurement settling delay $\ge 500\text{ ms}$ per step to allow displacement currents ($I = C \cdot \frac{dV}{dt}$) of the $28\text{ fF}$ cell capacitor and fixture parasitics to decay below the leakage threshold.
   - **Integration Aperture:** Set Analog-to-Digital Converter integration aperture to **10 NPLC** (Power Line Cycles) or Long Mode to filter $50/60\text{ Hz}$ line noise.
2. Execute the sweep and record $I_{\text{BL}}$ vs. $\text{V}_{\text{BL}}$, $I_{\text{SN}}$, and $I_{\text{BB}}$ simultaneously.

#### **Step 5: Leakage Extraction & Pass/Fail Analysis**
1. Extract the worst-case leakage current $I_{\text{leak, total}}$ at $\text{V}_{\text{SN}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ and $\text{V}_{\text{BL}} = 0.0\text{ V}$ ($|V_{\text{DS}}| = 1.8\text{ V}$).
2. Decompose $I_{\text{leak}}$ into junction/subthreshold leakage ($I_{\text{DS, off}}$ flowing into $\text{BL}$) and dielectric leakage ($I_{\text{diel}}$ flowing from $\text{SN}$ to plate).

---

### **4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics**

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Cell DC Leakage Current at 85°C** | **$< 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SMU current extraction at $V_{\text{SN}} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $V_{\text{BL}} = 0.0\text{ V}$, $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28.0$** (range: $25.0 - 30.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Small-signal high-frequency $C$-$V$ meter ($1\text{ MHz}$) |
| **Calculated Cell Retention Time at 85°C** | **$> 64$** | $\text{ms}$ | Derived retention: $t_{\text{ret}} = \frac{C_s \cdot \Delta V_{\text{margin}}}{I_{\text{leak}}} > 64\text{ ms}$ |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature Stability** | **$85.0 \pm 0.5$** | $^\circ\text{C}$ | RTD sensor reading during active sweep execution |

---

### **5. Literature Sources & Citations**
- *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*:
  - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); unit cell layout ($8F^2$); minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$; leakage current specification $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*:
  - Storage capacitor retention requirement ($25 - 30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$); crown capacitor dielectric EOT ($3 - 4\text{ nm}$); gate oxide thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$).
- *High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture*:
  - Core supply voltage $\text{V}_{\text{DD}} = 1.8\text{ V}$; pass transistor threshold voltage $V_{\text{th}} \approx 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$; wordline overdrive voltage $\text{V}_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$.

## Title: Thermal Chuck & Triaxial Shielded SMU Calibration at 85°C
**Branch / Generation**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 µm)

---

### 1. Calibration Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Dark Box Enclosure &  │

│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chamber Isolation & Environmental Control**:
   - Secure the wafer prober enclosure and engage the light-tight Faraday dark box to eliminate photoelectric carrier excitation and external 50/60 Hz electromagnetic pickup.
   - Connect the Source Measure Unit (SMU) force, sense, and driven-guard paths using low-noise triaxial cables directly to the thermal chuck and micro-positioner probe heads. Ensure outer shields connect to chassis earth ground and inner shields connect strictly to the driven active guard.

2. **Thermal Chuck Ramp to 85°C**:
   - Power on the closed-loop thermal chuck controller. Program the setpoint temperature to $85.0^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Engage dry CDA (Clean Dry Air) or nitrogen purge across the chuck surface to suppress moisture condensation and dielectric surface leakage.
   - Allow a minimum 15-minute thermal soak once the thermocouple sensor reaches $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ to establish uniform thermal equilibrium and minimize mechanical chuck expansion drift.

3. **Triaxial SMU Offset & Open-Circuit Calibration**:
   - Lift all measurement probes to the open-circuit position (air clearance $\ge 200\,\mu\text{m}$ above the wafer surface).
   - Execute instrument zero-offset / open-circuit calibration on the triaxial SMU at the $85^\circ\text{C}$ operational baseline to null out residual thermal EMF, cable dielectric absorption, and guard offset voltages.
   - Set the SMU measurement integration time to Long / High-Resolution (NPLC $\ge 10$) with the lowest physical current range enabled (10 fA or 100 fA range).

4. **Residual Leakage & Noise Floor Verification**:
   - Perform a 60-second baseline static DC current measurement with 0 V applied to verify that open-circuit background leakage remains well below the DRAM sub-femtoampere verification boundary prior to probing test dies.

| **Open-Circuit SMU Leakage Noise Floor** | `< 0.2` | $\text{fA}$ (femtoamperes) | Maximum baseline limit (must be strictly $< 1\,\text{fA}$) |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-DRAM180-042
**Title:** Temperature-Step Sub-Threshold & Node Junction Leakage I-V Sweep  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Metrology & Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the triaxial DC characterization procedure to extract sub-threshold channel leakage and storage node p-n junction leakage currents across temperature setpoints up to 85°C on test structures representing the 180nm 1T1C (8F²) access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and crown capacitor storage node.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Test Setup
- **Automated Thermal Wafer Prober:** Shielded dark box with triaxial thermal chuck ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ stability, range: $25^\circ\text{C}$ to $125^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Precision Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer:** Equipped with High-Resolution SMUs (HRSMUs) supporting sub-femtoampere ($<0.1\text{ fA}$) measurement resolution.
- **Cabling & Shielding:** Full triaxial connections with driven active guards routed to within $<10\text{ mm}$ of probe tips.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
[Step 1: Calibration] ──> [Step 2: Probing Setup] ──> [Step 3: 25°C Baseline Sweep]
                                                                  │
[Step 5: Analysis & Log] <── [Step 4: 85°C High-T Sweep] <───────┘
```

#### Step 1: Open-Circuit Calibration & Residual Floor Verification
1. Lift probe needles $\ge 500\,\mu\text{m}$ above the wafer surface inside the sealed, light-tight triaxial enclosure.
2. Run SMU zero-offset correction and integration noise auto-nulling using Long Integration Time (PLC $\ge 16$ to 32 cycles).
3. Measure the open-circuit triaxial noise floor; verify background residual leakage is $\le 0.1\text{ fA}$ across the $-0.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.8\text{ V}$ range.

#### Step 2: Test Structure Probing & Pinout Assignment
1. Lower tungsten probe tips onto the designated Kelvin/triaxial test pads for the cell access transistor:
   - **SMU 1 (Bitline Node / Shared Contact):** Biased at precharge baseline $V_{\text{pre}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ (or ground for sub-threshold sweeps).
   - **SMU 2 (Wordline Gate):** Swept from $-0.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.8\text{ V}$.
   - **SMU 3 (Storage Node / Crown W-Plug Pad):** Biased at cell high $V_{\text{cell}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ and cell low $0.0\text{ V}$.
   - **SMU 4 (Substrate / Well Contact):** Connected to $V_{\text{BB}} = -0.5\text{ V}$ back-bias or substrate ground.

#### Step 3: Room Temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$) Baseline I-V Sweep
1. Stabilize chuck temperature at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Sub-threshold Sweep:** Step $V_{\text{WL}}$ from $-0.2\text{ V}$ to $+1.0\text{ V}$ in $10\text{ mV}$ steps with $V_{\text{drain}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ to extract sub-threshold swing ($S$) and off-state channel current $I_{\text{off}}$ at $V_{\text{WL}} = 0\text{ V}$.
3. **Junction Leakage Sweep:** Hold $V_{\text{WL}} = -0.5\text{ V}$ (fully off), sweep storage node junction voltage $V_{\text{node}}$ from $0\text{ V}$ to $1.8\text{ V}$, measuring current $I_{\text{node}}$ to record baseline reverse-bias diode leakage.

#### Step 4: Temperature-Step Soak & $85^\circ\text{C}$ I-V Sweep Execution
1. Ramp the thermal chuck to $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ at $5^\circ\text{C/min}$. Allow a 15-minute thermal soak to prevent mechanical probe drift and chuck thermal gradient errors.
2. Execute the identical sub-threshold sweep ($V_{\text{WL}} = -0.2\text{ V} \to +1.0\text{ V}$) and junction reverse leakage sweep ($V_{\text{node}} = 0\text{ V} \to 1.8\text{ V}$) under shielded dark-box conditions.
3. Record steady-state off-current at $V_{\text{WL}} = 0\text{ V}$, $V_{\text{node}} = 1.8\text{ V}$, and $V_{\text{BB}} = -0.5\text{ V}$.

#### Step 5: Data Extraction & Pass/Fail Qualification
1. Extract combined off-state leakage $I_{\text{leak, total}} = I_{\text{sub-threshold}} + I_{\text{junction}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Verify total leakage satisfies the retention budget for the target retention window ($> 64\text{ ms}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Condition | Target / Tolerance | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Cell DC Leakage Current** | At $T_{\text{chuck}} = 85^\circ\text{C}$, $V_{\text{cell}} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $V_{\text{WL}} = 0.0\text{ V}$ | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Minimum Cell Storage Capacitance** | $C\text{-}V$ verification at $85^\circ\text{C}$, storage node to plate | $\ge 28.0$ (spec: $25 - 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature Stability** | Steady-state soak prior to & during sweep | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | In-line CD-SEM / physical gate length | $180 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 5. Literature & Context Citations
- **Transistor Geometry & Leakage Target:** Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
- **Capacitance & Retention Lifetime:** Storage capacitor minimum target $28\text{ fF}$ (within the $25 - 30\text{ fF}$ design window) ensuring cell retention interval $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (*Sources: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Array Voltage Levels:** Bitline precharge target $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ ($0.9\text{ V}$ at nominal $1.8\text{ V}$ rail) (*Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*).

# Standard Operating Procedure: Sub-Femtoampere Arrhenius Activation Energy & Retention Lifetime Extraction

**Context Path:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)` > `1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²)` > `Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling` > `Cell Retention & Soft-Error Immunity Metrology (28 fF / <1 fA Leakage Verification)` > `Sub-Femtoampere Triaxial Direct-Current Leakage Characterization` > `Temperature-Dependent DC Leakage Measurement & 85°C I-V Sweep Execution` > **`Sub-Femtoampere Arrhenius Activation Energy & Retention Lifetime Extraction`**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Thermal Chuck     │
│  Setting: 25C to 85C  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Triaxial DC Leakage  │
│      Extraction       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Arrhenius Plot: ln   │
│   I_leak vs 1000/T    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    E_a Slope Fit &    │
│  Retention Tau Calc   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental Chamber & Triaxial Probe Station Stabilization**:
   - Mount the 180nm 1T1C test array wafer on the thermal chuck. Connect triaxial guarded Kelvin probe lines directly to the cell test pads (storage node crown via tungsten plug / bitline contact).
   - Enclose the probe station in a dry nitrogen-purged, light-tight Faraday shield to suppress ambient photo-generation and humidity-induced leakage.

2. **Multi-Temperature DC Leakage Sweep Execution ($25^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$)**:
   - Program the thermal chuck to sweep temperatures from $25^\circ\text{C}$ up to $85^\circ\text{C}$ (e.g., $25^\circ\text{C}$, $50^\circ\text{C}$, $70^\circ\text{C}$, $85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Allow thermal stabilization ($\pm 0.1^\circ\text{C}$) at each setpoint.
   - Execute sub-femtoampere DC parameter extraction at nominal cell storage voltage to measure total node leakage $I_{\text{leak}}(T)$ (combining access transistor sub-threshold/junction leakage and dielectric conduction through the ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ stack).

3. **Arrhenius Extraction & Activation Energy ($E_a$) Calculation**:
   - Convert Chuck temperatures $T$ to absolute temperature (Kelvin, $K$).
   - Construct the Arrhenius characteristic curve: $\ln(I_{\text{leak}})$ versus $1000/T$.
   - Extract the activation energy $E_a$ from linear regression slope:
     $$\text{Slope} = -\frac{E_a}{k_B} \implies E_a = -k_B \times \frac{d(\ln I_{\text{leak}})}{d(1/T)}$$
   - Identify dominant leakage mechanisms: near silicon bandgap ($E_a \approx 1.1\text{ eV}$) indicating access transistor diffusion/subthreshold leakage, or mid-gap ($E_a \approx 0.55\text{–}0.7\text{ eV}$) indicating SRH generation-recombination / trap-assisted tunneling in the dielectric.

4. **Retention Lifetime ($\tau_{\text{ret}}$) Extrapolation**:
   - Compute retention lifetime at maximum operating temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$):
     $$\tau_{\text{ret}} = \frac{Q_{\text{usable}}}{I_{\text{leak}}(85^\circ\text{C})} = \frac{C_s \cdot \Delta V_{\text{margin}}}{I_{\text{leak}}(85^\circ\text{C})}$$
   - Validate against minimum signal development budget ($\Delta V = 100\text{–}150\text{ mV}$) on bitlines ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \ge 25\text{–}28\text{ fF}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
   Delta V_sig (mV)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
Ret Time @ 85C (ms)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
        C_cell (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
  I_leak @ 85C (fA)┤░                                  │
                   │░                                  │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       25      50       75     100 
```

1. **Storage Node Leakage Current at $85^\circ\text{C}$**:
   - **Target**: $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
2. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)**:
   - **Target**: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ (allowable range $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$) (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology / Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture*).
3. **Retention Refresh Lifetime at $85^\circ\text{C}$**:
   - **Target**: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
4. **Readout Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)**:
   - **Target**: $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ developed onto bitline with $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ (*Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*).

---

### Context Citations
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Specifies unit cell dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), crown stacked capacitor with ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction/subthreshold leakage target of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Defines 1T1C storage capacitor target of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, with high-k EOT of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Establishes bitline sensing condition with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, delivering differential voltage $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance

- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Node Title:** Temperature-Dependent $I_d\text{--}V_g$ and Reverse Diode $I\text{--}V$ Test Structure Setup  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Metrology / Characterization  

```text
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Wafer Chuck Thermal     │
│ Control (25°C -> 85°C)  │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Triaxial Probe Landing  │
│ on Test Structures      │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Temperature-Dependent   │    │ Reverse Diode I-V       │
│ Id-Vg Sweeps            │    │ Junction Leakage Sweeps │
└────────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬────────────┘
             │                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Extract Subthreshold    │    │ Extract Junction        │
│ Swing & Ioff            │    │ Leakage @ 85°C (<1 fA)  │
└─────────────────────────┘    └─────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Structure Selection & Thermal Chuck Stabilization**
   - Mount the 180nm processed test wafer onto the triaxial thermal probe station chuck.
   - Align probes with high-magnification optics to the dedicated test structures:
     - Access transistor test structures: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with gate oxide $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$.
     - Dedicated storage node $n^+/p$-well reverse diode test structures representing the access transistor drain junction connected to the crown storage node W-plug.
   - Set chuck temperature to baseline room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$), allow thermal equilibrium for 10 minutes, and subsequently step temperature to elevated conditions ($50^\circ\text{C}$, $75^\circ\text{C}$, and target maximum operating condition $85^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Triaxial Direct-Current Leakage Measurement Setup**
   - Connect Source-Measure Units (SMUs) via low-noise, guard-driven triaxial cabling to eliminate parasitic cable charging and system leakage down to sub-femtoampere ($< 1\text{ fA}$) resolution.
   - Enclose the probe station inside a dark, dry-nitrogen-purged, Faraday shielded enclosure to avoid photo-generated carriers and moisture condensation at elevated temperatures.

3. **Temperature-Dependent $I_d\text{--}V_g$ Characterization (Subthreshold Extraction)**
   - Apply nominal drain bias: linear regime ($V_{ds} = 50\text{ mV}$) and saturated operating regime ($V_{ds} = V_{DD} \text{ or } 1.8\text{ V}$).
   - Sweep gate voltage $V_{gs}$ across the subthreshold range (e.g., from $-0.5\text{ V}$ to $1.8\text{ V}$) while monitoring source current $I_s$ and drain current $I_d$ with integration time optimized for sub-fA current levels.
   - Record log($I_d$) vs. $V_{gs}$ at each temperature step ($25^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$) to extract Subthreshold Swing ($SS$) degradation and determine off-state leakage ($I_{off}$ at $V_{gs} = 0\text{ V}$).

4. **Reverse Diode $I\text{--}V$ Sweep (Junction Leakage Characterization)**
   - Connect the triaxial SMU terminal across the cell storage node $n^+/p$-well diode junction.
   - Sweep reverse bias voltage $V_R$ across the cell operating window ($0\text{ V}$ to $V_{DD}/2 \approx 0.9\text{ V}$ and up to full supply voltage $1.8\text{ V}$).
   - Measure reverse saturation leakage current across the temperature gradient ($25^\circ\text{C} \to 85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - De-embed junction area and perimeter leakage components to quantify storage node leakage entering the bitline and substrate.

5. **Retention Time Budget De-Embedding & Validation**
   - Sum subthreshold off-state leakage $I_{off}$ and reverse-biased junction leakage $I_{junc}$ at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Verify that the combined cell leakage conforms to the retention discharge budget $\Delta V = \frac{I_{leak} \cdot t_{refresh}}{C_s}$, ensuring retention interval $> 64\text{ ms}$ for a minimum cell capacitance budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.

---

#### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | At $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$, $V_{cell} = V_{DD}$, $V_{gs} = 0\text{ V}$ |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($L \times W$)** | $180 \times 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / Electrical Length Verification |
| **Thermal Chuck Operating Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Closed-loop RTD sensor chuck stabilization |
| **Target Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 28.0$ (min. $\ge 25$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Metrology verification for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention |

---

#### 3. Citations & References
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Channel geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum storage capacitance target ($28\text{ fF/cell}$), and high-temperature leakage constraint ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ cell storage retention specification ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), storage capacitance window ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$), and gate oxide physical thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Sensing charge redistribution budget ($Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$), typical cell capacitance reference ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$), and bitline precharge reference ($V_{DD}/2$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Subthreshold Swing and p-n Junction Leakage De-embedding Parameter Extraction  
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-DRAM-007`  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Cell Layout & Dimensions:** $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ Folded Bitline Crown-Type COB ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$)  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stage Stabilization:  │
│     Chuck at 85 C      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Direct-Current     │
│    Sub-Femtoamp I-V    │
│         Sweep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│   Subthreshold Swing   │    │      Reverse-Bias      │
│      SS Parameter      │    │    Junction Leakage    │
│       Extraction       │    │      De-embedding      │
│                        │    │                        │
└───────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                              │
            │ ╭────────────────────────────╯
            ▼ ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cell Leakage Budget:  │
│   I_leak < 1 fA per    │
│          cell          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Retention Window Check:│
│   t_ret > 64 ms for    │
│      C_s >= 28 fF      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental & Triaxial Metrology Bench Setup**
   - Mount the test wafer on a low-noise triaxial guarded thermal chuck inside an EMI-shielded dark box.
   - Set thermal chuck temperature to **$85^\circ\text{C}$** with thermal drift stabilized to within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Connect triaxial Kelvin probes to the Source Measurement Units (SMU) with guard shields driven to trace voltages to suppress cable leakage below $0.1\text{ fA}$.

2. **Access Transistor Subthreshold Sweep ($I_{D}\text{--}V_{GS}$)**
   - Land probes on the dedicated $8F^2$ access transistor test key ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Fix substrate body bias $V_B = 0\text{ V}$ and bitline terminal $V_S = 0\text{ V}$.
   - Apply cell storage node drain potential $V_{DS} = V_{DD}/2$ and $V_{DD}$ (representing full charge state).
   - Sweep wordline gate voltage $V_{GS}$ in the subthreshold regime from $-0.5\text{ V}$ to $+0.8\text{ V}$ with fine step increments ($\le 10\text{ mV}$) and settling integration time $\ge 100\text{ ms}$ per step.

3. **Subthreshold Swing ($SS$) Parameter Extraction**
   - Plot $\log_{10}(I_D)$ versus $V_{GS}$.
   - Extract the subthreshold swing parameter from the inverse maximum linear slope:
     $$SS = \left(\frac{\partial \log_{10} I_D}{\partial V_{GS}}\right)^{-1}$$
   - Verify gate dielectric integrity corresponding to the thermally grown $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide layer.

4. **Storage Node p-n Junction Leakage De-embedding**
   - Probe the array de-embedding dummy key (storage node diffusion contact matrix with gate turned off, $V_{GS} < V_{T}$).
   - Sweep reverse bias voltage across the p-n junction $V_{\text{junction}}$ up to operating voltage conditions.
   - De-embed pad/cable parasitic currents and isolate the perimeter/area junction leakage components from channel subthreshold conduction.

5. **Retention Time Budget & Target Compliance Audit**
   - Sum subthreshold off-state leakage ($I_{\text{sub}}$) and reverse-bias p-n junction leakage ($I_{\text{junc}}$) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to obtain total cell off-state leakage $I_{\text{leak}}$.
   - Compute nominal retention window with cell capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (targeting minimum cell retention time budget $> 64\text{ ms}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Thermal Chuck Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Embedded PT100/Thermocouple feedback |
| **Combined Cell Off-State Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-femtoampere triaxial DC probe measurement at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Unit Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ (min. range $25.0 \text{--} 30.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | $C\text{--}V$ multi-frequency impedance metrology |
| **Target Data Retention Refresh Interval ($t_{\text{ret}}$)** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Calculated retention budget ($\Delta Q / I_{\text{leak}}$) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Transistor Physical Critical Dimensions** | $L = 180 \pm 5$, $W = 220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM verification |

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance specification: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for alpha-particle soft-error immunity.
  - Leakage requirement: Combined subthreshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture.
  - Storage capacitor capacitance range: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Gate dielectric: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - Cell charge transfer relationship $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ and differential readout sensing budget constraints.

```text
           0.00      0.24       0.47      0.71     0.95 
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Baseline Parameter Extraction**:
   - Extract access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), gate oxide thickness ($t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$), and crown capacitor equivalent oxide thickness ($EOT = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) to establish a nominal cell capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (within the target specification of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$).
2. **Thermal & Leakage Component Modeling at $85^\circ\text{C}$**:
   - Model the subthreshold leakage across the access gate, drain-substrate junction leakage at the storage node, and dielectric tunneling leakage across the high-$\kappa$ capacitor ($EOT = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) under elevated thermal conditions of $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Statistical Monte Carlo Sensitivity Execution**:
   - Execute a $\ge 10,000$-run Monte Carlo statistical sensitivity sweep introducing process variations ($\pm 3\sigma$ variation in gate length $L$, oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$, and crown capacitor area) to generate the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of cell retention times.
4. **Sense Margin Evaluation**:
   - Calculate the available differential sensing voltage on a folded bitline:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     using bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, verifying that $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV}$ remains sufficient for sense amplifier latching after leakage discharge.
5. **Retention Time Budget & Refresh Timing Closure**:
   - Compute the usable cell charge $Q_{\text{usable}} = C_s \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{min\_sense}})$ and verify that the worst-case statistical retention limit satisfies:
     $$t_{\text{ret}} = \frac{Q_{\text{usable}}}{I_{\text{leak}}} \ge 64\text{ ms}\quad \text{at } 85^\circ\text{C}$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (range: $25\text{ -- }30$) | $\text{fF}$ | Small-signal CV extraction, 180nm crown capacitor |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Total leakage (subthreshold + junction) at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded bitline readout with $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **DRAM Refresh Interval ($t_{\text{ref}}$)** | $\ge 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Full array retention verification at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - Confirms unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and total leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - Confirms storage capacitance range of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, retention time requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate oxide thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$, and capacitor $EOT = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
- **`Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`**:
  - Confirms folded bitline architecture sensing equation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, typical parameters $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal development window of $100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Elevated Temperature Retention & Alpha-Source Soft-Error Rate Profiling

**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM, 8F² / 6F² Cell Topology, Crown-Type COB)  
**Process Step / Domain:** Metrology & Reliability Engineering  
**Action Type:** Make / Characterization  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wafer Mount &      │
│   Thermal Chuck Soak   │
│        at 85°C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Pause-Refresh      │
│  Retention Sweep 64ms  │
│        - 500ms         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Alpha-Source      │
│  Irradiation 241Am /   │
│         232Th          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Differential Sensing  │
│   Readout & Bit-Flip   │
│        Logging         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Thermal Chuck Stabilization & Die Conditioning:**
   - Mount the 180nm DRAM wafer/die onto the automated probe station thermal chuck.
   - Ramp chuck temperature to **85°C ± 0.5°C** and allow a 15-minute thermal soak to equilibrate junction and sub-threshold temperatures across the array.
2. **Cell Array Bias Pre-conditioning & Background Pattern Write:**
   - Set supply rail $V_{DD}$ to nominal operation. Assert bitline equalization to balance complementary bitline pairs ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) to $V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Write solid '1' ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and checkerboard patterns across the 8F² Crown-type COB array via row and column address decoders.
3. **Elevated Temperature Pause-Refresh Profiling:**
   - Disable automatic refresh cycles and apply calibrated pause intervals ($t_{pause}$) starting at $64\text{ ms}$ up to $500\text{ ms}$ at 85°C.
   - Assert wordlines ($WL$) to activate the 180nm access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Read out stored charge onto bitlines ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$); monitor differential signal development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ across CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifiers.
   - Record fail-bit maps and calculate total retention degradation caused by junction and sub-threshold leakage.
4. **Accelerated Alpha-Particle Soft-Error Rate (SER) Irradiation:**
   - Position an unsealed alpha-particle calibration source ($^{241}\text{Am}$ or $^{232}\text{Th}$ foil) at a fixed working distance directly above the unpassivated DRAM die surface.
   - Continuously cycle static retention tests under constant alpha flux at 85°C with nominal pause duration ($t_{pause} = 64\text{ ms}$).
   - Log soft-error upset events (single-bit flips $1 \to 0$ from electron collection at the cell storage node plug contact).
5. **Post-Exposure Recovery & Metrology Reporting:**
   - Retract the radiation source to the shielded enclosure.
   - Cool thermal chuck down to 25°C.
   - Compute fail-bit count versus pause time and calculate Soft Error Rate in FIT/Mb (Failures in Time per Megabit).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                         Metrology Target Thresholds    
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
        Sense dV (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
Retention Target (ms)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
        Cell Cap (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                         │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                         │
   Leakage Limit (fA)┤█                                │
                     │█                                │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    31.2    62.5    93.8  125.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Boundary Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Minimum bound ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ range) |
| **Cell Retention Time ($t_{ret}$)** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Measured at $T_{chuck} = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold + junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Signal developed onto $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - High-k dielectric: $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, or ONO stack with EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Precharge equalization level: $V_{DD} / 2$.
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance: $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-TRET85`  
**Title:** Thermal Chuck Calibration & Elevated Temperature Retention Time ($t_{RET}$) Characterization at 85°C  
**Generation / Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, 8F² / 6F² COB Stack)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Reliability Testing  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Thermal Chuck Setup  │
│  and Cal at 85 deg C  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Soaking and   │
│     Surface Probe     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Pattern Write: Data  │
│     1 and Data 0      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Variable Pause     │
│  Pause-Refresh Test:  │
│     10ms to 128ms     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Burst Readout and   │
│   Bit-Fail Mapping    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Retention Time     │
│    Extraction and     │
│   Acceptance Check    │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Thermal Chuck Closed-Loop Calibration
1. Power on the wafer prober thermal chuck controller and configure the setpoint to **85.0°C**.
2. Mount a calibrated surface thermocouple/RTD sensor wafer onto the chuck under full vacuum.
3. Allow the PID controller to settle; verify temperature uniformity across center, middle, and edge chuck zones within **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** of the 85.0°C target.

#### Step 2: Wafer Loading & Thermal Stabilization
1. Load the 180nm DRAM test wafer (containing 1T1C cells with $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and crown-type COB capacitors) onto the chuck.
2. Engage chuck vacuum (> 60 kPa) and soak the wafer for a minimum of **15 minutes** to ensure complete die and silicon substrate thermal equilibrium at 85°C.

#### Step 3: Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Interface & Pin Alignment
1. Align the probe card pins to the test pads on the DUT (or designated retention metrology test arrays).
2. Establish clean probe contact and verify contact resistance across power ($V_{DD}$), wordline ($V_{PP}/V_{WL}$), bitline precharge ($V_{BLP}$), and cell plate ($V_{CP}$) supply rails.

#### Step 4: Pattern Initialization (Write Cycle)
1. Write deterministic test data patterns into the cell array:
   - **Phase A:** Solid Data '1' (high state stored on the crown capacitor).
   - **Phase B:** Solid Data '0' / Checkerboard pattern to evaluate neighboring cell disturbance.
2. Ensure write cycle timing matches nominal array access specifications before starting the retention hold.

#### Step 5: Pause-Refresh Retention Hold & Burst Readout
1. Inhibit all internal and external refresh cycles ($Auto\text{-}Refresh / Self\text{-}Refresh$).
2. Apply a variable pause (hold) interval ranging from **10 ms to 128 ms** (stepping through 16 ms, 32 ms, 64 ms, and 128 ms) while holding the chuck strictly at 85°C.
3. At the end of each pause interval, execute a high-speed burst read command sequence across all addresses and capture the read data buffer.

#### Step 6: Bit-Fail Mapping & Leakage Extraction
1. Compare output data against the initialized pattern to record bit failures (single-bit flips).
2. Generate Bit-Fail Maps (BFM) and extract the cumulative failure distribution $t_{RET}$ curve.
3. From the retention degradation curve, calculate the cell access-transistor sub-threshold and storage node junction leakage current:
   $$I_{leak} = C_{cell} \cdot \frac{\Delta V_{SN}}{t_{RET}}$$

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Data Retention Time ($t_{RET}$)** | **$> 64$** | Minimum threshold at 85°C across array | $\text{ms}$ |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_{cell}$)** | **$\ge 28$** (nominal 25 – 30) | Minimum allowable crown capacitance | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | **$< 1.0$** | Maximum allowable leakage at 85°C | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature Accuracy** | **$85.0 \pm 0.5$** | Sustained soak & test uniformity | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 3. Context & Literature Citations

1. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance specification of **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$** per cell.
   - Requirement for elevated temperature data retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - 1T1C unit cell dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Minimum capacitance budget of **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** to guarantee noise immunity.
   - Access transistor sub-threshold and junction leakage target of **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** to maintain target refresh intervals.
