# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Implantation & Annealing Doping Profile Specification for Retrograde Well, Halo, and S/D Junctions
**Document ID:** `SOP-180NM-DRAM-IMP-ANN-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Process Level:** Circuit Design / 3D TCAD Boundary & Doping Profile Definition  
**Classification:** Standard Operating Procedure (Leaf Level - Make)

---

### 1. Purpose & Process Scope
This procedure specifies the ion implantation and thermal annealing doping process conditions and boundary parameter profiles for the 180nm 1T1C stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) DRAM access transistor. The objective is to define a retrograde p-well, pocket halo implants, and low-leakage source/drain (S/D) extension profiles that suppress short-channel punchthrough while maintaining ultra-low retention leakage (< 1 fA/cell at 85°C) to safeguard the storage node charge (> 25–30 fF) across refresh periods.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Implant Gate Dielectric & Surface Screening Validation
1. Verify gate dielectric integrity prior to S/D and halo implants:
   - Thermally grown SiO₂ via dry oxidation (furnace tube at 850°C–900°C) with physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
2. Validate screen oxide thickness ($5.0 \pm 0.5\text{ nm}$) across open active area regions to prevent ion channelling during well and halo implantation.

#### Step 2: Retrograde P-Well Ion Implantation
1. Perform multi-energy Boron ($^{11}\text{B}^{+}$) implantation to create a retrograde concentration peak submerged well below the channel-depletion edge:
   - **Deep Retrograde Well Peak:** Implantation energy $120\text{ keV}$ to $180\text{ keV}$, nominal dose $1.5 \times 10^{13}\text{ cm}^{-2}$ to $3.0 \times 10^{13}\text{ cm}^{-2}$, wafer tilt $7^\circ$, twist $22^\circ$ (subsurface peak at depth $\sim 0.45\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - **Channel / Anti-Punchthrough (APT) Well Tail:** Implantation energy $35\text{ keV}$ to $50\text{ keV}$, dose $3.0 \times 10^{12}\text{ cm}^{-2}$ to $6.0 \times 10^{12}\text{ cm}^{-2}$, keeping surface doping optimized for target threshold voltage ($V_{th} \approx 0.65\text{ V}$).

#### Step 3: Self-Aligned Halo (Pocket) Angle Implantation
1. Following polysilicon gate patterning (physical gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$):
   - Perform quad-rotation angle halo implant using $\text{BF}_2^{+}$ species.
   - Tilt angle: $25^\circ$ to $30^\circ$, 4-quadrant rotation ($0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ$).
   - Energy: $20\text{ keV}$ to $30\text{ keV}$, cumulative dose $8.0 \times 10^{12}\text{ cm}^{-2}$ to $1.5 \times 10^{13}\text{ cm}^{-2}$.
   - Ensure localized concentration at gate corners to suppress drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) without increasing deep-depletion band-to-band tunneling (BTBT).

#### Step 4: Storage Node & Shared Bitline S/D Extension / Junction Implantation
1. Pattern S/D photolithography mask over the active memory array:
   - Perform Phosphorus ($^{31}\text{P}^{+}$) or dual Arsenic/Phosphorus LDD/extension implant to produce a graded junction on the storage node junction side (minimizing electric field gradients).
   - Energy: $15\text{ keV}$ to $25\text{ keV}$, dose $1.0 \times 10^{14}\text{ cm}^{-2}$ to $3.0 \times 10^{14}\text{ cm}^{-2}$, tilt $0^\circ$.
2. Form sidewall spacer dielectric and execute heavy contact implant (Arsenic $^{75}\text{As}^{+}$) at the shared bitline contact pad and storage node contact plug interface ($40\text{ keV}$, $2.0 \times 10^{15}\text{ cm}^{-2}$).

#### Step 5: Rapid Thermal Annealing (RTA) & Dopant Activation
1. Transfer wafer lot to single-wafer RTA chamber under high-purity dry $\text{N}_2$ purge:
   - Ramp rate: $75^\circ\text{C/s}$ to $100^\circ\text{C/s}$.
   - Soak anneal / Spike anneal temperature: $950^\circ\text{C}$ to $1000^\circ\text{C}$ for $5\text{ s}$ to $10\text{ s}$.
   - Minimize transient enhanced diffusion (TED) of boron halo profile while completely repairing implantation-induced crystal displacement and activating donors ($> 90\%$ activation).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method / Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Cell Retention Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | $\le 1.0$ (Max allowable) | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Automated parametric wafer test / Sub-pA Source Measure Unit (SMU) |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0 \pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cross-Sectional TEM |
| **Gate Oxide Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramp-voltage Time-to-Breakdown (TDDB) tester |
| **Transistor Physical Critical Dimensions** | $L = 180 \pm 5$ ; $W = 220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Top-Down CD-SEM / In-line metrology |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Shared bitline contact between adjacent cells with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Storage capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for alpha-particle immunity and bitline coupling margin.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Storage node capacitance requirement: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms at } 85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Dry thermal oxidation kinetic regime performed at $900^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - Dielectric breakdown field target $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ with interface state density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$.
  - Target gate dielectric thickness: $3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Bitline Contact Boundary Calibration, Junction Leakage & Off-State Metrology TCAD Extraction
- **Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`8F²` COB 1T1C Topology, Generation Gen 2)
- **Council Domain:** Metrology / TCAD Circuit Boundary Calibration
- **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial / Calibrated Vendor TCAD Deck & Extraction Methodology)

---

## 1. Process Flow & Visual Diagram

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Geometry & Doping Deck Ingestion                    |
| - Channel L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm                            |
| - Shared Bitline Contact & Gate Oxide Tox = 3.5 nm          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Mesh Generation & Contact Boundary Calibration       |
| - Refine mesh at Bitline W-plug / Si contact interface     |
| - Apply Dirichlet / Ohmic & Schottky barrier boundaries     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Physical Model Activation                           |
| - Band-to-Band Tunneling (Hurkx / Schenk)                   |
| - SRH Recombination with trap-assisted tunneling           |
| - Drift-diffusion transport at 85°C                         |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Quiescent Off-State & Junction Leakage Extraction   |
| - Precharge condition: V_BL = V_DD / 2, V_WL = 0 V (Off)    |
| - Sweep Storage Node V_cell from 0 V to V_DD                |
| - Extract I_off (subthreshold) & I_junc (drain/substrate)   |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 5: Acceptance Validation & SPICE Macro-Model Export    |
| - Check total cell leakage <= 1 fA/cell at 85°C             |
| - Validate differential signal budget (Delta V ~100-150 mV) |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Solid Model & Boundary Condition Ingestion
1. Import the calibrated 3D solid geometry for the 180nm `8F²` unit cell access transistor:
   - Channel physical gate length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$
   - Channel physical active width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$
   - Gate dielectric: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
2. Define the shared bitline contact shared between adjacent pairs of memory cells with a tungsten plug (W-plug) contact interface.

### Step 2: Adaptive Mesh & Contact Boundary Definition
1. Configure adaptive meshing with maximum grid refinement ($\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ grid steps) across the bitline-contact/silicon junction metallurgical boundary and the gate edge overlap regions.
2. Assign Dirichlet contact boundary conditions to the Bitline W-plug contact, Storage Node contact, Wordline (Gate electrode), and P-well substrate.

### Step 3: TCAD Physics Model Activation
1. Set lattice operating temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($358.15\text{ K}$).
2. Enable temperature-dependent Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination models with doping dependence.
3. Activate Band-to-Band Tunneling (BTBT) and Trap-Assisted Tunneling (TAT) models to capture high-field junction band bending at the bitline and storage node diffusion edges.
4. Activate Philips unified mobility model and Fermi-Dirac statistics for degenerate source/drain regions.

### Step 4: Quiescent Leakage & Off-State Metrology Simulation
1. Establish the folded bitline precharge state: set Bitline voltage $V_{BL} = V_{DD}/2$.
2. Maintain access transistor in off-state: wordline voltage $V_{WL} = 0\text{ V}$.
3. Bias storage node contact to worst-case retention state ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and substrate to $V_{BB} \le 0\text{ V}$.
4. Solve coupled Poisson and electron/hole continuity equations to steady-state convergence.
5. Extract individual leakage components:
   - **Subthreshold leakage current ($I_{sub}$):** Drain-to-source channel leakage through the access transistor into the shared bitline.
   - **Junction leakage current ($I_{junc}$):** Reverse-biased junction leakage from diffusion regions into the substrate/well.
   - **Gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL):** Overlap tunneling currents under high drain-to-gate field.

### Step 5: Metric Verification and Parasitic Extraction Hand-off
1. Integrate total off-state leakage flux per cell: $I_{leak,total} = I_{sub} + I_{junc} + I_{GIDL}$.
2. Verify retention time capability based on nominal cell capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\text{ to }28\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
3. Format output metrics into SPICE-compatible compact diode and subthreshold leakage parameters for circuit simulation.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Exact nominal design target |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ |
| **Total Off-State & Junction Leakage ($I_{leak}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum upper bound at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Minimum operational threshold for retention |
| **Developed Readout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | For $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ |

---

## 4. Context References

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact between adjacent cells, tungsten plug (W-plug) connection, cell capacitance baseline $\ge 28\text{ fF}$, and junction/sub-threshold leakage requirement $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; cell capacitance retention requirement of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Precharge operation at $V_{DD}/2$, cell readout differential voltage $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ based on $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**Crown-Type COB Storage Node & MIM/ONO High-k Dielectric Stack Solid Modeling**

## Context & Classification
- **Node / Architecture:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Folded Bitline, Capacitor-Over-Bitline / COB)
- **Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > 8F² 1T1C COB Cell 3D TCAD Solid Modeling & Material Stack Definition > Crown-Type COB Storage Node & MIM/ONO High-k Dielectric Stack Solid Modeling
- **Action Type:** Buy (Procurement/COTS TCAD Solid Modeling Specification)

---

## 1. Objective & Scope
Define the 3D solid boundary representation (B-Rep / constructive solid geometry) and material interfaces for an 8F² folded-bitline DRAM cell crown-type stacked capacitor over bitline (COB). This model serves as the geometrical input deck for 3D field-solver parasitic capacitance extraction (RC extraction) and leakage metrology.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Storage Node Contact (SNC) & Plug Solid Definition
1. Import the planar access transistor layout boundary: gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. Construct the tungsten plug (W-plug) vertical cylinder over the active area storage drain node, traversing the pre-metal dielectric (PMD) above the bitline level to establish the Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) interconnect.
3. Apply boundary interface constraints ensuring the W-plug bottom interfaces cleanly with the drain junction without mesh distortion.

### Step 2: Crown Storage Node Solid Geometry Construction
1. Define the sacrificial mold oxide cavity aligned over the W-plug landing pad within the 8F² cell pitch envelope (wordline/bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$).
2. Form the 3D crown (cylinder) bottom storage node using conformal shell modeling (polysilicon or bottom metal electrode) lining the inner and outer sidewalls of the cavity.
3. Remove sacrificial core volume to expose both inner and outer cylindrical surfaces of the crown structure to maximize effective capacitor surface area per unit footprint.

### Step 3: High-$\kappa$ / ONO Dielectric Stack Boundary Modeling
1. Apply a conformal coating representing the dielectric stack along all exposed inner and outer faces of the crown node:
   - **Stack Option A:** Oxide-Nitride-Oxide (ONO) triple dielectric.
   - **Stack Option B:** Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) stack with $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric.
2. Parameterize the layer to an Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) target of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ with an effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
3. Enforce continuous non-intersecting solid shells along sharp crown top edges and inner fillet corners.

### Step 4: Top Plate (Common Plate Node) Infill & Cell Port Assignment
1. Solid-fill the surrounding cavity and crown interior with the top plate electrode material shell (e.g., TiN/polysilicon plate node).
2. Assign electrical port identities:
   - **Port 1 (Storage Node):** Node contacting the access transistor drain via the W-plug.
   - **Port 2 (Plate Node):** Common capacitor plate tied to $V_{\text{plate}}$ (typically $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$).
3. Export 3D solid geometry into ACIS/STEP/TCAD format for electrostatic finite element analysis (FEA) / 3D field solving.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria (Machine-Measurable Metrics)

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (acceptable range $25 - 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver Electrostatic Extraction ($Q/V$) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 - 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Solid Model Layer Metric / TEM cross-section correlation |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15$ | Dimensionless | Dielectric Permittivity Assignment Check ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack) |
| **Cell Access Transistor Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $180 \times 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | 3D CAD Dimension Check / GDSII alignment |
| **Wordline / Bitline Array Pitch** | $360 - 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Array Pitch Dimension Measurement |

---

## 4. Context References & Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM structure erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack with $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum storage capacitance target: $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for noise immunity and soft-error suppression.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Cell retention target requiring $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ using $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
  - Wordline and bitline pitch range: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Validates nominal storage capacitance $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ against bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ to guarantee signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.

## 2. Step-by-Step CAD Solid Modeling Procedure

1. **Cell Base & Contact Boundary Initialization**:
   - Establish the 8F² unit cell boundary coordinate frame with access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$ on a bitline/wordline pitch grid of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Model the tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pad over the active drain contact region interfacing the underlying Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) substrate.

2. **Sacrificial Oxide Mold Formation & Cylinder Hole Patterning**:
   - Construct the sacrificial dielectric mold block (e.g., PECVD/TEOS $\text{SiO}_2$) above the inter-layer dielectric (ILD).
   - Execute a boolean cylindrical subtractive extrusion to define the crown storage node well positioned centrally over the W-plug landing pad, applying anisotropic etch wall taper angles appropriate for 180nm high-aspect-ratio holes.

3. **Storage Node Conformal Layer Deposition (Poly-Si / TiN)**:
   - Perform a conformal boundary offset sweep inside the cylinder hole cavity using doped Polysilicon or Titanium Nitride (TiN) electrode material.
   - Establish solid contact anchoring at the base cylinder plate directly meeting the top boundary of the underlying tungsten plug.

4. **Node Separation (CMP / Top Surface Trimming)**:
   - Apply a planar cutting plane operation matching the Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) node-separation boundary at the top of the sacrificial mold layer to isolate adjacent cell storage electrodes.

5. **Sacrificial Mold Wet Strip Emulation (Crown Surface Exposure)**:
   - Remove/unmask the sacrificial oxide mold domain using a selective boolean removal, exposing both the inner and outer sidewalls of the standalone hollow cylinder crown electrode to maximize effective capacitor surface area.

6. **Model Integrity & Parasitic Extraction Interface Export**:
   - Verify non-manifold geometry edges, eliminate zero-thickness mesh artifacts, and export the 3D solid boundary representation (STEP/SAT/TCAD mesh) to the 3D field solver pipeline for full cell capacitance matrix and leakage metrology.


---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Storage Node (Bottom Electrode) Interface Preparation**
   - Verify the structural integrity and aspect ratio of the crown-shaped polysilicon or metal bottom electrode erected over the tungsten contact plug (W-plug).
   - Perform surface cleaning and pre-treatment to clear native oxides prior to high-$\kappa$ dielectric film deposition.

2. **Conformal High-$\kappa$ / ONO Dielectric Stack Deposition**
   - Deposit either an Oxide-Nitride-Oxide (ONO) triple dielectric or a high-$\kappa$ dielectric film ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ stack).
   - Maintain 3D sidewall step coverage $> 95\%$ along inner and outer vertical walls of the crown storage node to achieve an Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ with effective permittivity $\kappa > 15$.

3. **Dielectric Annealing & Interface Passivation**
   - Subject the deposited high-$\kappa$ stack to post-deposition annealing (PDA) in an oxidizing ambient to repair oxygen vacancies and passivate bulk trap states.
   - Inspect film thickness uniformity across the 8F² array via spectroscopic ellipsometry and cross-sectional TEM/SEM metrology.

4. **Conformal Top Plate Counter-Electrode Formation**
   - Deposit the common top plate counter-electrode material (conformal TiN metal-gate liner and/or heavily doped polysilicon) filling the crown cavities and planarizing the storage node array.
   - Route top-plate biasing lines to the cell plate reference voltage ($V_{plate} = V_{DD}/2$).

5. **3D Field-Solver Parasitic Extraction & Electrical Quality Gate**
   - Export the parameterized solid geometry into the 3D TCAD field solver with cell pitch defined by wordline/bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Extract cell capacitance $C_s$, coupling to adjacent bitlines, sub-threshold leakage, and junction leakage. Confirm compliance against soft-error retention requirements.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                     180nm Cell Parameter Benchmarks

                │██████████████████████████████████████│
Delta V max (mV)┤██████████████████████████████████████│

Delta V min (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
  Noise Imm (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                              │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                              │
 C_cell max (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
 C_cell min (fF)┤███████                               │
                │███████                               │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     37.5      75.0     112.5  150.0 
```

1. **Storage Capacitance Target ($C_s$):**
   - **Target Range:** **$25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell** (Minimum threshold: **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$ per cell** for alpha-particle soft-error and bitline coupling noise immunity).
2. **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) & Permittivity:**
   - **Target Range:** **$3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$**, with effective dielectric constant **$\kappa > 15$** (utilizing $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO stack).
3. **Cell Leakage Current Budget at Elevated Temperature:**
   - **Target Limit:** **$\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$** combined sub-threshold and junction leakage measured at **$85^\circ\text{C}$**, ensuring retention interval **$> 64\text{ ms}$**.
4. **Readout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$):**
   - **Target Range:** **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** differential signal developed across folded bitline pair ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ at $V_{DD}/2$ precharge) upon wordline activation.

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source 1:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Verified parameters: Access transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM over tungsten plug (W-plug); ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack with $\kappa > 15$; capacitance minimum of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - Verified parameters: 1T1C stacked capacitor with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$; data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; EOT $= 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 3:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
  - Verified parameters: Charge sharing equation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; typical signal window $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Storage Node 3D Electrostatic Field Mesh & Cell Capacitance Metrology Benchmarking
- **Council Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Cell Parasitic Extraction, Retention Leakage & Soft-Error Metrology Simulation > Storage Node 3D Electrostatic Field Mesh & Cell Capacitance Metrology Benchmarking
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm node)
- **Action Type:** Buy (Procurement & Tool Qualification of Commercial/Turnkey 3D Field Solver & TCAD Extraction Suite)

---

## 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Solid Model Import & Material Stack Definition│
│  (Crown COB Node, W-Plug, ONO / Ta2O5 Stack)  │
└──────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Adaptive 3D Electrostatic Mesh Generation   │
│   (Refinement along High-k Dielectric & EOT)  │
└──────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     3D Poisson / Electrostatic Potential      │
│            Field Solver Execution             │
└──────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    Cell Capacitance & Parasitic Extraction    │
│    (Maxwell Matrix Cs, C_BL Coupling Matrix)  │
└──────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Benchmarking & Acceptance Metrology Check   │
│    (Cs >= 25-28 fF, Refresh & Retention Met)  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **CAD Solid Model Import & Material Assignment**
   - Import the 3D solid model geometry of the crown-shaped capacitor over bitline (COB) cell at $8F^2$ topology ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Assign dielectric properties to the storage capacitor insulator: either triple ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) or high-$\kappa$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) targeted between $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Define tungsten plug (W-plug) contact and crown bottom/top electrode conductor boundaries.

2. **Boundary Conditions & Adaptive 3D Field Meshing**
   - Establish periodic unit cell lateral boundaries along the folded bitline array axes.
   - Configure local adaptive Delaunay tetrahedral / polyhedral meshing across thin high-$\kappa$ interfaces with minimum sub-element sizing along the film normal $\le 0.5\text{ nm}$ across the physical dielectric thickness.
   - Refine edge and corner curvature boundaries along the crown cylinder rim to eliminate artificial field divergence.

3. **3D Electrostatic Field Poisson Solution**
   - Apply electrostatic potentials across the plate electrode ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$) and storage node electrode ($V_{\text{SN}} = 0\text{ V}$ to $V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Solve the 3D Poisson equation:
     $$\nabla \cdot (\varepsilon(x, y, z) \nabla \Phi) = -\rho$$
   - Perform grid-convergence iterations until maximum relative electrostatic energy delta between successive mesh refinements satisfies $\Delta U / U \le 0.1\%$.

4. **Capacitance Extraction & Circuit Metrology Benchmarking**
   - Integrate total electric displacement flux $\oint_S \mathbf{D} \cdot d\mathbf{A}$ and electrostatic energy $U_E = \frac{1}{2} \int \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{D} \, dV$ to extract the self-capacitance $C_s$ and parasitic coupling matrix.
   - Compute bitline coupling ratio and differential readout signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
     verifying signal headroom across typical array load conditions ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Correlate extracted $C_s$ against refresh rate and leakage limits at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Target Metric Benchmarks
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Storage Node Capacitance (Cs)          : 25.0 to 30.0 fF (min 28.0 fF)
Dielectric Stack Effective Kappa       : > 15.0
Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)       : 3.0 nm to 4.0 nm
Retention Operating Temperature Spec   : 85 °C (refresh interval > 64 ms)
Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage       : < 1.0 fA/cell
Bitline Coupling Signal Margin (Delta V): 100 mV to 150 mV (at C_BL = 250 fF)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Specification | Physical Unit | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 25\text{ fF}$** (Target: **$28\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$**) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field solver electrostatic energy integral |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa$)** | **$> 15$** | Dimensionless | Material stack parameter extraction |
| **Capacitor Dielectric EOT** | **$3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$** | $\text{nm}$ | High-$\kappa$ physical thickness vs. $\text{SiO}_2$ equivalent |
| **Differential Signal Headroom ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** (for $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) | $\text{mV}$ | Folded bitline charge-sharing differential simulation |
| **Cell Sub-threshold/Junction Leakage** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Coupled TCAD / electrostatic drift-diffusion benchmark |

---

## 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Verified crown stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ with $\kappa > 15$, minimum $28\text{ fF}$ capacitance budget for alpha-particle noise immunity, and $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ leakage target at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Verified 1T1C $8F^2 / 6F^2$ crown/cylinder capacitor retention specification ($25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), dielectric EOT between $3\text{ nm}$ and $4\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Verified bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, and differential signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

## 8F² Unit Cell 3D TCAD Mesh Generation & Material Optical/Electrical Boundary Metrology Validation

### 1. Process Flow Diagram
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     3D Solid Model     │
│         Import         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Domain Decomposition  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Adaptive Delaunay    │
│        Meshing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Material Stack &    │
│      Permittivity      │
│       Assignment       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Interface Metrology   │
│       & Boundary       │
│       Validation       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Geometry Import & Domain Decomposition**
   - Import the solid geometry model for the 180nm 8F² 1T1C stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) unit cell.
   - Establish bounding box coordinates corresponding to wordline (WL) pitch and bitline (BL) pitch spanning **360 nm to 400 nm**.
   - Partition domains into: access transistor active silicon area ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact, tungsten plug (W-plug), and upper crown/cylinder storage capacitor volume.

2. **Adaptive 3D TCAD Mesh Generation**
   - Apply Delaunay tetrahedral spatial discretization across the unit cell volume.
   - Set refined adaptive mesh criteria at critical gradient boundaries:
     - Gate oxide layer: Physical thickness = **3.5 nm physical thickness**, enforcing a minimum of 5 mesh layers in the normal direction.
     - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer: Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) = **3 to 4 nm**.
     - Metal/dielectric interfaces at the crown capacitor sidewalls and W-plug drain contact.
   - Ensure mesh Delaunay element quality metric (minimum dihedral angle $> 15^\circ$, aspect ratio $< 1:10$ outside ultra-thin 1D boundary layers).

3. **Material Optical & Electrical Permittivity Stack Assignment**
   - Assign dielectric properties to the capacitor insulator layer using high-$\kappa$ formulations (silicon nitride $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / ONO) targeting effective dielectric constant **$\kappa > 15$**.
   - Set access transistor gate oxide baseline using dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ grown at **850°C to 900°C** ($\kappa \approx 3.9$, $t_{\text{phys}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Define workfunctions and contact boundary conditions for the crown top/bottom electrode (polysilicon/MIM) and W-plug interconnect.

4. **Metrology & Boundary Electrostatic Verification**
   - Solve static Poisson equations across the meshed 3D domain under zero-bias and operating bias conditions ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$, $V_{\text{BL}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
   - Extract integrated storage node cell capacitance ($C_s$) to verify alignment with cell capacitance targets (**25 fF to 30 fF**, minimum **28 fF**).
   - Perform boundary metrology checks on sub-threshold leakage, gate leakage, and junction leakage profiles at nominal temperature **85°C**.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target & Tolerance | Measurement Method / Physical Basis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$** (Minimum threshold: **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$**) | 3D field solver surface charge integration $\oint \mathbf{D} \cdot d\mathbf{A} / \Delta V$ across crown capacitor boundary |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa$)** | **$\kappa > 15$** (EOT: **$3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$**) | Optical/electrical boundary model validation of $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / ONO capacitor stack |
| **Leakage Current Density ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at 85°C)** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | Steady-state Drift-Diffusion transport boundary flux integration across access transistor junctions & capacitor dielectric |
| **Gate Oxide Interface Physical Thickness** | **$3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$** (Thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$) | TCAD 1D/3D interface profile extraction normal to the channel surface |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); W-plug drain contact; crown/MIM stacked capacitor; effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 8F² 1T1C stacked capacitor cell layout; retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; storage capacitance target $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$; EOT $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ with $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$; bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Signal development criteria where cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline reference $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ develop differential voltage $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 3D Electrostatic & Magnetostatic Field Solver Parasitic RC Extraction (8F² 1T1C DRAM Cell)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Layout GDSII &     │
│   Process Techfile    │
│      Definition       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Boundary Conditions  │
│    & Meshing Setup    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   3D Electrostatic    │
│  Field Solver Run -   │
│      Poisson Eq       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   3D Magnetostatic    │
│  Field Solver Run -   │
│      Ampere Law       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Parasitic RC      │
│  Extraction & Lumped  │
│   Model Generation    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Metrology &      │
│      Acceptance       │
│     Verification      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry Import & Domain Discretization**:
   - Import the 8F² folded bitline unit-cell layout geometry (channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure (crown polysilicon or MIM stack connected to the drain diffusion via tungsten plug/W-plug).
   - Define conformal thin layers: gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$), capacitor dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ with high-$\kappa$ material stack ($\kappa > 15$, such as $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO).

2. **Boundary Conditions & Field Discretization**:
   - Establish periodic boundary conditions along the X and Y axes representing the multi-cell memory array matrix to capture neighbor-line cross-coupling.
   - Apply adaptive tetrahedral/hexahedral meshing refined around thin dielectrics ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical gate oxide and $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ EOT dielectric) and high field-gradient edges (crown corners and tungsten plug contact interfaces).

3. **3D Electrostatic Extraction (Poisson Solver)**:
   - Solve the 3D Poisson equation:
     $$\nabla \cdot (\varepsilon(x, y, z) \nabla \Phi) = -\rho$$
   - Excite individual conductors (storage node, bitline, adjacent folded bitlines, wordline/pass gates, substrate) at unit potentials to construct the Maxwell capacitance matrix $[C]$.
   - Extract storage node capacitance $C_s$, bitline self-capacitance $C_{BL}$, and cell-to-bitline/bitline-to-bitline coupling capacitances.

4. **3D Magnetostatic & Conductor Resistance Extraction**:
   - Solve current continuity and the magnetostatic vector potential equation:
     $$\nabla \times \left(\frac{1}{\mu} \nabla \times \mathbf{A}\right) = \mathbf{J}$$
   - Extract parasitic series resistances ($R$) across the tungsten contact plug (W-plug), access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), and polysilicon/metal wordline and bitline runs.

5. **Lumped SPICE Netlist Synthesis & Signal Validation**:
   - Back-annotate the extracted $R$ and $C$ parasitics into an equivalent subcircuit netlist.
   - Verify readout signal margin $\Delta V$ using:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate retention compliance and leakage budget ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                          Target Metrics Overview       
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░                                   │
Access W / L Ratio┤░                                   │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒              │
    Signal Delta V┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒              │
   Coupling BL Cap┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
      C_s Cell Cap┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                  0.0     62.5     125.0   187.5  250.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0\text{ to }30.0$ (Minimum target $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Integrated 3D Electrostatic Charge Integration |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Multi-conductor Maxwell Matrix Summation |
| **Differential Readout Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0\text{ to }150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded Bitline Transient Charge-Sharing Simulation |
| **Retention Leakage Limit ($I_{leak}$)** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Extraction |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited

1. **"180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench"**:
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM structure erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric stack with $\kappa > 15$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-042`
**Title:** Extracted Netlist Metrology, Back-Annotation & Bitline Coupling Signal-Margin Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Cell Parasitic Extraction, Retention Leakage & Soft-Error Metrology Simulation > $8F^2$ 1T1C Cell 3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (RC Extraction) > Extracted Netlist Metrology, Back-Annotation & Bitline Coupling Signal-Margin Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Parse Post-Extraction DSPF Netlist & Validate Layer │
│    - W/L = 220 nm / 180 nm Access FET & Parasitic R, C │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 2. Back-Annotate Inter-Bitline Coupling Capacitances   │
│    - Folded-bitline pair (BL / /BL) at 360-400 nm pitch│
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 3. Execute Transient SPICE Charge-Sharing Simulation   │
│    - Precharge to VDD/2, Wordline assertion @ 85°C     │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 4. Differential Sense Margin Metrology & Verification  │
│    - Confirm delta-V >= 100 mV & I_leak <= 1 fA/cell   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Netlist Ingestion & Geometry Audit:**
   - Import the 3D field-solver parasitic netlist (DSPF/SPEF format) for the $8F^2$ 1T1C cell array.
   - Verify layout parameters against technology targets: access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline metal pitch within $360\text{ nm} \le P \le 400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Parasitic Reduction & Back-Annotation Setup:**
   - Map parasitic distributed resistance-capacitance (RC) networks to active bitline nodes (`BL`, `/BL`) and adjacent aggressor lines across the folded-bitline topology.
   - Sum lump distributed capacitance to verify baseline bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}}$ target and ensure cell storage capacitance $C_s$ satisfies the design budget.

3. **Precharge & Dynamic Read-Margin Simulation:**
   - Configure transient SPICE simulation at elevated operating temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Initialize complementary bitlines `BL` and `/BL` equalized to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Assert the wordline to switch the access transistor ON, dumping storage node charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ onto `BL`.
   - Apply worst-case in-phase/out-of-phase switching transitions on adjacent bitlines at $360\text{ nm}$ pitch to induce maximum inter-line coupling noise.

4. **Signal Margin & Retention Extraction:**
   - Measure developed differential voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right|$ immediately prior to sense amplifier latch activation (`SAN`/`SAP`).
   - Extract off-state subthreshold and junction leakage current $I_{\text{leak}}$ from the storage node to substrate/bitline to verify retention margin compliance for target refresh intervals $> 64\text{ ms}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric Description | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ (Range: $25.0 - 30.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $250.0$ | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Pre-Sensing Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $125.0$ | $100.0 - 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Storage Node Total Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$ @ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

* **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error and bitline coupling noise immunity.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]:**
  - Folded-bitline precharge equalization level: $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
  - Nominal array parameters: Cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
* **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**
  - Storage capacitance limits: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Interconnect pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate oxide thickness: $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cell Retention Time & Junction Leakage SPICE/TCAD Simulation at 85°C

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-004`  
**Classification:** Technical / Metrology & Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm Node, 8F² Folded Bitline Architecture)  
**Target Cell Area:** $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$)  

---

### 1. Process & Simulation Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    TCAD/SPICE Setup    │
│    L=180nm W=220nm     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Environment Temp    │
│       T = 85°C         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Charge Storage Node   │
│   Cs = 25 fF - 30 fF   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Transient Hold State  │
│    WL = 0V, BL = VDD/2 │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Total Leakage Current  │
│      < 1 fA/cell       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Retention Time Verif.  │
│      t_ret > 64 ms     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **TCAD Structure & Grid Definition:**
   - Construct the 2D/3D access NMOS mesh with physical channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and device width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Define a thermally grown gate dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$) with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Instantiate the Crown/Cylinder stacked capacitor topology over the drain diffusion node via tungsten plug (W-plug) contact.
   - Configure high-$\kappa$ / multi-layer dielectric (ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack, $\kappa > 15$, Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$) scaled to target $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (acceptable range: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$).

2. **Thermal & Physical Transport Models Setup:**
   - Set lattice/ambient simulation temperature to $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ ($358.15\text{ K}$).
   - Enable Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination, Hurkx band-to-band tunneling (BTBT), and trap-assisted tunneling (TAT) at the drain/storage-node p-n junction.
   - Enable temperature-dependent mobility degradation and high-field saturation models.

3. **Bitline Network & SPICE Deck Coupling:**
   - Couple the storage node capacitor ($C_s = 28\text{ fF}$) to the bitline model.
   - Set bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ within $150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ (corresponding to a 256 or 512 cells/BL block), verifying that the capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ remains bounded between $5:1$ and $9:1$.

4. **Bias Initialization & Write "1" Phase:**
   - Precharge Bitline ($\text{BL}$) to $V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Pulse Wordline ($\text{WL}$) to activate the access gate and charge the storage node capacitor node to $V_{SN} = V_{DD}$.
   - De-assert Wordline back to standby hold state ($V_{WL} = 0\text{ V}$) with a steep fall time ($t_f \le 1\text{ ns}$).

5. **Transient Hold & Leakage Current Integration:**
   - Execute transient simulation over a time span of $t_{sim} \ge 100\text{ ms}$ at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Monitor and isolate junction leakage components at the storage node:
     $$I_{\text{leak, total}} = I_{\text{sub-threshold}} + I_{\text{junction, rev}} + I_{\text{dielectric}} + I_{\text{BTBT}}$$
   - Continuously record node voltage decay $V_{SN}(t)$.

6. **Retention Time Evaluation:**
   - Calculate elapsed hold time $t_{\text{ret}}$ until node voltage drops to the sensing threshold margin required by the folded bitline sense amplifier:
     $$t_{\text{ret}} = \frac{C_s \cdot \Delta V_{SN}}{I_{\text{leak, total}}}$$
   - Confirm $t_{\text{ret}}$ meets the minimum specification prior to triggering refresh.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Unit | Target / Acceptance Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Retention Time ($t_{\text{ret}}$)** | $\text{ms}$ | **$\ge 64\text{ ms}$** at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Transient node voltage decay to minimum sense margin |
| **Total Cell Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | **$< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$** at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Integral junction + subthreshold current at $V_{WL}=0\text{ V}, V_{SN}=V_{DD}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\text{fF/cell}$ | **$25.0\text{ fF} - 30.0\text{ fF}$** (Nominal: $28.0\text{ fF}$) | High-frequency CV extraction / small-signal AC integration |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | ratio | **$5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$** (Strictly $< 10.0 : 1$) | Extracted array bitline capacitance ($150 - 250\text{ fF}$) over $C_s$ |

---

### 4. Context & Source Citations
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Access gate thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor EOT ($3 - 4\text{ nm}$), storage capacitance target ($25 - 30\text{ fF}$), and baseline cell retention specification ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor footprint ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), W-plug/Crown MIM/ONO topology ($\kappa > 15$, nominal $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$), and maximum leakage target ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:** Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), bitline loading capacitance ($C_b = 150 - 250\text{ fF}$ for 256/512 cell blocks), and $C_b / C_s$ ratio constraint ($5:1$ to $9:1$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Elevated Temperature (85°C) Subthreshold & Junction Leakage Transient SPICE Simulation

**Document ID:** `SOP-180NM-MET-042`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design / Metrology  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Cell Topology:** 1T1C Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB), $8F^2$  

---

### 1. Executive Summary & Objective
This procedure establishes the SPICE-level transient extraction and validation workflow for a single 1T1C DRAM unit cell operating under elevated junction temperatures ($T = 85^\circ\text{C}$). The objective is to evaluate subthreshold conduction, drain/source reverse-bias p-n junction leakage, and gate dielectric degradation over a full retention cycle ($t_{\text{ret}} \ge 64\text{ ms}$) to verify that storage node charge retention complies with the refresh interval requirement.

```
       WL = V_PP / V_SS (0V / -0.5V)
               │
               ▼
BL ───────┤ Access Transistor ├─── SN (Storage Node)
(V_DD/2)  (W=220nm, L=180nm)      │
                                  ├── C_s (28 fF Stacked Capacitor)
                                  │   └── V_PL (V_DD/2 Plate)
                                  ├── I_sub (Subthreshold Leakage to BL)
                                  └── I_junc (Junction Leakage to P-well)
```

---

### 2. Physical & Device Parameters

All parameters are configured in accordance with verified 180nm cell architecture:
- **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Gate Dielectric:** Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with physical oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($EOT \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
- **Storage Capacitor ($C_s$):** Stacked crown/cylinder capacitor, $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (nominal budget $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$).
- **Operating Junction Temperature:** $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ (358.15 K).
- **Bitline & Precharge Reference:** Folded bitline precharged to $V_{\text{pre}} = V_{DD} / 2$; cell plate biased at $V_{PL} = V_{DD} / 2$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Netlist Deck Configuration & Model Setup
1. Define the simulation environment in SPICE:
   ```spice
   .TEMP 85.0
   .OPTIONS ACCURATE=1 CONV=1 RELTOL=1e-5 ABSTOL=1e-15 CHGTOL=1e-16 GMIN=1e-18
   ```
2. Instantiate the access NMOS transistor model with calibrated temperature coefficients for reverse diode saturation current ($I_S$), temperature exponent ($XTI$), barrier height, and bandgap narrowing.
3. Configure the access transistor geometry: `W=220n L=180n`. Connect the body terminal to the cell substrate/P-well bias line ($V_{BB} \approx -0.5\text{V}$ to $0\text{V}$).

#### Step 2: Storage Capacitor & Parasitic Boundary Initialization
1. Instantiate the cell storage capacitor between the internal storage node `SN` and the cell plate `VPL` ($V_{DD}/2$):
   ```spice
   CS_CELL SN VPL 28fF
   ```
2. Include the tungsten contact plug (W-plug) parasitic resistance ($R_{plug}$) and the bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).

#### Step 3: Write "High" Transient Preconditioning
1. Set the initial bitline voltage to $V_{DD}$ ($1.8\text{ V}$).
2. Assert the Wordline (WL) by driving the gate from $0\text{ V}$ to the boosted gate voltage $V_{PP}$ ($> V_{DD} + V_{th}$) for $\Delta t = 10\text{ ns}$ to fully charge the storage node `SN` to $V_{DD}$.
3. De-assert the Wordline to turn off the access transistor ($V_{WL} = 0\text{ V}$ or negative back-bias).
4. Equalize the Bitline (BL) to $V_{DD} / 2$ to emulate the standard DRAM precharge state during retention holding.

#### Step 4: Long Transient Retention Holding Simulation
1. Execute a long-duration transient analysis over the retention interval:
   ```spice
   .TRAN 100us 64ms 0s 10us
   ```
2. Probe and decompose the current branches leaving node `SN`:
   - Subthreshold conduction into the bitline ($I_{\text{sub}} = I_{DS}$).
   - Reverse p-n junction leakage into the P-well/substrate ($I_{\text{junc}} = I_{D\text{-}body}$).
   - Dielectric leakage through the stacked capacitor dielectric ($I_{\text{diel}}$).

#### Step 5: Post-Processing & Read Margin Evaluation
1. Measure total instantaneous leakage: $I_{\text{leak\_total}}(t) = I_{\text{sub}}(t) + I_{\text{junc}}(t) + I_{\text{diel}}(t)$ across the holding window.
2. Calculate the stored node voltage drop $\Delta V_{SN}$ at $t = 64\text{ ms}$:
   $$\Delta V_{SN} = \frac{1}{C_s} \int_{0}^{64\text{ ms}} I_{\text{leak\_total}}(t) \, dt$$
3. Trigger a read cycle at $t = 64\text{ ms}$ by re-asserting the Wordline, and verify that the differential signal developed on the complementary bitlines satisfies:
   $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{SN}(64\text{ ms}) - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \ge 100\text{ mV}$$

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Evaluation Method | Target Spec | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Operating Temperature** | SPICE Environment Option (`.TEMP`) | $85$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current** | Transient probe at $V_{SN} = V_{DD}$, $V_{BL} = V_{DD}/2$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Node extraction parameter | $\ge 28.0$ (min. 25.0 to 30.0) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Minimum Retention Time** | Duration with valid state retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\ge 64$ | $\text{ms}$ |
| **Differential Readout Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | Developed signal at sense amplifier input ($C_{BL}=250\text{ fF}$) | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 5. Literature Sources & Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
   - *Cited parameters:* Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$; maximum subthreshold and junction leakage target of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked capacitor with W-plug over bitline.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**  
   - *Cited parameters:* 1T1C $8F^2$ architecture; cell capacitance range ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$); retention requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; gate oxide physical thickness $\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**  
   - *Cited parameters:* Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$; signal development differential voltage $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Cell Retention Time & 64ms Refresh Window Metrology Verification and Leakage Budget Validation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Metrology  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Verification  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                               EXECUTION FLOWCHART                               |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1: Environmental & Test Bench Conditioning (85°C Chuck / Chamber)]       |
|                                       │                                         |
|                                       ▼                                         |
|  [Step 2: 1T1C Storage Node Bias & Data State Initialization (Data '1' / '0')]  |
|                                       │                                         |
|                                       ▼                                         |
|  [Step 3: Leakage Current Metrology (Sub-threshold & Junction DC Measurement)]   |
|                                       │                                         |
|                                       ▼                                         |
|  [Step 4: 64 ms Pause Time & Differential Readout Sensing Margin Verification]  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Environmental & Test Bench Conditioning
1. Mount the 180nm test vehicle wafer or macro test structure onto the automated parametric prober/thermal chuck.
2. Elevate and stabilize the chuck/ambient chamber temperature to **85°C ± 0.5°C**.
3. Verify thermal equilibrium across the wafer before initiating electrical bias sweeps.

#### Step 2: Storage Node Bias & Precharge Setup
1. Initialize the folded bitline pair ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) to the precharge level of $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ via the bitline equalization network.
2. Assert the target wordline ($\text{WL}$) to turn on the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
3. Fully write a logic high state ("1") into the storage cell capacitor ($C_s$) to establish the initial charge $Q_s = C_s \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$, then de-assert the wordline to cut off the access transistor.

#### Step 3: Leakage Current Metrology
1. Perform high-precision parametric DC metrology at the storage node / bitline access terminal at 85°C.
2. Measure the cumulative leakage current, accounting for access transistor sub-threshold leakage, p-n junction leakage at the drain/storage contact tungsten plug ($\text{W-plug}$), and dielectric leakage through the high-$\kappa$ capacitor stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$).
3. Ensure measured leakage meets the sub-$1\text{ fA/cell}$ target budget to guarantee charge retention.

#### Step 4: 64 ms Pause-Time Verification & Sensing Readout
1. Keep the cell unaccessed during a standardized retention hold window of **$t_{\text{retention}} \ge 64\text{ ms}$** at 85°C.
2. Following the 64 ms window, precharge $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$, then re-assert the wordline to discharge residual charge onto the bitline ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
3. Monitor differential voltage development:
   $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
4. Trigger the sense amplifier latch signals ($\text{SAN}$ and $\text{SAP}$) and verify error-free latching without bit flips.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage/Chuck Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | Automated thermal chuck thermocouple probe |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (min. $\ge 28.0$ for noise immunity) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | $C\text{-}V$ parameter analyzer at $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Total Retention Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-femtoampere parametric electrometer at $85^{\circ}\text{C}$ |
| **Readout Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | High-speed sampling oscilloscope / Sense amplifier latch monitor |
| **Retention Window Pause Time** | $\ge 64.0$ | $\text{ms}$ | Automated digital pattern timing generator |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Capacitance & Dielectric Metrics:**
  - *"The storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF (femtofarads) per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C."* — *[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]*

- **Differential Readout Dynamics & Bitline Ratios:**
  - *"Precharge Operation: Prior to wordline assertion, bitlines are equalized to V_DD / 2... For typical cell capacitance C_s = 25 fF and bitline capacitance C_BL = 250 fF, signal delta V is approximately 100 mV to 150 mV."* — *[Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-SER-180NM`
**Title:** Alpha-Particle & Cosmic Neutron Single-Event Soft-Error Rate (SER) Metrology Modeling  
**Module:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Cell Parasitic Extraction, Retention Leakage & Soft-Error Metrology Simulation > Alpha-Particle & Cosmic Neutron Single-Event Soft-Error Rate (SER) Metrology Modeling  
**Action Type:** Buy / In-House Metrology Protocol Qualification  

---

### 1. Metrology Modeling Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Unit Cell Geometry   │
│          Mesh          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Critical Charge     │
│   Q_crit Extraction    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Alpha and Neutron    │
│   Monte Carlo Track    │
│       Deposition       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Transient Simulation  │
│        and SER         │
│     Quantification     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Mesh & Parasitic Boundary Construction:**
   - Instantiate the 180nm unit cell with Folded Bitline layout footprint of $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (feature size $F = 180\ \text{nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\ \text{nm}$ to $400\ \text{nm}$).
   - Set access NMOS transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, gate oxide physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\ \text{nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Place stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with crown/cylinder topology using W-plug drain contact and high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, such as ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\text{EOT} = 3.0\ \text{nm} - 4.0\ \text{nm}$).
   - Fix target storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$ (permissible cell budget: $25\ \text{fF} - 30\ \text{fF}$) and bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\ \text{fF} - 250\ \text{fF}$ across a 256/512-cell array block. Verify ratio $C_b / C_s$ is within $5:1$ to $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).

2. **Critical Charge ($Q_{crit}$) Derivation:**
   - Calculate storage node nominal signal charge:
     $$Q_{stored} = C_s \times V_{cell}$$
   - Extract critical flip charge $Q_{crit}$ required to collapse bitline sensing margin below sensing threshold under $85^\circ\text{C}$ operation:
     $$Q_{crit} = C_s \times \Delta V_{margin}$$
     *(For $C_s = 28\ \text{fF}$ and dynamic read delta, nominal $Q_{crit} \approx 25.2\ \text{fC}$)*.

3. **Single-Event Energy Deposition & Monte Carlo Track Injection:**
   - **Alpha-Particle Modeling:** Inject $\alpha$-particle tracks ($2.0\ \text{MeV} - 8.8\ \text{MeV}$ energy spectrum from packaging mold compound / trace uranium/thorium decay) traversing the silicon substrate and access transistor junction. Set track radius to $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ with Bragg peak ionization profiles.
   - **Cosmic Neutron Modeling:** Simulate atmospheric neutron strikes ($1\ \text{MeV} - 1\ \text{GeV}$) triggering recoil nuclear fragments ($^{28}\text{Si}(n, \alpha)$, $^{28}\text{Si}(n, p)$) directly into the storage node diffusion region.
   - Track transient carrier generation pairs:
     $$G(r, t) = \frac{\text{LET}(x)}{E_{eh}} \cdot f(r) \cdot g(t)$$
     where electron-hole pair creation energy $E_{eh} = 3.6\ \text{eV}$ in silicon.

4. **Transient Device Transport & Charge Collection:**
   - Perform 3D mixed-mode TCAD/SPICE transient simulation of electron funneling and drift-diffusion charge collection at the storage node and bitline contact plug over $t = 0\ \text{ps}$ to $5\ \text{ns}$.
   - Sum collected charge $Q_{coll} = \int I(t)\, dt$. Flag a Single-Event Upset (SEU) event whenever $Q_{coll} \ge Q_{crit}$.
   - Integrate baseline junction + sub-threshold leakage current boundary ($I_{leak} \le 1.0\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) to guarantee worst-case SER margin prior to standard $64\ \text{ms}$ refresh cycles.

5. **Soft-Error Rate (SER) Quantification:**
   - Compute total FIT rate ($\text{FIT} = 1\ \text{failure} / 10^9\ \text{device-hours}$):
     $$\text{SER}_{total} = \text{SER}_{\alpha} + \text{SER}_{neutron}$$
   - Report soft-error cross-section ($\sigma_{SEU}$) across cell array blocks.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

```text
                     DRAM SER Cell Integrity Parameters 
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Target Retention (ms)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
      C_s Budget (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                  │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                  │
          Q_crit (fC)┤██████████████                   │
                     │██████████████                   │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      16      32      48      64 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Window | Engineering Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $7.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \le C_b/C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ ($< 10:1$) | Dimensionless |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$ @ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | Max $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Critical Charge Margin ($Q_{crit}$)** | $25.2$ | $\ge 22.0$ | $\text{fC}$ |
| **Data Retention Interval ($T_{ret}$ @ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $\ge 64.0$ | $\ge 64.0$ | $\text{ms}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ cell footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
  - Storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF} - 30\ \text{fF}$ (nominal $28\ \text{fF}$).
  - Array bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\ \text{fF} - 250\ \text{fF}$ (256/512 cells/BL) with ratio $C_b / C_s$ kept between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Unit cell dimensions: $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, shared bitline contact.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM topology with W-plug drain contact.
  - Dielectric: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $\le 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Data retention baseline requirement $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $= 3.0\ \text{nm} - 4.0\ \text{nm}$ using $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\ \text{nm} - 400\ \text{nm}$; gate dielectric physical thickness $= 3.5\ \text{nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ ($850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$).
