# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-042: Testbench Setup & Worst-Case Bitline/Cell Parasitic Load Modeling

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│      Testbench      │
│   Initialization    │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Bitline Parasitic  │
│       Loading       │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  1T1C Memory Cell   │
│     Attachment      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Precharge and WL   │
│       Pulsing       │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Transient Margin   │
│     Extraction      │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the setup, netlisting, and transient verification of folded-bitline SPICE testbenches under worst-case parasitic loading for the 180nm open-source DRAM architecture (DRAM Foundation VN). It guarantees accurate simulation of charge sharing, equalization recovery, and differential sensing margins before physical layout tape-out.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Testbench Architecture Initialization**:
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitlines (`BL` and `/BL`) alongside the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch and $V_{DD}/2$ equalization transistor network.
   - Configure thermal simulation environment at nominal elevated temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate worst-case leakage conditions.

2. **Worst-Case Bitline Parasitic Network Insertion**:
   - Model the full-column parasitic capacitance along both `BL` and `/BL` by connecting lumped/distributed capacitive elements sized to total bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Include adjacent wire-to-wire coupling and contact parasitics corresponding to the $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch.

3. **1T1C Memory Cell Parametric Instantiation**:
   - Instantiate the unit cell access transistor at channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with gate oxide physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the storage node to the stacked capacitor model configured with storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal evaluation) and $28\text{ fF}$ (minimum noise-immunity corner).
   - Set cell leakage current limiters ensuring junction and sub-threshold leakage remain $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

4. **Precharge & Timing Sequence Execution**:
   - Assert the equalization signal to precharge and equilibrate both `BL` and `/BL` exactly to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - De-assert equalization, introduce settling dead-time, and apply Wordline (WL) pulse to activate the access transistor, transferring stored charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto `BL`.

5. **Transient Differential Margin Extraction**:
   - Measure the developed differential bitline voltage $\Delta V$ immediately prior to sense amplifier activation:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Activate latching strobes (`SAN` pull-down and `SAP` pull-up) and verify full rail-to-rail differential signal restoration without latch failure or meta-stability.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition / Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | `250` | $\text{fF}$ | Total column parasitic load per bitline branch |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `25 to 28` | $\text{fF}$ | Minimum budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | `100 to 150` | $\text{mV}$ | Signal development after charge-sharing on $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum junction/sub-threshold leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ retention) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Governs the folded-bitline topology, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge scheme, charge transfer equation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal margin $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Dictates access transistor sizing ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction/sub-threshold leakage limit $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ storage requirement for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

**Context & Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch & $V_{DD}/2$ Equalizer Schematic Sizing > Differential Sensing Margin & Equalization Recovery SPICE Transient Verification

### 1. Architectural & Transient Verification Workflow

```text
│     & Equalization     │
│        Recovery        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Schematic & Parasitic Netlist Setup:**
   - Instantiate the 1T1C cell with access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the access transistor drain to the storage node capacitor $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (or minimum capacitance budget $28\text{ fF}$) implemented as a stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - Configure complementary folded bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ with distributed lumped parasitic load $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Enforce layout pitch matching constraint to the memory array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ with interleaved sense amplifier placement.

2. **Precharge & DC Initialization Phase:**
   - Enable the equalization transistor network to precharge and equilibrate both bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$) to exactly $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Initialize cell storage voltage: condition $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$ (Data '1') and $V_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$ (Data '0'). Set initial simulation temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ to capture sub-threshold leakage effects.

3. **Wordline Assertion & Signal Development ($\Delta V$):**
   - De-assert the equalization signal to isolate $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$.
   - Assert the wordline ($\text{WL}$) pulse driving the access transistor ON, discharging/charging cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline.
   - Run transient analysis (`.tran`) and measure open-loop differential signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$

4. **Sense Amplifier Strobe & Full-Rail Latching:**
   - Trigger the sense amplifier control clocks: pull the N-sense latch strobe ($\text{SAN}$) to $\text{GND}$ and the P-sense latch strobe ($\text{SAP}$) to $V_{DD}$.
   - Verify differential latching speed and signal resolution driving bitlines to full rail CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$).
   - Measure 100% cell charge restoration before closing the access transistor.

5. **Wordline Deassertion & Equalization Recovery:**
   - De-assert wordline ($\text{WL}$) back to $0\text{ V}$.
   - Re-activate the equalization transistor network across $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$.
   - Measure equalization recovery time $t_{\text{EQR}}$ for $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ to converge back to $V_{DD}/2$ within steady-state error tolerance.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| **Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | SPICE `.MEAS` differential peak voltage $(\vert V_{BL} - V_{/BL}\vert)$ at end of charge sharing |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget** | **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$** (nominal $25\text{ fF}$) | Soft error immunity / noise budget verification |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** | Sub-threshold & junction leakage under $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **$360\text{ nm}$** | Interleaved layout DRC spacing matching memory array bitlines |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations
- **Source 1: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout***
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; charge sharing model $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ with $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$; nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$; latching via $\text{SAN} \to \text{GND}$ and $\text{SAP} \to V_{DD}$ to full rail ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$); pitch matching constraint of $360\text{ nm}$.

## Title: PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Mismatch Sensing Margin Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-MET-004`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & Metrology / Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│      Step 1: Setup 180nm Parasitics          │
│        (Cs = 25-28 fF, CBL = 250 fF)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 2: Bitline Precharge/Equalization   │
│                 (V_BL = VDD/2)               │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 3: WL Assertion & Signal Readout    │
│            (Access L=180nm, W=220nm)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 4: Differential Sense & Latch       │
│           (Activate SAN/SAP Clocks)          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Step 5: PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Sweep    │
│     (-40°C to 85°C, Vth/W/L Mismatch Runs)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Initialization**:
   - Construct the folded-bitline SPICE testbench with complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Instantiate the 1T1C stacked storage capacitor with nominal capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ and total bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Size the unit access transistor using nominal 180nm parameters: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}\text{ SiO}_2$.

2. **Precharge & Equalization Stabilization**:
   - Apply bitline equalization clock signal ($EQ$) to bias both complementary bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Verify differential bitline offset before wordline firing is settled to zero ($|V_{BL} - V_{/BL}| \approx 0\text{ mV}$).

3. **Wordline Assertion & Differential Signal Development**:
   - De-assert equalization ($EQ \to \text{GND}$) and assert the wordline ($WL$).
   - Execute cell charge transfer onto $BL$ based on $Q_s = C_s \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$.
   - Measure developed signal $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \times |V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2|$ immediately prior to sense amplifier latch activation.

4. **Latch Activation & Transient Latching**:
   - Assert sense amplifier strobe signals: trigger pull-down sense strobe $SAN$ toward GND and pull-up sense strobe $SAP$ toward $V_{DD}$.
   - Record differential resolution time and verify full rail-to-rail latching without state inversion.

5. **PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Statistical Sweep**:
   - Execute transient simulations across process corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) and operational temperatures spanning $-40^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Perform a 1,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch sweep incorporating $V_{th}$, channel length ($L$), and channel width ($W$) variations on the cross-coupled sense amplifier transistor pairs.
   - Extract the $3\sigma$ worst-case differential sensing margin $\Delta V$.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Measurement Condition | Specification Target | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Stacked crown/cylinder capacitor metrology | $25.0 \le C_s \le 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | Extracted folded-bitline wire & drain parasitics | $250.0 \pm 10\%$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | Nominal charge share prior to latching ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$) | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target** | Storage node junction & subthreshold leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Data Retention Time Target** | Array cell retention window at $85^\circ\text{C}$ junction temp | $> 64.0$ | $\text{ms}$ |

---

### 4. Process Corner Margin Evaluation

```text
                Differential Sensing Margin Delta V (mV)
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
 MC 3-Sigma Worst┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│

   Slow (SS, 85C)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
Nominal (TT, 25C)┤██████████████████████████████████   │
                 │██████████████████████████████████   │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0     37.5     75.0     112.5  150.0 
```

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Reference Context

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, and signal development equation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
  - Baseline nominal parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, resulting in $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

  - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Cell leakage constraint: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

```text
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Signal Development   │
│   Delta V=100-150mV    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     SAN Activation     │
│    Pulldown to GND     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAP Activation Delay  │
│     1-2ns to V_DD      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Full Rail        │
│  Restoration & Latch   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Array & Parasitic Parameter Setup**:
   - Configure the 1T1C storage node cell capacitor with nominal capacitance $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (valid window: $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$) mapped onto an $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($\text{Area} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ (or $C_{BL}$) in the range of $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for a 256/512 cells-per-bitline sub-array block, enforcing a capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (never exceeding $10:1$).

2. **Phase 1 – Precharge & Equalization Phase (`EQ` High)**:
   - Assert equalization control signal `EQ` to activate the equalization NMOS transistor network.
   - Short complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ together and bias them to the precision precharge voltage reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Initialize sense amplifier common source nodes $SAN$ and $SAP$ to $V_{DD} / 2$.

3. **Phase 2 – Wordline Overdrive & Signal Development (`WL` Assertion)**:
   - De-assert `EQ` to high-impedance isolate $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Assert wordline ($WL$) from $0\text{ V}$ to boosted overdrive voltage $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$) to overcome threshold voltage loss ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$) across the NMOS access transistor.
   - Allow charge sharing between cell storage node $C_s$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$, generating differential read signal:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     Verify that developed nominal differential signal $\Delta V$ reaches $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **Phase 3 – Staged Regenerative Sensing & Latching (`SAN` then `SAP`)**:
   - **N-Sense Activation**: Pull the common source node $SAN$ rapidly from $V_{DD} / 2$ to $\text{GND}$ via the NMOS pulldown switch. The NMOS transistor whose gate is connected to the higher bitline conducts harder, discharging the lower bitline toward $0\text{ V}$.
   - **P-Sense Activation**: After an intentional delay of $1\text{ ns}$ to $2\text{ ns}$ post-$SAN$ turn-on, assert the PMOS pullup switch to pull $SAP$ from $V_{DD} / 2$ to $V_{DD}$, amplifying the higher bitline toward full-rail $V_{DD}$.
   - Confirm active full-rail latching and non-destructive charge restoration into the storage cell.

5. **Phase 4 – Monte Carlo Statistical Mismatch Simulation**:
   - Execute transient Monte Carlo runs (Gaussian statistical transistor mismatch, $\Delta V_{th}$, and geometric variation across the cross-coupled inverter pairs).
   - Sweep corner temperatures and process spreads while logging differential sensing margin $\Delta V$, sensing delay, and latch yield under worst-case '0' and '1' readout states.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Description | Target Value / Boundary | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Differential Bitline Read Signal ($\Delta V$) | $100$ to $150$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **AC-02** | Capacitance Ratio Budget ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 \le \text{Ratio} \le 9.0 : 1$ ($< 10.0 : 1$ max) | Dimensionless ratio |
| **AC-03** | Boosted Wordline Voltage ($V_{PP}$) | $2.6$ to $2.8$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **AC-04** | Staged Sensing Activation Delay ($t_{SAN \to SAP}$) | $1.0$ to $2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |

---

### Verified Local Literature Sources

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - CMOS cross-coupled latch and equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$, ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (hard degradation ceiling at $10:1$).
3. **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
   - Wordline overdrive voltage $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$.
   - Precharge reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Staged latching: $SAN$ pulled to $\text{GND}$ followed by $SAP$ pulled to $V_{DD}$ with a $1\text{ ns} - 2\text{ ns}$ delay.

# SOP: 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup

**Task Level:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Equalization Phase:  │
│  EQ High, VBLP=0.9V   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      WL Boosted       │
│      Assertion:       │
│     VPP=2.6V-2.8V     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Charge Sharing:    │
│  Delta V Develops on  │
│          BL           │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  N-Sense Activation:  │
│   SAN pulls to GND    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  P-Sense Activation:  │
│   SAP pulls to VDD    │
│         1.8V          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full Rail       │
│  Restoration & Latch  │
│       Complete        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Topology & SPICE Netlist Construction**:
   - Instantiate a folded-bitline pair (`BL` and `/BL`) representing an array block column of 256 to 512 cells per bitline.
   - Configure the 1T1C cell footprint under the $8F^2$ architecture (area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the storage node capacitor to $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (within the target specification window of $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$).
   - Connect the CMOS sense amplifier comprising cross-coupled NMOS pull-down transistors (N-sense) and cross-coupled PMOS pull-up transistors (P-sense) connected across `BL` and `/BL`.
   - Implement the equalization transistor network across `BL` and `/BL` driven by control signal `EQ` and referenced to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$).

2. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Lumped Array Modeling**:
   - Extract distributed bitline wire parasitics across the 256/512-cell column metal tracks and access junction diffusions.
   - Constrain total lumped bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$ (or $C_b$) within $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$.
   - Ensure the bitline-to-cell capacitance budget ratio satisfies $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ (strictly $< 10:1$ to avert signal margin degradation).

3. **Bias Supplies & Control Stimulus Setup**:
   - Set bitline precharge reference $V_{BLP} = 0.9\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Configure wordline overdrive pulse `WL` switching from $0\text{ V}$ up to boosted voltage $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$ (exceeding $V_{DD} + V_{th}$) to prevent threshold drop during cell charge transfer.
   - Pre-charge SAN and SAP latch common source nodes to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ during equalization.

4. **Transient Sensing Timing Sequencer**:
   - **Phase 1 (Equalization)**: Assert `EQ` high to short `BL` and `/BL` to $0.9\text{ V}$; de-assert `EQ` to $0\text{ V}$.
   - **Phase 2 (Wordline Pulse & Charge Sharing)**: Assert `WL` to $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$). Evaluate differential voltage development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - **Phase 3 (N-Sense Latching)**: Assert pull-down switch on common source node `SAN` to rapidly discharge to $\text{GND}$ ($0\text{ V}$), amplifying the bitline with the lower potential toward $0\text{ V}$.
   - **Phase 4 (P-Sense Latching)**: Following a timing delay of $1\text{ ns}$ to $2\text{ ns}$ after `SAN` activation, drive common source node `SAP` to $V_{DD}$ ($1.8\text{ V}$) via the PMOS pull-up switch to restore the companion bitline to full rail $V_{DD}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Nominal Target / Range | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-02** | Total Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$ / $C_b$) | $150.0 \text{ to } 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-03** | Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (Max: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Ratio |
| **AC-04** | Read Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$) | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **AC-05** | Wordline Boosted Amplitude ($V_{PP}$) | $2.6 \text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **AC-06** | N-to-P Sense Activation Stagger Delay ($t_{SAN \to SAP}$) | $1.0 \text{ to } 2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines in folded-bitline topology; equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; charge sharing equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; nominal parameters $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $180\text{ nm}$); storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$); bitline parasitic budget $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ for 256/512 cells per bitline; capacitance ratio constraint $5:1 \le C_b/C_s \le 9:1$ (degradation threshold $> 10:1$).
- **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**: Equalization phase to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$; wordline assertion to boosted level $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$ overdrive); SAN activation pulling to $\text{GND}$; staggered SAP pull-up to $V_{DD}$ with a $1\text{ ns} - 2\text{ ns}$ delay.

**Title:** 1T1C Bitline and Folded Sense Amp Schematic Netlisting with $V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Equalizer  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Discipline:** DRAM Circuit Design / 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup

---

## 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      1. Parameter      │
│     Definition and     │
│     Topology Setup     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      2. Equalizer      │
│       Subcircuit       │
│    Netlisting VDD/2    │
│       Precharge        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Folded CMOS Sense  │
│     Amp Subcircuit     │
│       Netlisting       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. 1T1C Memory Cell   │
│   and Complementary    │
│  Bitline Integration   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      5. Transient      │
│  Simulation and Latch  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Parameter Definition & Global Node Configuration
1. Define supply rails and common bias nodes: $V_{DD}$, $GND$, and $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$ (precharge reference voltage).
2. Instantiate access transistor dimension parameters: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
3. Define lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ on both complementary lines (`BL` and `/BL`).
4. Set minimum storage cell capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (nominal baseline $25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).

### Step 2: Netlist the $V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Equalizer Subcircuit
1. Create subcircuit `.subckt EQUALIZER BL BL_B EQ VBLP`:
   - Instantiate NMOS equalization transistor across the bitline pair between `BL` and `/BL` gated by `EQ`.
   - Instantiate two NMOS pull-up transistors connecting `BL` to `VBLP` and `/BL` to `VBLP`, both gated by control line `EQ`.
2. Configure layout pitch constraint targeting memory array pitch matching ($360\text{ nm}$ per bitline pair pitch).

### Step 3: Netlist the Folded CMOS Cross-Coupled Sense Amplifier Latch
1. Create subcircuit `.subckt SENSE_AMP BL BL_B SAP SAN`:
   - **N-Latch (SAN pull-down):** Two cross-coupled NMOS transistors where NMOS1 drain is tied to `BL` and gate to `/BL`, and NMOS2 drain is tied to `/BL` and gate to `BL`. Common source is tied to control line `SAN`.
   - **P-Latch (SAP pull-up):** Two cross-coupled PMOS transistors where PMOS1 drain is tied to `BL` and gate to `/BL`, and PMOS2 drain is tied to `/BL` and gate to `BL`. Common source is tied to control line `SAP`.
2. Implement interleaved layout pin pitch matching the $360\text{ nm}$ array bitline pitch.

### Step 4: Netlist the 1T1C Memory Unit Cell and Array Connection
1. Netlist 1T1C unit cell `.subckt CELL_1T1C BL WL VPL`:
   - NMOS access transistor ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$) connected between bitline `BL` and storage node `SN`, gated by `WL`.
   - Storage capacitor $C_s$ ($28\text{ fF}$, stacked capacitor over bitline architecture) connected between `SN` and cell plate line `VPL` ($V_{DD} / 2$).
2. Connect complementary dummy cell or reference line on `/BL` for folded bitline differential operation.

### Step 5: Transient Operating Sequence & Testbench Verification
1. **Precharge Phase:** Assert `EQ` high while `SAN` and `SAP` are held at $V_{DD} / 2$. Verify `BL` and `/BL` settle precisely to $V_{DD} / 2$. Deassert `EQ`.
2. **Charge Sharing Phase:** Assert `WL` high. Access transistor dumps charge onto `BL`, developing differential voltage:
   $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
3. **Sensing & Restoration Phase:** Activate `SAN` (pulls to $GND$) and `SAP` (pulls to $V_{DD}$). Verify rails diverge rapidly to full CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$), restoring storage cell charge to 100%.

---

## 3. Physical & Electrical Netlist Targets

```text
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

  Signal Dev dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
Bitline Cap CBL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
    Cell Cap Cs (fF)┤████                              │
                    │████                              │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0      90       180     270    360 
```

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE `.measure` capacitance at storage node |
| **AC-02** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$) | $250.0 \pm 10.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped interconnect RC extraction report |
| **AC-03** | Developed Read Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$) | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage delta $\|\text{V(BL)} - \text{V(/BL)}\|$ at latch trigger |
| **AC-04** | Sense Amplifier Layout Pitch Budget | $\le 360.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC / Layout pitch constraint check |
| **AC-05** | Cell Retention Junction/Sub-threshold Leakage | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | DC quiescent current probe at storage node |

---

## 5. Literature Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, equalization network to $V_{DD}/2$, and sense signal development equation: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
   - Baseline capacitances ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$).
   - Strobe sequence: `SAN` to $GND$, `SAP` to $V_{DD}$ for differential sensing and full restoration.
   - Array-to-sense amplifier pitch matching constraint: $360\text{ nm}$.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance threshold: $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity.
   - Access transistor junction and sub-threshold leakage limit: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Multi-Metal Stack and Inter-Bitline Parasitic Extraction (PEX) Rule Setup
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation [Circuit Design] > 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup [Circuit Design] > Multi-Metal Stack and Inter-Bitline Parasitic Extraction (PEX) Rule Setup [Circuit Design]  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Establish an accurate 2.5D/3D Parasitic Extraction (PEX) deck and rule deck definition for the multi-metal interconnect stack (Tungsten bitline/local interconnect through upper routing metals) of the folded bitline array and sense amplifier network. This ensures exact extraction of inter-bitline coupling capacitance ($C_{c}$), total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$), and plate ground return parasitics to validate sensing signal margin ($\Delta V$) during transient read operations.

```text
       Bitline Interconnect Topology & Field Boundary Setup
       ----------------------------------------------------
       BL_i-1             BL_i (True)        /BL_i (Bar)        BL_i+1
        [M1]   <--Cc-->   [M1 / W]   <--Cc-->   [M1 / W]   <--Cc-->   [M1]
         |                   |                     |                   |
      -------             -------               -------             -------
     | C_sub |           | C_sub |             | C_sub |           | C_sub |
      -------             -------               -------             -------
    ========================================================================
                                Substrate Ground
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Process Stackup & Dielectric Constant Definition**
   - Import the 180nm back-end-of-line (BEOL) and Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) interconnect stack profile into the extraction rule compiler.
   - Configure the inter-layer dielectrics (ILD) and high-$k$ capacitor dielectric boundary models:
     - Set the stacked capacitor dielectric layer to ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective relative permittivity $\kappa > 15$ (EOT: $3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$).
     - Define gate dielectric oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) physical thickness at $3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Define tungsten plug (W-plug) contact resistivity and metal aspect ratios for access transistor drain-to-capacitor node and bitline contact interfaces.

2. **Array Pitch & Boundary Extraction Window Setup**
   - Set the nominal lithographic bitline pitch and wordline pitch extraction grid to $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ corresponding to the $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline cell geometry.
   - Constrain access transistor drawn gate parameters to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Establish extraction lateral halo window extending at least 5 pitches ($>2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) laterally to capture adjacent inter-bitline fringing fields ($BL$ to $/BL$ and $BL_i$ to $BL_{i+1}$).

3. **Field Solver Calibration for Inter-Bitline Coupling Capacitance**
   - Run a deterministic 3D field solver on a calibrated $3\times3$ array slice with Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) geometry to extract the multi-conductor capacitance matrix ($C_{ij}$).
   - Decompose total bitline capacitance into:
     $$C_{BL} = C_{area} + C_{fringe} + C_{overlap} + 2 \cdot C_{c}$$
     where $C_c$ is the lateral coupling capacitance between adjacent folded bitlines.
   - Tune the calibrated PEX lookup table (LUT) / corner decks so that the nominal total bitline parasitic capacitance satisfies the $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ baseline target for a standard sub-array column length.

4. **1T1C Node Isolation & Netlist Stitching Verification**
   - Ensure the PEX extraction rules cleanly distinguish between:
     - Distributed bitline wiring parasitics ($R_{BL}$, $C_{BL}$).
     - Storage node capacitor target ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ nominal, budget target range $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$).
   - Check that sub-threshold and junction leakage parameters are back-annotated into BSIM models with targets $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to support $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Generate the stitched DSPF/SPEF back-annotated netlist for the sense amplifier testbench.

5. **Transient Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Extraction Sanity Check**
   - Run an automated netlist testbench step with wordline assertion dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the precharged bitlines ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Verify that the extracted differential read voltage meets:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     yielding a nominal differential signal margin of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ into the cross-coupled sense amplifier latch inputs ($SAN$ / $SAP$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | `250` | `fF` | $\pm 10\%$ ($225 - 275\text{ fF}$) | 3D PEX netlist extraction / SPICE `.measure` |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` | `fF` | Minimum $\ge 25.0\text{ fF}$ (Range: $25 - 30\text{ fF}$) | PEX LVS extraction across cell storage node |
| **Developed Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | `100 - 150` | `mV` | Minimum $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ | Transient SPICE differential probe $(V_{BL} - V_{/BL})$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Budget (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | `fA/cell` | Maximum $\le 1.0\text{ fA}$ | Quiescent DC bias leakage extraction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | `nm` | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | PEX techfile stackup deck rule check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - High-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$).
  - Minimum storage capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$).
  - Leakage requirement ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for target refresh retention).
  - Tungsten plug (W-plug) stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$.
  - Bitline load capacitance reference ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).
  - Cell capacitance reference ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$).
  - Differential signal development equation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ yielding $100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ cell topology, $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch.
  - Storage capacitance budget range of $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown gate oxide thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-CKT-DRAM-180NM-042`
**Title:** Pre-Layout vs Post-PEX Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Verification Testbench  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm CMOS DRAM Process)  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & Layout Verification (Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier)  
**Action Type:** Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Architectural & Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Precharge BL/BLB to   │
│         VDD/2          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline Assertion   │
│         WL ON          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Charge Sharing Delta  │
│     V Development      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sense Amp Activation  │
│        SAN/SAP         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Full Rail CMOS     │
│      Restoration       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Layout Schematic Testbench Formulation (`TB_PRE_SENSE`):**
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitline pair (`BL`, `/BL`) paired with the cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch sense amplifier and equalization network.
   - Configure unit access transistor geometry to gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Tie 1T1C storage cell node with nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (evaluation limit down to minimum $28\text{ fF}$ budget) and bitline lump capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Initialize precharge equalization transistors to set $V_{\text{BL}} = V_{/\text{BL}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

2. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX Netlist Generation - `TB_POST_PEX`):**
   - Run full 3D/2.5D field solver parasitic extraction (R + C + CC coupled bitline parasitics) on the physical layout across the interleaved sense amplifier pitch matching array ($360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch).
   - Extract distributed parasitic resistance and capacitance networks for bitline metal tracks, contact tungsten plugs (W-plugs), and cross-coupled latch routing into a post-PEX DSPF/SPEF netlist.

3. **Transient Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$) Simulation:**
   - De-assert bitline equalization signal to float `BL` and `/BL` at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Assert wordline ($WL$) to turn on access transistor, initiating charge sharing:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Probe bitline differential margin $\Delta V = |V_{\text{BL}} - V_{/\text{BL}}|$ at the precise instant directly before latch strobe activation (`SAN` pulling to GND, `SAP` pulling to $V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Evaluate read '1' ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$) and read '0' ($V_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$) conditions across both pre-layout schematic and post-PEX netlists.

4. **Differential Degradation Comparison & Latch Margin Sign-Off:**
   - Calculate parasitic degradation percentage:
     $$\text{Degradation} (\%) = \frac{\Delta V_{\text{pre}} - \Delta V_{\text{post}}}{\Delta V_{\text{pre}}} \times 100$$
   - Run transient sensing to verify successful rail-to-rail latching ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$) and 100% cell charge restoration without sensing failure or latch metastability under thermal corner conditions ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Pre-Layout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V_{\text{pre}}$) | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage probe at charge-sharing equilibrium |
| **AC-02** | Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Small-signal capacitance extraction ($C\text{-}V$) |
| **AC-03** | Unit Access Transistor Dimensions ($L \times W$) | $180 \times 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Netlist instance parameter check & DRC audit |
| **AC-04** | Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$) | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC operating point / transient leakage integration |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture; precharge equalization to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; charge dumping relation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding nominal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$; strobe signal activation (`SAN` to GND, `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$) driving rails to $0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$ with 100% cell restoration; interleaved pitch matching at $360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch for the 180nm node.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Unit access transistor gate geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture connected via tungsten plug (W-plug); minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error and bitline noise immunity; leakage current ceiling target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1T1C Bitline Parasitics & Equalizer SPICE Netlist Preparation

**Task Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation > Transient Sensing Dynamics & Bitline Equalization SPICE Simulation > **1T1C Bitline Parasitics & Equalizer SPICE Netlist Preparation**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Architecture Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Unit Cell Geometry   │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Folded Bitline RC    │
│   Parasitic Netlist    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Bitline Equalizer    │
│   Network Subcircuit   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Simulation Transient  │
│     Control Setup      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Delta V    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Parameter Extraction & 1T1C Subcircuit Definition**
   - Define the subcircuit for the 180nm access MOSFET with nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate oxide physical thickness is set to $T_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Parameterize cell storage capacitance $C_s$ to nominal $25\text{ fF}$ (stack/trench budget range: $25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$, minimum requirement $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Set cell leakage current to $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across junction/subthreshold leakage paths.

2. **Folded Bitline RC Parasitic Netlist Generation**
   - Establish complementary folded bitline tracks (`BL` and `/BL`) modeled with bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Partition total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ into a multi-stage distributed $\pi$-ladder subcircuit representing contact sharing (shared bitline contact per 2 adjacent cells) and wire inter-line coupling parasitics.

3. **Bitline Equalizer & Precharge Subcircuit Implementation**
   - Synthesize the equalization transistor network across complementary nodes `BL` and `/BL`:
     - Cross-equalizer bridging transistor connected between `BL` and `/BL` driven by control signal `EQ`.
     - Dual precharge pull-up/pull-down transistors routing the precharge reference level $V_{EQ} = V_{DD} / 2$ to both `BL` and `/BL` simultaneously.
   - Size equalizer switches to guarantee rapid, symmetric voltage collapse toward $V_{DD}/2$ during the precharge phase prior to wordline activation.

4. **Transient Simulation Control & Signal Development Deck Setup**
   - Instantiate precharge conditioning pulse: assert `EQ` high to precharge both bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$, then de-assert `EQ` prior to wordline assertion.
   - Apply wordline assertion pulse ($V_{WL}$) to access transistor gate to initiate charge dump:
     $$Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$$
   - Formulate transient `.tran` directive and monitor signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0$ to $28.0$ | Min $25\text{ fF}$, typical $28\text{ fF}$ ($\ge 25\text{ fF}$ retention budget) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250.0$ | $\pm 10\%$ target extraction budget | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($W / L$)** | $220 / 180$ | Drawn geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0$ to $150.0$ | Evaluated across bitline pairs after cell dump | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target** | $< 1.0$ | At operating temperature of $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$ using an equalization network.
  - Charge sharing model $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ and differential voltage formula $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Reference parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}\text{--}150\text{ mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Storage capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ folded bitline cell layout with storage capacitor maintaining $25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Simulation Flow

```text
            │
            │

│                       │
│    Charge-Sharing     │
│  Signal Development   │
│        Delta V        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Sense Amplifier    │
│  Activation SAN/SAP   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full-Rail       │
│     Restoration &     │
│        Readout        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Precharge & Equalization Phase Setup**:
   - Instantiate the complementary bitline pair ($BL$ and $/BL$) with lump parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and an interleaved layout pitch matching $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Configure the equalization transistor network to short $BL$ and $/BL$ and bias them to $V_{DD}/2$ prior to wordline activation.
   - Run a transient initialization sweep to verify equalization settle to $V_{DD}/2$.

2. **Access Transistor & Storage Cell Model Configuration**:
   - Netlist the 1T1C unit cell with an access transistor of channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the access transistor drain terminal via a tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) model to a stacked capacitor ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, nominal $25\text{ fF} - 28\text{ fF}$) employing high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, such as ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
   - Set cell sub-threshold and junction leakage models to enforce $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Wordline Assertion & Differential Charge-Sharing Dynamic Analysis**:
   - Initialize cell pre-stored voltage levels for both Data '1' ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and Data '0' ($V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Turn off the equalization network, then assert the wordline ($WL$) high to turn on the access transistor.
   - Dump cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto $BL$ while maintaining $/BL$ at reference level $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Monitor dynamic charge sharing and quantify the developed differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$

4. **Sense Amplifier Latch Activation & Full-Rail Restoration**:
   - Trigger the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch via differential strobe drivers: assert $SAN$ pulling to $\text{GND}$ and $SAP$ pulling to $V_{DD}$.
   - Record transient waveforms driving $BL$ and $/BL$ to rail CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) to confirm $100\%$ cell charge restoration and readout latching integrity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked MIM/Crown capacitor extraction |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Measured at end of charge-sharing window ($C_s = 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$) |
| **Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Transient leakage current measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Pitch Constraint** | $360.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical pitch match to memory array bitlines (180nm node) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ via equalization transistor network.
  - Charge-sharing equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Parasitic and signal metrics: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, leading to $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} \text{ to } 150\text{ mV}$.
  - Latch activation: $SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$, driving full-rail $0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$ levels and restoring charge to $100\%$.
  - Interleaved layout pitch matching array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit access transistor dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Connection: Tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) to stacked capacitor (crown/MIM) over bitline (COB).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum cell capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage current budget: $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Sense Amp Latch    │
│        SAN/SAP        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full Rail       │
│      Restoration      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Transient Netlist Parameter Setup**:
   - Instantiate the 1T1C unit cell with access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ connected to the folded bitline pair ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$).
   - Configure the storage cell capacitance $C_s$ to nominal $25\text{ fF}$ (budgeted $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) and lumped bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Set operating junction temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ with cell sub-threshold/junction leakage modeled below $1\text{ fA/cell}$.

2. **Bitline Equalization & Precharge Phase**:
   - Drive the bitline equalization transistor network gate control to active high prior to wordline assertion.
   - Precharge and equalize both $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ precisely to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - De-assert the equalization signal, leaving bitlines floating in high-impedance mode at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

3. **Wordline Activation & Signal Development ($\Delta V$)**:
   - Assert the wordline ($\text{WL}$) to turn on the access transistor, transferring cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Allow bitline signal development across the folded bitline pair according to:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Probe the developed differential voltage between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ prior to sense amplifier latch triggering.

4. **Latch Timing Assertion & Full-Rail Restoration**:
   - Trigger the sense amplifier control clock: pull the NMOS common pull-down signal ($\text{SAN}$) down toward $V_{\text{SS}}$, followed by driving the PMOS common pull-up signal ($\text{SAP}$) toward $V_{\text{DD}}$.
   - Characterize the latch delay margin between WL assertion and SAN/SAP activation to ensure sensing occurs only after signal development stabilizes above noise margins.
   - Verify differential amplification drives the evaluated bitline to full supply rail ($V_{\text{DD}}$ for Read-1, $V_{\text{SS}}$ for Read-0) to accomplish active cell charge restoration.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Parameter | Minimum | Nominal / Target | Maximum | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0$ | $28.0$ | $30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE extracted netlist parameter check |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0$ | $125.0$ | $150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage delta measurement at $t_{\text{SAN}}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180.0$ | $180.0$ | $180.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Mask geometry / schematic DRC parameter check |
| **Cell Leakage Current (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | — | — | $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC/Transient leakage current integration at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; precharge level $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$; bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$; differential sensing signal range $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$; latch activation sequence via $\text{SAN}$ and $\text{SAP}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; folded bitline COB layout; minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell; maximum leakage threshold of $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Storage capacitance spec $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell; retention constraint $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Monte Carlo Mismatch & $V_{th}$ Variation Statistical Yield Analysis

**SOP Identifier:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-MET-004`  
**Hierarchical Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation > Monte Carlo Mismatch & $V_{th}$ Variation Statistical Yield Analysis  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Metrology & Yield Statistical Characterization  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the protocol for executing statistical Monte Carlo mismatch simulations and threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) process variation analysis on cross-coupled CMOS Sense Amplifiers (SA) within a folded-bitline DRAM architecture. The primary objective is to evaluate sense amplifier offset distribution, quantify bitline differential signal margin degradation, and verify retention/sensing yield under statistical manufacturing variations at the 180 nm technology node.

---

### 2. Relevant Technical Context & Literature Citations
* **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  * Unit cell architecture: 1T1C folded bitline ($8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$).
  * Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$): Nominally $28\,\text{fF}$ (minimum $25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$).
  * Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$ or $C_{BL}$): $150\,\text{fF}$ to $250\,\text{fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
  * Bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio ($C_b / C_s$): Target $5:1$ to $9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$).
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  * Precharge equalization level: $V_{DD} / 2$.
  * Signal development voltage: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\,\text{mV}$ to $150\,\text{mV}$.
  * Latch topology: CMOS cross-coupled inverter pair gated by sensing timing signals ($\text{SAN}$ and $\text{SAP}$).
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  * Unit access transistor sizing: Channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  * Sub-threshold and junction leakage limit: $< 1\,\text{fA}/\text{cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
                     +---------------------------------------+
                     |  Step 1: Netlist & Parasitic Setup    |
                     |  Cs = 25-28 fF, Cb = 150-250 fF       |
                     +-------------------+-------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
                     +---------------------------------------+
                     |  Step 2: Statistical Model Config     |
                     |  Pelgrom mismatch & Vth variations    |
                     +-------------------+-------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
                     +---------------------------------------+
                     |  Step 3: Monte Carlo Transient Run   |
                     |  N >= 1,000 runs, T = 85°C            |
                     +-------------------+-------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
                     +---------------------------------------+
                     |  Step 4: Offset & Yield Analysis      |
                     |  Delta V vs. V_offset, 3-sigma audit  |
                     +---------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Netlist & Parasitic Parameter Setup
1. Instantiate the folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier core with precharge/equalizer circuitry and complementary bitline legs ($BL$ and $/BL$).
2. Configure parasitic bitline capacitance lumped model:
   * Set $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$ (corresponding to 512 cells per folded bitline block).
   * Set storage node capacitance $C_s = 28\,\text{fF}$ (minimum allowable limit $25\,\text{fF}$).
   * Verify the nominal capacitance ratio $C_{BL} / C_s \approx 8.93:1$ (confirm strictly $< 10:1$).
3. Set access NMOS transistor dimensions to $W = 220\,\text{nm}$ and $L = 180\,\text{nm}$.
4. Initialize the equalization voltage to $V_{DD} / 2$.

#### Step 2: Statistical Variation & Mismatch Parameter Assignment
1. Enable PDK-specific Monte Carlo variation models including:
   * **Global (inter-die) process corners:** Typical, Slow-Slow, Fast-Fast.
   * **Local (intra-die) mismatch:** Pelgrom $V_{th}$ mismatch ($\sigma_{Vth} \propto 1/\sqrt{W \cdot L}$) applied to the cross-coupled NMOS and PMOS pair.
2. Configure thermal junction boundary condition to $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to capture worst-case cell leakage ($< 1\,\text{fA}/\text{cell}$) and degraded drive current.

#### Step 3: Transient Sensing Simulation Run
1. Configure a minimum sample size of $N = 1,000$ Monte Carlo iterations.
2. For each iteration, execute transient analysis of the read cycle:
   * Assert Equalize signal to precharge $BL$ and $/BL$ to $V_{DD} / 2$.
   * De-assert Equalize, assert Wordline ($WL$) to transfer charge from $C_s$ to $BL$.
   * Develop signal margin $\Delta V$ across $BL$ and $/BL$ before activating the sense amplifier.
   * Assert $\text{SAN}$ (pulling to $V_{SS}$) and $\text{SAP}$ (pulling to $V_{DD}$) to latch the data.
3. Record sense amplifier input-referred offset voltage ($V_{OS}$), bitline differential voltage ($\Delta V$), and latching state (read '1' and read '0').

#### Step 4: Post-Processing & Statistical Yield Quantification
1. Compute the mean ($\mu$) and standard deviation ($\sigma$) of the sense amplifier offset voltage ($V_{OS}$).
2. Calculate the effective read margin under mismatch:
   $$\text{Margin}_{\text{effective}} = \Delta V - 3\sigma_{V_{OS}}$$
3. Identify sensing failure instances where $|V_{OS}| \ge \Delta V$, resulting in inverted latch decisions.
4. Calculate statistical sensing yield against the $> 3\sigma$ design envelope.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Evaluation Condition | Target Specification | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Pre-simulation verification | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | Reject run if outside range |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_{BL} / C_s$)** | Parasitic extraction audit ($C_{BL} = 150\text{--}250\,\text{fF}$) | $5.0 : 1 \le C_{BL}/C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ (Max: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless | Adjust bitline cell count if $\ge 10:1$ |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | Nominal read cycle prior to latch activation | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Flag read margin error if $< 100.0\,\text{mV}$ |
| **Statistical Sensing Yield ($3\sigma$)** | $N \ge 1,000$ Monte Carlo runs at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\ge 99.73$ (Zero sensing inversions at $\pm 3\sigma$) | $\%$ | Rework SA transistor sizing if $< 99.73\%$ |

**Level / Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Discipline**: Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer — Circuit Design & Metrology  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Step 1: Baseline    │
│   180nm BSIM/SPICE    │

│    Step 2: Pelgrom    │
│       Mismatch        │

            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Step 3: Folded     │
│    Bitline Netlist    │
│      Integration      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Step 4: Monte Carlo  │
│      Statistical      │
│  Execution & Sensing  │
│   Margin Extraction   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Baseline 180nm BSIM/SPICE Deck & Parameter Definition**
   - Initialize the SPICE deck targeting the 180nm CMOS technology node with physical gate dielectric thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$.
   - Instantiate unit-cell access transistor geometry with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\,\mu\text{m}$) and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Parameterize nominal cell storage capacitance $C_s$ within the budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (stacked capacitor architecture) and bitline loading capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

2. **Pelgrom Mismatch Function & Statistical Parameterization**
   - Define local device mismatch for threshold voltage ($\sigma_{\Delta V_{th}}$) and current factor ($\sigma_{\Delta \beta / \beta}$) across cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch pairs using the Pelgrom model:
     $$\sigma_{\Delta V_{th}} = \frac{A_{Vth}}{\sqrt{W \cdot L}}$$
   - Embed Gaussian random variation parameters inside the SPICE subcircuit model cards:
     - Assign independent Gaussian random variables (`gauss(0, sigma, 1)`) to access transistors and differential latch transistor pairs (NMOS pulldown and PMOS pullup).
     - Incorporate temperature corner at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to capture worst-case sub-threshold and junction leakage ($I_{leak} \le 1\text{ fA/cell}$).

3. **Folded Bitline Netlist Integration & Precharge Bias Setup**
   - Assemble the folded-bitline topology connecting complementary bitlines `BL` and `/BL` across the cross-coupled inverter latch and equalization transistor network.
   - Configure transient bias: equalize `BL` and `/BL` to $V_{DD} / 2$ prior to wordline activation.
   - Set cell stored charge: $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ where differential signal development follows:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$

4. **Monte Carlo Transient Simulation & Sensing Margin Yield Extraction**
   - Run a minimum 1,000-point Monte Carlo transient simulation sweep with random seed initialization across mismatch corners.
   - Assert wordline ($WL$), allow signal development across complementary bitlines, and trigger sense amplifier activation latching signals ($SAN$ pulling low, $SAP$ pulling high).
   - Evaluate differential input offset $V_{os}$ against developed signal $\Delta V$ to ensure zero read-inversion failures across statistical distributions.

---

### Key Capacitance & Signal Margin References

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
   Delta V_sig Max┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
   Delta V_sig Min┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
C_BL (Bitline Cap)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    C_s (Cell Cap)┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                  0.0     62.5     125.0   187.5  250.0 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Verification Point |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE extracted node capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ nominal target for noise immunity) |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250 \pm 10$ | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted folded-bitline wire & junction parasitic loading netlist capacitance |
| **Developed Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage delta $|\text{BL} - \text{/BL}|$ post wordline assertion prior to latch strobe |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $180 \times 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Netlist instance geometry ($L = 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$, $W = 0.22\,\mu\text{m}$) |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target ($I_{leak}$)** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC/transient junction and sub-threshold leakage evaluated at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Context Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing architecture, folded bitline topology, precharge/equalization to $V_{DD}/2$, signal development formulation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$, cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and developed signal range $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry with $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell, and cell leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C architecture, $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ storage capacitance requirement for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate oxide thickness $t_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$, and array pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
