# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Multi-Corner Monte Carlo Transient Execution
**Document ID:** `SOP-CKT-180-FBSA-MC01`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm Open-Source DRAM Chip)  
**Action Type:** Make / Simulation & Verification  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Transient Phases

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Equalization to V_DD  │
│          / 2           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Charge Sharing &    │
│   Signal Development   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    SAN / SAP Strobe    │
│        Latching        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Full-Rail        │
│  Restoration & Monte   │
│      Carlo Metric      │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Netlist Setup & Dimension Parameterization:**
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitline pair (`BL` and `/BL`) alongside the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch sense amplifier and equalization network.
   - Configure access transistor dimensions to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ as defined for the 180nm unit cell.
   - Constrain the sense amplifier layout width boundary to pitch-match the memory array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ utilizing an interleaved layout topology.

2. **Parasitic Loading & Initial Cell State Pre-Charging:**
   - Assign the total lumped bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ per bitline branch.
   - Assign storage cell capacitance to $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal test condition) and evaluate soft-error margin floor using stacked capacitor budget minimum $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$.
   - Initialize the equalization transistor network to drive and balance complementary lines $BL$ and $/BL$ to exactly $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

3. **Multi-Corner Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) Definition:**
   - Configure simulation multi-corner matrices spanning typical (TT), slow (SS), and fast (FF) device corners.
   - Set operational junction temperatures across the test matrix with the worst-case leakage corner evaluated at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.

4. **Monte Carlo Mismatch & $V_{th}$ Statistical Injection:**
   - Set up statistical Monte Carlo models encompassing threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) mismatch and physical transistor dimension variations ($\Delta W$, $\Delta L$) across the cross-coupled inverter pair.
   - Set sample count to $N \ge 1000$ iterations per PVT corner.

5. **Transient Execution & Signal Development Sequence:**
   - **Phase 1 (Precharge Release):** De-assert the equalization network at $t_1$.
   - **Phase 2 (Charge Sharing):** Assert the wordline to switch on the access transistor, transferring cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ onto bitline $BL$. Allow signal development $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.
   - **Phase 3 (Sensing & Latching Activation):** Assert sense amplifier latching signals by pulling `SAN` to $0\text{ V}$ (GND) and `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$ to trigger positive feedback latching.
   - **Phase 4 (Full-Rail Restoration):** Monitor differential amplification until complementary bitlines reach full-rail CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$), verifying 100% cell charge restoration.

6. **Post-Processing & Statistical Metric Extraction:**
   - Extract bitline differential development voltage $\Delta V$, sensing delay, and restoration rail compliance.
   - Verify cell storage sub-threshold and junction leakage across Monte Carlo runs at high temperature.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Measured at end of charge sharing ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) prior to `SAN`/`SAP` activation |
| **Cell Capacitance Minimum ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked capacitor budget target for noise & soft-error immunity |
| **Sense Amplifier Pitch Constraint** | $360$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical pitch match constraint across interleaved array bitlines at 180nm |
| **Cell Leakage Current Ceiling** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Total sub-threshold and junction leakage evaluated at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Literature References
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:** Differential CMOS cross-coupled latch topology, $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ equalization, charge sharing relation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$, nominal values $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$, `SAN` $\rightarrow \text{GND}$, `SAP` $\rightarrow V_{\text{DD}}$ rail restoration, and $360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch-matching.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage current target of $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

```text
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Signal Development   │
│    with Cs and CBL     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sense Amp Activation  │
│      SAN and SAP       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Statistical Vos and   │
│    Yield Extraction    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Netlist Initialization & Device Layout Configuration:**
   - Instantiate the 180nm folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch sense amplifier and equalizer subcircuit.
   - Set access transistor dimensions to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure sense amplifier pitch matches the memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$) utilizing interleaved layout topology.
   - Model the bitline capacitance at nominal $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and cell storage stacked capacitor at $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (ensuring layout conforms to minimum $28\text{ fF}$ cell capacitance budget requirements for soft-error immunity).

2. **Precharge & Equalization Phase:**
   - Activate the bitline equalization transistor network prior to wordline assertion.
   - Precharge both complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) symmetrically to $V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Confirm equalized stability across all interleaved sense amplifier blocks before asserting the wordline.

3. **Charge Sharing & Signal Development:**
   - Assert the wordline to switch on the $180\text{ nm} \times 220\text{ nm}$ access transistor, dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline.
   - Allow passive charge sharing to develop the differential signal voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Verify differential signal development window reaches between $100\text{ mV}$ and $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **Sense Amplifier Latching & Metrology Strobe:**
   - Strobe the sense amplifier latching signals: drive $SAN$ to $GND$ and $SAP$ to $V_{DD}$.
   - Amplify the developed differential voltage to full rail CMOS logic levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$), confirming simultaneous restore of cell charge back to $100\%$.

5. **Monte Carlo Statistical Yield & Offset Metrology Extraction:**
   - Execute a multi-run Monte Carlo simulation incorporating device threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) mismatch and process variations across the cross-coupled pair.
   - Extract the input offset voltage ($V_{os}$) distribution across iterations.
   - Verify that sensing margin $\Delta V > |V_{os}|$ holds across statistical corners to guarantee zero flipped reads and confirm differential sensing yield.
   - Quantify sub-threshold and junction leakage current to verify stability across the required refresh interval at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Delta V Signal Margin┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 Input Offset (Sigma)┤▒▒▒▒▒                            │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒                            │
Sub-threshold Leakage┤█                                │
                     │█                                │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    31.2    62.5    93.8  125.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Evaluation Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Signal development window with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Layout Pitch** | $360$ | $\text{nm}$ | Matching array bitline pitch in 180nm folded bitline node |
| **Unit Cell Capacitance Budget ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor budget for alpha soft-error and coupling immunity |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Cell retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across refresh interval |

---

## 4. Source Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, precharge to $V_{DD} / 2$.
  - Charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ and signal development $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
  - Nominal values: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
  - Latching control ($SAN \to GND$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$) restoring cell charge to $100\%$, with sense amplifier pitch matched to array bitline pitch at $360\text{ nm}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Unit cell geometry: access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Maximum allowable leakage current: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

## Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction

- **Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node
- **Module**: Architecture & Integration > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer
- **Action Type**: Make

```text
│  Extraction: C_BL max  │

│  Sign-off DRC and LVS  │
│         Clean          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pitch Matching & Interleaved Strip Grid Allocation**:
   - Establish sense amplifier column routing pitch aligned precisely to the memory array bitline pitch of **$360\text{ nm}$** ($2F$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Because a full cross-coupled CMOS latch and equalization network cannot physically fit within a single $360\text{ nm}$ lane, place sense amplifiers in an **interleaved layout** topology (alternating top and bottom sense amplifier blocks to expand layout pitch to $720\text{ nm}$ per physical amplifier block).

2. **Equalization & Precharge Network Placement**:
   - Layout the 3-transistor equalization/precharge network directly bridging complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
   - Route the equalization control gate line and connect the precharge bias rail to $\frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}$.

3. **CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch Layout**:
   - Construct the cross-coupled inverter pairs consisting of PMOS pull-up transistors connected to common node $\text{SAP}$ and NMOS pull-down transistors connected to common node $\text{SAN}$.
   - Ensure symmetric layout between complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to maintain common-mode noise cancellation in the folded bitline architecture.

4. **Bitline Routing & Shielding**:
   - Route $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ pairs adjacent to one another along the folded path to ensure that external substrate and wordline noise couples equally into both rails.
   - Keep routing parasitic capacitance within the bitline capacitance ceiling:
     $$C_{\text{BL}} \le 250\text{ fF}$$

5. **Sign-off DRC & LVS Clean Verification**:
   - Execute design rule check (DRC) on the 180nm design rules for contact enclosures, metal spacings, active diffusion boundaries, and plug connections.
   - Execute layout-versus-schematic (LVS) extraction to verify complete pin-to-pin netlist equivalence between schematic and extracted physical layout.

6. **Parasitic RC Extraction & Signal Margin Check**:
   - Extract lumped and distributed parasitic capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$).
   - Simulate readout signal development with cell storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ (stacked capacitor target: $28\text{ fF}$ minimum) using:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Confirm differential voltage development $\Delta V$ falls within **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$**.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ in folded-bitline topology.
  - Bitline precharge to $\frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}$.
  - Sensing signal development formula: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
  - Values: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$.
  - Pitch matching requirements: $360\text{ nm}$ memory array bitline pitch in 180nm node requiring interleaved layout; latching via $\text{SAN} \to \text{GND}$ and $\text{SAP} \to V_{\text{DD}}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - 180nm geometry: access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
  - Dielectric: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Minimum capacitance budget: $28\text{ fF}/\text{cell}$; leakage target: $< 1\text{ fA}/\text{cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Interleaved Sense Amp & Precharge Pitch-Matched Layout Floorplanning

**Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Node / Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Task Classification**: Circuit Design & Physical Layout (`Make`)  

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the physical floorplanning, pitch matching, and layout methodology for the CMOS folded-bitline regenerative sense amplifier (N-Sense/P-Sense) and precharge/equalization circuitry. 

In the 180nm process node, the memory array bitline pitch is **360 nm**. To fit the complex multi-transistor sense amplifier and precharge networks within this tightly constrained pitch without DRC violations, an **interleaved layout architecture** (alternating pitch matching across both sides of the memory sub-array) must be floorplanned and routed.

---

## 2. Layout Architecture & Floorplan Topology

```text
    +--------------------------------------------------------+
    |        Top Interleaved Sense Amp / Precharge Bank      |
    |   (Services Even Bitline Pairs: BL0//BL0, BL2//BL2)    |
    +========================================================+
    |                                                        |
    |                   DRAM Cell Array                      |
    |            Bitline Pitch: 360 nm (0.36 µm)             |
    |                                                        |
    +========================================================+
    |       Bottom Interleaved Sense Amp / Precharge Bank    |
    |    (Services Odd Bitline Pairs: BL1//BL1, BL3//BL3)    |
    +--------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pitch Matching via Dual-Bank Interleaving**:
   - Local array bitline pair spacing: $2 \times 360\text{ nm} = 720\text{ nm}$.
   - Interleaving splits alternating bitline pairs between the top and bottom of the subarray, expanding the effective layout allocation per sense amp strip to **$720\text{ nm}$ pitch width**.
2. **Circuit Strip Organization**:
   - **Section A (Equalizer / Precharge Network)**: 3-transistor NMOS precharge block connecting to $V_{\text{BLP}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$ and gate controlled by signal `EQ`.
   - **Section B (N-Sense Amplifier - NSA)**: Cross-coupled NMOS latch pair tied to common source pull-down line `SAN` (switching from $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ to $\text{GND}$).
   - **Section C (P-Sense Amplifier - PSA)**: Cross-coupled PMOS latch pair tied to common source pull-up line `SAP` (switching from $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ to $V_{\text{DD}}$).

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Sub-Array Boundary & Pitch Frame Definition
1. Set the physical grid pitch reference: Place active column rails on a strict **360 nm** bitline center-to-center pitch.
2. Route even column pairs ($\text{BL}_0, \overline{\text{BL}}_0$) through the top boundary and odd column pairs ($\text{BL}_1, \overline{\text{BL}}_1$) through the bottom boundary to create the **720 nm** physical window per sense amplifier block.
3. Align metal-1 (M1) or metal-2 (M2) bitline tracks symmetrically to maintain strictly identical parasitic capacitance on true and complementary bitlines ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).

### Step 2: Equalization & Precharge Transistor Layout
1. Place three NMOS equalization transistors at the array boundary entrance:
   - One transistor bridging $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
   - Two transistors connecting $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to the precision $V_{\text{BLP}}$ supply line ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
2. Connect gates of all three equalization transistors to the common `EQ` control signal rail.
3. Ensure contact and diffusion symmetrical matching between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to minimize differential offset voltage during turn-off.

### Step 3: N-Sense Amp (NSA) Cross-Coupled Core Placement
1. Lay out the cross-coupled NMOS pair inside the 720 nm boundary envelope.
2. Cross-couple the poly gates and drain diffusions symmetrically using cross-over routing in Metal 1 / Contact plugs.
3. Tie the NMOS source diffusions directly to the horizontal common pulldown bus `SAN`.
4. Ensure the `SAN` line is sized with low resistance to support rapid discharge during N-sense latching.

### Step 4: P-Sense Amp (PSA) Core Placement & N-Well Isolation
1. Lay out the cross-coupled PMOS pair in an adjacent dedicated N-well strip.
2. Maintain design rule spacing between the NMOS array substrate and the PMOS N-well.
3. Cross-couple the PMOS gates and drains identically matching the NSA topology.
4. Route PMOS sources to the common horizontal pullup bus `SAP`.
5. Maintain parasitic capacitance symmetry between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ tracks spanning across the NSA and PSA blocks.

### Step 5: Power Supply & Signal Bus Distribution
1. Route global activation rails (`SAN`, `SAP`, `EQ`, and $V_{\text{BLP}}$) horizontally across all interleaved sense amplifiers using low-resistivity upper metal layers (e.g., M3/M4).
2. Insert decoupling tap cells along $V_{\text{BLP}}$ ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$) to absorb transient charge injection during bitline equalization.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | **Memory Array Bitline Pitch** | **$360\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$** (grid strict) | Physical DRC check on bitline metal line center-to-center spacing |
| **AC-02** | **Interleaved Sense Amp Slot Pitch** | **$720\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$** | DRC boundary measurement per interleaved sense amp cell pitch |
| **AC-03** | **Nominal Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | **$250\text{ fF} \pm 10\%$** | Post-layout RC parasitic extraction (PEX) across nominal line length |
| **AC-04** | **Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | SPICE transient read simulation ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) |

---

## 5. Literature & Context Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  * Array bitline pitch constraint: *360 nm in 180nm node*, requiring interleaved layout.
  * Bitline equalization to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ via equalization transistor network.
  * Typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, and differential signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  * Full-rail restore via latching signals: `SAN` to $\text{GND}$, `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$.
* **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
  * Equalization Phase: `EQ` high shorting $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to precision $V_{\text{BLP}}$ ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
  * Wordline boosted overdrive transition ($V_{\text{PP}} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$).
  * Phased latching: NMOS pulldown switch pulls `SAN` to $\text{GND}$, followed by PMOS pullup switch pulling `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$ with 1–2 ns delay.

- **Hierarchy Level**: Generation 2 ($\mu$m) — Circuit Design / Layout Floorplanning
- **Scope**: Pitch boundary matching, bitline interleaving scheme, and cell-to-core interface definition for folded bitline CMOS sense amplifiers and equalization networks.

```text

│   Start: Cell Array    │
│          Edge          │

┌────────────────────────┐

│  Integration: SA & EQ  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Array Bitline Pitch Boundary Alignment**:
   - Establish the primary memory cell array boundary at the contact edge of the access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the raw cell array bitline pair grid pitch to exactly $360\text{ nm}$ per adjacent complementary bitline line pair ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) following the 180nm folded bitline architecture.

2. **Interleaved Pitch Expansion Configuration**:
   - Split alternating complementary bitline pairs into an interleaved top/bottom floorplan:
     - **Even Bitline Pairs ($BL_0, \overline{BL_0}, BL_2, \overline{BL_2}, \dots$)**: Route toward the upper boundary Sense Amplifier/Equalizer bank.
     - **Odd Bitline Pairs ($BL_1, \overline{BL_1}, BL_3, \overline{BL_3}, \dots$)**: Route toward the lower boundary Sense Amplifier/Equalizer bank.
   - Expand the effective layout pitch allocated for each CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch and equalization circuit from $360\text{ nm}$ to $720\text{ nm}$ ($2 \times$ pitch relaxation), accommodating PMOS/NMOS active diffusion, well taps, and cross-coupling contacts.

3. **Equalizer & Precharge Cell-to-Core Transition Placement**:
   - Place the bitline equalization transistor network directly adjacent to the cell array boundary before the main sense amplifier latch.
   - Route the equalization control rail ($EQ$) and intermediate precharge reference voltage rail ($V_{DD}/2$) orthogonally across the $720\text{ nm}$ interleaved channels.

4. **Sense Amplifier Core Floorplan & Control Rail Routing**:
   - Align the CMOS cross-coupled latch stages downstream of the equalization network.
   - Lay out the bottom NMOS pulldown latch with common node $SAN$ (pulling down to $\text{GND}$) and the top PMOS pullup latch with common node $SAP$ (pulling up to $V_{DD}$).
   - Verify continuous shielding and pitch clearance to keep bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} \le 250\text{ fF}$ against the cell storage node budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$–$28\text{ fF}$.

| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance Budget ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-Layout RC Extraction (PEX / LVS) |
| **Nominal Differential Readout Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient SPICE Simulation ($\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2})$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Memory array bitline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ in the 180nm node requiring interleaved layout.
  - Signal development parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Sensing control signals: $SAN$ pulling to $\text{GND}$, $SAP$ pulling to $V_{DD}$, and precharge equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell transistor geometry: Gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity and signal integrity.

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. Precharge & Equalizer Transistor Layout  │
│     (V_DD/2 precharge pass-gate placement)   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. Cross-Coupled Latch Device Placement     │
│     (NMOS SAN to GND, PMOS SAP to V_DD)      │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. Symmetric Differential Metal Routing     │
│     (BL and /BL parasitic capacitance match) │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. Extraction & Sign-Off Verification       │
│     (DRC/LVS, Delta V: 100-150 mV check)     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Interleaved Pitch Grid & Boundary Definition**:
   - Establish the column pitch boundary locked to the memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up an interleaved sense amplifier architecture (alternating odd/even column banks) so that each sense amplifier physical layout slot has an expanded pitch boundary ($720\text{ nm}$) to accommodate wide cross-coupled CMOS transistors while matching the $360\text{ nm}$ array line pitch.
2. **Precharge & Equalizer Pass-Gate Network Layout**:
   - Place the equalization pass transistors bridging complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) and connecting to the $V_{DD}/2$ precharge rail.
   - Route the equalization gate control signal ($EQ$) orthogonal to the bitlines using M1/Poly with minimal RC skew to ensure simultaneous charge equalization across all bitline pairs prior to wordline assertion.
3. **Cross-Coupled Latch Placement & Cross-Under Routing**:
   - Place the cross-coupled NMOS inverter pair connected to the $SAN$ latching node (pulling to GND) and the PMOS inverter pair connected to the $SAP$ latching node (pulling to $V_{DD}$).
   - Route symmetric cross-under gate-drain interconnects using identical metal trace lengths, layer transitions, and via counts to eliminate parasitic imbalance between $BL$ and $/BL$.
4. **Symmetric Folded Bitline Interconnect Routing**:
   - Route complementary bitlines through the sensing strip on parallel metal tracks with identical spacing and boundary shielding.
   - Match parasitic capacitance budgets so total column bitline capacitance sits at $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ against the cell storage capacitance ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).
5. **DRC, LVS, and Differential Margin Extraction**:
   - Execute DRC on active diffusion, gate poly, tungsten contact plugs (W-plugs), and lower metal interconnects.
   - Run LVS extraction verifying 1:1 netlist equivalence against the schematic.
   - Perform post-layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX) and transient readout simulation to verify that the signal development margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ achieves $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ before latching.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **360** | **nm** | GDS Layout Coordinate & DRC Pitch Rule Check |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **250** | **fF** | Post-Layout Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) |
| **Minimum Unit Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **25 to 28** | **fF** | Stacked Capacitor 3D Extraction / C-V Metrology |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **100 to 150** | **mV** | Post-Layout SPICE Transient Read Simulation |
| **DRC / LVS Violation Count** | **0** | **Count** | Batch Verification Sign-Off Summary Report |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Local Context

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Validates folded-bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ prior to wordline assertion.
  - Differential signal development equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Defines nominal parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Sensing activation pulling $SAN$ to GND and $SAP$ to $V_{DD}$, driving full CMOS rail levels and restoring cell charge.
  - Array bitline pitch matching of $360\text{ nm}$ in the 180nm node requiring interleaved layout.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Specifies unit cell access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Defines stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects.
  - Establishes minimum storage capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell and leakage budget $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Sense Amp Stripe DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Bitline Imbalance Extraction

- **Context / Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction > Interleaved Sense Amp & Precharge Pitch-Matched Layout Floorplanning > Sense Amp Stripe DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Bitline Imbalance Extraction [Metrology]
- **Document Path**: [sop_sense_amp_stripe_drc_lvs_rc_imbalance_extraction.md](docs/sop/sop_sense_amp_stripe_drc_lvs_rc_imbalance_extraction.md)

---

### Process Flow

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     Interleaved Sense Amp GDS Layout In       │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: DRC Pitch & Geometry Verification    │
│  - 360 nm Array Bitline Pitch                 │
│  - Access Gate L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm         │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Hierarchical LVS Netlist Matching    │
│  - Cross-Coupled Inverter Latch (SAN / SAP)   │
│  - Equalizer / Precharge (VDD / 2) Switches   │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: 2.5D/3D PEX Parasitic RC Extraction  │
│  - True BL and Complementary /BL Parasitics   │
│  - Neighbor Lateral Coupling & Substrate C    │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 4: BL / /BL Imbalance Screen & Readout  │
│  - Delta C_BL Imbalance Screen (< 2.5 fF)     │
│  - Dynamic Delta V Margin: 100 mV to 150 mV   │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Stripe Layout Ingestion & DRC Verification**:
   - Stream in the completed GDSII/OASIS layout of the pitch-matched sense amplifier stripe (including equalizer pass-gates, isolation switches, and boundary cell arrays).
   - Execute the 180nm design rule deck to confirm that bitline metal/poly layout conforms strictly to the $360\text{ nm}$ array pitch.
   - Verify unit access transistor dimensions enforce gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. **Hierarchical LVS Netlist Equivalence Extraction**:
   - Extract device connectivity across NMOS pull-down cross-coupled pairs, PMOS pull-up cross-coupled pairs, and equalization networks.
   - Run layout-versus-schematic (LVS) comparison against the golden folded-bitline SPICE schematic, verifying $0$ unmatched nets, $0$ device parameter mismatches, and proper well-tap biasing.
3. **2.5D/3D Parasitic Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Run multi-layer field solver extraction on true ($BL$) and complement ($\overline{BL}$) conductor routes, extracting distributed line resistance ($R$) and ground/mutual capacitance ($C + CC$).
   - Export full parasitic netlists in SPEF/DSPF formats.
4. **Parasitic RC Imbalance Screening & Readout Margin Verification**:
   - Compute bitline capacitive asymmetry $\Delta C_{BL} = |C_{BL} - C_{\overline{BL}}|$ relative to the nominal bitline budget ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Run transient SPICE simulations injecting stored cell charge ($C_s \ge 25\text{ to } 28\text{ fF}$) with bitlines equalized at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Confirm differential sensing voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$ develops cleanly within the $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ window before latch actuation to full rail ($0\text{V}$ and $V_{DD}$).

---

### Target Metrics & Acceptance Criteria

```text
            Sense Amp Stripe Verification Metric Targets

   C_BL (fF)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■             │
            │░░░░                                      │
    C_s (fF)┤░░░░                                      │
  W_act (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
 L_gate (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
  Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████████│
            │██████████████████████████████████████████│
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0        90         180       270      360 
```

1. **Array Bitline Pitch**: **$360\text{ nm}$** (Automated DRC pitch rule check).
2. **Access Transistor Channel Geometry**: **$L = 180\text{ nm}$**, **$W = 220\text{ nm}$** (Automated DRC gate/active check).
3. **Nominal Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)**: **$250\text{ fF}$** (3D PEX extraction).
4. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)**: **$25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$** (PEX/LVS device extraction).
5. **Differential Readout Voltage ($\Delta V$)**: **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** (Post-layout transient SPICE simulation).
6. **Bitline Capacitive Imbalance ($\Delta C_{BL}$)**: **$\le 2.5\text{ fF}$** ($< 1\%$ mismatch of nominal $C_{BL}$).
7. **Cell Leakage Current Target**: **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** at $85^\circ\text{C}$ junction temperature.

---

### Source Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing and refresh of 1T1C memory cell, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge equalization, full-rail latching ($0\text{V}$ and $V_{DD}$), cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, differential voltage $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$, and interleaved layout with pitch matching array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, minimum $28\text{ fF}$ cell capacitance budget, and leakage current kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction [Circuit Design] > Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Inter-Array Boundary Routing & VSS/VDD Ground Plane Shielding Implementation

**Module**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 µm)  
**Discipline**: Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer / Layout DRC/LVS  
**Knowledge Record**: [inter_array_boundary_routing_shielding.md](docs/knowledge/inter_array_boundary_routing_shielding.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Inter-Array Boundary  │
│     Pitch Matching     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boundary Guard-Ring   │
│  & Well Tap Strapping  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Co-axial        │
│  Ground/Supply Plane   │
│       Shielding        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Parasitic RC      │
│      Extraction &      │
│  Differential Signal   │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Boundary Pitch Transition & Geometric Alignment**:
   - Route memory sub-array complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) across the array-to-periphery boundary maintaining an interconnect pitch between **$360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$**.
   - Ensure the boundary transition preserves the access transistor channel length dimension ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) design ground rules without lithographic line-end shortening.

2. **Substrate Tap & Well-Boundary Guard Ring Strapping**:
   - Place continuous N-well and P-substrate tap guard rings along the boundary edge between the array core and the sense amplifier region to clamp minority carrier injection.
   - Tie guard rings directly to quiet external ground rails ($V_{SS}$) and array precharge references ($V_{DD}/2$) using low-resistance contact arrays.

3. **Co-planar / Sandwich Ground Plane ($V_{SS}/V_{DD}$) Shielding**:
   - Implement co-planar lateral metal shielding lines flanking each folded bitline pair on the bitline interconnect layer.
   - Place continuous $V_{SS}$ and $V_{DD}$ metal plane grids (Metal-2 / Metal-3) over and under the boundary interconnect routing to create a pseudo-coaxial shielded cage, isolating sensitive differential sensing nodes from external wordline toggle noise.

4. **Parasitic RC Extraction & Signal Integrity Verification**:
   - Execute 3D parasitic extraction (PEX) across the entire boundary interface.
   - Verify that complementary line capacitance mismatch does not exceed the sensing tolerance budget and total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$) complies with readout development requirements.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Boundary Routing Interconnect Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC pitch gauge / CD-SEM |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout 3D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) |
| **Cell Readout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | SPICE transient readout simulation ($C_s \ge 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$) |
| **Cell Retention Leakage Budget** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE corner analysis at $85^\circ\text{C}$ junction temperature |

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

Inter-Array Pitch Dev┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│

C_BL Shield Rejection┤████████████████████████████████ │

                     0.0    24.6    49.1    73.7   98.2 
```

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context applied*: Specifies the bitline and wordline pitch constraint of **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$**, and minimum cell capacitance $C_s$ of **$25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$** for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - *Context applied*: Directly provides nominal bitline parasitic capacitance target **$C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$**, precharge level of $V_{DD}/2$, and signal development differential margin **$\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$** derived from $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
- **Source 3: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Context applied*: Specifies access transistor dimensions **$L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$**, minimum capacitance requirement of **$28\text{ fF}$**, and sub-threshold leakage limit **$< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$**.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Automated Rule-Based Dummy Metal Fill Synthesis & Insertion

**Module / Task:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion` > `Automated Rule-Based Dummy Metal Fill Synthesis & Insertion`  
**Process Technology:** 180nm CMOS DRAM Generation (Gen 2, $\mu$m)  
**Action Type:** Make / Circuit Layout Implementation

#### 1. Workflow Architecture & Synthesis Lifecycle

```text

│                      │
│   Read GDSII/OASIS   │

│                      │

            │
            ▼

│  Generate Exclusion  │
│   Halos & Density    │
│       Windows        │

            ▼

│                      │
│   Synthesize Dummy   │
│     Metal Tiles      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼

│                      │
│   DRC & Parasitic    │
│      Extraction      │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Database Ingestion & Layout Hierarchy Freezing:**
   - Ingest target layout (GDSII/OASIS) covering the sense amplifier boundary, equalizer circuits, bitline twists, and pitch-matched memory array boundary.
   - Lock critical functional layers: Active/OD ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$ access transistor footprint), Polysilicon/Wordline, Stacked Capacitor/Crown regions, Bitline contacts, and Signal Metal-1/Metal-2 interconnects.
2. **Exclusion Halo & Density Window Setup:**
   - Define keep-out (exclusion) halos around sensitive differential folded bitlines ($\text{BL}/\overline{\text{BL}}$) and high-impedance sense amplifier nodes to prevent parasitic capacitance imbalance.
   - Set up sliding density analysis windows across boundary routing regions to scan local metal density gradients.
3. **Automated Dummy Tile Synthesis:**
   - Generate staggered, floating or grounded dummy metal patterns (Metal-1: target thickness calibrated to $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$) conforming to the 180nm minimum interconnect pitch rules ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Fill low-density micro-zones while maintaining design rule clearances from signal tracks to prevent CMP dishing/erosion during chemical-mechanical planarization.
4. **Physical DRC & Density Check:**
   - Execute DRC deck verifying metal area density limits, minimum dummy-to-signal space, and dummy-to-dummy spacing across all sliding windows.
5. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Budget Verification:**
   - Run parasitic RC extraction on folded bitlines and equalizer interconnects.
   - Ensure the incremental coupling capacitance introduced by dummy fill does not degrade the storage cell capacitor operating budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$, minimum $25 - 30\text{ fF}$ retention margin).

---

```text
  Rs (mOhm/sq)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │
 M1 Thick (nm)┤█████████████████████████████████████   │
              │█████████████████████████████████████   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        95        190      285      380
```

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Fill DRC Density Compliance Verification & Full Parasitic Extraction (PEX)

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-DES-005`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & Layout Verification — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Target:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Sense Amplifier & Boundary Routing Verification  

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: Merge Layout  │
│    & GDS Stream-In     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Automated    │
│  Metal & Poly Density  │
│       Rule Check       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Step 3:         │
│   Pattern-Dependent    │
│      CMP Optical       │
│       Simulation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 4: 3D Field    │
│    Solver Parasitic    │
│     Extraction PEX     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 5: Post-Extract  │
│   Signal & RC Delay    │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream-In & Hierarchy Flattening / Merge**:
   - Merge the boundary routing, shielding traces, and dummy metal fill layers (Metal 1–Metal 3, Poly, and Contact/Via plugs) into the top-level folded bitline sense amplifier block.
   - Verify layout connectivity, pin placements, and layer mapping consistency.

2. **Automated Design Rule Check (DRC) Density Verification**:
   - Execute DRC density verification across moving inspection windows (typically $20\,\mu\text{m} \times 20\,\mu\text{m}$ to $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ stepped at $50\%$ overlap) on active routing layers and fill regions.
   - Check local metal density against design manual window constraints (preventing dielectric dishing and metal erosion during CMP). Ensure wordline and bitline pitches remain strictly within $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$ bounds.

3. **Pattern-Dependent Chemical-Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Modeling**:
   - Perform post-fill surface topography and thickness variation analysis to confirm dielectric/metal planarity prior to ILD/IMD deposition.
   - Flag any density gradient spikes along array boundaries and sense amplifier pitch-matching interfaces.

4. **3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Run calibrated field solver PEX on the post-fill layout extracting coupled distributed RC networks ($R$, $C_{\text{coupled}}$, $C_{\text{ground}}$).
   - Characterize coupling capacitance between complementary bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) and dummy metal shielding lines, accounting for the stacked capacitor (COB crown/cylinder) over the bitline contact.

5. **Back-Annotated Post-Layout Signal Development Sign-off**:
   - Back-annotate extracted parasitics into the folded bitline sense amplifier testbench.
   - Simulate charge sharing and signal development upon wordline activation:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Confirm differential voltage $\Delta V$ and sub-threshold leakage margins under high-temperature corner conditions ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                     │
Max Leakage (fA)┤░                                     │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Delta V (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_BL / 10 (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
        C_s (fF)┤█████████                             │
                │█████████                             │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     31.2      62.5     93.8   125.0 
```

| Metric # | Parameter / Acceptance Criteria | Target Value & Unit | Physical Tolerance / Boundary |
|:---:|:---|:---:|:---|
| **AC-1** | Minimum Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 25.0\text{ to }28.0\,\text{fF}$ | Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity; must not drop below $25\,\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-2** | Extracted Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$) | $\le 250.0\,\text{fF}$ | Post-fill lumped distributed $C_{\text{BL}}$ baseline |
| **AC-3** | Post-Extract Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$) | $100.0\text{ to }150.0\,\text{mV}$ | Minimum sense margin developed on $\text{BL}/\overline{\text{BL}}$ differential pair |
| **AC-4** | Access Transistor Sub-threshold / Junction Leakage | $\le 1.0\,\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured/simulated at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain $>64\,\text{ms}$ retention interval |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.
   - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
   - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
   - Precharge to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; cell charge dump $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Differential signal development formula: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.
   - Parametric baseline: $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\,\text{fF}$, yielding signal $\Delta V \approx 100\,\text{mV}\text{ to }150\,\text{mV}$.

3. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ layout; minimum cell capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Array bitline and wordline pitch constrained to approximately $360\,\text{nm}\text{ to }400\,\text{nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)
**Node / Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Hierarchy**: [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) [Metrology]  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│      Layout GDSII / OASIS       │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        DRC Verification         │
│   (Width, Spacing, Density)     │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        LVS Extraction &         │
│         Netlist Compare         │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        PEX Parasitic RC         │
│      Extraction (BL & /BL)      │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│    Back-Annotated Post-Layout   │
│      Read Margin Simulation     │
│                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDSII Ingestion & DRC Verification**:
   - Stream in the pitch-matched folded bitline sense amplifier array layout database (GDSII / OASIS format).
   - Execute DRC deck enforcing 180nm foundry design rules, specifically validating:
     - Access transistor gate dimension checks: Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - 8F² folded bitline cell area constraint: Unit cell pitch footprint must equal $0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$ ($8 \times (0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m})^2$).
     - Stacked capacitor crown/MIM layer enclosure and tungsten contact plug (W-plug) alignment rules over the drain contact.
   - Ensure clean DRC rule log with `0` violations before proceeding.

2. **Device Recognition & LVS Netlist Extraction**:
   - Run layout device extraction to extract:
     - 1T1C storage cells, equalization NMOS networks, and CMOS cross-coupled inverter sense amplifier latches.
     - Stacked capacitor nodes ($C_s$) utilizing high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer / ONO stacks ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Execute LVS comparison between extracted netlist and schematic netlist.
   - Verify 1-to-1 pin and topological match for complementary bitline pairs (`BL` and `/BL`), wordlines (`WL`), sense enable lines (`SAN`, `SAP`), and bitline equalization precharge rails ($V_{DD}/2$).

3. **Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Extract full parasitic resistance ($R$) and parasitic capacitance ($C$) across bitline tracks (`BL`, `/BL`) for blocks containing 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Extract coupling capacitance ($C_{c}$) between adjacent folded bitline pairs and ground capacitance ($C_g$).
   - Extract storage node capacitance $C_s$ and verify dielectric parameters.
   - Export DSPF/SPEF back-annotated parasitic netlist.

4. **Post-Layout Signal Development & Margin Validation**:
   - Instantiate back-annotated netlist in SPICE transient simulation.
   - Precharge `BL` and `/BL` to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Assert wordline to dump storage charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto `BL`.
   - Calculate developed differential read voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Confirm sensing margin and sense amplifier activation prior to latching.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
  Margin dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
 C_BL (Limit fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
C_s (Nominal fF)┤█████                                 │
                │█████                                 │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extracted PEX Netlist |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $150.0 \text{ to } 250.0$ (Max $\le 250.0$) | $\text{fF}$ (for 256–512 cells/BL) | PEX Bitline Trace Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_{BL} / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (Hard Limit $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless ratio | PEX Parameter Calculation |
| **Differential Voltage Read Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Back-Annotated SPICE Simulation |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines `BL` and `/BL`.
  - Bitline precharge / equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Charge dump formulation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ and differential voltage swing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Baseline nominal target: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, delivering developed differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ unit footprint ($0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
  - Storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Array block bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
  - Strict capacitance budget constraint $C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$; hard degradation boundary at $C_b / C_s > 10:1$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM structure with W-plug over drain contact.
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric / ONO layer effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, maintaining $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Rule Deck Execution & Pitch-Matched Sense Amplifier Geometry Clean-up

**Node / Process Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`Gen 2 (µm)`)  
**Discipline**: Metrology / Layout Verification  
**Full Document**: [sop_drc_pitch_matched_sense_amp.md](docs/sop_drc_pitch_matched_sense_amp.md)

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Load GDSII Layout    │
│   and 180nm DRC Deck   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Execute Hierarchical  │
│       DRC Engine       │◄─╮
│                        │  │
└────────────┬───────────┘  │
             │              │
             │              │
             ▼              │
┌────────────◇───────────┐  │
│                        │  │
│  Violations Present?   │  │
│                        │  │
└────────────◇───────────┘  │
             │              │
             │              │
             ├──────────────┼──────────────╮No
          Yes│              │              │
             ▼              │              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐  │ ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │  │ │                        │
│   Clean-up SA Local    │  │ │    DRC-Clean Layout    │
│        Geometry        │  │ │   Frozen for PEX and   │
│                        │  │ │          LVS           │
│                        │  │ │                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘  │ └────────────────────────┘
             │              │
             │              │
             ▼              │
┌────────────────────────┐  │
│                        │  │
│   Adjust Interleaved   │  │
│     Pitch to 360nm     ├──╯
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Environment & Rule Deck Initialization**:
   - Ingest GDSII/OASIS design database containing the folded-bitline array core, equalizers, and sense amplifier strips.
   - Load foundry-certified 180nm open-source DRC rules (Diffusion, Poly, Contact/Via, Metal 1–3).
   - Configure hierarchical partitioning to isolate cell abutment borders and pitch transition regions.

2. **Pitch-Matched Sense Amplifier Alignment & Boundary Checks**:
   - Inspect the sense amplifier boundary against the memory array bitline pitch; verify cell pitch equals exactly **360 nm**.
   - Validate interleaved staggered layout placements ($2\times$ or $4\times$ array pitch) allowing cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS pairs to fit within lateral physical design rules.
   - Verify access transistor boundary dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and contact enclosures.

3. **DRC Rule Deck Execution**:
   - Run the full batch DRC engine over the sense amp macros and adjacent bitline routing.
   - Categorize output violations into minimum spacing (Metal 1 BL/BLB tracks), poly gate extensions, and contact overlap enclosures.

4. **Geometry Clean-up & Differential Symmetry Preservation**:
   - Push/pull violating polygons to satisfy clearance margins while maintaining strictly identical path lengths and geometries for `BL` and `/BL` to prevent offset voltages.
   - Center precharge/equalization ($V_{DD}/2$) transistor source/drain taps.
   - Perform incremental DRC runs until **0 violations** remain.

5. **Sign-Off & Layout Freezing**:
   - Verify layout database integrity and export frozen DRC-clean GDSII to subsequent LVS and Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) workflows.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   Critical Geometric and Target Metrics
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░                               │
        Min Cell Cs┤░░░░                               │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │

    Access Length L┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                 │
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                 │
Pitch Matched Pitch┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       90      180      270    360 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline Pitch-Match** | `360` | $\pm 0.0$ (Strict Grid Lock) | `nm` | DRC Automated Pitch Deck Check |
| **Sense Amp Pitch DRC Violations** | `0` | Absolute Zero | `count` | 180nm DRC Rule Deck Output Log |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | $\pm 0.0$ (Nominal Drawn) | `nm` | Poly Gate Length DRC Deck Metric |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | $\pm 0.0$ (Nominal Drawn) | `nm` | Active Diffusion Width DRC Metric |
| **Minimum Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget** | $\ge 28$ | Hard floor (soft-error immunity) | `fF` | Post-Layout PEX Extraction |

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *"Sense amplifier pitch must match memory array bitline pitch (360 nm in 180nm node), requiring interleaved layout."*
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; differential voltage $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; with typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum storage capacitance budget: $28\text{ fF}$ per cell for alpha-particle soft error immunity; leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.

```text
│  Folded BL Symmetry &  │
│     Topology Audit     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       LVS Clean        │
│   Verification Pass    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Prerequisite GDSII & Connectivity Preparation:**
   - Confirm DRC clean sign-off on the folded bitline memory array block and pitch-matched sense amplifier latch bank.
   - Verify layout text pin attachments (`BL`, `/BL`, `WL<0:N>`, `EQ`, `SAN`, `SAP`, `V_DD`, `V_SS`, `V_BL_EQ` / $V_{DD}/2$) on their corresponding routing metal/poly layers with strict hierarchy port preservation.

2. **Rule Deck Compilation & Device Extraction:**
   - Execute LVS extraction rule deck (e.g., open-source Magic / Netgen or KLayout DRC/LVS).
   - Recognize 1T1C access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) sharing tungsten bitline plugs (W-plugs), stacked storage capacitor terminals ($C_s$), and CMOS cross-coupled inverter pairs (NMOS pulldowns and PMOS pullups).
   - Generate layout-extracted netlist (`layout_extracted.spice`) retaining geometric parameters ($W$, $L$, and parasitic port assignments).

3. **Topology Equivalence Comparison (LVS Netlist Match):**
   - Run two-way graph isomorphism comparison between golden schematic SPICE (`schematic.spice`) and `layout_extracted.spice`.
   - Cross-check port labeling, transistor finger splitting, dummy devices, and shared drain/source junction topologies.
   - Resolve any topological discrepancies (e.g., node swap, pin mismatch, floating wells, or soft substrate ties).

4. **Folded Bitline Differential Topology & Symmetry Cross-Check:**
   - Audit the pitch-matched sense amplifier cross-coupling connections ensuring complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ intersect the differential latch nodes with mirrored parasitic parity.
   - Inspect the equalization transistor network to verify true symmetric connection across $BL$ and $/BL$ tied to the precharge bias line ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Confirm storage node connectivity through the W-plug stacked capacitor layer to substrate/plate nodes without shorting adjacent bitline metal tracks.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Parameter | Metric / Bound | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\Delta L = 0\text{ nm}$, $\Delta W = 0\text{ nm}$ (Zero netlist mismatch) |
| **Bitline & Wordline Layout Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Measured metallization/poly pitch must fall within $[360, 400]\text{ nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Node Target Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25 \text{ to } 30$ (Minimum: $28$) | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ |
| **Topological Netlist Discrepancy Count** | $0$ | $\text{errors}$ | Netgen/LVS report: Unmatched nets $= 0$, unmatched devices $= 0$ |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between adjacent cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell (dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$).
- **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ cell storage capacitor nominal baseline: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch budget: $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **[Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture connected between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ with precharge equalization network to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) & Differential Bitline Signal-Margin Metrology

- **Location**: [docs/sop/sop_pex_bitline_signal_margin_metrology.md](docs/sop/sop_pex_bitline_signal_margin_metrology.md)
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) | Gen 2 ($\mu$m)
- **Action Type**: Make | Metrology

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Layout & Layer  │
│      Stack Input       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       LVS Clean        │
│      Connectivity      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3D Field Solver PEX   │
│    & RC Extraction     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Back-Annotated     │
│    Transistor-Level    │
│   Netlist Generation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Bitline    │
│     Signal-Margin      │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Full-Rail        │
│  Restoration & Noise   │
│       Validation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layout Connectivity & Physical Ingestion**:
   - Ingest physical GDSII/OASIS design database containing the memory cell array and folded bitline sense amplifiers.
   - Verify array pitch matches the 180nm standard: Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and pitch-matched array bitline pitch at exactly $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Run Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) to establish verified device and net connectivity across $BL$, $/BL$, and storage nodes.

2. **3D/2.5D Field Solver Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Load calibrated 180nm BEOL/FEOL layer profiles with tungsten plug ($W$-plug) contacts.
   - Extract lumped and distributed wire resistance ($R_{BL}$) and total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$), accounting for intra-pair and inter-pair coupling capacitance ($C_c$).
   - Back-annotate cell storage capacitance $C_s$ into the extracted DSPF/SPEF netlist.

3. **Precharge & Signal Development Setup**:
   - Establish initial conditions with complementary bitlines equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Assert wordline ($V_{WL} = V_{PP}$) across access transistors to dump cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto $BL$.

4. **Transient Differential Signal-Margin Metrology & Sense Latching**:
   - Probe dynamic differential voltage development $\Delta V = |V_{BL} - V_{/BL}|$ prior to sense amplifier latching:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Activate regenerative latching strobes ($SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$).
   - Verify full-rail CMOS level swing ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) and $100\%$ charge restoration back into the 1T1C storage cell.
   - Characterize access transistor leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to confirm refresh retention margin.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
Signal Margin dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
 Bitline Cap CBL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
     Cell Cap Cs (fF)┤███                              │
                     │███                              │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      90      180     270    360 
```

| Acceptance Metric | Target Specification | Metrology Mode | Physical Significance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Pitch** | **$360\text{ nm}$** | Automated DRC GDSII Measurement | Interleaved sense amp pitch-matching |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$250\text{ fF}$** nominal | PEX 3D Field Extraction | Total parasitics per column net |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$25\text{ fF}$** (nominal) / **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$** (budget) | PEX & C-V Extraction | Alpha-particle & coupling immunity |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | Transient Differential Probe | Sensing window before $SAN$/$SAP$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | **$\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | DC Off-State Leakage Metrology | Retention interval & refresh integrity |

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Signal split relationship: $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$.
  - Differential signal range: $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Sensing sequence: Precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, strobe activation ($SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$) driving full rails ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) with $100\%$ charge restore.
  - Pitch constraints: Sense amplifier layout pitch-matched to array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor parameters: Gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitor requirement: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget for noise immunity.
  - Leakage constraint: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
