# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Hierarchical Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Charge Pump Generator

**Discipline / Category**: DRAM Circuit Design  
**Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source CMOS  
**Wordline Boosted Voltage ($V_{PP}$)**: $2.50\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ (Prevents NMOS $V_{th}$ drop)  
**Row Cycle Time ($t_{RC}$)**: $55.0\text{ ns}$ | **Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$)**: $15.0\text{ ns}$

---

### 1. Hierarchical Row Architecture & Block Diagram

```text
Row Address Bits [A0:A8] (512 Rows per Bank)
        │
        ├─► [ 3-to-8 Predecoder Tree ] ──────────► Predecoded Lines [PRE_A, PRE_B, PRE_C]
        │                                                     │
        │                                                     ▼
        │                                       ┌───────────────────────────┐
        │                                       │   Main Wordline Driver    │
        │                                       │          (MWD)            │
        │                                       └─────────────┬─────────────┘
        │                                                     │
        │                                                     ▼
        │                                       ┌───────────────────────────┐
        │                                       │ High-Voltage Level Shifter│
        │                                       │    (0-1.8V -> 0-2.5V VPP) │
        │                                       └─────────────┬─────────────┘
        │                                                     │
        ▼                                                     ▼
  [ Dickson VPP Charge Pump ] ─────────────────► Sub-Wordline Driver (SWD)
    (4-stage 40MHz oscillator)                                │
                                                              ▼
                                                    Selected Wordline (WL)
                                                 (Drives 256 Cell Gates @ 2.5V)
```

---

### 2. Four-Stage Dickson $V_{PP}$ Charge Pump Architecture

To eliminate the $V_{th}$ threshold drop of the NMOS cell access transistor ($V_{cell} = V_{WL} - V_{th} = 1.8\text{ V} - 0.55\text{ V} = 1.25\text{ V}$), the wordline must be driven by boosted high voltage:

$$V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th(access)} + \Delta V_{overdrive} = 1.80\text{ V} + 0.55\text{ V} + 0.15\text{ V} = 2.50\text{ V}$$

#### Charge Pump Equations:
For an $N$-stage pump ($N = 4$) with clock amplitude $V_{\phi} = 1.80\text{ V}$, flying capacitor $C_{pump} = 25\text{ pF}$, and oscillator frequency $f_{osc} = 40\text{ MHz}$:

$$V_{out} = V_{DD} + N \cdot \left( \frac{C_{pump}}{C_{pump} + C_{str}} V_{\phi} - V_{diode} \right) - \frac{I_{load}}{f_{osc} (C_{pump} + C_{str})}$$

- Flying capacitor: $C_{pump} = 25\text{ pF}$ (MIM capacitor stack)
- Decoupling reservoir capacitor: $C_{res} = 650\text{ pF}$ (maintains $V_{PP}$ ripple $\le 25\text{ mV}$ peak-to-peak)
- Wordline Driver buffer chain: Tapered fanout ($1.0\times, 3.16\times, 10.0\times, 31.6\times$) driving $2.2\text{ pF}$ lumped wordline capacitance with rise time $t_r \le 1.8\text{ ns}$.

---

### 3. Acceptance Verification & Timing Performance Envelope

| Parameter / Metric | Minimum | Typical | Maximum | Units | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Boosted Supply Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.45$ | $2.50$ | $2.55$ | $\text{V}$ | Digital Multimeter / High-Z Probe |
| **$V_{PP}$ Voltage Ripple ($V_{rip}$)** | $-$ | $18.0$ | $25.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | $500\text{ MHz}$ Digital Oscilloscope |
| **Wordline Rise Time ($t_r$, 10% to 90%)** | $1.2$ | $1.8$ | $2.5$ | $\text{ns}$ | Active Picoprobe (Load: 2.2 pF) |
| **Row Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$)** | $12.0$ | $14.5$ | $15.0$ | $\text{ns}$ | Automated ATE Test Pattern |
| **Decoder Standby Power** | $-$ | $45.0$ | $120.0$ | $\mu\text{W}$ | Current Sense Resistor |
citations: Dickson, J. - On-Chip High-Voltage Generation in MNOS Integrated Circuits (IEEE JSSC)
Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: Address Decoders and Wordline Drivers
SkyWater SKY130 PDK High-Voltage Device Models (5.0V / 2.5V Devices)

# Standard Operating Procedure: Dickson Charge Pump $V_{PP}$ Generator & Level Shifter Design

**Subsystem**: Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Dickson Charge Pump $V_{PP}$ Generator & Level Shifter Design  
**Technology Generation**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Documentation Artifact**: [sop_dickson_charge_pump_vpp_level_shifter.md](docs/sop_dickson_charge_pump_vpp_level_shifter.md)

---

### Architectural Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Ring Oscillator CLK  │
│        / CLKB         │◄───────────╮
│                       │            │
└───────────┬───────────┘            │
            │                        │
            │                        │
            ▼                        │
┌───────────────────────┐            │
│                       │            │
│    4-Stage Dickson    │            │
│      Charge Pump      │            │Feedback Enable/Disable
│                       │            │
└───────────┬───────────┘            │
            │                        │
            ├────────────────────────┼───────────────────────╮
            ▼                        │                       ▼
┌───────────────────────┐            │           ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │            │           │                       │
│    VPP Regulator &    │            │           │    Wordline Driver    │
│      Hysteresis       ├────────────╯           │     Level Shifter     │
│      Comparator       │                        │                       │
│                       │                        │                       │
└───────────────────────┘                        └───────────┬───────────┘
                                                             │
            ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      1T1C Access      │
│  Transistor Wordline  │
│          WL           │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Non-Overlapping Clock Phase Generator**:
   - Synthesize complementary two-phase non-overlapping clocks ($\Phi$ and $\bar{\Phi}$) using a voltage-controlled ring oscillator and cross-coupled NAND logic to eliminate shoot-through current and prevent charge backflow between adjacent pump stages.
2. **Dickson Charge Pump Design & Stage Sizing**:
   - Construct a multi-stage Dickson charge pump using cross-coupled / dynamic body-biased NMOS pass transistors to eliminate $V_{th}$ drops per stage.
   - Size pumping capacitors (MIM or poly-insulator-poly) to support dynamic active wordline transitions and satisfy load requirements while dampening peak clock-feedthrough ripple.
3. **Closed-Loop $V_{PP}$ Voltage Regulation**:
   - Deploy a high-impedance resistive ladder and a low-power bandgap-referenced hysteresis comparator (with a $20\,\text{mV}$ deadband) that toggles the pump oscillator enable line when $V_{PP}$ reaches the programmed target, maintaining stability and low standby power.
4. **Wordline Driver Level Shifter Synthesis**:
   - Implement cross-coupled dual-rail level shifters capable of translating core logic pulses ($0\,\text{V} \rightarrow V_{DD}$) to boosted wordline drive rails ($0\,\text{V} \rightarrow V_{PP}$).
   - Guard against hot-carrier injection and oxide stress by ensuring gate oxide electric fields do not exceed dielectric safety margins for the access transistor's $3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical gate oxide thickness.
5. **PVT & Dynamic Load Validation**:
   - Execute transient SPICE characterizations across TT, FF, SS process corners at $-40^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$ with lumped parasitic capacitances for bitline ($C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$) and storage node ($C_s = 25\,\text{fF} \text{--} 28\,\text{fF}$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ (range: $25.0 - 30.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Quasi-static C-V test & post-layout extraction |
| **Bitline Readout Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 - 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded bitline transient sense amp simulation ($C_{BL}=250\,\text{fF}$) |
| **Access Transistor Leakage Current** | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold & junction leakage DC test ($V_{WL} = 0\,\text{V}$) |
| **Access Gate Dielectric Thickness** | $\sim 3.5$ (Capacitor EOT: $3.0 - 4.0$) | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / TEM physical oxide cross-section |

#### Parameter Target Distribution:
```text
               Critical Design Parameter Targets        
       ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │░░                                             │
    EOT┤░░                                             │
       │▒                                              │
Leakage┤▒                                              │
Delta_V┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 CS_Cap┤██████████                                     │
       │██████████                                     │
       └┬───────────┬──────────┬───────────┬──────────┬┘
       0.0        37.5       75.0        112.5    150.0 
```

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Sources

- **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$); minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\,\text{fF}$ per cell; sub-threshold and junction leakage target $\le 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.*
- **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *1T1C stacked cell capacitor retention metric requiring $25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ per cell for retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\,\text{nm}$ to $4\,\text{nm}$; gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.*
- **Source 3: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - *Folded bitline charge sharing relationship $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; nominal bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$ and cell capacitance $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ yielding differential signal development window of $100\,\text{mV}$ to $150\,\text{mV}$.*

```text
                 │█████████████████████████████████████│
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       55       110      165     220 
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure Summary

1. **Address Predecoder Sizing ($V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ Domain)**:
   - Partition address bits ($RA[0:1]$, $RA[2:4]$) into 2-to-4 and 3-to-8 static CMOS NAND predecoder trees ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set stage electrical effort $h \approx 3.0 \text{ to } 3.6$ ($W_p = 2.0 - 3.6\text{ µm}$, $W_n = 1.2 - 2.4\text{ µm}$) to drive global predecode lines.
2. **Level Shifter Interfacing ($1.8\text{ V } V_{DD} \rightarrow 2.5\text{ V - } 2.8\text{ V } V_{PP}$)**:
   - Cross-coupled PMOS level shifters with NMOS pulldown branches.
   - Employ thick-oxide/extended-drain transistors ($> 3.3\text{ V}$ breakdown) with latch PMOS $W/L = 1.5\text{ µm} / 0.35\text{ µm}$ and pulldown NMOS $W/L = 3.0\text{ µm} / 0.18\text{ µm}$ to ensure contention-free switching.
3. **Sub-Wordline Driver (SWD) Sizing & Pitch-Matching**:
   - Layout-matched to the $2F = 360\text{ nm}$ wordline pitch driving access NMOS gates ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Pull-up boost driver $W_{pu} = 2.4 - 3.2\text{ µm}$ ($L = 0.35\text{ µm}$), pull-down driver $W_{pd} = 1.8 - 2.4\text{ µm}$ ($L = 180\text{ nm}$), and wordline clamp device $W = 0.5\text{ µm}$ to hold deactivated wordlines at $V_{SS}$.
4. **RC Load Extraction & Far-End Rise Time Verification**:
   - Extract lumped distributed RC loading for 256/512 access cell gates ($C_{WL,total} \approx 180\text{ fF}$) to verify far-end rise time and preserve sense margin.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Boost Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5 \le V_{PP} \le 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Transient SPICE / Post-layout Simulation |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0$ ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, $C_b = 150 - 250\text{ fF}$) | Ratio (dimensionless) | Extracted Netlist Metrology / LVS |
| **Wordline Far-End Rise Time ($t_{rise, 10\%-90\%}$)** | $\le 2.2$ | $\text{ns}$ | Distributed RC SPICE transient analysis |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180 \pm 5$, $W = 220 \pm 8$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC / GDS Layout Metrology |

---

### 5. Verified Literature Citations

- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: Overdrive voltage requirement $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$ to eliminate NMOS threshold loss ($V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture with $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($0.259\text{ µm}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$), $C_b = 150 - 250\text{ fF}$, and strict capacitance ratio limit $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DRAM-DEC-002: Hierarchical Address Predecoder Tree & Multi-Stage Logic Topology Design

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the engineering procedure for designing, sizing, level-translating, and physically verifying the hierarchical row/column address predecoder tree and multi-stage logic topology in a 180nm open-source DRAM architecture. It covers the logic decomposition from address buffers ($V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$) through level conversion up to boosted wordline driver interfaces ($V_{PP} = 2.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$) driving folded bitline memory cell matrices.

---

### 2. Architecture & Signal Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Address Latches /    │
│  Buffers (VDD = 1.8V)  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Stage 1: Tree      │
│  Predecoder (2-to-4 /  │
│      3-to-8 NAND)      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Stage 2: Level     │
│       Shifting &       │
│   High-Voltage Gate    │
│     (VDD to VPP =      │
│       2.5V-2.8V)       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Stage 3:        │
│  Sub-Wordline Driver   │
│  Matrix & Array Cell   │
│       Selection        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Address Bus Partitioning & Predecoder Grouping
1. Group row address bits ($RA[n:0]$) into 2-bit or 3-bit predecode clusters to minimize layout pitch routing congestion and gate fan-in:
   - Implement 2-to-4 predecoders using dual-input static NAND gates for low-order address pairs.
   - Implement 3-to-8 predecoders using triple-input NAND gates for bank/block address groups.
2. Maintain standard logic core supply voltage at $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ for the predecoder tree stage to minimize dynamic charging power across global predecoder buslines.

#### Step 2: Multi-Stage Fan-Out & Driver Sizing
1. Establish multi-stage logical effort tapering across predecode lines to drive the physical array row pitch:
   - Size predecoder branch inverters and buffers targeting an optimal stage effort ($h \approx 3\text{ to }4$).
   - Match output capacitance driving capabilities to the distributed array pitch lines.
2. For the final sub-wordline driver stage interfacing with the access transistors:
   - Ensure the driver drives the unit access transistor channel geometry of channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$ and width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Ensure wordline driver sizing accounts for the stacked capacitor storage node loading ($C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$) plus parasitic bitline/wordline cross-coupling capacitances.

#### Step 3: Voltage Domain Conversion & Overdrive Protection
1. Route the on-chip boosted supply rail from the Dickson charge pump ($V_{PP} = 2.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$) into the post-predecoder level-shifter and sub-wordline driver wells.
2. Configure high-voltage level shifters to transition predecoded select signals from $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ logic levels to $V_{PP} = 2.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$.
3. Ensure $V_{PP}$ overdrive eliminates threshold voltage loss ($V_{th} \sim 0.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }0.7\,\text{V}$, preventing the $V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.8\,\text{V} - 0.6\,\text{V} = 1.2\,\text{V}$ write limit), restoring full $1.8\,\text{V}$ signal writing to the storage node.

#### Step 4: OpenROAD Physical Implementation Flow
1. **Floorplanning & Power Grid**:
   - Initialize macro boundaries, insert tap cells/well ties, and create dual-rail power distribution networks (PDN) containing separate $V_{DD}$ ($1.8\,\text{V}$) and $V_{PP}$ ($2.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$) straps.
2. **Global & Detailed Placement**:
   - Place predecoder standard cells along array perimeter channels; run automatic placement optimization to repair max slew, max capacitance, and max fanout violations.
   - Legalize placement to grid ensuring design rule compliance.
3. **Clock Tree & Setup/Hold Optimization**:
   - Insert and balance address latch buffers; optimize setup and hold timing across address decoding cycles.
4. **Global/Detailed Routing & Extraction**:
   - Run antenna repair and generate DRC-clean routing paths across multi-metal stacks.
   - Perform parasitic RC extraction using OpenRCX, followed by final static timing analysis (STA) and physical verification.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Logic Core Supply Voltage ($V_{DD}$)** | $1.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Static Rail Analysis / OpenROAD PDN Signoff |
| **Boosted Wordline Driver Rail ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5 \le V_{PP} \le 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Transient Simulation / Charge Pump DC Signoff |
| **Access Transistor Gate Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC / GDS Layout Extraction Signoff |
| **Storage Node Target Capacitance Loading** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | OpenRCX Parasitic Extraction / 3D Cap Profiling |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Extraction |

---

### 5. Literature Sources Cited

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$), storage node capacitance budget ($\ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$), and leakage current ceiling ($< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
2. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**
   - Core voltage ($V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$), NMOS threshold voltage ($V_{th} \sim 0.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }0.7\,\text{V}$), $V_{th}$-loss analysis ($1.2\,\text{V}$ degradation), and high-voltage wordline overdrive target ($V_{PP} = 2.5\,\text{V}\text{ to }2.8\,\text{V}$).
3. **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**
   - Automated RTL-to-GDSII flow steps: Floorplanning & PDN creation, Global Placement with max slew/capacitance/fanout repair, Detailed Placement legalization, Global/Detailed DRC routing, and OpenRCX parasitic extraction.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture (Dickson, J. - IEEE JSSC On-Chip High-Voltage Generation in MNOS Integrated Circuits)
OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-OpenROAD-Project/OpenROAD/master/README.md)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Predecoder Logic Network Topology Synthesis & Logic Effort Gate Sizing
**Module Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Hierarchical Address Predecoder Tree & Multi-Stage Logic Topology Design > Predecoder Logic Network Topology Synthesis & Logic Effort Gate Sizing  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Network Topology & Synthesis Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Row Address Buffer   │
│         Inputs         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  NAND Predecoder Tree  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      CMOS Tapered      │
│    Inverter Buffer     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wordline Load Pitch   │
│         360nm          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Input Load & Interconnect Extraction**:
   - Extract the physical pitch and parasitic routing capacitance of the target array wordline drivers matched to the wordline layout pitch constraint of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Constrain the minimum channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ across all NMOS and PMOS logic gates in the predecoder network.

2. **Predecoder Network Topology Partitioning**:
   - Group raw internal address lines into 2-to-4 or 3-to-8 predecoded bundle groups using multi-input static CMOS NAND gates to minimize global address routing line transitions and active dynamic power.
   - Set the gate oxide physical thickness to $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).

3. **Logical Effort ($g$) and Electrical Effort ($h$) Sizing**:
   - Compute stage effort $f = g \cdot h$ across the predecoder path where the 2-input NAND gate possesses logical effort $g_{\text{NAND2}} = 4/3$ and 3-input NAND $g_{\text{NAND3}} = 5/3$.
   - Scale individual transistor widths progressively from initial address receiver buffers up to the final predecoded driver stages, setting the baseline unit access/logic pull-down width to $W = 220\text{ nm}$ for $L = 180\text{ nm}$.

4. **Transient Simulation & Dynamic Delay Verification**:
   - Execute SPICE corner sweeps (TT, FF, SS) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate predecoder propagation delay and output transition slew rate driving the wordline line load.
   - Verify that output slew transitions drive the wordline decoding hierarchy with zero logic hazards or subthreshold glitching to prevent partial access transistor turn-on and cell leakage.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Constraint | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Logic Gate Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | `nm` | Exact / DRC Nominal | GDSII DRC / Extracted Netlist LVS |
| **Transistor Unit Width Baseline ($W$)** | `220` | `nm` | $\pm 5\%$ | Layout LVS & Parameter Extraction |
| **Wordline Wiring Grid Pitch Constraint** | `360` to `400` | `nm` | Pitch boundary range | Physical DRC Design Rule Check |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | `nm` | Process spec ($\text{SiO}_2$ dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) | In-line Ellipsometry / TEM / SPICE Model Spec |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline and cell junction leakage constraints at operational junction temperature $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Bitline and wordline pitch defined at approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Task: Multi-Stage Decoder Transistor-Level Schematic Implementation & Interconnect Buffering
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Hierarchical Address Predecoder Tree & Multi-Stage Logic Topology Design > Multi-Stage Decoder Transistor-Level Schematic Implementation & Interconnect Buffering  
**Node Generation**: Gen 2 ($180\,\text{nm}$)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Implementation Procedure

1. **Predecoder Stage Schematic Capture & Sizing**
   - Implement the tree logic network (NAND/NOR gates and inverters) to decode predecoded row/column address combinations.
   - Set standard gate oxide physical thickness to $3.5\,\text{nm}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$) with nominal access transistor gate length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$ as reference for 180nm CMOS device limits.
   - Size pull-up PMOS and pull-down NMOS network aspect ratios ($W/L$) to balance rising and falling propagation delays under worst-case corner variations.

2. **Distributed Interconnect Modeling & Layout Constraint Mapping**
   - Extract routing constraints assuming a wordline/bitline wiring pitch of $360\,\text{nm}\text{ to }400\,\text{nm}$.
   - Model the interconnect lines driving the sub-wordline decoders as distributed $\Pi$-ladder $RC$ networks, accounting for wire capacitance and neighboring line-to-line parasitic coupling.

3. **Interconnect Repeater & Buffer Insertion**
   - Insert multi-stage tapered inverter repeaters along long predecoder global interconnects to break cumulative quadratic $RC$ delays into linear stages.
   - Size driver buffer stages with progressive tapering factors (fanout-of-4 sizing guideline) to drive the high wordline load without causing supply rail collapse or excessive ground bounce.

4. **Transient Simulation & Signal Integrity Verification**
   - Run transient SPICE simulations over PVT corners (Slow-Slow, Nominal, Fast-Fast at temperatures up to $85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Verify non-overlap margins of complementary predecoder outputs to prevent spurious wordline activation and avoid race conditions during address switching.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Schematic DRC / SPICE model parameter validation |
| **Metal Pitch Constraint (Interconnect Pitch)** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC / Layout interconnect spacing rule check |
| **Nominal Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Schematic / LVS transistor parameter netlist inspection |
| **Max Operating Temperature Compliance** | $85$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Transient SPICE corner simulation under max ambient temperature |

---

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Context applied*: Gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness; bitline and wordline pitch of approximately $360\,\text{nm}\text{ to }400\,\text{nm}$; minimum channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$; thermal ceiling specification at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Context applied*: Baseline 180nm channel length geometry ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$); temperature operating threshold ($85^\circ\text{C}$) defining leakage and refresh limits across decoded blocks.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Voltage $V_{PP}$ Wordline Driver Transistor Sizing & Taper Optimization

- **Scope / Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Gen 2 (µm)
- **Classification:** Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump / Circuit Design
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Architectural Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Address Predecoder /  │
│     Level Shifter      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │ (0V to 1.8V -> 0V to V_PP)
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Intermediate Taper   │
│         Buffer         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │ (Optimized Fanout Taper Factor e ~ 3-4)
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Final High-Voltage   │
│       VPP Driver       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │ (V_PP = 2.5V - 2.8V Drive)
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wordline Array Load   │
│    L=180nm, W=220nm    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Array Wordline Capacitive & Resistive Load Extraction**:
   - Model the target distributed wordline line load based on unit cell access transistor geometry: gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with gate oxide $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($EOT \approx 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$).
   - Calculate total parasitic gate-to-channel capacitance across the wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$) accounting for cell storage capacitance $C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (25 fF to 30 fF range) to establish the total lumped/distributed array line capacitance $C_{WL\_total}$.

2. **Supply & Overdrive Voltage Boundary Establishment**:
   - Couple the final driver rail to the regulated on-chip Dickson charge pump delivery network.
   - Set driver high rail $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$ (nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, NMOS access gate $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$, eliminating the $33\%$ threshold voltage loss to ensure a full $1.8\text{ V}$ level is stored onto the cell capacitor).

3. **Level Shifter Stage Integration**:
   - Insert cross-coupled high-voltage level shifters between the standard core logic predecoder ($1.8\text{ V}$ logic swing) and the wordline driver buffer stages to transition the swing to $0\text{ V} \leftrightarrow V_{PP}$ without gate oxide breakdown.

4. **Multi-Stage Inverter Taper Optimization**:
   - Determine the required tapering factor $u$ ($u \approx 3\text{ to } 4$) across $N$ stages:
     $$N = \ln\left(\frac{C_{WL\_total}}{C_{in}}\right)$$
   - Size stage-by-stage PMOS and NMOS high-voltage thick-oxide devices proportionally. Ensure pull-up PMOS width to pull-down NMOS width ratio accounts for hole-to-electron mobility difference ($\approx 2:1$ to $2.5:1$).

5. **Physical Layout Pitch-Matching & Verification**:
   - Pitch-match the final driver output fingers to the physical DRAM wordline array pitch ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform transient spice simulations under worst-case corner ($85^\circ\text{C}$) to guarantee wordline rise/fall slew times while maintaining junction and sub-threshold leakage targets $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                    Target Acceptance Criteria Metrics  
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░                                │
   Max T_rise (ns)┤░░░░                                │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                    │
   Min C_cell (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                    │
Min Retention (ms)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   V_PP Supply (V)┤███                                 │
                  │███                                 │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0       16       32      48       64 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **$V_{PP}$ Wordline Boosted Level** | $\ge 2.5\text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Regulated output under active wordline switching |
| **Storage Node Stored Voltage ($V_{SN}$)** | $1.8$ (full $V_{DD}$, no $V_{th}$ loss) | $\text{V}$ | Write '1' into cell node with $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{--}0.7\text{ V}$ |
| **Cell Retention Time** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Measured at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$, $I_{leak} < 1\text{ fA/cell}$ |
| **Unit Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28$ ($25\text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked capacitor at $3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$ EOT |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump ($V_{PP}$) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
  - $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$; $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$; threshold loss mitigation via $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Wordline and bitline pitch $\approx 360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; physical gate oxide $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ (dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$); EOT $\approx 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$; minimum data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Wordline RC Load Extraction and Breakdown-Reliability Transistor Sizing

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Scope
This SOP defines the circuit-design and parasitic-extraction flow for calculating distributed wordline (WL) RC transmission line parameters and sizing the boosted high-voltage wordline driver ($V_{PP}$) in 180nm open-source DRAM architectures.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Extract Unit Cell WL  │
│        C and R         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Assemble Distributed  │
│       RC Ladder        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Size VPP Driver     │
│      Transistors       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Transient Rise Time   │
│        Sign-Off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Extract Unit Cell Geometric Capacitance & Parasitic Overlap:**
   - Parameterize the access transistor gate with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ across the wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Compute gate capacitance components:
     $$C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\epsilon_{\text{ox}}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$$
     where gate dielectric is dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (EOT $\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Include cell-level coupling capacitances to adjacent bitline lines (pitch $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$) and tungsten contact plug (W-plug) vertical sidewalls.

2. **Assemble Wordline Distributed RC Ladder:**
   - For an array block of $N$ access transistors per wordline, compute total wordline capacitance $C_{\text{WL\_total}} = \sum (C_{\text{gate}} + C_{\text{fringe}} + C_{\text{interconnect}})$.
   - Extract polycide/refractory metal wordline sheet resistance $R_{\square}$ and interconnect line length per unit cell ($360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).
   - Model the wordline as a multi-stage distributed $\Pi$ or T-ladder network. Calculate the far-end Elmore delay:
     $$\tau_{\text{Elmore}} = R_{\text{driver}} C_{\text{WL\_total}} + \sum_{k=1}^N R_k \left(\sum_{j=k}^N C_j\right)$$

3. **Breakdown-Reliability Transistor Sizing ($V_{PP}$ Driver):**
   - Size the final stage $V_{PP}$ pull-up PMOS and pull-down NMOS drivers against gate-oxide breakdown limits. Because the wordline carries boosted $V_{PP}$ to fully transfer high levels into the cell capacitor ($25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$ minimum budget), the gate oxide electric field under $V_{PP}$ stress must not exceed time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB) limits for $3.5\text{ nm}$ oxide thickness ($E_{\text{ox}} = V_{PP} / t_{\text{ox}}$).
   - Increase driver transistor channel length $L > 180\text{ nm}$ or implement a thick-oxide cascode topology if $V_{PP} / t_{\text{ox}}$ exceeds peak reliability limits.
   - Adjust channel width $W_{\text{driver}}$ to match driving impedance $R_{\text{driver}}$ such that total wordline rise time to 90% $V_{PP}$ meets the subarray row cycle target.

4. **SPICE Extraction & Dynamic Transient Sign-Off:**
   - Simulate corner cases (Fast-Fast, Typical-Typical, Slow-Slow) at elevated junction temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Verify that far-end wordline activation does not inject noise exceeding the margin on unselected bitlines, and confirm bitline differential sensing window ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}\text{--}150\text{ mV}$ developed from access to $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$) is preserved.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
Baseline 180nm Reliability Parameters
                         ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                         │█████████████████████████████│
   Retention Temp (deg C)┤█████████████████████████████│
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
      Min Cap Budget (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
Dielectric Thickness (nm)┤▒▒                           │
                         │▒▒                           │
                 EOT (nm)┤░░                           │
                         │░░                           │
                         └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                         0.0   21.2   42.5   63.8  85.0 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target / Tolerance Value | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-WL-01** | Access Transistor Dimensions | $L = 180 \pm 10$, $W = 220 \pm 15$ | $\text{nm}$ | GDS/OASIS DRC & LVS extraction |
| **AC-WL-02** | Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ (grown at $850\text{--}900$) | $\text{nm}$ (at $^\circ\text{C}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **AC-WL-03** | Wordline Layout Pitch | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM metrology / Layout DRC |
| **AC-WL-04** | Cell Capacitor Load Budget | $25.0\text{ to }30.0$ (minimum $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | Dynamic charge extraction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitance Budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity and bitline coupling mitigation.
  - Leakage constraint: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Storage capacitance baseline: $25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$ per cell (data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Dielectric stack: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; high-k capacitor stack EOT $3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$.
  - Wordline and bitline pitch: $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Readout development: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV}\text{--}150\text{ mV}$ with $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** VPP High-Voltage Multi-Stage Tapered Inverter Buffer Sizing & Layout Implementation  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & Layout Engineering  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > High-Voltage VPP Wordline Driver Transistor Sizing & Taper Optimization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture & Sizing Budget

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   1. Taper Factor    │
│        Sizing        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼

│                      │
│  2. Wordline Driver  │
│        Sizing        │

└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   3. Layout Pitch    │
│       Matching       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  4. Guard Ring DRC   │
│         LVS          │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

```text
                180nm Physical Geometry Budgets (nm)    
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │████████████████████████                  │
    Access W┤████████████████████████                  │
            │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                       │
    Access L┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                       │
Tox Physical┤▒                                         │
            │▒                                         │
WL Pitch Max┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
WL Pitch Min┤██████████████████████████████████████    │
            │██████████████████████████████████████    │
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0        100        200       300      400 
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Calculate Wordline Equivalent Load & Multi-Stage Taper Ratio**:
   - Determine the total wordline capacitive loading presented by array unit cells (each cell access gate having nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) plus interconnect capacitance across the row.
   - Establish a geometric staging taper factor $f \approx 2.7\text{ -- }3.2$ to drive the large wordline capacitive load from the internal predecoder logic levels up to the boosted $V_{PP}$ domain while minimizing total propagation delay $\sum t_{pd}$.

2. **Size High-Voltage Pull-Up and Pull-Down Transistors**:
   - For all high-voltage $V_{PP}$ inverter stages, specify driver transistor gate channels respecting the core/access baseline channel length ($L \ge 180\text{ nm}$) and channel width ($W \ge 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Verify that gate oxide thickness adheres to the thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ (grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation) or utilizes thick-oxide dual-gate/I-O high-voltage transistor variants to prevent time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB) under elevated $V_{PP}$ bias.
   - Scale final-stage PMOS pull-up and NMOS pull-down finger widths to guarantee sharp rise/fall transition edges into the multi-cell row array.

3. **Pitch-Matched Multi-Finger Layout Implementation**:
   - Route and arrange the final driver stage layout into folded, interdigitated multi-finger geometries to fit within the memory array boundary.
   - Constrain driver output routing and cell pitch to match the standard array wordline pitch specification of **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$**.
   - Share adjacent drain contacts where appropriate to lower extrinsic diffusion junction capacitance and minimize silicon area consumption.

4. **High-Voltage Well Isolation, Guard Rings & Sign-off**:
   - Enclose PMOS drivers within an isolated deep N-well biased strictly at $V_{PP}$, bounded by continuous $N^+$ and $P^+$ guard rings to suppress minority-carrier injection and eliminate latch-up risks during rapid $V_{PP}$ switching.
   - Perform full-chip physical verification (DRC and LVS) on the driver block, extract parasitic RC interconnects, and verify that wordline driver assertion meets array activation timing specs without exceeding junction leakage constraints ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Acceptance Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Pitch Layout Envelope** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC pitch spacing check / GDSII measurement |
| **Transistor Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $\sim 3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / TEM / Process Tech File Rule |
| **Driver Transistor Minimum Channel Length ($L$)** | $\ge 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Calibre / Pegasus DRC minimum channel length check |
| **Unit Cell Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Layout vs. Schematic (LVS) parameter extraction |
| **Cell Retention Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Post-layout corner SPICE simulation & wafer test |

---

#### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **[1] 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry defines access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared contact topology, and junction leakage limits $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for retention integrity.
- **[2] Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Defines wordline and bitline pitch at $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric thermal oxidation conditions at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$, and physical $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **[3] Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Defines array parasitic balancing, precharge levels ($V_{DD}/2$), and differential activation sensitivities under cell capacitance loading ($C_s = 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Layout Wordline Rise-Time Transient Simulation & Slew/Overshoot Verification
**Module Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > High-Voltage VPP Wordline Driver Transistor Sizing & Taper Optimization > Post-Layout Wordline Rise-Time Transient Simulation & Slew/Overshoot Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Extract Parasitics   │
│          RLC          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Configure SPICE    │
│    Transient Setup    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Simulate Wordline   │
│   Rise-Time & Slew    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Measure VPP      │
│  Overshoot & Ringing  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│                       │
│   Acceptance Check    │
│                       │
└───────────◇───────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX / RLC Extraction):**
   - Extract distributed 3D parasitic RC netlists from the finalized wordline decoder layout, driver taper chain, and array wordline stitch strap geometry (pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Model the distributed line loading consisting of access transistor gates ($W = 220\text{ nm}, L = 180\text{ nm}$) and stacked capacitor nodes ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).

2. **Transient Testbench & Corner Initialization:**
   - Instantiate post-layout netlists into SPICE/Spectre netlist under Fast-Fast (FF), Typical-Typical (TT), and Slow-Slow (SS) process corners at operating junction temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Connect the high-voltage $V_{PP}$ boosted supply rail driving the tapered CMOS stage.

3. **Transient Execution & Waveform Measurement:**
   - Apply address predecode switching pulses and trigger the high-voltage wordline driver.
   - Measure transient rise-time ($t_r$, 10% to 90% of $V_{PP}$) at both near-end (adjacent to the driver output) and far-end (furthest cell gate in the memory mat) nodes.
   - Capture dynamic transition slew rate ($dV/dt$) across the $V_{DD}/2$ bitline equalization baseline to prevent sense amplifier disturbed latching.

4. **Overshoot, Ringing & Oxide Reliability Check:**
   - Measure peak positive voltage spike ($V_{\text{peak}} - V_{PP}$) and ringing settling time on the access transistor gate.
   - Verify electrical stress against the thermal dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide layer ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) to prevent dielectric wearout or subthreshold leakage degradation ($I_{\text{leak}} \le 1\text{ fA/cell}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Metric Target / Tolerance | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Far-End Rise Time ($10\% \to 90\%$)** | $\le 3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{ns}$ | SPICE transient simulation (`.measure tran`) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (SS Corner) |
| **Wordline Driver Peak Voltage Overshoot** | $\le 5\%$ above nominal $V_{PP}$ (Peak margin $< 150$) | $\text{mV}$ | Automated peak detector (`.measure tran MAX v(wl_far)`) |
| **Access Transistor Slew Rate ($dV/dt$)** | $\ge 0.80$ | $\text{V/ns}$ | Transient derivative measurement at $V_{PP}/2$ trip point |
| **Gate Oxide Dielectric Field Stress ($E_{ox}$)** | $\le 7.5$ (on $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$) | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Peak electrical field calculation across $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ |

---

### Citations & Literature Context
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry parameters (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor structure, minimum capacitance target ($28\text{ fF/cell}$), and leakage constraint ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Bitline equalization ($V_{DD}/2$), cell signal development $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and timing coordination with wordline assertion.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C array layout ($8F^2 / 6F^2$), wordline/bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), data retention target ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), and gate dielectric parameters ($\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$, physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Distributed RC Poly/Metal Wordline Transmission Line Modeling & Extraction

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      GDSII Layout      │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Segment RC       │
│     Discretization     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Coupling & Gate Load  │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Distributed Ladder   │
│     Netlist Export     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Transient Slew &    │
│    Delay Simulation    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Geometry & Stack Layer Definition**:
   - Extract the physical wordline trace profile from the DRAM cell matrix layout with wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Map poly-gate segments interfacing access transistors with physical channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Define gate dielectric stack parameter with thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ having a physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.

2. **Per-Segment Distributed Resistance Extraction**:
   - Discretize the wordline into discrete $\Pi$- or T-segments corresponding to each individual 1T1C memory cell pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Calculate sheet resistance across the composite polycide / metal shunt strapping layer to determine line resistance per unit length ($R_{\text{seg}}$).

3. **Capacitive Loading & Dielectric Coupling Formulation**:
   - Compute the active gate oxide capacitance component per cell ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \cdot W \cdot L}{t_{\text{ox}}}$) utilizing the access transistor footprint ($W = 220\text{ nm}, L = 180\text{ nm}, t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Extract lateral inter-wordline parasitic coupling capacitance and wordline-to-bitline crossing capacitance over the folded bitline layout array.

4. **Multi-Stage Transmission Line Netlist Assembly**:
   - Cascade the extracted per-segment $R_{\text{seg}}$ series resistors and parallel shunt capacitors ($C_{\text{gate}} + C_{\text{parasitic}}$) into a multi-stage distributed ladder network.
   - Stitch metal wordline strapping shunt vias to model the parallel low-resistance strap reduction across cell sub-blocks.

5. **Transient Slew & Activation Propagation Verification**:
   - Drive the distributed transmission line with the wordline driver stage ($V_{\text{PP}}$ supply level) in SPICE/transient simulation.
   - Probe rise-time slew rate and signal propagation delay between the nearest cell (near-end) and the furthest cell (far-end) across the memory mat to verify activation integrity.

---

```text
Access L (nm)┤█████████████████████                    │
```

| **Thermally Grown Gate $\text{SiO}_2$ Dielectric Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ |

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry parameters confirming access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms wordline and bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$, with thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide at $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (processed at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: High-Bandwidth Active Picoprobe & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Transient Measurement Setup
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-042`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{\text{PP}}$ Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Distributed RC Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay Transient Metrology > High-Bandwidth Active Picoprobe & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Transient Measurement Setup  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m scale)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Development Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Environmental Prep & Anti-Vibration Bench Setup (22°C ± 1°C)"] --> B["2. Picoprobe Mechanical Alignment to Wordline Node (Pitch: 360-400 nm)"]
    B --> C["3. High-Z Active Probe Tip Calibration & De-skew (< 0.1 pF parasitic load)"]
    C --> D["4. Row Address Decoder & VPP Pump Step Stimulation"]
    D --> E["5. Distributed RC Slew Rate & Signal Development Capture (Delta V: 100-150 mV)"]
    E --> F["6. In-Situ Automated Validation & Metric Acceptance Check"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Test Environmental Stabilization & Isolation**
   - Ensure the analytical probe station chuck thermal controller is stabilized at nominal room test conditions ($22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for accelerated retention/leakage validation).
   - Activate the active vibration isolation platform and verify optical microscope illumination to prevent localized photon-induced silicon carrier generation.

2. **Picoprobe Mechanical Landing & Sub-Micron Positioning**
   - Mount the high-bandwidth active picoprobe (high input impedance FET probe with ultra-low capacitive loading $< 0.1\text{ pF}$) onto the sub-micron 3-axis motorized micro-manipulator.
   - Using high-magnification optics, align the tungsten/beryllium-copper picoprobe tip onto the designated internal metal test pad or de-passivated wordline driver tap along the array edge, strictly respecting the **wordline pitch constraint of 360 nm to 400 nm**.
   - Lower the micro-manipulator with fine Z-axis translation until an electrical contact scrub of $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ is visually confirmed, avoiding damage to underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide and access transistor channels ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

3. **Instrument Calibration & Ground Reference Loop Optimization**
   - Connect the active picoprobe to a $\ge 4\text{ GHz}$ digital storage oscilloscope terminated into $50\ \Omega$.
   - Mount the ultra-short coaxial ground blade directly to the adjacent localized on-chip $V_{\text{SS}}$ shield/ground pad to minimize parasitic ground lead loop inductance ($L_{\text{gnd}} < 1\text{ nH}$).
   - Perform fixture de-skew and dynamic baseline zeroing prior to pulsing.

4. **Address Decoder & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Wordline Activation**
   - Initialize automated vector test generation to trigger the hierarchical row address predecoders and wordline driver stage.
   - Assert the boosted $V_{\text{PP}}$ wordline pulse to activate the access transistors across the distributed RC wordline matrix.
   - Observe the transient rise time ($10\% - 90\%$), propagation delay across near-end vs. far-end wordline sectors, and $V_{\text{PP}}$ supply droop during peak gate-capacitance charging.

5. **Differential Signal & Cell Readout Correlation**
   - Correlate wordline activation slew rate with differential signal development on the complementary bitline pair ($\Delta V$), verifying that bitline equalization at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ breaks cleanly into the expected cell readout signal ($100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) prior to sense amplifier latching.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               180nm DRAM Physical & Metrology Targets  
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
WL Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
 Delta V (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
    C_BL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
  C_cell (fF)┤████                                     │
             │████                                     │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0        95        190       285      380 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Operating Range | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Contact Pitch** | **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$** | $\pm 10\text{ nm}$ | In-situ optical/SEM coordinate overlay |
| **Signal Development Window ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | Minimum $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ at sense activation | High-speed active picoprobe DSO capture |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{s}}$)** | **$25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$** (min $28\text{ fF}$ design target) | $\pm 2.0\text{ fF}$ (effective $\kappa > 15$) | Quasistatic CV / transient charge integration |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature (Retention/Leakage Test)** | **$85^\circ\text{C}$** (leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ steady-state | Chuck PID thermocouple logger |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Signal development charge distribution: $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, typical cell capacitance $C_{\text{s}} = 25\text{ fF}$.
   - Differential signal development target: $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
   - Precharge operation at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Transistor geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Cell capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell with dielectric stack effective constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Physical dimensions: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ maintaining data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Far-End Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$) Oscilloscope Characterization
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-WL-TRCD-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Distributed RC Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay Transient Metrology > Far-End Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay $t_{RCD}$ Oscilloscope Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### Characterization Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  ACT Command & Master  │
│     Clock Trigger      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Active Picoprobe    │
│    Probe Station at    │
│     Far-End WL Pad     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Real-Time DSO Slew   │
│    Rate 10% to 90%     │
│      Acquisition       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Sense Amp Strobe    │
│   SAN/SAP Cross-Over   │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Extract Far-End     │
│  Propagation Delay &   │
│     Effective tRCD     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This procedure defines the experimental oscilloscope metrology to quantify the distributed RC propagation delay and edge degradation (slew rate) along the polycide wordline (WL) at the physical boundary (far-end edge of the 180nm cell mat, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$ access transistor matrix). It directly qualifies the row activation timing margin ($t_{RCD}$: Row-to-Column Command Delay) needed for robust folded-bitline signal charge transfer ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) into the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch before strobe activation.

---

### 2. Equipment & Metrology Setup
1. **Real-Time Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO):** $\ge 4\text{ GHz}$ analog bandwidth, $\ge 20\text{ GSa/s}$ real-time sampling rate, 50 $\Omega$ input impedance.
2. **Active High-Impedance Microprobe:** Active FET Picoprobe with input tip capacitance $C_{tip} \le 0.1\text{ pF}$ and input resistance $R_{in} \ge 1\text{ M}\Omega$ to eliminate loading on high-impedance far-end distributed RC poly/silicide lines.
3. **Automated Sub-Micron Analytical Wafer Prober:** Thermal chuck calibrated at $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate high-temperature corner retention and sub-threshold leakage conditions.
4. **Pattern Generator / Automated Test Equipment (ATE):** Delivering synchronous `PRECHARGE`, `ACTIVATE` (Row Address Strobe), and `READ` burst sequences.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

#### Step 3.1: Wafer Loading & Thermal Stabilization
1. Mount the 180nm DRAM test wafer on the micro-probing chuck.
2. Set and stabilize chuck temperature at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** to replicate worst-case retention and channel leakage constraints.
3. Align micropositioner tips to dedicated top-metal unpassivated test pads located at:
   - **Near-End Node:** Wordline driver output node ($WL_{near}$).
   - **Far-End Node:** Termination point of the selected row across the memory mat ($WL_{far}$).
   - **Internal Sensing Node:** Sense amplifier latch strobe test point ($SAN$ pull-down / $SAP$ pull-up).

#### Step 3.2: Pattern Generation & Oscilloscope Synchronization
1. Program the ATE pattern generator to issue a periodic `PRECHARGE-ALL` followed by row `ACTIVATE` command pulses.
2. Ensure precharge equalization verifies complementary bitlines settling to $V_{DD} / 2$ prior to assertion.
3. Trigger DSO Channel 1 on the rising edge of the system clock/master command bus corresponding to `ACTIVATE` (50% amplitude crossing).

#### Step 3.3: Far-End Wordline Slew Rate Acquisition
1. Acquire DSO waveform on Channel 2 ($WL_{far}$) over 512 ensemble-averaged acquisitions to suppress thermal and Johnson-Nyquist noise.
2. Measure the $10\%$ to $90\%$ voltage transition time ($t_{rise}$) from ground ($0\text{ V}$) to the boosted wordline potential ($V_{PP}$).
3. Calculate the far-end wordline slew rate:
   $$\text{Slew Rate} = \frac{V_{PP}(90\%) - V_{PP}(10\%)}{t_{rise(10\%-90\%)}}$$

#### Step 3.4: Signal Development & Effective $t_{RCD}$ Timing Extraction
1. Monitor Channel 3 connected to the sense amplifier pull-down node ($SAN$).
2. Measure the total propagation and activation delay from the external `ACTIVATE` command timestamp ($t_0$) to the $50\%$ crossing of $WL_{far}$ reaching full activation threshold ($V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive}$).
3. Measure the time delta between full far-end cell charge dumping ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{--}150\text{ mV}$ signal development) and the strobe activation of $SAN$ pulling to ground.
4. Record the effective $t_{RCD}$ margin:
   $$t_{RCD(\text{meas})} = t(SAN_{\text{active}}) - t(ACT_{\text{cmd}})$$

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Chuck Metrology Temperature** | $85.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ | Calibrated Chuck RTD Sensor |
| **Bitline Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ min threshold | High-Z Oscilloscope Microprobe |
| **Storage Cell Unit Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ | $\text{fF}$ | $\ge 25\text{ fF}$ ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$ for high-k/noise target) | CV Metrology / Charge Integral Extraction |
| **Access Transistor Physical Gate Length** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Target nominal design rule | In-line CD-SEM / Layout GDS Verification |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Defines folded-bitline topology, bitline equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$, cell charge dumping equation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$, differential signal development target $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and sense amplifier latching operation ($SAN$ pulling low).
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Defines the 180nm unit cell geometry (access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ per cell for alpha-particle soft error immunity, and sub-threshold/junction leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Defines 1T1C architecture, cell layout ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$), minimum cell storage capacitance range of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ to guarantee data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate dielectric dry oxidation thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$), and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
citations: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Parasitic RC Extraction & Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation
**Chip Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Hierarchy:** `[Architecture & Integration]` > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump `[DRAM Circuit Design]` > Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology `[Metrology]` > Parasitic RC Extraction & Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation `[Circuit Design]`  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Layout & Layer  │
│          Map           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Rule-based 3D PEX    │
│         Engine         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       RC Network       │
│  Distributed Slicing   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline Driver &    │
│     Pass-Gate Mesh     │
│        Netlist         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   SPICE Simulation &   │
│  Slew Rate Metrology   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Layout Design Rule and Geometry Ingestion**:
   - Ingest the physical GDSII layout for the 180nm folded bitline unit cell matrix ($8F^2$ footprint with unit cell area $A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Bind the 1T1C NMOS access transistor dimensions with channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, ensuring shared bitline contact definitions across adjacent pairs.

2. **Extraction Stack & Dielectric Profiling**:
   - Configure the extraction rules for the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure erected over drain contacts via tungsten plugs (W-plugs).
   - Set up the dielectric stack rules for high-$\kappa$ dielectrics (effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, using ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
   - Define interconnect metal layers, polysilicon wordline sheet resistance, and contact via resistances.

3. **Distributed RC Segment Slicing & Mesh Extraction**:
   - Run 3D field-solver/rule-based parasitic extraction (PEX) on the continuous wordline line extending across an array sector of $256$ to $512$ unit cells.
   - Symmetrically segment the wordline interconnect into per-cell distributed $\Pi$ or $\text{T}$-filter ladder stages, accounting for wordline series wire resistance ($R_{\text{WL}}$) and gate-to-channel / overlap capacitances ($C_{\text{ox}}, C_{\text{g-ov}}$).
   - Incorporate bitline coupling parasitics and maintain array line loading representing bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$.

4. **VPP Voltage Driver & Storage Node Coupling Stitching**:
   - Instantiate the wordline driver model coupled to the boosted high-voltage rail $V_{\text{PP}}$ ($V_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}$ to $2.8\ \text{V}$, driven by the on-chip 4-stage Dickson oscillator with flying capacitors $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\ \text{pF}$ to $50\ \text{pF}$ and clock frequencies of $20\ \text{MHz}$ to $50\ \text{MHz}$).
   - Wire each distributed access NMOS gate tap to its respective storage node capacitor ($C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$, nominal target $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - Set access device threshold voltage parameters $V_{\text{th}} = 0.5\ \text{V}$ to $0.7\ \text{V}$ (nominally $0.6\ \text{V}$).

5. **Netlist Generation & DRC/LVS Cross-Check**:
   - Export the hierarchical SPICE subcircuit netlist (`wordline_rc_mesh.sp`) including full distributed parasitics, sub-threshold leakage parameters ($I_{\text{leak}} < 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), and port definitions for near-end and far-end wordline transient metrology.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-extraction nodal capacitance metrology |
| **Bitline-to-Storage Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $\le 9.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (hard limit $< 10.0 : 1$) | Ratio | Analytical RC ratio check on 256/512 cell array |
| **Wordline Overdrive Rail Voltage ($V_{\text{PP}}$)** | $2.8$ | $2.5 \text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | SPICE DC/Transient operating point check |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-layout static leakage simulation |

---

### Literature Citations & Context Alignment

1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Validates cell footprint ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$), storage node capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$, nominally $28\ \text{fF}$), bitline parasitic budget ($C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$ for 256/512 cells), and the critical ratio constraint ($C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$, degradation above $10:1$).
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Validates access NMOS geometry ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), stacked COB capacitor with tungsten plug contacts, high-$\kappa$ dielectric parameters ($\kappa > 15$ with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$), and leakage ceiling of $1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - Validates NMOS threshold voltage loss ($V_{\text{th}} \sim 0.5\ \text{V}$ to $0.7\ \text{V}$), the requirement for boosted wordline overdrive voltage $V_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}$ to $2.8\ \text{V}$, and Dickson pump design specs (4 stages, $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\ \text{pF}$ to $50\ \text{pF}$, clock rate $20\ \text{MHz}$ to $50\ \text{MHz}$).

---

```text
│                        │

```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream In & Layer Map Binding (`.layermap`):**
   - Bind numeric GDSII layers and datatype indices to target logical CAD layers:
     - `NWEL` / `PWEL` (Active Wells)
     - `DIFF` (Access Transistor Channel: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)
     - `POLY1` / `WL` (Wordline gate conductor)
     - `CONT` & `W-PLUG` (Tungsten plug contact to drain/source)
     - `MET1` / `BL` (Bitline layer)
     - `SN_NODE` / `CROWN_CAP` (Stacked capacitor node over bitline)
     - `VIA1`, `MET2` (Interconnect routing & VPP distribution)
2. **Interconnect Stack & Dielectric Specification (`.itf` / `.ict` / `.tech`):**
   - Configure gate oxide layer: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (dry oxidation target $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Define Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) dielectric stack: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{--}4.0\text{ nm}$.
   - Specify Tungsten plug contacts (`W-plug`) connecting cell drain diffusion to the crown bottom electrode.
3. **Geometric Pitch & Design Rule Checking (DRC) Deck Configuration:**
   - Enforce memory array bitline pitch to $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Enforce wordline pitch to $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$ across the array.
   - Configure sense amplifier pitch matching at $360\text{ nm}$ requiring interleaved layout pitch definitions.
4. **LVS Pin Binding & Tech File Sign-Off:**
   - Map text/pin labels to corresponding conductor layers (`WL`, `BL`, `BL_B`, `VPP`, `VDD`, `GND`, `SAP`, `SAN`).
   - Run stream validation check to verify zero layer mapping collisions, consistent polygon connectivity, and successful generation of extraction-ready parasitic models.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
  Gate Ox Thick (nm)┤░                                 │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│

Cell Cap Budget (fF)┤████                              │
                    │████                              │
```
